text.body:
||śrīḥ|| śrīmate rāmānujāya namaḥ | śrīsudarśanabhaṭṭārakaviracitā śrībhāṣyavyākhyā śrutapradīpikā | prathamādhyāye prathamaḥ pādaḥ || akhilabhuvanajanmasthemabhaṅgādilīle vinatavividhabhūtavrātarakṣaikadīkṣe | śrutiśirasi vidīpte brahmaṇi śrīnivāse bhavatu mama parasmin śemuṣī bhaktirūpā || varadaṃ dviradādriśekharaṃ kamalāyā dayitaṃ dayānidhim | sakalārthijanārthitapradaṃ praṇamāmi praṇatārtihāriṇam || vedāntasūtrabhāṣyārthamācāryopāsanācchatam | tadgirā dīpikevāhaṃ darśayiṣye yathāmati || prāripsitaprabandhasyāvighnaparisamāptipracayagamanārthamiṣṭadevatopāsanalakṣaṇamaṅgalaṃ śrutyākurvannarthaṃ pratipādyaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ śrotṛbuddhisamavadhānāya darśayati - akhileti | prathamena pādena prathamadvikārthasaṃkṣepaḥ, dvitīyena tūttarasya | bhavatīti bhuvanaṃ kāryajātam | katipayakāraṇacaturmukhādivyāvṛttyartham akhila śabdaḥ | prāyikatvanivṛttyarthaṃ sakaletya nuktiḥ | ajñātaṃ nāsti itivadakhileti vyatirekoktiḥ | akāropakramatvasiddhaye nikhiletyanuktiḥ | tasya bhagavadvācakatvaśaktiyogāttadavivakṣāyāmapi māṅgalikatvamakārasya | naño maṅgaletaratvaṃ niṣedhyaviśeṣāpekṣayā, na svataḥ | atra tu vaikalyaniṣedhena pauṣkalyaparatvāt māṅgalikatvameva | janma trividham | sthemā - antaryāmiviṣṇvavatārādimukhenaiva karaṇīyā vividhā sthitiḥ | bhaṅgaḥ - nityanaimittikaprākṛtarūpaḥ | mokṣasya layāntarbhāve'pi śāstrasya pradhānaprayojanatayā viṣayavat pṛthageva vaktavyatvādanekārthasādhāraṇena śabdena tamantarbhāvayitumayuktam | ato hi pūrvācāryāḥ pṛthagūcuḥ - jagajjanmasthitidhvaṃsamahānandaikahetave jagadudbhavasthitipraṇāśasaṃsāravimocanādayaḥ iti | ādi śabdenānupraveśaniyamanadhāraṇādi gṛhyate; pradeśāntare jagadutpattisthitisaṃhārāntaḥ praveśaniyamanādilīlam iti svenaiva kaṇṭharaveṇoktārthasvīkārasyaivocitatvāt | aprameyo'niyojyaśca ityādyuktaprakāreṇa sāpekṣatvādivyudāsāya līlā śabdaḥ | janayitṛtvādyanuktvā janmādyuktirupādānābhiprāyā; bahu syāṃ prajāyeyeti iti hi śrutiḥ | līlā śabdena nimittatvaṃ dyotitam | avāptasamastakāmasya vyāpārānupapatiṃta pariharatānena līlāśabdena dvitīyalakṣaṇārthaśca sūcitaḥ | atha dvitīyadvikārthaṃ saṃkṣipati - vinateti | vinatarakṣāpa dābhyāṃ tṛtīyacaturthalakṣaṇārthau sūcitau | viśeṣeṇa natāḥ prahvībhūtāḥ upāsakāḥ; tadvaividhyaṃ taduparyapi bādarāyaṇaḥ saṃbhavāt ityādivakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa | bhūtāḥ; bhagavajjñānena labdhasattākāḥ iti bhāvaḥ; asti brahmeti cedveda, santamenaṃ tato viduriti iti śruteḥ | vinatabhūtasaṃbandhī vrāto vinatabhūtavrātaḥ | vrāta śabdena āsphoṭayanti pitaraḥ paśurmanuṣyaḥ pakṣī vā ityādyartho'bhipretaḥ | rakṣā iṣṭaprāpaṇāniṣṭanivāraṇalakṣaṇā | eka śabdaḥ prādhānyaparaḥ apyahaṃ jīvitaṃ jahyām kāmamātmānaṃ bhāryāṃputraṃ voparundhyānna tveva dāsakarmakaram iti hyuktam | sā pradhānā dīkṣā yasya tattathoktam | dīkṣāśabdenāvarjanīyatvaṃ garbhitam; etadvrataṃ mama iti hi taduktiḥ | atha śāstropoddhātacatuḥsūtryarthamāha - śrutīti | brahmaṇo mānaśūnyatvānyamānakatvavyudāsena śāstrārambhaṇīyatā hi tadarthaḥ | śruti śabdaḥ pramāṇavailakṣaṇyaṃ dyotayati; śrūyate nityamiti hi śrutiḥ | śiraḥ śabdenānanyaparabhāgoktiḥ | vidīptiḥ viśeṣeṇa dīptiḥ; agnyādirūpeṇakarmārādhyatāyā api vedāntāvagatatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ svato'nantapuruṣārthatvaṃ cābhipretya viśeṣeṇa dīptatvamuktam | brahmaṇīti sāmānyaśabdaḥ | śrīnivāsa iti viśeṣaśabdaḥ | atra chāgo vā mantravarṇāt iti nyāyo'bhipretaḥ | śrīnivāsa śabdena rūḍhito'vayavataśca trimūrtyaikyasāmyottīrṇatvādivyudāso nityavibhūtiyogaśca phalitaḥ | parasminniti paramataḥ setūnmāna ityatra nirṇītaṃ prāpyatvaṃ vivakṣitam | athopāyopeyātmake pratipādye vinatapadasūcitamupāyāṃśaṃ viśinaṣṭi - śemuṣī bhaktirūpeti | atrāpi chāgapaśunyāyo'bhipretaḥ | padadvayena dhīkarmasamuccayavākyārthajñānamātropāyatvavyudāsaḥ | svanikarṣābhiprāyeṇāha - mameti | bhavatu - phalāntarādetadviṣayopāyaḥ svādutama iti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ paramaviṣayo darśitaḥ | prayojanaṃ cātrātisaṃkṣiptam | atha svagranthasyāvāntaraviṣayaṃ svavyākhyeyasya vyākhyeyāntarādvaiṣamyaṃ ca vadan saṃkṣiptaṃ śāstraprayojanaṃ ca viśadīkurvan vyākhyānāntarebhyaḥ svagranthasya vailakṣaṇyaṃ ca darśayannarthāt gurūpāsanarūpaṃ maṅgalamācarati - pārāśaryeti | pārāśaryavacassudhāmupaniṣaddugdhābdhimadhyoddhṛtāṃ saṃsārāgnividīpanavyapagataprāṇātmasañjīvanīm | pūrvācāryasurakṣitāṃ bahumativyāghātadūrasthitām ānītāṃ tu nijākṣaraiḥ sumanaso bhaumāḥ pibantvanvaham || vyāsasyaiva bādarāyaṇatvaṃ śrutisiddham | janmataḥ prakarṣaṃ ca sūcayati pārāśaryaśabdena | vacaḥ - śabdo'rthaparyantaḥ, vedavit ityatra vedaśabdavat | vacasaḥ sudhāmiti nirvāhe rūpakaprakaraṇānaucityaṃ sudhāśabdāmukhyatvaṃ ca | amṛtatvahetutvāt sudhātvarūpaṇam | pūrvabhāgādapyavyavadhānena brahmapratipādanarūpā setyabhiprāya upaniṣa cchabdaḥ | upaniṣadāṃ vedasāratvābhiprāyo dugdhaśabdaḥ; yathā āraṇkaṃ ca vedebhya oṣadhībhyo yathāmṛtam iti | abdhi śabda ānantyaparaḥ | madhya śabdena sarvaśrutimukhyatvamabhipretam, madhyasya sarvapradeśānuguṇyāt | anena svavyākhyeyasya pramāṇamūlatā avāntaraviṣayaśca darśitau | uddhṛtaśabdenātinimnadeśanimagnodgrahaṇamabhidadhatā niḥśeṣārthagrahaṇaṃ sūcitam | parama prayojanamāha - saṃsāreti | saṃsārasyāgnitvaṃ tāpatrayātmakatayā | tatrāpyavāntarabhedaṃ vidyālabdheḥ pūrvaṃ kadācidapyanirvāpyatvaṃ vaividhyamanuparatatvaṃ ca dyotayati vidīpana śabdaḥ | anādikālaṃ bahumukhaśravaṇādiṣvanyatamaprakāreṇālabdhaparamātmāno vyapagataprāṇāḥ | prāṇāḥ paramātmā, prāṇamevābhisaṃviśanti iti śrautaprayogāt | saṃjīvinīm iti paramamokṣahetutvaṃ vivakṣitam | svagranthasya satsaṃpradāyamūlakatāmāha - pūrveti | ārthaṃ gurūpāsanaṃ caitatkīrtanamukhenātra kṛtam | śaṃkarādivyudāsāya pūrvaśabdaḥ | surakṣitām na paramupadeśena, granthanirmāṇenāpīti bhāvaḥ | tarhi sā kimiti na prathitetyatrāha - bahumatīti | bahūnāṃ yā matayaḥ tāsāṃ vyāghāto mitho virodhaḥ, tena dūrasthitām | na yathāvadapratipattimātram, anyathā ca pratipattirabhūditi bhāvaḥ | tuśabdaḥ svagranthavaiṣamyaparaḥ | sudhāsamākhyānuguṇyāya mamākṣarairityanuktiḥ; gāyatryavayavāmṛtākṣarairityarthaḥ | sumanasaḥ; sārāsāravivekādivicakṣaṇāḥ | bhaumāḥ; adhītasāṅgasaśiraskavedāḥ śrutakarmamīmāṃsā bhūlokavāsinaḥ | deśakālāntarādiṣu vṛttyādisāphalyamiti bhāvaḥ | pibantu; sudhāpānavadasya śravaṇādyapi sukharūpam ityarthaḥ | anvaham; bhogyatātiśayāt gabhīratvācca | bhagavaddhodhāyanakṛtāṃ vistīrṇāṃ brahmasūtravṛtiṃta pūrvācāryāḥ sañcikṣipuḥ | tanmatānusāreṇa sūtrākṣarāṇi vyākhyāsyante||1|| pūrvācāryagranthāḥ pravartyantām; kiṃ granthāntaranirmāṇaprayatnagauraveṇetyatrāha - bhagavaditi | pūrvācāryaśabdo'tra vivṛtaḥ | śaṅkarādibhyo'pi jñānādhikyaparo bhagava cchabdaḥ | dramiḍācāryādigrantho'tisaṃkṣiptaḥ | tanmatānusāreṇa; na tu svotprekṣayā | sūtrākṣarāṇi; prakṛti pratyayānuguṇyena; na tu yathākathaṃcidyojayitavyānīti bhāvaḥ | vyāṅbhyāmupasargābhyāmapekṣitavistarānapekṣitasaṃkocau vivakṣitau | vyākhyeyaṃ padam upādatte - atheti | <1 jijñāsādhikaraṇam> athāto brahmajijñāsā || 1-1-1|| atrāyamathaśabda ānantarye bhavati | ataḥśabdo vṛttasya hetubhāve | adhītasāṅgasaśiraskavedasya ... brahmajijñāsā hyanantarabhāvinī ||1|| pūrvavṛttāpratipattirūpāpavādena prasiddhiprakarṣasyākiṃñcitkaratayā saṃśayaviparyayau sta iti tadvyudāsāyāthaśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe - atreti | athaśabda ānantarya iti pratijñā | bhavatīti svārasyaṃ sūcitam | atrāyamiti tadapavādaparihāraḥ | atra; vedottarabhāgārthavicārārambhe | anena pūrvabhāgārthavicārasya vṛttatvamākṣiptam | evaṃ brahmajijñāsāpadasāmarthyasūcitam atha śabdānuśāsanam ityādyathaśabdādasya vyāvṛtiṃta sūcayatā ayaṃ śabdena ataḥśabdaśiraskatvaṃ darśitam | anena vṛttasāmānyasyātaḥ padenābhidhānaṃ jñāpitam, etacchabdasya prakṛtavācitvasvārasyāt | evaṃ vṛttaviśeṣākṣepakatatsāmānyābhidhāyakapadadvayasamabhivyāhāralabdhamathaśabdasyānantaryaparatvamityarthāduktaṃ bhavati | ato'tha maunam ityādiṣu prakṛtipratyayayoranekārthasādhāraṇyadarśanādataḥśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe - ata iti | atrāyaṃ bhavati ityanuṣaṅgaḥ | atra bhavati śabdau pūrvavat | ayam; athaśabdapūrvakaḥ; prakṛtipratyayasvārasyāt athaśabdasvārasyāt brahmajijñāsāpadasāmarthyāccetyarthaḥ | na ca athātaḥ śabdārthanirṇayasyānyonyasāpekṣatvādanyonyāśrayaḥ śaṅkyaḥ. tayorānantaryavṛttaparatvasvārasyasya vyutpattyavagatatayānyonyānapekṣatvāt | atretyādisūcitaṃ vṛttaṃ vartiṣyamāṇaṃ tayorhetuhetumadbhāvaṃ ca vivṛṇvan vartiṣyamāṇasyānantaryaṃ ca ghaṭayati - adhīteti | sāṅgaśabdenādhyayanasyāpātapratītihetutvaṃ dyotitam; saśiraska śabdena vyākhyānapaurvāparyanimittavyākhyeyapaurvāparyaṃ bhāgadvayasyaikaprabandhatvaṃ kṛtsnadhyayanaṃ ca; karmajñānabrahmajijñāsā padābhyāṃ vṛttavartiṣyamāṇe; kevala śabdena brahmajñānavaidhuryam; alpāsthirānantasthira śabdābhyāṃ hetuhetumadbhāvaḥ; anantarabhāvinīti padena athātaḥ śabdadvayaphalitaṃ hetupauṣkalyaṃ ca | tasmin sati hi phalānantaryam | anantasthiraphala śabdo brahmaviśeṣaṇam; brahmajijñāsāyā vā; tasyāstathātvaṃ sadvārakam | brahmaṇo jijñāsā brahmajijñāsā | brahmaṇa iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī; ......... kṛdyogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyate iti pratiprasavasadbhāvāt ||1|| athaikapadyahetubhūtasamāsārthaṃ nirūpayan vibhaktyantaravyāvṛttyarthaṃ vyasya nirdiśati - brahmaṇa iti | pañcamīmarthāntaraśaṅkāṃ ca vyapanudannāha - brahmaṇa itīti | kuta ityatra āha - kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛtīti | karmatve sati viṣayatvaṃ prayojanatvaṃ ca sidhyediti bhāvaḥ | sāmānyavidhyapekṣayā pratipadavidherbalīyastve'pi pratipade samāsaniṣedhāt paraṃparāsaṃbandhasyāpi saṃbandhasāmānyāntarbhāvena brahmānubandhināmupāyādīnāmapi jijñāsyatvasiddheḥ sāmarthyāt brahmaṇaḥ karmatvākṣepācca sāmānyaparatvamāśaṅkyāha - yadyapīti | parigrahe'pi ityatra pariṇā anubandhināṃ jijñāsyatāsiddhirdyotitā | karmārthatvasiddhiḥ; ṣaṣṭhyā iti śeṣaḥ | ābhidhānikasyaiva grāhyatvāditi; upapadavibhaktirapi kārakavibhaktivat karmaṇi dvitīyā ityādivat kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti ityādiśabdānuśāsanasvārasyādarthavatīti bhāṣyakārābhiprāyaḥ | eva kāreṇa vilambitadhīhetvapekṣayā śīghradhīhetorbalīyastvamabhipretam | pradhānasyāpradhānānāṃ ca karmatvākṣepādapi pradhānasyābhidhānikatvamitareṣāmākṣiptatvaṃ ca yuktamityarthaḥ | samāsaniṣedhamāśaṅkya pariharati - na ceti | pratiprasavo 'pavādāpavādaḥ | aprayuktavibhakteranabhidhāyakatve'pyanuśāsanādhīnalakṣyārthaviśeṣa nirṇayāya ṣaṣṭhī vyākhyātā | prātipadikena vibhaktyarthalakṣaṇāyāṃ tu na kevalaṃ yogyatādi kāraṇam, anuśāsanaṃ cāpekṣitamiti tadanusāreṇa vyākhyātam | brahmaśabdena svabhāvato nirastanikhiladoṣo'navadhikātiśayāsaṃkhyeyakalyāṇaguṇagaṇaḥ puruṣottamo'bhidhīyat | ... ... ... ... tāpatrayāturaimṛtatvātaya sa eva jijñāsāsyaḥ | ataḥ sarveśvara eva jijñāsākarmabhṛtaṃ brahma ||2|| atha samastayoḥ padayoḥ prathamapadamanekārthasādhāraṇyena prasiddheḥ parairanyathā vyākhyātatvācca saṃśayaviparyayau sta iti tadvyudāsāya vyācaṣṭe - brahmeti | parītya lokān iti śrutyanusāreṇa puruṣottama ityuktam | svetaracidacidvilakṣaṇatvaṃ tacchabdārthaḥ | svetarānyatvaṃ tṛṇāderapyastīti tadvyāvṛttyarthamubhayaliṅgatvena vailakṣaṇyamāha - svabhāvataḥ ityādinā | nikhileti baddhādi vyudāsaḥ | svabhāvataḥ iti muktavyāvṛttiḥ | sāvadhikātiśayanityavyudāsāya anavadhikātiśaya śabdaḥ | pratyekaṃ tādṛśā guṇā asaṃkhyeyāḥ | ekasya guṇasya vidhābhedarūpaguṇapuñjābhiprāyo gaṇa śabdaḥ | satyasaṃkalpatvāntarbhūtā hi vaśitvādayaḥ | abhidhīyate; mukhyavṛttyā bodhyate | śabdasāmarthyādarthasāmarthyavaśācca bhagavatparatvaṃ vaktuṃ prathamaṃ śabdasāmarthyamupapipādayiṣuranyatra gauṇatvaṃ hṛdi nidhāya brahmaśabdasya guṇayogataḥ pravṛttatvamāha - sarvatreti | sarvatra prayogeṣu viṣayeṣu | tataḥ kimityatrāha - bṛhattvaṃ ceti | anyasyāpi kiṃ na syādityatrāha - sa ceti | caḥ śaṅkānivṛttau | kathamevakāraḥ? anyatrāpi hi prayujyata ityatrāha - tasmāditi | sarveṣāṃ mukhyatvaṃ kiṃ na syādityatrāha - aneketi | ananyathāsiddhaprayogo hi śaktikalpakaḥ | atra tvanyathāsiddha iti bhāvaḥ | nātrānekaśaktiklṛptiprasaṅgaḥ; na cānyatrāmukhyatvam; ekayaivāvayavaśaktyā sarvatra mukhyatvādityatrāha - bhagavaditi | paṅkajaśabdasyotpalādivyāvṛttatāmarasānuvṛttapadmatvavat prayogaviṣayānugatatadaviṣayavyāvṛttapravṛttinimittābhāvenānekaśaktikalpane prāpte prayogasyānyathāsiddhatvāt puṣkalapravṛttinimitta eva viṣaye mukhyo'nyatrāmukhyaśca yathā bhagavacchabdo nirṇītastathā brahmaśabdo'pītyarthaḥ | athārthasāmarthyamupapādayati - tāpeti | na hi kārāgṛhanigalito nigalamocanāya yācyaḥ; kiṃtu yacchāsanānnigalanaṃ tannivṛttau sa evetyabhiprayantī tamevam ityādiśrutirihānustriyate | nigamayati - ata iti; ataḥ śabdavaśādarthavaśāccetyarthaḥ | jñātumicchā jijñāsā | icchāyā iṣyamāṇapradhānatvāt ... ... ... mīmāṃsāśāstram athāto dharmajijñāsā ityārabhya, anāvṛttiḥ śabdādanāvṛttiḥ śabdāt ityevamantaṃ saṅgativiśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭakramam || prakṛtipratyayavibhāgena dvitīyaṃ padaṃ vyācaṣṭe - jñātumiti | icchāyāḥkāryatve pratīte'pi snātvā bhuñjīta itivadaprāpteṃ'śe vidhirityarthaḥ | sannantanirdeśo vicārasya rāgaprāptatvajñāpanāya | tathāca dharmajijñāsā ityatrāpi jñānaṃ vicārarūpaṃ vidheyam | vicāraḥ kartavyaḥ ityanyatrokteḥ | pramitistu phalatayā arthasiddhā | mīmāṃsā hīyam | iha - upakramasūtre | anenāsya sūtrasya jijñāsyaviśeṣaparatvavyudāsaḥ | ārambhaṇīyatve siddhe hi jijñāsya viśeṣanirṇayaḥ | sa cottaratra īkṣaternāśabdam ityārabhya kriyate | atha vākyārthaṃ yojayati - mīmāṃseti | pūrvavṛttādityādi pratijñā | anyadupapādakam | pūrvabhāgoparitanabhāga śabdābhyāṃ vyākhyānasya kramaniyamānanvitabhāgādhyayanātmakatvaṃ darśitam | taddhetubhūtaṃ vyākhyeyasya tathātvaṃ pūrvaṃ padayojanāyāmuktam | ubhayatrobhayaṃ vācyam | granthalāghavāyaivamuktiḥ | tanmatānusāreṇeti pratijñāṃ vṛttigranthena saṃvādayati - tadāheti | karmacintānantaryākṣepakarmaikaśāstryaṃ ca vṛttau darśayati - vakṣyati ceti | lakṣaṇam adhyāyaḥ | saṃhitam ekavyākhyeyavyākhyānarūpatayā saṃbaddhamiti bhāvaḥ | śārīrakaṃ brahmamīmāṃsā; jagaccharīrakabrahmaviṣayatvāt | ṣoḍaśalakṣaṇena; ṣoḍaśādhyāyena | śāstraikyapratyanīkamarthavirodhaṃ pratipādyabhedaṃ prayojanabhedaṃ kartṛbhedaṃ cāśaṅkyāha - ata iti | ataḥ; ekavyākhyeyavyākhyānarūpatayā prabandhaikyasiddheḥ | pratipipādayiṣitaḥ; pratipādayitumiṣṭaḥ, tātparyaviṣaya ityarthaḥ | devatānirākaraṇādikaṃ devatājñānānapekṣaphalapradatvarūpakarmaprāśastyādyarthāntaraparam; na tu devatānirāsādau tātparyam | anyārthaṃ tu jaiminiḥ paraṃ jaiminirmukhyatvāt ityādau jaiminerbrahmābhyupagamadarśanāditi bhāvaḥ | dravyadevatāsāmānye dravyabalīyastvamapi pramāṇadvārā, na svarūpataḥ | dravyasvarūpaṃ hi pratyakṣaṃ havissvarūpaṃ, dharma eva hi śāstragamyaḥ, devatāyāstu svarūpaṃ phalapradatvamapi śāstraikagamyamityādyanusandheyam | ato viruddhārthe tātparyābhāvānnārthavirodhaḥ | pūrvottarakāṇḍābhiprāyeṇa ṣaṭkabhedavadadhyāyabhedavadi tyuktam | anena prayojanapratipādyabhedau parihṛtau | ṣaṭkadvayacintitaprakṛtivikṛtirūpārthatatphalabhedasya śāstrabhedakatvābhāvāt | kartṛbhedaparihārastu sphuṭatayā noktaḥ | asti hi vaiyākaraṇapūrvottaravṛttyādau kartṛbhedaḥ | astvaikaśāstryam; brahmacintā pūrvaṃ kiṃ na syādityatrāha - mīmāṃseti | saṃgativiśeṣāḥ vakṣyamāṇāḥ - pāṭhakramaḥ, cetanānāṃ trivarge prathamaṃ prāvaṇyarūpo'rthakramaḥ, padārthavākyārthabhāvaḥ, dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikabhāvaḥ, upajīvyopajīvakabhāvaśca | evaṃ paurvāparyaniyāmakasaṃgativiśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭakramaṃ kramaviśeṣavadityarthaḥ | tathā hi - prathamaṃ tāvat svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ ityadhyayanenaiva svādhyāyaśabdavācyavedākhyākṣararāśergrahaṇaṃ vidhīyate | ... ... ... ... ... vrataniyamaviśeṣayuktasya cācāryoccāraṇānūccāraṇarūpamakṣararāśigrahaṇaphalamadhyayanamityavagamyate || aikaśāstryakarmavicāratadanantarabhāvi brahmavicārāpekṣopayogitvena adhītasāṅgasaśiraska iti prāk pratijñātasāṅgakṛtsnavedādhyayanakartavyatāyāṃ pramāṇatayā svādhyāyavidhimupanyasyan tasyārthajñānaparyantatvanimittāṃ brahmavicārānārambhaśaṅkāṃ vādivipratipattinimittasaṃśayaṃ ca vyudasyati - tathāhīti | vidherakṣaragrahaṇaparyantatve siddhe hyārambhaṇīyatvasiddhiḥ | anyathā adhītya snāyāt ityarthajñāne karmaśeṣatayā viniyukte satyavahantavyavrīhivat jñātavyātmano'pi karmaśeṣatvāt ayamātmā brahma ityātmabrahmaśabdayostulyārthatvācca karmasu kartṛtayāvaklṛptajīvasvarūpaparā vedāntā iti tadatiriktāprāmāṇikeśvaravicārarūpaśāstrasyānārambhaṇīyatāpatteḥ | tatra bhāṭṭābhimatāṃścaturo'rthān gurukumārilānabhimatamekaṃ ca saṃgraheṇa pratijānīte - prathamamiti | prathamaṃ tāvat; prathamata eva | prāthamyoktyā śāstrāntareṇa sādhanacatuṣṭayasiddhyayogaḥ phalitaḥ | śāstrāntarādhigamāyogyadaśāpekṣayā prāthamyam; garbhāṣṭamopanītasya hyadhyayanam | ata eva aṣṭavarṣam ityuktakālaviśeṣo'pyupanayanadvārādhyayanāṅgamiti phalitam | anenopanayanasyādhyayanāṅgatvaṃ, svādhyāyavidhivākyopādānenādhyayanasya svavidhiprayuktatvam, adhyayanena iti nirdeśena saṃskāravidhitvam, evakāreṇa niyamavidhitvaṃ ca dyotyate | akṣararāśimātrasya svādhyāyaśabdavācyatvavyudāsāya vedākhya śabdaḥ | vedākhyetyanena kṛtsnādhyayanasya vihitatvamapyabhipretam | na hi vedaikadeśaḥ svādhyāyaśabdārthaḥ | nāsāvarthāvabodhanaparyanto vidhirityabhiprāyeṇa akṣararāśigrahaṇamityuktam | vidherakṣaragrahaṇaparyantatayā adhītyābhisamāvṛtya adhītya snāyāt ityatrārthajñānasya karmaśeṣatvābhāvena jñātavyātmano'vahantavyavrīhyādivat karmaśeṣatvābhāvena karmasu karturjīvādanyasminpramāṇasaṃbhāvanayā tadvilakṣaṇeśvaravicārarūpaśāstramārambhaṇīyamiti phalitamityabhiprāyaḥ | ayaṃ cārthaḥ adhyayanamātravataḥ iti vakṣyamāṇasūtrārthaḥ pratipattisaukaryāyātra darśitaḥ; prāthamyaṃ sāṅgatvaṃ ca nātra pratītam; adhyāpanavidhiśravaṇāt; tatprayuktatā ca pratīyata iti śaṅkāyāmāha - tacceti | caḥ śaṅkānivṛttau | kiṃrūpam svatantroccāraṇarūpaṃ paratantroccāraṇarūpaṃ vā, sakṛduktirūpam, asakṛduktirūpaṃ vetyarthaḥ | katham? kimaṅgakam? aṣṭavarṣatvamupanayanadvārā adhyayanaśeṣam | dvādaśāhena prajākāmaṃ yājayet itivadadhyayanaśrutiḥ | na hi tatra yajanaṃ yājanavidhiprayuktam | atra brāhmaṇam iti dvitīyāśrutyā māṇavakaśeṣamupanayanamantaraṅgatvaliṅgāt tadgatādhyayanāṅgam | upanīya iti ktvāśrutistu vilambadvayahatā; sā hi smṛtiranuvādarūpā ca | ataḥ śruterliṅgaṃ prabalam | na ca kartrabhiprāyaphalātmanepadavaśādupanayanamupanetṛgatādhyāpanāṅgamiti vācyam, akartrabhiprāyārthena saṃmānana - ityādisūtreṇātmanepadasya vihitatvāt | kartaryeva phalānvayaḥ kartrabhiprāyatvamiti tannivṛttau phalasyobhayānvayasaṃbhavenopanayanaphalasya gurugatatvasaṃbhavādadhyāpanāṅgatvamiti śaṅkā ca nirastā, agnīnādadhīta ityatra svarita ityādisūtreṇa vihite'pyātmanepade phalasyobhayānvayadarśanāt | ataḥ kartnabhiprāyatvaṃ na kartaryeva phalānvayaḥ; kiṃtu phalasya kartranvayamātramiti tannivṛttau kartari phalānvayo na sidhyediti nācārye phalānvayaḥ | na ca cetanadvayānanvayaḥ kartrabhiprāyatvamṛtvijovṛṇīte ityatra phalasyobhayatrānvayāt | na cāvyavahitaphalasya kartranvayaḥ kartrabhiprāyatvamityācāryakavyavahitatvādātmanepadāprāptau saṃmānana ityādisūtreṇa vyavahitaphalasya kartranvaye'pyātmanepadaṃ vidhīyata iti vyavahitācāryakaniṣpattyarthatayopanayanasyādhyāpanāṅgatvaṃ kartrabhiprāyatvavirodhīti vācyam, uttarakratuvidhīn pratyādhānasyevādhyāpanaṃ pratyaṅgatvābhāve'pyupanayanasya tadupakārakatvamātreṇācāryakaniṣpādakatvopapatteḥ | ata upanayanaphalaṃ nācāryānvayīti na tadadhyāpanāṅgam | vratam, upākarmādi | niyamāḥ; padyu vā etat śmaśānam ityādyuktadeśakālabhakṣyābhakṣyādiniyamāḥ | anena upadeśaśca iti pṛthaṅnirdeśaḥ śrutitvasmṛtitvavimatisaṃmativibhāgāt | māsān.... ardhapañcamān ityanenāṅgādhyayanakālasiddhiḥ | evamaṅgavidhisahitapradhānavidhinā kiṃ pratipannamityatrāha - evamiti evam; sāṅge vidhau nirūpite | satsaṃtāna ityādikam abhijanavidyāsamudetam ityādisūtrānuvidhāyi | ācāryopanītasya ; guruviśeṣaṇamupanayanadvārā māṇavakārthaṃ yathā pakṣāntare māṇavakaviśeṣaṇamanyārthamiti bhāvaḥ | ātmaguṇāḥ; akrodhādayaḥ | vrataniyamaviśeṣayuktasyeti dṛṣṭāntatayoktiḥ | anena padadvayena kathamityākāṅkṣāpūraṇam | uparitanapadadvayena kiṃrūpamityākāṅkṣā ca śamitā, paratantrāsakṛduccāraṇarūpatāsiddheḥ | ādyatvaṃ ca tena siddham | āvṛttyaśravaṇe'pi dṛṣṭaphalasya cāparityājyatayāvaghātādivadāvṛttisiddhiḥ || adhyayanaṃ ca svādhyāyasaṃskāraḥ, svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ iti svādhyāyasya karmatvāvagamāt | ... ... ... prayojanavato'rthānāpātato dṛṣṭvā, tatsvarūpaprakāraviśeṣanirṇayaphalavedavākyavicārarūpamīmāṃsāśravaṇo'dhītavedaḥ puruṣaḥ svayameva pravartate || prathamaṃ tāvat ityādau pratijñātaṃ saṃskāravidhimupapādayitumāha - adhyayanaṃ ceti | kuta ityatrāha - svādhyāya iti | svādhyāyasya karmatvāvagamānnāpūrvadvārā puruṣasaṃskāra ityarthaḥ | saktūn juhoti itivat kiṃ na syādityāśaṅkya tatsvarūpaṃ śikṣayati - saṃskāra iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - saṃskāryatvamiti; na saktuvadanupayuktamiti bhāvaḥ | kuta ityatrāha -- dharmeti; catuṣṭayakīrtanena vedākhyaprabandhasyānugatārthaśca sūcitaḥ | svarūpeṇāpi; arthajñānānuṣṭānābhyāmṛte'pītyarthaḥ | japādinā svarūpeṇāpi; japyamānenākṣararāśimātreṇāpītyarthaḥ | anuṣṭhānaśeṣaṃ jñānama dṛṣṭaparyanto japaścādhyayanasaṃskṛtenaiva, na tu pustakādyavagateneti niyamavidhitvaṃ ca siddham |arthajñānaparyantatvaṃ kiṃ śabdasvārasyāt, utārthānupapattyeti vikalpamabhipretya prathamaṃ śiraḥ prativadannadhyayanavidhicintanamupasaṃharati - evamiti | vratānupraviṣṭānanupraviṣṭamantrābhiprāyeṇa mantravadi tyuktam | ananupraviṣṭāḥ śaṃ no mitraḥ ityādayaḥ | niyamāḥ; pūrvoktāḥ | arthajñānavyudāsāya mātraśabdaḥ; śabdapratipannametāvat, tatra tātparyaṃ ca paryavasyatītyarthaḥ; na hyādhānavākyamuttarakratuviniyogaparyantam, tadvaditi bhāvaḥ | atha vidherakṣaragrahaṇaparyantatve svādhyāyasyārthaparatve mānābhāvādavivakṣitārthatvaṃ, vidheḥ puruṣārthaparyantatvābhāvaḥ, pravartakābhāvānmīmāṃsānārambhaṇīyatvaṃ ca syāt - iti trividhānupapattimūlāmarthadhīparyantatāṃ tannimittāṃ brahmavicārārambhaśaṅkāṃ ca vyudasya, ekavyākhyeyavyākhyānatayā śāstraikyamapi darśayati - adhyayanetyādinā | svabhāvataḥ ityādinā avivakṣitārthatvaparihāraḥ | sākṣātprayojanaparyavasānaṃ tvanmate'pi na; paraṃparayā cedasmanmate'pyastītyabhiprāyeṇa prayojanavirahaṃ pariharati prayojanavadartha śabdaḥ | svargamokṣādiprayojanavanto'rthā yajñopāsanādayaḥ | pūrvaṃ śrutisvabhāvoktiḥ; paścāt tannimittāpātapratītiḥ | āpātapratītisamaye'pi prayojanavattayaiva pratītisiddhyarthaṃ prayojanavato'rthā niti punaḥ kīrtanam | tatra hetuḥ - gṛhītāditi; sāṅgādhyayanagṛhītādityarthaḥ; avagamyamānān dṛṣṭvā; avagatatvaṃ dṛṣṭvā | svarūpam aṅgī; prakāraḥ aṅgam | viśeṣaḥ pūrvapakṣitarūpādvaiṣamyam | vyākaraṇādivyāvṛttaṃ śāstraśarīraṃ vicāraḥ | nirṇayaḥ phalam | svayamevādhītavedatve sati puruṣatvāccetanatvādrāgata eva pravartate, na tu vidhinetyarthaḥ | anena pravartakābhāvādanārambhaḥ parihṛtaḥ | śrutau smṛtau cādhyayanaśabdasya tulyārthatayā prābalyadaurbalyakalpanamanarthakam | śrutiścāsti - vedamadhītyābhisamāvṛtya iti | rāgaprāptasyāpi svopayogyarthārjanāderiva śravaṇasyāpi vidhiravasarapradaḥ | ktvāpratyayaḥ samānakartṛkatvapūrvakālatvaparaḥ, na tvānantaryaparaḥ | snātakasyāpi śravaṇaṃ ghaṭate, śrāvayiturivāvasarasaṃbhavāt | na ca udakāharaṇādibhiranuṣṭhānoparodhaḥ, adhyayanavidhiprayuktānāṃ tannivṛttau nivṛtteḥ | vittakhyātyādi guroḥ phalam | yāvacchravaṇasamāpti hitaiṣivacanādanuṣṭhānopapattiḥ | na ca tarhi mīmāṃsānairapekṣyam, mūlajijñāsayā svayaṃ pratipipādayiṣayā ca sāpekṣatvāt | na ca hitaiṣivākyādanuṣṭhāne'paśūdranayavirodhaḥ, na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyāt ityādibhirbrāhmaṇaistasyānupadeśāt; kratuṣu japyamantrādīnāṃ traivarṇikādhikāropanayanāṅgakādhyayanasāpekṣatvācca | ato rāgataḥ pravṛttyupapattiḥ | vedavākyavicārarūpaśabdena vyākhyeyaikyācchāstraikyaṃ ca siddhamityabhipretam | tatra karmavidhisvarūpe nirūpite karmaṇāmalpāsthiraphalatvaṃ dṛṣṭvā ... ... tannirṇayaphalavedāntāvicārarūpaśārīrakamīmāṃsāyāmadhikaroti|| evamastu, kathaṃ paurvāparyaniyamaḥ ityatrāha - tatreti | nirūpite; karmasvarūpameva nirūpitam | āvṛttividhānādinā'lpāsthiraphalatvaṃ phalitamiti bhāvaḥ | yadvā karma nirūpitam, na tvārādhyaparadevatā | tajjñāne sati hi phalānantyamiti bhāvaḥ | annavānannādo bhavati ityānuṣaṅgikaphalavyudāsāya amṛtatvarūpa śabdaḥ | svādhyāyamīmāṃsāprayojanavadarthādi śabdāḥ ubhayabhāgasādhāraṇāḥ | upaniṣadādayastvasādhāraṇāḥ | evamaikaśāstryaṃ, paurvāparyaniyamaḥ, brahmavicārārambhaṇīyatvaṃ cetyarthatrayamupapāditam | tathā ca vedāntavākyāni kevalakarmaphalasya kṣayitvaṃ brahmajñānasya cākṣayaphalatvaṃ darśayanti ... ... pṛthagātmānaṃ preritāraṃ ca matvā juṣṭastatastenāmṛtatvameti ityādīni || āpātadhījanakavākyāni santītyāha tathā ca iti | yathā sūtraṃ vyākhyātaṃ, tathā ityarthaḥ | kṣayiphalatvaparavākyopādānaṃ kvacinnirṇītārthasaṃvādadarśanādarthāntarāṇāmapi śraddheyatvāya | lokyata iti lokaḥ phalam | phaladvārā'ntavattvamuktam | antavat iti vākyaṃ kevalakarmaparam, aviditvā iti hi prakṛtam | dhruvaphalāsādhanatvamāha - na hi iti | dhruvaṃ tat iti vākyakhaṇḍaḥ | tadupapādayati - plavā hi iti | iti karmaphalakṣayitvaparāṇi | athobhayaparam - parīkṣya iti | brāhmaṇaḥ brahma vedaḥ, tadadhīta ityaṇ | yaḥ ityadhyāhāryaḥ, saḥ ityukteḥ | akṛtaḥ - paraḥ puruṣaḥ | itiradhyāhāryaḥ | eva iti niyamavidhiḥ | śrotriyam - śrutavedāntam | brahmaniṣṭham - brahmasākṣātkāriṇam | śamadamau śravaṇaupayikatādātvikāvadhānamātrahetū, na tvatyanta bāhyāntarakaraṇaviṣayaprāvaṇyatyāgaḥ | sa hi nirūpayiṣyate | akṣaraṃ satyaṃ - svarūpato guṇataścāvikāramiti cidacidvyāvṛttiḥ | provāca - prabrūyāt | chandasi luṅlaṅliṭaḥ iti vidhau liṭ | athānantasthiraphalavākyāni | brahmavit iti vākyenānantyasiddhiḥ | yato vācaḥ iti hi prakaraṇam | na punaḥ ityādikaṃ mṛtyutatkāryanivṛttiparam | na rogaṃ nota duḥkhatām iti hi na paśyaḥ ityanantaraṃ śrūyate | paśya śabdaviṣaya uktaḥ - tadekaṃ iti | svarāṭ - akarmavaśyaḥ | sa hi svatantraḥ | tamevam ityupāyāntaranivṛttiḥ | pṛthaktvajñānasyopāyatvaṃ pṛthak iti | juṣṭaḥ - prītiviṣayīkṛtaḥ || nanu ca sāṅgavedādhyayanādeva karmaṇāṃ svargādiphalatvaṃ svargādīnāṃ ca kṣayitvaṃ ... ... ... tathaiva dharmavicāro'pi kartavya iti paśyatu bhavān || udāhṛtavākyamātratṛptaścodayati - nanu ca iti | kṣayiphalatvajñānāya hi karmavicāraḥ | tat sāṅgādhyayanasiddhamityanantaphalecchostadeva jijñāsyamiti codyam | evaṃ tarhi - udāhṛta vākyamātratṛpto'si cet | kṛtsnasya brahmaṇo'pīti bhāvaḥ | satyam iti | āpātapratītāvabhyupagamaḥ, vicāranairapekṣye'nabhyupagamaḥ | annavān ityādyavagatālpāsthira phaladākāśaprāṇādiśabdaiḥ tānyevānuvinaśyati ityanityatvādibhiśca saṃśayādyanativṛttiḥ | bhavān - anudāhṛtāspaṣṭārthavākyāntarajijñāsu | akṣayyaṃ ha vai apāma somamamṛtā abhūma ityādikaṃ pūrvabhāge'pi paśyetyarthaḥ | udāhṛtavākyaiḥ tṛptiścet uttaratrāpi syāt | anudāhṛtairatṛptiścet pūrvatrāpi syāt | sāntānantādiviruddhārthadhīrubhayatra tulyeti vicāryatvamaviśiṣṭhamityuktaṃ bhavati || laghupūrvapakṣaḥ | nanu ca brahmajijñāsā yadeva niyamenāpekṣate, tadeva pūrvavṛttaṃ vaktavyam | ... ... ... ato tatpradhānaṃ śāstram, tadapekṣitameva pūrvavṛttaṃ kimapi vaktavyam || itthaṃ karmaṇa phaladvārā hānāya nirūpyatvamuktam | atha svarūpeṇopādānāya nirūpyatvamupapādayituṃ niyamenānapekṣitatvamukhena codayati - nanu ca iti | prathama evakāro'pekṣitadvitvavyudāsāya, dvitīyastvanapekṣitasya pūrvavṛttatvavyudāsāya | tataḥ kimityatrāha - na dharma iti | kuta ityatrāha - adhīta iti | vedāntamātrādhyāyinastatraivā''pātapratīterityarthaḥ | yadvā kṛtsnādhyāyino'pi sukṛtavaśāt uttaratrāpekṣotpatteriti | tadā apekṣitāṃśasyāpyadhītatvam adhīta iti padārthaḥ | śaṅkate - karma iti | prastāvodgīthapratihāropadravanidhanākhyeṣu sāmāvayaveṣu dvitīya udgīthaḥ | upāsanasya karmāṅgatāpratītivyudāsāya āśraya śabdaḥ | hetugarbhaṃ padamidamaśakyatve | sopālambhaṃ prativakti - anabhijña iti | pradhānapratipādyaṃ jñānaṃ na vetsītyarthaḥ | tatkimityatrāha - asmin iti | jñātṛjñeyajñānarūpo bhedaḥ, avāntarabhidayāvividhaḥ | saḥ avidyākṛtaḥ | anavasthāparihāraḥ anādi śabdena | āvidyabhedarśanahetukajanmajarādinirasanīyatvāya duḥkhasāgara śabdaḥ | mithyājñānaṃ - bhrāntijñānam, mithyābhūtajñānaṃ vā | jñānanivartyatvāyamithyātvoktiḥ | ātmaikatvavijñānam - candraikatvavijñānaṃ hi tadbhedabhramanivartakam, na karma ityartha | kva - na kvāpi | jñānotpattitatsādhanānugrahatatphaleṣu na kvāpītyartha, pratyuta - bhedavāsanāhetutvāditi bhāvaḥ | udgīthādidhiyāmaupaniṣadatvāt, brahmavidyāpekṣitāstaḥ; ataḥ śārīrake taccintanaṃ sākṣātsaṅgatamityatrāha - udgītha iti | kuta iha cintetyatrāha - jñāna iti | tuśabdau śaṅkādvayavyāvartakau | ataḥ iti | prāsaṅgikāpekṣitaṃ na pūrvavṛttam, kintu pradhānāpekṣitamevetyarthaḥ || bāḍham; tadapekṣitaṃ ca karmavijñānameva; karmasamuccitāt jñānādapavargaśruteḥ | vakṣyati ca, karvāpekṣā ca yajñādiśruteraśvavat iti | .. ... ... iti vibhāgo na śakyate jñātum | atastadeva pūrvavṛttam || atra bhāskarīyāḥ prāhuḥ bāḍham iti | siddhāntina iti ca saṃpradāyaḥ, aṅgatvopagamasāmyāt | pūrvaṃ tūcitaṃ karma ityādestadgranthasthatvāt | bāḍham iti niyatāpekṣitasya vṛttatve saṃmatiḥ, na karmetyatra vimatiḥ | kiṃ niyatāpekṣitamityatrāha - tat iti | tvadanabhimatameveti bhāvaḥ | kuta ityatrāha - karma iti | śrutiḥ ca yajñena ityādi | samuccayaḥ - saṃbandhamātram | caḥ pratipādakasamuccaye | tataḥ kimityatrāha - apekṣite ca iti | padārthapratipattau na vākyārthapratītiriti bhāvaḥ | nigamayati ataḥ iti || samasamuccayavādimatāvalambanena pārśvasthaḥ codayati - bāḍham ityādinā iti ca nirvāhaḥ sāṃpradāyikaḥ | tadā samapradhānatayā'nvayaḥ samuccayaḥ vivakṣitaḥ | śrutiḥ ca vidyāṃ cāvidyāṃ ca ityādiḥ | caḥ pratipādyasamuccaye | aṅgabhāvaṃ ca vakṣyatītyarthaḥ | jñānotpatteḥ prāgaṅgabhāvasya tadabhyupagamāt | upari pūrvavat | yadyapi yādavaprakāśamate karmadhiyaḥ pūrvavṛttatvamanabhimataṃ, tathāpi tadabhimataṃ karmaṇa ubhayathā'pekṣitatvamupajīvya pārśvasthena codayitrā pūrvavṛttatvamāpādyate iti nigamanagranthāvirodhaḥ || naitadyuktam; sakalaviśeṣapratyanīkacinmātrabrahmavijñānādevāvidyānivṛtteḥ | avidyānivṛttireva hi mokṣaḥ | ... ... ... kathamiva sādhanaṃ bhavet ? mṛṣāvādī prativadati - naitat iti | kathamayuktatvamityapekṣāyāṃ, karmaṇo'pekṣitatve saṃbhāvitaṃ kṛtsnaṃ prakāraṃ dūṣayiṣyan, kiṃ samuccayaśabdena samapradhānatayā'nvayo vivakṣitaḥ, uta samuccayaśabdasya saṃbandhamātraparatvaṃ vivakṣitvā tenāṅgatayā saṃbandho'bhidhitsita iti vikalpamabhipretya, prathame śirasi sādhyadvitvaṃ sādhanadvitvaṃ ca granthadvayena vyudasyati - sakala ityādinā | sakalabhedāḥ - sajātīyavijātīya svagatabhedāḥ | teṣāṃ pratyanīkaṃ - sarpādīnāṃ rajjuvat | mātracā vyāvṛttirūpabhedavyudāsaḥ | karmasādhyābhimatapratibandhanivṛtterjñānasādhyatvasya tameva viditvā'timṛtyumeti ityādibhiḥ pratipādanānna sādhanadvitvamityarthaḥ | nivṛttireva pratibandhe nivṛtte nityaprāptasya prāptirnasādhyeti bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kimityapekṣāyāṃ karmaṇo mokṣavirodhitvaṃ pratyutaviruddhameva iti prāguktaṃ vivṛṇoti - varṇa iti | ādi śabdo niṣiddhādiparaḥ | bhedadarśananivṛttirūpa iti - kāraṇājñānanivṛttiḥ kāryājñānanivṛttigarbheti tadrūpatvam | kathamiva - na kathañcit || śrutayaśca karmaṇāmanityaphalatvena mokṣavirodhitvaṃ jñānasyaiva mokṣasādhanatvaṃ ca .. ... ... ... tameva viditvā'timṛtyumeti ityādyāḥ || śrauto'rtho na tarkabādhya ityatrāha - śrutayaśca iti | pūrvaṃ vastuvirodha uktaḥ | anityaphalatvena iti - phaladvārā virodhaḥ | antavat iti bahūnāṃ bahukālānuṣṭhitānāmapyantavattvam | tadyathā iti phaladvārā virodho darśitaḥ | jñānasyopāyatvaṃ, prāptṛprāpyabhedavirahaḥ, pratibandhanivṛttereva sādhyatvam, upāyāntaraniṣedhaśca brahmavit ityādivākyaiḥ sidhyati | evaṃ tarkānugṛhītasphuṭārthānekaśrutyanuguṇārthā vidyāṃ cāvidyāṃ ca iti śrutiriti bhāvaḥ || yadapi cedamuktaṃ, yajñādikarmāpekṣā vidyeti ... ... ... ... samāhito bhūtvā''tmanyevā''tmānaṃ paśyet iti || atha yajñādiśrutervidyāyāḥ karmasāpekṣatvaparatāṃ vyudasyati - yat iti | yajñādikarmāpekṣā vidyā iti vacanavyaktyā samapradhānatayā vā'ṅgatayā vā yatkarmāpekṣitamuktaṃ, tadbhedavāsanāhetutvāt sannantapadaśravaṇācca manaḥśuddhidvāreṇecchārthamityarthaḥ | samasamuccayapratipādakatāvyudāsaparatve phala śabdo mokṣaparaḥ | aṅgatvaparatāvyudāsaparatve vedanaparaḥ | vividiṣanti ityetat asinā jighāṃsati itivat syāditi śaṅkāyāṃ, prathamamitikartavyatātvena jñānotpattyupāyatāṃ vyudasyati - vividiṣāyām iti | śamādīnāmeva nivṛttirūpaśamādeḥ pravṛttirūpayajñādibhirvirodhānna samuccaya iti bhāvaḥ | vividiṣanti iti śabdasvārasyabhañjakanyāyanirīkṣaṇavilambenātulyatvāt na vikalpa ityabhipretya śrutireva ityuktam | ktvāśrutyā hi śīghrapratipattiḥ | icchārthamapekṣitatve'pi kathaṃ karma tyajyate, śamādiḥ svīkriyate? ityatrāha - antaraṅga iti | karmāpekṣā jñānasyecchādvāreṇa vyavahitā; utpannāyāmapīcchāyāṃ jñānotpattau śamādyapekṣitamiti tadantaraṅgamiti bhāvaḥ || tadevaṃ janmāntaraśatānuṣṭhitānabhisaṃhitaphalaviśeṣakarmamṛditakaṣāyasya ... ... arthasvabhāvādevedameva pūrvavṛttamiti jñāyate || atha vividiṣārthaṃ karmajñānaṃ pūrvavṛttaṃ syāditi śaṅkāṃ ca vyudasyan jñānotpattau karaṇatvaṃ vyudasyati - tadevam ityādinā | idaṃ saṃbhavatīti nirasyate, na tvabhyupetamiti | evam - uktopapattibhiḥ samuccayena vikalpena cetikartavyatātve'nupapanne ityarthaḥ | icchārthaṃ tajjñānasyāsmin janmani saṃpādyatāvyudāsāya janmāntara śabda | anekajanmasaṃsiddhyapekṣatveneha janmanyapyanuṣṭheyatvaśaṅkāvyudāsāya śata śabdaḥ | kāryakalpyaṃ hi kāraṇamiti bhāvaḥ | svargādipradasya kathamicchārthatvamityatrāha - anabhisaṃhita iti | mṛditakaṣāyasya - mṛditapāpasya | sadeva iti kāraṇavākyam | satyam ityādi śodhakam | vyāvṛttivaiśadyāya niṣkalam ityādi | aikyavākyam ayamātmā iti | tātparyaliṅgapuṣkalam tattvamasi iti | sāmānyato viśeṣataśca aikyasiddhiḥ | vākyaṃ karaṇaṃ, na karmetyarthaḥ | nididhyāsanavidhivaiyarthyamāśaṅkyā''ha - vākyārtha iti | avaiyarthyajñāpanāya tāni śikṣayati - śravaṇam iti | vidyāpratipādakāni - vidyāniṣpādakāni ityarthaḥ | iti - samuccayāṅgāṅgibhāvayoranupapannatvāt | evaṃrūpasya - bandhanivṛttau karmānapekṣavākyārthajñānopakramabhūtasya | tacca kimityatrāha - tacca iti | sādhanacatuṣṭayasya vṛttatve hetuṃ vastusāmarthyamāha - anena iti | nityānityavivekānnityecchā anityajihāsā ca; tadupayogīśamādiriti kathamanena vinā jijñāseti bhāvaḥ | śamādikaṃ vṛttamastu; karmacāpekṣitamastviti śaṅkāyāmāha - arthasvabhāvādeva iti | ayogavyavacchedaheturarthasvabhāva evānyayogavyavacchedasyāpi heturityarthaḥ | śamādikaṃ hi nivṛttirūpatvāt karmapratikṣepakam | karmaṇo bhedāvalambitvaṃ, jñānasya karmānapekṣatvaṃ ceti jñānakarmaṇorarthasvabhāvau garbhitau || etaduktaṃ bhavati - brahmasvarūpācchādikāvidyāmūlamapāramārthikaṃ ... ... ... uktameva sādhanacatuṣṭayaṃ pūrvavṛttamiti vaktavyam || kathaṃ viśeṣapratyanīke'dhyāsaḥ? kathaṃ tannivṛttau karmānapekṣā? manasaḥ kathaṃ mālinyanairmalye? kaścārthasvabhāvaḥ? ityāśaṅkāyāmuktaṃ saṅkalayyadarśayati - etaduktam iti | svarūpatirodheradhyāsaḥ | bhedadarśanameva, na satyaṃ kimapi | tathā sati hi karmāpekṣā | tataḥ kiṃ bandhasya jñānamātranivartyatve ityatrāha - bandhaśca iti | samūlaḥ - avidyābhedadarśanasahitaḥ | jñānenaiva, na tu karmaṇā | na hi sarpabhramanivṛttau rajjudhīḥ karmāpekṣā | evaṃ samuccayavyudāsaḥ | atha karaṇatvaṃ vyudasyati - nivartakaṃ ca iti | tasya - karmānapekṣasya; etasya - advaitaviṣayasya | tatra hetuḥ vākyajanyatvam; kāryam bandhanivṛttiḥ | tarhi kutretyata āha - vividiṣāyameva iti | śrutipratipannāyāmeveti bhāvaḥ | sa ca kathamityatrāha - sa ca iti | naivaṃ śrutamityatrāha - itīmam iti | imaṃ praṇāḍyā upayogam abhipretya uktamityarthaḥ | prakṛtamupasaṃharati - ataḥ iti | ataḥ hānārthamupādānārthaṃ ca karmajñānasyānapekṣitatvādityarthaḥ | atra vyākhyātāra āhuḥ - birodhādapramāṇatvāccittaśuddhyupayojanāt | jñānamātrasya hetutvaśruteḥ sāmarthyato'pi ca || śamādyaṅgakatāmrānānna dhīkarmasamuccayaḥ | śravaṇādikramonnidravākyajā dhīrvimocikā | |iti|| iti laghupūrvapakṣaḥ | laghusiddhāntaḥ | atrocyate - yaduktam avidyānivṛttireva mokṣaḥ, sā ca brahmavijñānādeva bhavati iti, tadabhyupagamyate | avidyānivṛttaye vedāntavākyairvidhitsitaṃ jñānaṃ kiṃrūpamiti vivecanīyam ... ... tāvanmātreṇāvidyānivṛttyanupalabdheśca|| asmin pūrvapakṣe siddhānta ucyata ityāha - atra iti | sādhyasādhanadvitvanirāsamabhyupagamena prativakti - yat iti | tarhi kutra vimatirityatrāha - avidyā iti | kiṃrūpam - karmāṅgakatvārhaṃ maduktaṃ jñānam, uta tadanarhaṃ tvaduktamiti sādhanaprakāraviśeṣe vimatiḥ | paramataṃ svamataṃ cāha - kiṃ vākyāt iti | na tu paramatavikalpaḥ | tvanmatamayuktamityāha - na tāvat iti | na tu dūṣyaśirasoranyataradūṣaṇam | kuta ityapekṣāyāṃ vidhivaiyarthyaṃ hetumāha - tasya iti | na hi vyutpannasya śabdaśravaṇādarthabodho vidhyapekṣaḥ | pratyakṣavirodhaṃ ca hetumāha - tāvat iti | idaṃ dūṣaṇadvayam āpastabhbena coktaṃ - buddhe kṣemaprāpaṇaṃ, tacchāstrairvipratiṣiddham; buddhe cet kṣemaprāpaṇamihaiva na duḥkhamupalabheta iti | upāsanadhruvānusmṛtidarśanabhakti yāvajjīvānuvṛttiniṣkramaṇamārgaviśeṣaparabahuśāstravirodhaḥ śāstrairiti vivakṣitaḥ | viśeṣataḥ pratiṣedhaḥ vipratiṣedhaḥ; prabalaiḥ pratiṣedhaḥ,? na tu samairuparodha ityarthaḥ || na ca vācyam - medavāsanāyāmanirastāyāṃ vākyamavidyānivartakaṃ jñānaṃ na janayati ... ... ... ato vākyārthajñānādanyadeva dhyānopāsanādiśabdavācyaṃ jñānaṃ vedāntavākyairvidhitsitam || anayoḥ parihāradvayaṃ paroktamanūdya nirasyati - na ca iti | idānīmutpadyamānajñānavyāvṛttyarthamāha - avidyānivartakam iti | paścādapi tat vākyataścedadyaiva tatastat syādityata āha - bheda iti | vyāsādīnāmapi jñānānudayavādaḥ śrotṛdhiyo durāroha iti bādhitānuvṛttimāha - jāte'pi iti | sarvamūlāvidyaikyāt sarvasya ityaktam | na doṣāya - mūlājñānānivartakatvaṃ na doṣāya | tarhibandhakaṃ syādityatrāha - anivṛttamapi iti | chinnamūlatvena - chinnāvidyākhyamūlatvena | śravaṇādervākyārthajñānopayogācchāstravirodhaparihāraśca arthāt siddha ityabhipretam | anutpattipakṣaṃ dūṣayati - satyām iti | nyāyānugṛhītavyutpannapadapaṅktirūpaṃ vākyam sāmagrī | pratibandhakasthityā tadvaikalyamāśaṃkyāha - satyāmapi iti | bādhakotpattau bādhyā vāsanā na pratibandhiketyarthaḥ | bādhitānuvṛtiṃta dūṣayati - satyapi iti | bhavatā - kṛtsnamithyātvavādinā | bhavatā ityabhipretaṃ vivṛṇoti - bheda iti | aikyajñānodaye'pi kiṃ vāsanā sthitā, uta tannivṛttāvapi bhedadhīriti śirodvaye prathamaṃ dūṣayati - jñānotpattāvapi iti | svayaṃ nāśe tatklṛptibhramastasyāpi tatheti bhāvaḥ | dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati - vāsanā iti | chinnamūlam - chinnavāsanākhyamūlam | bāliśabhāṣitam iti | muktirvinā jñānena syāt, tacca śravaṇādibhirvinā syāt, vinā'pi avidyayā jagadbhramaḥ syāt, sā ca vinā'dhiṣṭhānena syāt iti bhāvaḥ | tarhi kathaṃ dvicandrajñānānuvṛttirityatrāha - dvicandra iti | timiraṃ pāramārthikaṃ, na mithyā iti tasya jñānābādhitatvāt | tarhi upadeśavaiyarthyamityatrāha - prabala iti | aindrajālikakṛtabhayādivyudāsāya prabala ityādipadam | yāthārthyāparokṣyārthaṃpravṛttidvārā vā sārthatvam | evaṃ parapakṣe bādhakasthitau bādhyasthitirahetukakāryodayaśca, svapakṣe tadubhayābhāva iti vaiṣamyaṃ darśitam | siṃhāvalokitakenānutpatiṃta dūṣayati - api ca iti | adṛṣṭadvārā cennivartyaṃ satyaṃ syāditi dṛṣṭadvārā nivartyatve dūṣaṇamidam | ataḥ pāriśeṣyānmuktyupāyajñānaṃ vākyārthadhiyo'nyadityāha - ataḥ iti || tathā ca śrutayaḥ - vijñāya prajñāṃ kurvīta, anuvidya vijānāti ... ... ... yastadveda yat sa veda sa mayaitaduktaḥ ityatra, anu ma etāṃ bhagavo devatāṃ śādhi yāṃ devatāmupāsse iti || tathā ca iti | na paraṃ pāriśeṣyādavagamyate, śrūyate cetyarthaḥ | upasargaviśeṣasanvidhipratyaya yogāyoge'pyaikārthyajñāpanārthaṃ sāmānyaśabdānāṃ chāgapaśunyāyādviśeṣaparyavasānajñāpanārthaṃ cānekavākyopādānam | nicāyya - cāyṛ darśane | iti śabdaḥ svarūpe; evaṃ śabda upasargayogādiprakāre | prajñāṃ kurvīta ityādiṣu jñānamātraṃ vidheyaṃ pratīyate, na jñānaviśeṣa ityatrāha - atra iti | atra - udāhṛtavākyasamudāye | ādi śabdāt ātmānaṃ dhyāyatha ityādeḥ grahaṇam | chāgapaśunyāyāt dhyānarūpaviśeṣe paryavasānamityarthaḥ | tarhi lyabantapadābhyāṃ anveṣṭavyaḥ ityanena ca kimucyata ityatrāha - vākyārtha iti | sāmānyaśabdaḥ śravaṇādau viśeṣe paryavasyedityatrāha - śrotavyaḥ iti | śravaṇādiparyavasāne vidhyānarthakyādaprāptasya dhyānasya vidheyatvamāha – tasmāt iti | uktārthasya sautratāmāha - vakṣyati iti | sūtrārthamāha - tadidam iti | tṛtīyalakṣaṇāvasāne prakṛtaṃ śrutiṣu sāmānyaśadoktaṃ vā tadidam ityuktam | hetumāha - vidi - iti | sthalatrayamudāharati - manaḥ iti | na sa ityādau vyavadhānābhāvanna atra śabdaḥ | atrādau copāsiḥ śrutaḥ, atha yo'nyāṃ devatāmupāste iti | kvacidādau, kvacidādyantayoḥ, kvacidante ca viśeṣaśabdaḥ | kvacidante, kvacinmadhye, kvacidādau ca sāmānyaśabdaḥ ityudāharaṇatrayavibhāgaḥ | idaṃ vākyaṃ rātrisatra vākyavat draṣṭavyam | tatra hi vidhivākyanirdiṣṭā rātrīḥ arthavāde ya etā rātrīḥ ityanūdya phalatvena pratiṣṭhā samarpyate | tadvadatrāpi vidhivākyanirdiṣṭamupāsanamarthavāde ya evaṃ veda iti vidinā'nūdya, tatphalatvena bhāti ca ityādinā bhānatapane samarpyete | yastat iti | yaḥ - veditā raikvaḥ; yat -vedyaṃ brahma; saḥ - etaccobhayaṃ tavoktamityarthaḥ | me anuśādhi ityanvayaḥ | kasmiṃścit prakaraṇe sāmānyaśabdanirdiṣṭasya tattulyaprakaraṇāntare viśeṣaśabdenoktiḥ prāguktā | ekaikasmin prakaraṇe vyatikareṇoktiratroktā | etat dvayamapi sūtre pūrvatra ca hetutayā vivakṣitam | ekatroktirlāghavāya | tadidam ityādi sūtravyākhyānam | na cet apavargopāyatayā vidhitsitaṃ dhyānam i tyucyet, na tu vedanamiti | anyathā śrṛṅkhalitoktiprakaraṇavairūpyāt || dhyānaṃ ca tailadhārāvadavicchinnasmṛtisantānarūpam - dhruvāsmṛtiḥ | ... ... ... ... ... ... upāsanaṃ syāt dhruvānusmṛtirdarśanānnirvacanācca iti tasyaiva vedanasyopāsanarūpasyāsakṛdāvṛttasya dhruvānusmṛtitvamupavarṇitam || pūrvaprakṛtadhyānaṃ viśinaṣṭi - dhyānaṃ ca iti | smṛtīnāṃ dhruvatvaṃ vijātīyasmṛtyavyavadhānam | apavargopāyatvaśravaṇāt - nididhyāsitavyaḥ ityādivihitadhyānameva dhruvā smṛtiḥ ityatra phalaikyādavagatamityarthaḥ | katipayaviśeṣaṃ pradarśayataḥ sūtrakṛto'bhipretaṃ viśeṣāntaramāha - nāma | sarvagatam - adhiṣṭhānatayā''śritam | atha śodhakavākyam - satyam iti | kāraṇavākyaśodhakavākyāntaraikārthya sāmānādhikaraṇyairnirviśeṣaparatvamabhipretam | satyādivākyasya vyāvṛttiparatvaspāṣṭyāyāha - niṣkalam iti | kalāḥ - avayavāḥ | śāntam ityādi - ūrmiṣaṭkarahitamityarthaḥ | yasya iti - jñeyatvaniṣedhaḥ | na dṛṣṭeḥ iti jñātṛtvaniṣedhaḥ | asukhavyāvṛttiḥ ānandaḥ iti | atha cidanyamithyātvamāha - idaṃ sarvam ātmā iti | rajjureva sarpaḥ itivat bādhārthaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamabhipretam | tasminneva iti pratijñātaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sarvādhyāsādhiṣṭhānatvaṃ ca sūcitam | bādhaṃ sphuṭayati - neha iti | bhedadṛgajña ityāha mṛtyoḥ iti | atra mṛtyuḥ - avidyā | tarhi kadācinnivṛttiḥ syādityatrāha - yatra hi iti | yatra -yadā; tat -tadā | itareṇa, kaḥ iti ca padadvayamadhyāhartavyam | dṛṣṭāntenopapādayati - vācā iti | uktamṛtyukāryabhedadhīphalaṃ darśayati - yadā iti | atha cinmātrasatyatvatadanyamithyātvaparaṃ sūtradvayam - na sthānataḥ ityādi || atha purāṇoktimarthadvaye'pi darśayati - pratyastamita iti | pratyastamitabhedam - sajātīyavijātīyasvagatabhedarahitam | sattāmātram - vyāvṛttirūpabhedarahitam | tucchatāṃ vyudasyati - ātmasaṃvedyam iti | svaprakāśamityarthaḥ | tatra hetuḥ - jñānam iti | atyantanirmalam - nityāspṛṣṭaduḥkhitvajñātṛtvādibhedam | arthaḥ - devādiḥ | nānyo'sti iti jagadapāramārthyamuktam | tadvivaraṇāya yadetat iti ślokadvayam | uktabhramanivṛttiḥ tattvajñānena ityāha - ye tu iti | jīvaikyaprakaraṇamāha - tasya iti | ekamayam - ekam | ātma para śabdanimittātmabhedaśaṅkāṃ vyudasyati - yadi iti | nidarśayati - veṇu iti | upadiśati - soham iti | yathopadeśamanuṣṭhānam - tatyāja iti | jīvabrahmabhedanivṛttiḥ - vibheda iti | arthadvaye'pi śrīgītoktiḥ - ahamātmā iti | bhūta śabdasya śarīramātraspāṣṭyāya āha - kṣetra iti | anyamithyātvam - na tadasti iti | ananyaparatvamuktam - vastusvarūpa iti || mithyātvaṃ nāma pratīyamānatvapūrvakayathāvasthitavastujñānanivartyatvam ... ... ... doṣaśca svarūpatirodhānavicitravikṣepakarī sadasadanirvacanīyā'nādyavidyā|| na atyantāsattvaṃ mithyātvam, khyāternirasanīyābhāvena śāstravaiyarthyaprasaṅgācca; na cānyatra sato'nyatra khyātatvam, kvā'pi satyatvaprasaṅgādityatrāha - mithyātvam iti | pratīyamānatva ityasadvyāvṛttiḥ | yathāvasthita iti sadvyāvṛttiḥ | pratīyamānatvapūrvaka iti tanniyamapūrvakatvaṃ vivakṣitam | abbhakṣa itivat | jñānanivartyatvam iti - jñānamātranivartyatvam | vastuśabdaḥ karmadhārayaśaṅkāvyudāsāya | evaṃ sati mudgarādinivartyaśaktyupabṛṃhita jñānanivartyabhrāntijñānanivartyasamyagrajatanivartakadhīprāgabhāvavyudāsaḥ | na ca bhūrandhradhīnivṛttarajjusarpe'tivyāptiḥ, tasyāpi yathā - vasthitarajjudhiyā nivartanārhatvāt | nidarśayati - yathā iti | nanu rajjvāderjaḍatvena svarūpānavabhāsādadhyāsaḥ; svaprakāśavastuni tu sa kathamityatrāha - doṣa iti | doṣa evādhyāsaprayojakaḥ, svato vā parato vā bhānaṃ tattvadhyāsopayogi adhiṣṭhāne bhāte'pi hi saḥ iti bhāvaḥ | mithyālakṣaṇaṃ tasya doṣakalpitatvaṃ ca dṛṣṭānte darśitaṃ dārṣṭāntike'tidiśan śaṅkādvayaṃ ca śamayati - evam iti | kathamekatra bahvadhyāsa iti śaṅkāṃ vyudasyati - para iti | adhiṣṭhānavailakṣaṇyāt rajjau sarpabhūrandhrādivaditi bhāvaḥ | sarvajñe kathaṃ bhrāntiriti ca śaṅkāṃ vyudasyati - para iti | sarvajñatvādayaḥ saguṇabrahmaṇaḥ, na tu parasyetyarthaḥ | doṣa ityādipadaiḥ prāguktārthadvayātideśaḥ | idaṃ - pratīyamānam | nānāvidhatvavivaraṇam deva ityādipadam || doṣaḥ kaḥ? sa satyaścenna dhīnivartyaḥ; na ceddoṣāntarāpekṣayā anavasthā | sa cet brahmaṇyatirohite kalpyate, bhramānudayānucchedayoranyataraḥ syāt | tirohite cet; yadi tirodhiḥ svataḥ, anivṛttiḥ svarūpanivṛttirvā syāt | parataścedanavasthā | nānādhyāsā nānādoṣamūlāśca dṛṣṭā iti bahuśaṅkāparihārāyāha - doṣaśca iti | avidyā iti, sadasadanirvacanīya iti, anādi iti, svarūpatirodhānavividhavicitravikṣepakarī iti śabdairimāḥ śaṅkāḥ pratyuktāḥ || anṛtena hi pratyūḍhāḥ teṣāṃ satyānāṃ satāmanṛtamapidhānam ... ... ... ... brahmaivānādyavidyayā sadasadanirvācyayā tirohitasvarūpaṃ svagatanānātvaṃ paśyatītyavagamyate || evaṃvidhāvidyāyāṃ mānamāha - anṛtena ityādinā | pratyūḍhāḥ - pratibaddhāḥ | pratyūḍhaśabdavivaraṇāyāha - teṣām iti | bahuvacanam aditiḥ pāśān itivat | nāsadāsīt ityanirvacanīyatvam | tamo hi sūkṣmāvasthaprakṛtiḥ, na tu mithyārūpāvidyetyatrāha - māyāṃ tu iti | bahubhramahetutvamāha - indra iti | dhiyā vinā durnirasatvamāha - mama iti | anāditvamāha - anādi iti | ādi śabdaḥ prāguktasvarūpaparaśrutismṛtigaṇaparaḥ | indramaheśvarādi śabdaiḥ saviśeṣatvaśaṅkāṃ nirasyan vākyānāmarthamāha - nirviśeṣa iti | svarūpaparavākyaikārthyāt doṣaparavākyeṣvapi nirviśeṣaṃ vastu doṣāśrayatayā vivakṣitamityarthaḥ | svagata iti adhiṣṭhānabhūtena svena saṃbandhamavagamyate | yata iti pūraṇam || yathoktaḥ - jñānasvarūpo bhagavān yato'sāvāśeṣamūrtirna tu vastubhūtaḥ | ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...| etattu yatsaṃvyavahārabhūtaṃ tatrāpi coktaṃ bhuvanāśritaṃ te || iti || svarūpaparairiva vākyairnirviśeṣaṃ vastu doṣāśrayatayā doṣaparasmṛtyā apijñāyate ityāha - yathā iti | vastu śabdo vakṣyamāṇadevādiparaḥ | vividhaṃjñāyate'neneti vijñānam avidyā | bhedadarśanasyājñānakāryatvaṃ vyatirekeṇa vivṛṇoti - yadā iti | śuddham nijarūpi - avidyākṛtabhedadarśanarahitam | samantāt kalpyante bhedā anenetyavidyā - saṅkalpaḥ | avidyātarusaṃbhūtiḥ iti vakṣyate | vastuṣu - devādidharmiṣu | vastubhedāḥ - devādyākārabhedāḥ | vastvasti ityādiślokadvayaṃ siddhānte vakṣyate | vijātīyabhedaniṣedhamupasaṃharati - tasmāt iti | sajātīyabhedaṃ niṣedhati - vijñānam iti | svagatamapi niṣedhati - jñānam iti | viśuddhaṃ vimalam avidyābhedaddaṣṭirahitam | sadaikam vṛddhyādirahitam | nedaṃ paramatamityāha - sat iti | etat - jñānam; bhuvanāśritam - bhuvanenādhiṣṭhānatayā''śritam | saṃvyavahārabhūtam - samantāt vyavahārāspadaṃ vartata iti yat, tatra heturavidyetyukta ityarthaḥ || asyāścāvidyāyā nirviśeṣacinmātrabrahmātmaikatvavijñānena nivṛtiṃta vadanti ... ... anena ca brahmātmaikatvavijñānena mithyārūpasya sakāraṇasya bandhasya nivṛttiryuktā|| tataḥ kiṃ jñānasya karmanairapekṣya ityatrāha - asyāśca iti | ajñānanivṛtiṃta darśayituṃ na punaḥ iti vākyamupāttam | jñānasyaikyaviṣayatvāya tadekam iti | tathā satyabhayaprāptyai yadā iti | ātmyam -śarīram | niruktiḥ - nāma | abhayam - bhayābhāvāya; avyayībhāvasamāsaḥ | bandhakatvena parābhimatasyāpi jñānena nivartyatvāyā''ha - bhidyata iti | atra bhedapratītivyudāsāyāha - brahma iti | upāyāntaraniṣedhamāha - tameva iti | nātrājñānanivṛttiḥ pratītetyatrāha - atra iti | kathamityatrāha - yathā iti | pramādam iti -anavadhānam, taddheturavidyetyarthaḥ || nirviśeṣabrahmātmaikyaviṣayatvaṃ nāvagatamityatrāha - satyam iti | nirviśeṣatvaṃ śodhakasiddham | tena ātmana aikyaṃ śrāvayati - athayo'nyām iti | bhedadhīrniṣiddhā; athopadeśaṃ darśayati - tattvam iti | tathā devatāṃ pratyāha - tvaṃ vā iti | svasminnanusandhatte -- tadyoham iti | asya sautratāmāha - vakṣyati iti | tadabhiprāyajñoktimāha - tathā ca iti | tanniṣpatteḥ - tasmin kalpitatvāt | mānānugrāhakaṃ darśayati - anena ca iti | mithyārūpasya iti hetugarbham | sakāraṇasya -sāvidyasya | sarpabhramo hi rajjujñānena nivartyaḥ, na karmaṇeti bhāvaḥ || nanu ca - sakalabhedanivṛttiḥ pratyakṣaviruddhā kathamiva śāstrajanyavijñānena kriyate? ... ... ... yatsaṃbhāvyamānānyathāsiddhi, tadbhādhyam; ananyathāsiddhamanavakāśamitaraddhādhakam - iti sarvatra bādhyabādhakabhāvanirṇayaḥ - iti || codayati - nanu ca iti | dvicandrasvapnādivyudāsāya sakala iti | vyāptiliṅgadharmidhīvyutpattyādyarthaṃ pratyakṣasāpekṣatvāt vahnyanuṣṇatvahetudravyatvavat yūpādityaikyavākyavat tadviruddhaṃ śrutirna bodhayediti bhāvaḥ | etat pariharan kiṃ pratyakṣasya bādhyatvaṃ na saṃbhavatīti manuṣe, uta parokṣasya bādhakatvaṃ na saṃbhavatīti vikalpaṃ hṛdi nidhāya prathamaṃ śiraḥ prativakti - kathaṃ vā iti | pratyakṣābhāsatvaṃ na pratītidaśāyāṃ bhātam; paścādvādhastulya iti bhāvaḥ | parokṣasya mūlino na bādhakatvamiti śaṅkate - tatra iti | tulyatvavyāvṛttaye tu śabdaḥ | mūlitvaparokṣatvābhiprāyeṇa pratyakṣamūlasya śāstrasya ityuktam | tulyatve viparyayo'pi syāditi prayojakāntaramabhyupagamayitumāha - tulyayoḥ iti | tatra paroktaṃ śaṅkate pūrvottarayoḥ iti | tadatrāpi tulyamityāha - śāstra iti | mūlamūlibhāvādyabhāvaviśeṣitau duṣṭahetujatvatadabhāvau tayoḥ prayojakāvityata āha - etaduktam iti | tulyatva iti | tulyatve sati duṣṭakāraṇajanyatva tadabhāvāvityarthaḥ | ādi śabdāt parokṣāparokṣatvaṃ pūrvottaratvaṃ ca vivakṣitam | kuta ityatrāha - jvālā iti | anyathā ityadhyāhāryam | ayogaprasaṅgādityarthaḥ | kiṃviṣayaṃ pratyakṣaṃ bādhyata ityatrāha - tatra hi iti | tarhi kiṃ prayojakamityatrāha - evaṃ ca iti | tvadukte'nupapanne satītyarthaḥ | dvayoḥ pramāṇayoḥ iti | dvayoḥ pratyakṣayoḥ, pratyakṣānumānayoḥ, anumānayoḥ pratyakṣāgamayoḥ, anumānāgamayoḥ, āgamayorvetyarthaḥ | ananyathāsiddhatvam - viruddhaviṣayamānābādhenānudayatvam; tacca viṣayāntarālābhāpramāṇakoṭiniveśābhāvarūpāt anavakāśatvāt | sarvatra - pratyakṣādiṣu sajātīyayorvijātīyayoḥ virodhe ityarthaḥ | iti etaduktam ityanvayaḥ || tasmādanādinidhanāvicchinna saṃpradāyāsaṃbhāvyamānadoṣagandhānavakāśaśāstrajanya nirviśeṣanityaśuddhamuktabuddhasvaprakāśacinmātra ... ... ... ... tenaivāpacchedanyāyena nirguṇavākyānāṃ guṇāpekṣatvena paratvāt balīyastvamiti na kiñcidapahīnam || tataḥ kiṃ śāstraprābalyasya ityatrāha - tasmāt iti | anādinidhanā hyeṣā iti smṛtiḥ apauruṣeyatvasādhakaliṅgaṃ ca smāritam anādi ityādinā | yato doṣāsaṃbhāvanā, tato'pramāṇakoṭyaniveśaḥ | arthavirodhaṃ darśayati - nirviśeṣa ityādinā | śuddhiḥ - avidyāvirahaḥ | tataḥ muktam - avidyākāryabandharahitam | buddham - bhāsamānam; tacca svataḥ | tacca cidrūpatayā śrutatvāditi padārthaḥ | vividhavikalparūpo bandhaḥ | kaśca doṣa ityatrāha - saṃbhāvyate ca iti | bhedaprapañcaḥ - bhedasamudāyaḥ jñātrādiḥ; sa ca devādirūpeṇa vividhaḥ | sa ca brāhmaṇādirūpeṇa vikalpavāniti vividhavikalpabhedarūpaḥ | ādi śabdena bhedadarśanamuktam | tayoranyonyāśrayavyudāsāya anādi śabdaḥ | bījāṅkuravat pravāhānādiḥ | kācādivyudāsāya avidyākhya śabdaḥ | kvācitkena kācādinā sarvatra doṣānumāne, vākyatvāt vede'pi prasajet | yogyānupalabdhistu tulyeti bhāvaḥ | ādi śabdaḥ kāraṇāvidyāviṣayo vā || codayati - nanu iti | anantaroktabādhyatvaprayojakābhāvamāha - anādi iti | apiḥ virodhe | bādhyabādhakatābhyupagamanimittaṃ virodhaṃ darśayati - jyotiṣṭomena iti | bādhyatvamaṅgīkurvan dṛṣṭahetukatvamanupagacchan pariharati - satyam iti | sāvakāśatvānavakāśatvāvāntaravidhārūpeṇa paurvāparyeṇa nirvāhaḥ | udgātṛpratihartrapacchedayornaimittikatvenādakṣiṇasaṃsthāpanasarvasvadakṣiṇatve vihite | ekaprayoge tayorvirodhaḥ; tatra yaugapadye vikalpaḥ; paurvāparye tu pūrvaprābalyam asañjātavirodhitayodayāt, parasya sapratipakṣatayaivodayācca iti pūrvapakṣitam | virodhyasannidhānāt tadabādhena pūrvasyodayasaṃbhavaḥ; uttarasya tu sannihitavirodhyabādhenodayāsaṃbhavāt, bādhitvaivodaya iti prābalyam; nimittodayānnaimittikaśāstraṃ coditameveti siddhāntitam | taduktam pūrvābādhena notpattiruttarasya hi sidhyati iti | pāṭhakramāt trivarge saṃsāriṇāṃ prathamaprāvaṇyarūpārthakramācca paurvāparyasiddhiriti tena nyāyena pūrvabādha ityarthaḥ || tādṛśapaurvāparyābhāvāt saguṇopāstiśāstreṣu nāyaṃ nirvāha ityatrāha - vedānta iti | kuta ityatrāha - nirguṇatvāt iti | apacchedanyāyaphalarūpabādhadarśanādityarthaḥ | saguṇopāsanasya jakṣaṇādisāṃsārikaphalaśravaṇāt pūrvatvamabhipraiti | svarūpa parasaguṇavākyeṣu kathamiti codayati - nanu ca iti | pariharati - nirguṇa iti | kāni nirguṇavākyāni, kathaṃ ca teṣāṃ sāmarthyamityatrāha - etaduktam iti | kūṭastham - nirvikāram | itarāṇi - yaḥ sarvajñaḥ ityādīni | guṇāpekṣatvena - niṣedhasya prasañjakasāpekṣatvādityarthaḥ | na kiñcidapahīnam - upāsanārthatvāt saguṇavākyānām na vaiyarthyamiti bhāvaḥ | yadvā - yaḥ sarvajñaḥ ityāderapyupāsanārthatvaṃ vivakṣannāha - vedānta iti | paurvāparyābhāvānna guṇabādhaḥ | tata eva nopāsanārthatvaklṛptiḥ iti codayati - nanu ca iti | vidhiniṣedharūpapaurvāparyamabhipretya pariharati - nirguṇa iti | sarvamanyat pūrvavat || nanu ca - satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma ityatra satyajñānādayo guṇāḥ pratīyante | netyucyate, ... ... ... ... ... evamekasyaiva vastunaḥ sakaletaravirodhyākāratāmavagamayadarthavattaramekārthamaparyāyaṃ ca padatnayam || nirguṇaparatayopāttaṃ satyādivākyaṃ saguṇaparaṃ buddhvā codayati - nanu ca iti | satyajñānādayaḥ - satyatvajñānatvādayaḥ | dvyekayoḥ itivat dvitvaikatvayoriti hyarthaḥ | anyathā dvyekeṣu iti bahuvacanaprasaṅgāt | pariharati - neti iti | pratītiḥ āpātadhīścenna naḥ kṣatiḥ, pramitiścennetyupapādayiṣyata ityarthaḥ | kuta ityatrāha - sāmānādhikaraṇyena iti | śaṅkate - aneka iti | vyadhikaraṇavākyeṣviva na padārthānekatvaṃ vākyārthaikatvavirodhīti bhāvaḥ | samānādhikaraṇavyadhikaraṇavākyayorabhidhānaviśeṣānabhijña ityupālabhya pariharati - anabhidhāna iti | devānāṃ priyaḥ - chāgaḥ, ajñaḥ iti bhāvaḥ | kathamityatrāha - ekārthatvam iti | na tu pṛthagarthapadasamudāyabodhyapradhānārthaikatvam, tattu vyadhikaraṇavākyeṣviti bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha - viśiṣṭa iti | samānādhikaraṇavākyasthaprātipadikāni kiṃ viśeṣaṇamātraparāṇi, uta viśiṣṭaparāṇi, uta svarūpamātraparāṇi iti vikalpamabhipretya, prathame viśeṣaṇarūpārthānekatvānnārthaikyam; dvitīye'pi tat tulyam | kiñca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣya rūpārthabhedācca nārthaikyam | viśeṣaṇabhedena viśeṣyabhedaprasaṅgācca | viśeṣaṇaṃ hi bhedakam | devadattaḥ śyāmo yuvā ityādau pratyakṣabalādaikyam | brahma tu na tadgocaram | na ca ekavacanāntadharmivācipadaikyāt viśeṣyaikyam, khaṇḍo muṇḍaḥ pūrṇaśrṛṅgo gauḥ ityatrādṛṣṭeḥ tadvahutvaṃ pratyakṣabalāt iti cet na, apratyakṣagorapi puruṣasyānena vākyena gobahutvapratīteḥ | tasmādapratyakṣe brahmaṇi viśeṣaṇabhedaprayuktaviśeṣyabhedo durvāra ityādidūṣaṇāni viśeṣaṇabhedena ityādigranthenoktāni | artha śabdo viśeṣyasyāpi vācakaḥ | krameṇābhidhānaṃ cet viśeṣya iva viśeṣaṇe'pi padāntaravihita viśeṣaṇānvayāt viśeṣaṇayormithaḥ samavāyaḥ | yugapaccet samānavibhaktyā viśeṣyāṃśa iva viśeṣaṇe'pyaikyapratipādanāt viśeṣaṇaikyam uddeśyopādeyavibhāgābhāvaśca ityādidūṣaṇānyanyatroktāni ihābhipretāni | tataḥ kimityatrāha - tataśca iti | śirodvayadūṣaṇāt tṛtīyaśiro'rthāt svīkṛtam | tadvivṛṇvaṃścodayati - evam iti | evaṃ tarhi - vastumātraparatve | ekatarapadavaiyarthyaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇahāniścābhiprete, parihariṣyamāṇatvāt | idaṃ bahugranthaiḥ parihartuṃ madhye tvarayā na codanīyamityabhiprāyeṇāha - ekārtha iti | ekārthābhidhāyitve'pi iti codya hetvanuvādaḥ | pariharati ekatva iti | tātparyaniścayaḥ samānavibhaktyā | lakṣaṇahāniparihāraḥ caśabdābhipretaḥ | arthavatvam - prayojanavattvam | bahuvyāvartyavyudasanāt arthavattvam | pravṛttinimittabhūtaistaiḥ aparyāyatā, sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇānurodhaśca ekārthatvāvirodhena sidhyantītyuktaṃ bhavati || tat tvaṃ padayorivānvayamukhenopalakṣaṇadvārā svarūpaparatvaṃ kiṃ na syāt? vyāvṛttibahutvānnaikārthatvaṃ, vyāvartyānantyānna tadvyudāsaḥ katipayapadaiḥ śakyate; yebhyo vyāvṛttiḥ, kāni ca tāni? vyāvṛttibhiḥ sadharmakatvam | vyāvṛttayo na dharmāścet paryāyatā syādityāśaṃkyāha - etaduktam iti | kāraṇatayoktasya śaṅkitadoṣavyudāsasyāpekṣitatvāt tadvyāvṛttimukhena svarūpaparatvamabhipretya lakṣaṇataḥ ityādyuktam | sarvamanena padatrayeṇa phalataḥ iti | prayojakena rūpeṇānantavyāvartyavyudāsaḥ iti bhāvaḥ | vyudāsastu phalitaḥ | padāni tu svarūpapāṇītyekārthatvaṃ cābhipretam | kena kasmāt vyāvṛttirityatrāha - tatra iti | kāraṇatayaiva tucchatvavyāvṛttervikārivyāvṛttiruktā | jaḍarūpa ityasya vyākhyānam anyādhīnaprakāśa iti | tābhiḥ sadharmakatvamityatrāha - na ca iti | vādiviśeṣāpekṣayā bhāvābhāvarūpatoktiḥ | tarhi kimityatrāha - api tu iti | nidarśayati - yathā iti | na dharmāntaram iti | anupalambhāt, tadabhyupagame'navasthānācceti bhāvaḥ | tarhi paryāyatā syāditi śaṅkāyāṃ, śauklyaṃ kāṣrṇyavyāvṛttaṃ pītimavyāvṛttamityādipratibandyabhiprāyeṇāha - ekasyaiva iti | arthavattaram -dṛṣṭāntāpekṣayā parābhimatasaguṇaparatvāpekṣayā ca | śauklyaṃ hi pratyakṣam | ato vākyaṃ mandaprayojanam | śodhakasya śaṅkitadoṣavyudāso hi kṛtyam, na tu guṇānvayajñāpanamiti || prathamādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || <1. sarvatra prasiddhayadhikaraṇam |> prathame pāde adhītavedaḥ puruṣaḥ karmamīmāṃsā ... spaṣṭaliṅgakāni tṛtīye; tattatpratipādanacchāyānusārīṇi caturthe|| pratyadhikāraṇamanugatasya prathamapādarthasya tripādīsaṅgatyarthaṃ buddhisthatvāya tri pādīsūtraviṣayabhūtavākyānāṃ prāguktanyāyāviṣayatayā tasyā ārambhaṇīyatvasiddhaye ca prathamapādādhikaraṇārthānukramaḥ | śāstrārambhasiddhyarthāyāḥ catusmūtryā arthāt prathamapāde saṅgatiḥ | janamādi trisūtryāḥ prathamādhīnāraṃbhātvāt prāthamikārthānukrame śāstrāraṃbhasiddhaye ityuktam | janmādi trisūtryāḥ prathamapāde viśeṣasaṅgatiścāsti, cidacidvilakṣaṇavastulakṣaṇajanmādiparatvāt | cidacidvilakṣaṇavastumadbhāvo hi prathamapādārthaḥ | śāstrāraṃbha iti paramutaratrānuṣaṅgeṇa catussūtryarthaṃ vā || prathamādhikaraṇārthamāha - adhīta iti | janmādyadhikaraṇārthamāha ananta iti| mahānandaikakāraṇam iti tadvajijñāsasva iti phalitārtha uktaḥ | abrūmahi ityantaṃ spaṣṭārtham | tattatpadānāṃ prayojanavattvaṃ pūrvānurodhe nānusandheyam || pādārthamāha - tadevam iti | atipatita iti kutarkāṇāṃ dharmigrāhakabādho'bhipretaḥ | cidacidvilakṣaṇakāraṇāstitvaṃ pādānugatārtha uktaḥ | ataḥ param iti | uktasya brahmakāraṇatvasyānyayogavyavacchedaḥ kriyate ityarthaḥ || jīvādi iti | aspaṣṭa ityādikaṃ na brahmaliṅgagatamiti bhāvaḥ | tattat iti | tacchabdo liṅgiparaḥ | spaṣṭatarapūrvapakṣabījāni ityarthaḥ | dvitīyādye jīvaliṅgāvagamāt jīvādi ityuktiḥ | avayavisvārasyajīvaparatāya iti śaṅkāyā'vāntarasaṅgatiḥ | sarvatādātmyamanaḥprāṇasaṃbandhārbhakaukastvāṇutvādīni jīvaliṅgāni dṛśyante || sarvatra prasiddhopadeśāt || 1-2-1 || idamāmnāyate chāndogye - atha khalu kratumayaḥ ... ... upasaṃhārasthabrahmapadamapi jīva eva pūjārthaṃ prayuktamityadhyavasīyate iti || sarvatra prasiddhopadeśāt | viṣayamāha - idam iti | prathamayojanāpekṣitamātramupāttam atha khalu ityādikam, na tu sarvam ityādi | bhārūpaḥ ityāde dvitīyasūtraviṣayatvāt bhārūpa ityantamupāttam | bhāṣyāntarānurodhena prathamayojanā | sarvaṃ khalu ityādeḥ paraviṣayatvaṃ sphuṭam | atha khalu ityādiviṣayamidaṃ sūtramanyairvyākhyātam || pūrvavākyasya paraviṣayatvāt, taccheṣatvāduttaravākyānyapi tatheti na jīvaparatvaśaṅkā ityadhikaraṇamanāraṃbhaṇīyamityatrāha - atra iti | vidhyanta ropāsyaparatayā na pūrvaṇaikaviṣayateti jīvaparatvaśaṅkocitetyarthaḥ | pratipādita syopāsanasya iti | kratuśabdaḥ upāsanaparaḥ | na tu prāgvihita brahmopāsanāṅgabhūtakarmaparaḥ, yathākratuḥ ityanena phalasaṃbandhadarśanāt | tatra ca kratuḥ upāstiḥ taṃ yathā yathopāsate ityetadaikārthyāt | prāk brahmopāsane vihite'pi jīvasya kratupracuratvāt, tadupāstyantaravidhiścopapanna iti bhāvaḥ | tatra ityādi spaṣṭam | upakaraṇopakaraṇitvalakṣaṇasaṃbandha viśeṣasyāsphuṭatvāt aspaṣṭaliṅgatā || prāk prakṛtaṃ brahmaiva kratuṃ kurvīta ityatropāsyatayā saṃbadhya manomayatvādiviśeṣyaṃ syāditi śaṅkāyāṃ, kiṃ brahmapadasya vidhipadākāṃkṣayā, uta kratuṃ kurvīta ityasyopāsyākāṃkṣayā vā brahmaśabdasyottaratrānvaya iti vikalpamabhipretya, prathamaṃ śiraḥ prativakti - na ca sarvam it | anyārtha tayā nirākāṃkṣatvādityarthaḥ | dvitīyaṃ prativakti - na ca sa kratum iti ananyārthena svavākyārthena nirākāṃkṣatvādityarthaḥ | vibhakti iti | prathamāntasyeva dvitīyāntasyāpyananvayaḥ, aṣaṣṭyantatvāviśeṣāt vipariṇāmastu sannihitānanyārthapadasyaivocita ityarthaḥ | ubhayākāṃkṣā - vidhipadamanomayādi padākāṃkṣā || evaṃ prāpte brūmaḥ - sarvatra prasiddhopadeśāt | manomayatvādi guṇakaḥ ... ... manāyattaṃ jñānaṃ prāṇāyattāṃ sthatiṃ ca brahmaṇo niṣedhati || rāddhāntamāha - evam iti | sarvatra prasiddhopadeśāt | sarvatra sāmānyaviśeṣaśabdavatsu iti bhāvaḥ | manomātreṇa saṃbandhamātraṃ darśitaṃ manomaya iti vākye ; hṛdā ityatra saṃbandhaviśeṣaḥ | na cakṣuṣā ityatramanoviśeṣaṇa saṃbandhaviśeṣaḥ| prāṇaśarīratvaṃ darśayati - tathā iti | prāṇaḥ - dhārakaḥ | dhārako hi śarīrī | upasaṃhāravirodhamāha - evam iti | niṣedhāvirodhamāha - aprāṇa iti || athavā - sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma jjalāniti ... ... anādya vidyayā devatiryaṅmanuṣyasthāvarātmanā'vatiṣṭhate iti |
svāmimatayojanāmāha - athavā iti | adhyāhāryapratijñatvāt, ādyantagatabrahmaśabdadvayaviṣayaikyakhārasyavirodhāt, evaṃvicchāntaḥ iti śānteḥ śravaṇamanananiṣpādyatvadarśanāt, tadupāyopāstyāntarādarśanāt āśaṃsāryatvaṃ śāntaśabdāsvārasyāt, vṛttyananurodhācca prāgyojanā na varamiti bhāvaḥ | atraiva iti | na tu śāntyupāyamuktyupāyayorasti bhidā ityarthaḥ | śānta śabdasvārasyaṃ darśayan vākyārthamāha - sarvātmakam iti | upādānam - vidhānam | anuvādaḥ - dadhnā juhoti ityatra homavat | vākyārthamāha - ataḥ iti | evamekaviṣayatvamaṅgīkṛtya saṃśayamāha - tatra iti | avidyākarmaṇoranāditvaṃ bījāṅkuranayāt | parasya tadanupapattimāha parasya tu iti | brahmaśabdaḥ kathamityatrāha - pratyak iti | upapādayati ata iti | pravṛttinimittyogaṃ darśayati - pratyak iti | kāraṇatvaṃ nirvahati - aviduṣaḥ iti | brahmatvaṃ śuddhe, kāraṇatvaṃ baddhe | tat kathaṃ brahmatvasarvatvasāmānādhikaraṇyamityatrāha - tadayam iti || atra pratividhīyate - sarvatra prasiddhopadeśāt | ... ... yathāha vṛttikāraḥ - sarvaṃ khalviti sarvātmā brahmośaḥ iti || 1 || rāddhāntamāha - atra iti | sarvatra prasiṃddhopadeśāt | sarvatra sarva śabdo na vācakaparaḥ | kiṃ tu vācyapara iti bhāvaḥ | prasiddhasya hi hetutvam | hetutayoktyā janmādīnaṃ prasiddhatayopadeśaḥ | khalunā tādātmyasya prasiddhatayoktirityarthaḥ | uktaṃ spaṣṭayati - brahmaṇa iti | prasidiṃdha darśayati tathā hi iti| yato vācaḥ ityāderjīvaparatvañyāvṛttyarthamāha - ānanda iti | ānanda śabdasya ānandamayaparatvaṃ spaṣṭayati - pūrvānuvāka iti | vākyāntaramāha - sa kāraṇam iti | kāraṇatvakṛtatādātmyamapyarthasida mityabhipretyāha - ataḥ iti | śrutyantareṣu kāraṇatayā tādātmyopadeśāt iṃhoktaṃ tādātmyamupapannamityarthaḥ | cidacidvilakṣaṇasya kathaṃ tādātmyamityatrāha ataḥ iti | śrutibhireva tadanatvokteḥ ātmatvasiddharityarthaḥ| sthito hi dehātbhāvaḥna tu kāraṇadaśāyām; tadānīmaikyokterityatrāha - paraṃ brahma hi iti | vastusāmarthyāt kaṇṭhoktyā ceti bhāvaḥ | tatkimityatrāha evaṃbhūta iti || yaduktam ityādi sphṛṭam | jīvakarma iti | kartṛtvopādanate brahmaṇaḥ; karma tu vaiṣamyamātraherityarthaḥ | ataḥ iti nigamanam | khoktārthasya sāṃpradāyikatvamāha - imameva iti | sarvaṃ khalu iti vākye sarvātmakata yoktaṃ brahma īśaḥ paramātmetyarthaḥ || 1|| vivakṣitaguṇopapatteśca || 1-2-2 || vakṣyamāṇāśca guṇāḥ paramātmanyevopapadyante ... ... joṣamāsīna ityarthaḥ | ta ete vivakṣitā guṇāḥ paramātmanyevopa padyante || 2|| vivakṣitaguṇopapatteśca | vaktumicchiviṣayatvam - vivakṣitatvam | tadanantarabhāvivacanaviṣayatvamiti vakṣyamāṇā ityuktam | manomaya śabdaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣavākyānuguṇaṃ vyāceṣṭe - pariśuddhena iti | ekena iti | abbhakṣa vat avadhāraṇagarbhatvamabhipretam | tadvivṛṇotiviveka iti | phalitamāha - anena iti | kuta ityatrāha - malina iti | vyāpaka nivṛttyā vāyapyanivṛttiḥ | ādheyatvādisiddhiḥ kathamityatrāha kathamityatrāha - ādheyatva iti | bhā dīptiḥ, taddharmako bhārūpaḥ | taddharmakatvaṃ vigrahadvārā ityāha bhāsvara iti | ākāśa eva tadotaṃ protaṃ ca ityuktapratyabhijñābhiprāyeṇāha sakaletara iti | prakāśayati, svasmā ityarthaḥ | sarvā vā iti | sarvakarmārādhya ityarthaḥ | niṣedhasya vihitavyatiriktaviṣayatvamabhipretyāha - tata iti | kuta iti - kuta ityatrāha ityarthaḥ | ata eva - na tu vāksāmarthyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | tat vivṛṇoti - paripūrṇā iti | nigamayati - ta ete iti || 2 || anupapattestu na śārīraḥ || 1-2-3 || tamimaṃ guṇasāgaraṃ paryālocatayāṃ ... .... nāsmin prakaraṇe śārīraparigraśahaṅkā jāyata ityarthaḥ || 3 || mukte'pyasaṃbhavaṃ vyatirekamukhenāha - anupapattestu na śārīraḥ | mukte'pyanupapattyarthaṃ yogyaśabdaḥ | baddhoktiḥ dṛṣṭāntatayā || 3 || karmakartṛvyapadeśācca || 1-2-4 || etamitaḥ pretyāmisaṃbhavitā'smi ... ... prāpyaṃ paraṃ brahmopāsyamiti prāpturanyadevedamiti vijñāyate || 4 || karmakartṛvyapadeśācca | vyatirekopapādanaparamidam | prāpyaprāptṛbhedaḥ sautraḥ | tataḥ kiṃ sarvaṃ khalu ityuktasyopāsyasya jīvāt bhedasya ityatrāha - ataḥ iti ||4 || śabdaviśeṣāt || 1-2-5|| eṣa ma ātmā'ntarhṛdaye ... ... puruṣo hiraṇmayaḥ iti prathamayopāsyaḥ | ataḥpara evopāsyaḥ || 5 || paramasādhyasya hetumāha - śabdaviśeṣāt | asamānavibhaktinirdeśo'bhipretaḥ sanānaprakaraṇe śāṇḍilyavidyāyām || 5 || itaśca śārīrādanyaḥ - smṛteśca || 1-2-6 || sarvasya cāhaṃ hṛdi sanniviṣṭaḥ ... ... ... paramātmānaṃ copāsyaṃ smṛtirdarśayati || 6 || smṛteśca | hṛdisthitau apāsyopāsakabhede ca smṛtirdaśiṃtā || 6 || arbhakaukastvāt tadvyāpadeśācca neti cenna nicāyyatvādevaṃ vyomavacca || 1.2-7 || alpāyatantvam - arbhakaukastvam | ... ... ata upāsanārthamarbhakaukastvamaṇīyastvaṃ ca || 7 || arbhakaukastvāt tadvyapadeśācca neti cenna nicāyyatvādevaṃ veyomavacca | alpatvākṣepakokteḥ tatkaṇṭhokteśca ityarthaḥ | parasya tadvaidharmyamāha - api tu iti| viparītaṃ kasmānnetyatrāha - tathā hi iti | prakaraṇāvicchedāya atha khalu ityādyuktam| svarūpaguṇān advārakaguṇān | pūrvatra uttaratra ca vibhutvokteḥ madhye'lpatvamuktamaupādhikamityarthaḥ || saṃbhogaprāptiriti cenna vaiśeṣyāt || 1.2-8 || jīvasyeva parasyāpi ... ... tayoranyaḥ pippalaṃ svādūtti anaśnannanyo'bhicākaśīti iti || 8 || saṃbhogaprāptiriti cenna vaiśeṣyāt | śarīrāntarvartitvam - hṛdi sthitatvam | vaiśeṣayaṃ - viśeṣaḥ || 8 || iti sarvatraprasiddhyadhikaraṇam -1 <2.attradhikaraṇam ||> yadi paramātmā na bhoktā evaṃ tarhi ... attā carācaragrahaṇāt || 1-2-9 || kaṭhavallīṣvābhnāyate - yasya brahma ca ... .... jagadupasaṃhāritvarūpaṃ paramātmana eva || 9 || avāntarasaṅgatimāha - yadi iti | attā carācaragrahaṇāt | attuśabdāśruteḥ | sūcita ityuktā | rāddhante carācarasaṃhārarūpatāyāṃ hetudvayamāha - so'dhvanaḥ ityādinā | brahmakṣatra śabdo kṛtsnacarācarapradarśanārthāviti bhāvaḥ | mṛtyūpasecanatvaṃ kathaṃ carārarādyadanīyatvamityatnāha - upasecanaṃ hi iti || 9 || prakaraṇācca ||1-2-10 || prakaraṇaṃ cedaṃ parasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ .... ... tatprasādādṛte tasya duravabodhatvameva pūrvaprastuta pratyabhijñāyate || 10 || prakaraṇācca | prakaraṇokyaṃ kathaṇityatnāha - ka itthā iti || atha syat - nāyaṃ bhrahmakṣatnaudanasūcitaḥ ... ... tadetat prakaraṇatvāt pūrvaprastuto'ttā'pi sa eva bhavitumarhati – iti uttaratya śaṅkāmāha - atha syāt iti | anantaram - na hyavyavahitasya viccheda iti bhāvaḥ | atra prakaraṇāt ṛtapānaliṅgabalīyastvamuktam | kathaṃ bhovaturjivatvaṃ, kathaṃ vā dvitīyasya buddhiprāṇayoranyataratvamiṃtyatrāha - ṛcapānaṃ hi iti | pūrvoktāttṛtvavat jagatsaṃhartṛtvamapi bavaktuṃ na śakyamiti bhāvaḥ | yathā iti | karaṇaṃ kartṛtvopacāra ityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimatturjivatvasyetyatrāha - tadeka iti || tatrocyate - guhāṃ praviṣṭāvātmānau hi taddarśanāt || 1-2-11 || na prāṇajīvau buddhijīvau vā guhāṃ praviṣṭau ... ... yadvā prayojyaprayojakarūpeṇa pāne kartṛtvaṃ jīvaparayoruṣapapadyate || 11 || guhāṃ pravaṣṭāvātmānau hi taddarśanāt | jīvasyāpi iti | guhāpraveśo dṛśyate ityanvayaḥ | prakaraṇavicchedakaliṅgāsiddhamāha - evaṃ ca iti | mukhyakalpaṃ nirvāhāntaramāha - yadvā iti | prayojakakarturapi kartṛtvamasti || 11 || viśeṣaṇācca || 1-2-12 || asmin prakaraṇe jīvaparamātmānāveva .... .... chāyātapau ityajñatvasarvajñatvābhyāṃ tāveva viśeṣya vyapadiśyete || viśeṣaṇācca | śakemahi - upāsitumiti śeṣaḥ | ihāpyudāhṛtavākyaikārthyāditi bhāvaḥ || atha syāt yeyaṃ prete vicikitsā manuṣye ... ... tadapokṣitāṃśca viśeṣānupadideśa iti sarvaṃ samāñjasam | ataḥ paramātmaivātteti siddham ||12|| catarthe pāde vakṣyamāṇāvapi codyaparihārāviha sugrahatvāyoktau, codyasya dhīsthatvāt | atha syāt iti | varadvayaṃ kiṃ, varaṇāyogaḥ kathamityatrāha - tathā hi iti | atra iti | mokṣajñānāya tadanubandhi jijñāsayā praśna ityarthaḥ | tadupāya iti | prativacanaprakārādupāyādīnāṃ pṛṣṭatvāvagamaḥ | nikhaila iti kāraṇaśodhakādyartha uktaḥ | viśeṣān praṇavāgrividyādīn || 12 || iti attradhikaraṇam || 2 || <3. antarādhikaraṇam ||> antara upapatte || 1-2-13 || idamāmananti chandogāḥ - ya eṣo'kṣaiṇi puruṣo dṛśyate | ... ... eva hi sarvaṣu lokeṣu bhāti ityeṣāṃ guṇānāṃ paramātmanyevopapatteḥ || 13 || antara upapatteḥ | parasya taṃ durdarśam ka itthā veda iti durdarśatvokteḥ, yaeṣa dṛśyate ityukto na paraḥ iti śaṅkayā saṅgatirarthasiddheni na kaṇṭhoktā | ya eṣa iti prasiddhavaduktiḥ | dṛśyate iti aparokṣatvoktiḥ pratibimbādīnāṃ kramāt aparokṣakālpanikaśrutiprasiddhayaḥ || rāddhānte eṣām iti | nirupādhikānāmiti bhāvaḥ || 13 || sthānādivyapadeśācca || 1-2-14 || yakṣuṣi sthitiniyamanādaya ... ... yogibhirdṛśyamānātvā dupapadyate || 14 || sthānādivyapadeśācca | ādiśabdāt dhārakatvāvedyatvādi | sādhakahetūktiphalitāṃ pūrvapakṣayuktyoranyathāsidiṃdha cāha - ataḥ iti || 14 || sukhaviśiṣṭābhidhānādeva ca || 1-2-15 || itaścākṣyādhāraḥ puruṣottamaḥ ... ... prakṛtasyaiva brahmaṇo'tnābhi dhānādayamakṣyādhāraḥ paramātmā || 15 || sukhaviśiṣṭābhidhānādeva ca | aṅgatvādiviśedha ityatrāha - na ca iti | aṅgiphalāvirodhaśaṅkāvyudāsāya tadvirodhi ityuktam | ucyate ityādi | ubhayatra - upakramopasaṃhārayoḥ | hetucatuṣṭyenāṅgaṅgitvamuktam | prāṇo brahma ityādanā phalavirodhamupagamyāha - evaṃ ca iti | sa ca netyāha - na ca iti | paripālayāmaḥ iti bhujeḥ parasmaipaditvāt iti bhāvaḥ | nanu iti | sthānaguṇayorvakṣyamāṇatvākathāt tayorna vidheyatvamiti na tadvidhānāyātra paramātmovyata ityanayaparamityarthaḥ | parigarati - tadabhi iti | sphuṭam || 15 || nanu ca - kaṃ brahma khaṃ brahma ... ... mano brahma ityādivacanasārūpyāt || anantarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - nanu ca iti | yāvatā - pratyuta ityarthaḥ | vacanasārūpyāt iti | brahmaśabdasya paścādupādānāt brahma dṛṣṭi viśeṣamamityarthaḥ | brahmaśabdena nigamanābhāvācceti bhāvaḥ|| tatrāha - ata eva ca sa brahma || 1-2-16 || yatastatra yadeva kaṃ tadeva kham ... ... tadeva cātrākṣyādhāratayā'bhidhīyate ityakṣyādhāraḥ paramātmā || 16 || ata eva ca sa brahma | nigamanavākyānusārāt saḥ iti pulliṅgatā | yadeva kam ityarthopādānaṃ, na vākyopādānam | yadvāvakam iti vākyam | atrāpyanyonyadṛṣṭividhiḥ syāt, kathaṃ ca kha śabdoktasya brahmatvamityatnāha - etaduktam iti | jñātatvājñātatvamiti beṣamyaṃ ca kathaṃ, kathaṃ ca khasya sukhaviśiṣṭatvamiti śaṅkāyāṃ tadvivarītumāha asyāyam iti | dṛṣṭividhiparatve jñātatvājñāvibhāgāyogāt mumukṣuṃ pratyupadeśāt arthāntarājñānaṃ prati dṛṣṭividhyantarasyottaratvāyogācca mitho vyavacchedakatve sthite sati vākyasyārthamāha - brahmaṇaḥ iti | ataḥ - dṛṣṭividhitvāyogena anantasukharūpabrahmaparokramavākyānuguṇyādupasaṃhāravakyasyetyarthaḥ | yayā śaṅkayā sūtrautthānaṃ, tasyāḥ parihṛtatvamāha - ataḥ kam iti | sūtrārthaṃ paramaprakṛtena saṅgamayati - tadeva ca iti || 16 || śrutopaniṣatkagatyabhidhānācca || 1.2.17 || śutopaniṣatkasya - adhigataparamapuruṣayāthātbhyasya ... ... ... ato'pyayamakṣipuruṣaḥ paramātmā || 17 || śrutopaniṣatkagatvabhidhānācca | śrutopaniṣatkasya iti vyasya nirdeśo vyākhyānāya || 17 || anavasthiterasaṃbhavācca netaraḥ || 1-2-18 || pratibibhbādīnāmakṣiṇi niyamenānavasthānāt ... ... ... tasmāt akṣipuruṣaḥ paramātmā || 18 || anavasthiterasaṃbhavācca netaraḥ | padadvayenādimasūtradvayārthavyatireko dhīsthakrameṇa darśitaḥ | raśmibhiḥ iti vidyāniṣṭa itivat vaśīkāramātnābhi prāyaḥ pratiṣṭhita śabdaḥ | khaṭvadidvārakaprāsādaśayanavat sadvārakatayā cakṣuḥ - saṃbandhopapattirityarthaḥ | adhikaraṇārthaṇupasaṃharati - tasmāt iti || 18 || iti antarādhikaraṇam -3 <4. antaryābhyadhikaraṇam |> svānādivyapadeśācca ityatna ... ... paramātmatvaṃ sādhitam | idanīṃ tadeva samarthayate || avāntarasaṅgatimāha - sthāna iti | antaryābhyadhidaivādhilokādiṣu taddharmavyapadeśāt || 1-2-19 || kāṇvā mādhyandināśca vājasaneyinaḥ ... ... nānyo'to'sti draṣṭā iti draṣṭrantaraniṣedhācca iti || antaryabhyadhidaivādhilokādiṣu taddharmavyapadeśāt | viṣayaṃ śodhayati - kāṇvā ityādinā | vedayajñaśabdau abhimānidevatāparau | kathaṃ viśvacidacinniyantari jīvatvaśaṅkā iti śaṅkāyāṃ pūrvapakṣayuktimāha vākyaśeṣa iti | tataḥ kimantaryāmiṇo jīvatvasyetyatrāha - evaṃ draṣṭuḥ iti | tataḥ kiṃ rūpādisākṣātkartṛtvamarthaṃ ityatrāha - nānya iti | tannānyatra niṣedhyam, jīveṣu tatsaṃbhavāt karaṇādhīnaṃ tu tadanyatra niṣedhyaṃ, parasmin tadayogādityarthaḥ | yacchabdāvṛttyā ca bahutvam | sa iti jātau, uparkame yaḥ iti ca | ātmani sthityādayaḥ svārasyena neyā iti bhāvaḥ || evaṃ prāpre'bhidhīyate - antaryābhyadhidaivādhilokādiṣu ... jīvasyātmatayopadiśyamāno'ntaryamī na pratyagātmā bhavitumarhati || 19 || rāddhānte padacihnineṣu iti | adhiśabdasaprabhīpunaruktiprasaṅgānnārthaparatvamiti bhāvaḥ | padadvayoktiprayojanamāha - kāṇva iti | tasya uttaramastu, tataḥ kimityatrāha - tadetat iti | anyasminnasaṃbhave śrutyantarāṇyudāharati - tathā hi iti | samānaprakaraṇavākyamāha - tathā iti| paśyatvacakṣuḥ iti vyāhatamityatrāha - na ca darśana iti | anugatanimittamāha - api tu iti | aśabdatva'pi vyāptibalāt karaṇāyattatvamityatnāha - sa ca iti | sopādhikamityarthaḥ | paroktayukiṃta prativaktinānyo'taḥ iti | uktaṃ vivṛṇoti yaṃ pṛthivī iti | ninyatrantaram iti | ataḥ śabdakhārasyena uktalakṣaṇadraṣṭantaraṃ niṣidhyate iti niyantṛrūpadraṣṭrantaraniṣedha ityarthaḥ | vyatirekavibhaktinirdeśo'pi śabdaviśeṣāt iti pūrvoktabhedahetutayā atrābhipreta ityāha - eṣa te iti || 19 || na ca smārtamataddharmābhilāpāccharīraśca || 1-2-10 || smārtaṃ - pradhānam ... ... pratyagātmani vyacatirekaśca sūtradvayena darśitaḥ || 20|| na ca smārtamataddharmābhilāpācchārīścā| aprastutasmārtanirāsaḥ kimartha ityatrāha - etaduktam iti | sūtradvayaponaruktyaṃ netyāha amiṣām iti || 20 || nirapekṣaṃ ca getvantaramāha - ubhaye'pi hi bhedenainamadhīyate || 1-2-12 || ubhaye - mādhyandināḥ kāṇvāśca ... ... pratyagātmano vilakṣaṇo'pahatapāpmā paramātmā nārāyaṇa iti siddham || 21 || ubhaye'pi hi bhedenainamadhīyate | niyābhyatayā iti bhedakadharmoktyā bhedasiddhirityarthaḥ | apavādābhāvāt vyatirekanirdeśādikhārasyasiddhiḥ || 21 || iti antaryāmyadhikaraṇam - 4 <5. adṛśyatvādiguṇakādhitakaṇam ||> adṛśyatvādiguṇako dharmokteḥ || 1-2-22 || ārtharvaṇikā adhīyate ... ... ato''trākṣaraśabdo bhūtasūkṣmamacetanaṃ brūte || 22 || adṛśyatvādiguṇako dharmokteḥ | akṣarāt parataḥ parasya ca sūtravivakṣitatvaṃ pulliṅgasūcatam | adṛṣṭo draṣṭā ityādāviva iti saṅgatiḥ sūcitā | na hmatrādṛśyatvaṃ draṣṭṛtvavat niyantṛtvasahacarāti pradhānaparatvaśaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ| parato'kṣarāt iti vibhaktisāmyena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ svataḥ prāptamiti bhāvaḥ | adṛśyatvaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ, dṛṣṭāntaśca cetanaparatvanuguṇa ityatnāha etaduktam iti | antaraṅge sati bahiraṅgaṃ na grāhyamiti bhāvaḥ | dṛṣṭāntānu guṇyamāha - tadadhiṣṭhitam iti | rāddhānte idaṃ vākyamuktaviṣayaṃ syādityatrāha - tathā hi iti | akṣaraṃ na paramātmā, paratvakṣavaṇāt ityatnāha - paścāt iti | pañcamyapekṣāsvārasyāt anvayasvārasyācca vaiyadhikaraṇyamiti bhāvaḥ | arthavirodhaṃ hetumāha tasya iti | yasya paradharmanvayaḥ śrutaḥ, sa hi paraḥ | ataḥ etatparakaraṇastha brahmaśabdayoriva bhinnavaṣayatvaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ || 22 || itaśca na pradhānapuruṣauviśeṣaṇabhedavyapadeśābhyāṃ ca netarau || 1-2-13 || viśinaṣṭi ... ... mahadādivannāmāntarābhilāpayogyakṣaraṇābhāvādvā akṣaratvaṃ kathaṃcidupapadyate || 13 || viśeṣaṇabhedavyapadeśābhyāṃ ca tetarau | kasmāt kiṃ kārdharmaiḥ viśinaṣṭītyatrāha - pradhānāt iti | bhedavyapadeśaṃ viṣṛṇoti - tathā iti | ubhayamupapādayitumāha - tathā hi iti | viśeṣaṇavāciśabdaināpi paraviṣayatvasiddhimāha - paravidyaiva ca iti | jñeye brahmaṇi kṛtsnajñeyāntarbhāntarbhāvāt tadvetane kṛtsnavedanāntarbhāvāt sarvavidyāpratiṣṭhā ityuktam | vidyayorbhinnaviṣayatvavyudāsāya vyācaṣṭai - brahma prepsunā iti | vidye veditavye iti tapo'tapyata, odanapākaṃ pacati itivat | viṣayaikye ko bheda ityatrāha - parośca iti | tathātve sāmagrībhedaṃ hetumāha - tatra iti | prathamenaivālamityatrāha - tayoḥ iti | tadvaiyarthyaṃ śrutamityatnāha - tacca iti | kiṃ prathamena ityatrāha - tadupāya iti | sādhanasaptakānugṛhītam - sāyadhanasaptakasahitam | uktaṃ spaṣṭayitumāha āha ca iti | āgamotthaparaṃ tatra ityādivākyamityāha tatra iti | kiṃ dharmaśāstrādinā, na cātrāgamotthaṃ pratītamityatrāha - sāṅgasya iti | atha iti uktam ityanvayaḥ | tapasā ityādivākyaṃ vyācaṣṭe brahmaṇaḥ iti | bhoktṛvargasya iti satyaśabdārtha uktaḥ | paunaruktyaśaṅkā vyudāsāyāha - yaḥ sarvajñaḥ iti | dadhnā juhoti itivaditi bhāvaḥ | bhogyabhoktṛ iti | adyate'tti ca iti hi annanirūktiriti bhāvaḥ | mantreṣu ityādi | caturmukhalokakāmaparatvavyāvṛttarthaṇāha - sārvajñya iti | tadaitat satyam ityādyaikārthyāditi bhāvaḥ | yeṣu puruṣeṣu || sautrahetvordvitīyaṃ vivṛṇoti - bhedavyapadeśo'pi iti | aśnute iti prokṣaṇīnayo'bhipretaḥ || 23 || rūpopanyāsācca || 1-2-24 || agnirmūrdhā cakṣuṣī ... ... sarvabhūtāntātmanaḥ paramātmana eva saṃbhavati | ataśca paramātmā || 24 || rūpopanyāsācca | sphṛṭārtham | adhikaraṇārthaṃ nigamayati - ataḥ iti || 24 || iti adṛśyatvādiguṇakādhikaraṇam - 5 <6. vaiśvānarādhikaraṇam ||> vaiśvānaraḥ sādhāraṇaśabdaviśeṣāt || 1-2-25 || itadamāmananti chandogāḥ - ātmānamevemaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ ... ...vaiśvānarātmavijñānaphalaṃ vaiśvānarātmānaṃ paraṃ brahmeti jñāpayati || 25 || vaiśvānaraḥ sādhāraṇaśabdaviśeṣāt | upanyastaṃ rūpaṃ parasmādanyasya dṛśyati iti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ | sādhāraṇa śabdasya sūtrasthatvāt śakya nirṇaya uta na ita saṃśayaḥ kṛtaḥ | ahnāṃ ketuḥ - ādityaḥ | ātmabrahmaśabdau kathamityatrāha - vākya iti || rāddhānte viśeṣyata iti na ghañpratyayārthaḥ samāsāntargataṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ | karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhītyarthaḥ | kṛdantapadayoga karmārthaṣaṣṭhīnimittamiti jñāpayituṃ viśeṣa padopādānam | yadvā viśeṣyata iti ghañarthoktiḥ | samāsaśca karmadhārayāḥ | viśeṣyamāṇatvāditi phalatārthaḥ, na śābdārthaḥ | ke punardharmā ityatrāha - tathā hi iti | dharmyekatvānekatvajijñāsayā vā padadvayaviśeṣaṇe tātparyādvā kiṃśabdadvayam || 25 || itaśca vaiśvānaraḥ paramātmā - smaryamāṇamanumānaṃ syāditi || 1-2-26 || dyuprabhūti pṛthivyantamavayavavibhāgena ........... paramapuruṣasyaiva rupamiti vaiśvānaraḥ paramapuruṣa eva || 26 || smaryamāṇamanumānaṃ syāditi | liṅgavāciśabdaśravaṇāt iti śabdavaiyarthyamityatrāha - itiśabdaḥ iti | mūrdhādīnāmupadeśaḥ saṃbhūya kathaṃ na kṛta ityatrāha - tathā hi iti | viśvasya rūpakatvāt prakāśakatvāt ādityo viśvarūpaḥ | anyat spaṣṭam || 26 || punarapyanirṇayamevāśaṅkya pariharati - śabdādibhyo'ntaḥ pratiṣṭhānāśca neti cenna, tathā dṛṣṭūyupadeśādasaṃbhavāt puruṣamapi cainamadhīyate || 1-2-27 || śabdādibhyo'ntaḥpratiṣṭhānāśca ityādi | tretāgniklṛptiprāṇāhutyādhāratvayoḥ ādi śabdenopādānam etacchatisthatayā sannikṛṣṭatvāt | vājinām iti - viprakarṇāt kaṇṭhoktiriti bhāvaḥ | uktahetvanukrameṇa śaṃkitamarthaṃ nigamayati - ataḥ iti || tanna ityādi | jāṭharaliṅgaparamātmaliṅgaśravaṇāt viśiṣṭopāstiparatvamityarthaḥ | viśiṣṭapratipādanaṃ katham, tatsiddhau hi viśiṣṭopāstiparatvamityatrāha - agniśabdādibhiḥ iti | kiṃ ca iti | puruṣaśabdasya jīvādiparatvaṃ prakaraṇādivaśāt, na tu svataḥ iti bhāvaḥ || 27 || ata eva na devatā bhūtaśca || 1-2-28 || uktebhya eva .......... mahābhūtasyāpi na vaiśvānaratvaprasaṅgaḥ || 28 || ata eva na devatā bhūtaśca | jāṭharavat paricchinanatvābhāve'pi nātmabrahmaśabdādikṛtsnahetava upapannā iti bhāvaḥ || 28 || sākṣādapyavirodhaṃ jaiminiḥ || 1-2-29 || vaiśvānarasamānādhikaraṇasyāgniśabdasya ......... paramātmāsādhāraṇadarma viśeṣitaḥ paramātmānamevābhidhatta iti || 29 || sākṣādapyavirodhaṃ jaiminiḥ | sākṣāt iti vyākhyeyam |avyavadhānena iti vyāravyānam | vaiśvānara śabdaḥ kena guṇena vartate; tadvat agniśabdasya kena guṇena vṛttirityatrāha - etaduktam iti || 29 || yastvetamevaṃ prādeśamātrabhivimānam ... abhivyakterityāśmarathyaḥ || 1-2-30 || upāsakābhivyaktyarthaṃ ... ... vigatamānasya hyabhivyaktereva hetorbhavati || 30 || uttarasūtrāśaṅkāmāha - yastu iti || abhivyakterityāśmarathyaḥ | paricchinnatvaṃ bhūtatṛtīyadevatayo roveti śaṅkā'tra parihṛtā | dyuprabhṛti ityādibhiḥ prādeśamātrādi śūbdāḥ vivṛtāḥ || 30 || anantarasya śaṅkāmāha bhūrdha iti | bhūrdhaprabhṛtyavayavaviśeṣaiḥ purupāvidhatvaṃ ... anusmṛterbāgariḥ || 1-2-31 || tathopāsanārthamiti bādarirācāryo ... ... tanmumukṣubhistyājyatvādiha na gṛhyate || 31 || anusmṛterbādariḥ | puruṣavidhatvam upāsārtham | sā camuktyarthetyarthaḥ|| 31 || yadi paramātmā vaiśvānaraḥ, kathaṃ tarhi ... saṃpatteriti jauministathā hi darśayati || 1-2-32 || asya paramātmana eva vaiśvānarasya ... ... evaṃ hāsya sarve pāpmānaḥ pradūyante iti || 32 || saṃpatteriti jaiministathā hi darśayati | saṃpattiḥ -
