atasmin tatkalpanam | tathā ityādisūtrakhaṇḍaṃ vyacaṣṭe - tathā hi iti | agnihotraklṛpteḥ paramātmārādhanārthatāṃ phalameva darśayatītyarthaḥ || 32 || āmananti cainamasmin || 1-2-33 || enaṃ paramapuruṣaṃ dyuṇūrdhatvādiviśiṣṭaṃ ... .... ataḥ paramātmā puruṣottama eva vaiśvānara iti siddham || 33 || iti vaiśvānarādhikaraṇam - 6 iti śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracite śārīkaramīmāṃsābhāṣye prathamasyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || na parasya dyaprabhṛtiśarīratvam; upāsakāṅgānāṃ dyuprabhṛtitvādyukteriti śaṅkāyāmanantarasūtram || āmananti cainamasmin | enam itigarmitaṃ vivṛṇvan uktaṃ vivṛṇoti - ayamarthaḥ| iti | spaṣṭam | phalaṃ ca iti | phalavatsannidhau aphalaṃ tadaṅgamiti bhāvaḥ | buddhisaukaryāya prāguktamarthametatsūtrārthena saṅgatamāha evam iti | ataḥ | iti || 33 || iti vaiśvānaradhikaraṇam - 6 iti śraharitakulatilakavāgvijayisūnunā śrīraṅgarājadivyājñālabdhavedavyāsāparanāmadheyena śrīmadvaradācāryapādasevāsamadhigataśrībhagavadrāmānujaviracitaśārīkamīmāṃsābhāṣyahṛdayena śrūsudarśanasūriṇā vilikhitāyāṃ śrutapradīpikāyāṃ prathamasyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || prathamādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || <1. dyubhvādyadhikaraṇam |> dyubhvādyāyatanaṃ svaśabdāt || 1-3-1 || ātharvaṇikā adhīyate - yasmit dyauḥ ... ... manaḥprabhṛti jīvopakaraṇādhāratvaṃ ca sarvādhārasya parasyaivopapadyate || 1 || dyubhvādyāyatanaṃ śvaśabdāt | pādasaṅgatiḥ prāguktā | dyupṛthivyādyādhāratvaṃ parasmādanyasya dṛśyata iti śaṅkayā'vāntarasaṅgatiḥ | spaṣṭajīvaliṅgakatvāt adṛśyatvādhikaraṇe etadanirūpaṇam | ātharvaṇikāḥ ityādi | sphuṭam | yathākathañcit - svarūpeṇa vā karmaṇā vā dhārakatvam iti bhāvaḥ || rāddhānte - ātmaśabda iti | gaganadigādau prayogābhāvāt yogarūḍha iti bhāvaḥ | bahudhā ityādinā hetuphalavaiṣamyaṃ janmana uktam | viśadayitumāha - smṛtirapi iti || 1 || itaśca paramapuruṣaḥ - muktopasṛpyavyapadeśācca || 1-3-2|| ayaṃ dyupṛthivyādyāyatanabhūtaḥ puruṣaḥ ... nirdiṣṭo dyupṛthivyā dyāyatanabhūtaḥ puruṣaḥ paraṃ brahmaiva || 2 || muktopasṛpyavyapadeśācca | na hi vākye muktaśabdaḥ iti śaṅkāyāṃ vyācaṣṭe saṃsāra iti | pralayavyāvṛttyarthaṃ vidhūtapuṇyapāpatvam uktam | nipañjana śabdavyākhyā prakṛtisaṃsargarahitaiḥ iti || 2 || parabrahmāsādhāraṇaśabdādibhiḥ parameva brahma ... nanumānamatacchabdāt prāṇabhṛcca || 1-3-3 || yathā'smin prakaraṇe pradhānapratipādakaśabdābhāvāt .... .... arthābhāve yadavyayam ityavyayībhāvaḥ || 3 || evamiti anvaya uktaḥ | vyatireko vakṣyata ityarthaḥ | nānumāna matacchabdāt prāṇabhṛcca | arthābhāve yadavyayam iti arthopādānam, na sūtropādānam || 3 || itaścāyaṃ na pratyagātmā - bhedavyapadeśāt || 1-3-4 || samāne vṛkṣe puruṣo nimagno ... .... tadā vītaśoko bhavati || 4 || prakaraṇāt || 1-3-5 || prakaraṇaṃ cedaṃ parasya brahmaṇaḥ ... .... prakaraṇavicchedāśaṅkāmātramatra paryahārṣma || 5 || prakaraṇāt | tarhi kimanenādhikaraṇena ityatrāha - nāḍī iti || 5 || sthityadanābhyāṃ ca || 1-3-6 || dvā suparṇa sayuja sakhāyā ... ... ato dyubhvādyāyatanaṃ paramātmeti siddham || 6 || sthityadanābhyāṃ ca | abhyarhitatvādalpātvādvā sthiteḥ prāthamyaṃ sūtro | bhāṣayo tu śrutyuktakrameṇa vyākhātam | adhikaraṇārthamupasaṃharati - ataḥ iti || 6 || iti dyabhvādyadhikaraṇam -1 <2. bhūmādhikaraṇam ||> bhūmā saṃprasādādadhyupadeśāt || 1-3-7 || idamāmananti chandogāḥ - yatra nānyat paśyati ... ... evaṃ pratyagāttve niścite sati tadanuguṇatayā vākśeṣo netavya iti || bhūtā saṃprasādādadhyupadeśāt | paraprakaraṇāvicchedāt tatparatvamuktam | tarhi jīvapakaraṇāvicchedāt jīvaparatvamiti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ | paṭhyate, na tvākṛtigaṇasthaḥ | bahoḥ iti | bahuśabdasya bhūśabdādeśaḥ |pratyayāderaco lopaśca ityarthaḥ | atra iti | tadalpam iti alpadharmi pratiyogiparatvāt na saṃkhyāparatvadharmamātraparatve ityarthaḥ | bahavaḥ puruṣā rājan, alpaṃ vā bahu vā ityādau bahuśabdasya saṃkhyāvaipulyasādhāraṇya darśanāt athaṃ nirṇayaḥ kriyate | dharmivastvantarānuktisahitena dharmipratiyogitvena bhūmno dharmitvaniśnayaḥ | upakrośatadabhāvau saprāṇatvaniṣprāṇatvanibandhanau syātām . na tu sajīvatvājīvatvakṛtau ityatrāha - aprāṇeṣu iti | hiṃsyatvaṃ parasmāt pañcavṛttiprāṇācca vyāvartakamityarthaḥ | prāṇaśabdavācyo jīvo'stu, tasya kathaṃ bhūmatvamityatrāha - ayameva ca iti || tu śabdāt prakaraṇāntaratvamāśaṅkyāha - kiṃ ca iti | eṣa tu vā agnihotrī yaḥ satyaṃ vadati itivat iti bhāvaḥ | yadā vai vijānāni iti jīvaviṣayaśastrajanyajñānavānuktaḥ | upakrame saśokatvaṃ jīvasya pratipannam, tat kathaṃ vipulasukhatvamityatrāha - avidyāviyuktam iti | sve mahimni sthitatvādi kathamityatrāha - tadanuguṇatayā iti || evaṃ prāpte'bhidhīyate - bhūmā saṃprādādadhyupadeśāt ... ... prakānta ātmā prāṇaśabdanirdiṣādanya iti gamyate || rāddhānte, na hi prāṇaśabdāmantaraṃ tato'dhiko bhūmāśabdaḥ śruta ityatrāha - satyaśabdābhidheyasya iti | prakaraṇāvicchedāt satyaṃ bhūmetyarthaḥ | satyaṃ bhūmā'stu, tataḥ kiṃ tasya paramātmatva ityatrāha - satya iti | ativadati iti satyasyādhikatvopadeśe'pi, ādhaikyasya prāṇapratiyogikatvāśraṇāt, satyaṃ cānataṃ ca ityādivat jīvasyāpi satyaśabdavācyatvasaṃbhavācca satyasya jīvādarthāntaratvaṃ na sidhyatītmatrāha etaduktam iti | yadyapi satyādhikyasya prāṇaḥ pratiyogitayā na śrutaḥ, tathā'pi ādhikyasya pratiyogyapekṣāyāṃ nāmādivadanantarasannihitaḥ prāṇa eva pratiyogī bhavitumarhatīti tatpratiyogikādhikyavataḥ parasya brahmaṇaḥ satyaṃ jñānam ityādiṣu satyaśabdanirdiṣyasya tato'rthāntaratvaṃ siddhamamityarthaḥ | tataḥ kiṃ bhūmnaḥ paramātmatva ityatrāha - satyaśabda iti || adhikatayopadeśādarthāntaratvamuktam | athādhikatayopadeśa eva kathamiti śaṅkate praṇaśabda iti | prativakti - sa vā iti | vyāvartayati adhikatayetyarthaḥ | prāṅnirdiṣṭāduttarasyādhikatayoktiparaprakaraṇatvāditi bhāvaḥ | nātivādyantarapratītiḥ, pūrvātivādipratyabhijñānādityatrāha - ata eva iti | ataḥ - tuśabdasvārasyāt | tataḥ kimityatrāha - ato'sya iti | agrihotradṛṣṭāntamabhipretya codayati - nanu iti | pariharati - naitat iti | dṛṣṭāntavaiṣamyaṃ vaktu tuśabdāt dharmyantarapratītimāha - tuśabdena iti | vaiṣamyamāha - eṣa tu iti | agnihotryantaratvanimittāgnihotrāntaratva hetudravyadevatāntarāpratītyā tuśabdakhārasyaṃ bhagnam | atra tu ativādyantaratvanimittopāranāntaratvahetūpāsyavastusiddherna svārasyabhaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | satyaśabdasyopāsyāntaraparatve tuśabdasvārasyam; tatsiddhāvupāsyāntaraparatvamityatrāha satyaśabdaśca iti | śrutiprasiddhyā tuśabdaśakyā ca noktadoṣa ityarthaḥ | prāṇaniṣṭhasyāsādhāraṇamativāditvaṃ svārasyabhañjakamityatrāha - ativāditvaṃ hi iti | na hyayaṃ śabdo rūḍhaḥ, kintu yaugika ityarthaḥ | parabrahmavādina eva iti | avayavārthapauṣkalyāditi bhāvaḥ | tuśabdātiśabdasvārasyam eva kāreṇābhipretam | ata eva - ativādiśabdasya yaugikatvādeva | ākhyātanirdeśaśiṣyaprārthane iti bhāvaḥ | ācāryaśca iti | satyavadanaparatve jijñāsitavyaśabdākhārasyaṃ ceti bhāvaḥ | mukhaāntareṇādhikatayopadeśamāha - ātmanaḥ iti || yuduktam - asti bhagavaḥ prāṇādbhūyaḥ iti praśnasya ... .... satyaśabdābhidheyasya brahmaṇo bhūmetyupadeśādbhūmā paraṃ brahma || uktaṃ ca iti | tuśabdaśrutiḥ ātmotpattirūpaliṅgaṃ cetyarthaḥ | praśnābhāvaḥ | kiṃnibandhana ityatrāha - asti iti | brahmasākṣātkāropāya bhūtam iti | yadā vai vijānāti ityādivākyasya yadā sākṣātkaroti tadā satyamativadatītyarthaḥ | ativādasya prakṛtatvādityabhiprāyaḥ | sukharūpatā jñānaṃ yādṛcchikavidvadvākyaiḥ anubhūyamāne iti arthavaśādadhyāhṛtam | iha vākye viśiṣṭānyaniṣedhaḥ | kathamīśadṛṣṭāvīśitavyadṛṣṭirityatrāha - ata aiśvarya iti | guṇaśabdo'pṛthaksthitivācī | ātmaguṇaviśeṣo hi sukhamityatrāha tadeva hi sukham iti | upādhinā duḥkharūpatve, saṃbandhājñānādananukūlatve dṛṣṭāntadvayam | anyarājānaḥ svārāṭ iti upādhitadvigamau darśitau | vibhūtyādiviśiṣṭasyānanda rūpatvamāha - niratiśaya iti | tagātmānaṃ svayamakuruta, raso vai saḥ iti hi tatra śrutam | satrārthamupasaṃharati - ataḥ iti || 7 || dharmoṣapatteśaaca || 1-3-8 || asya bhūmno ye dharmā āmnāyante ... .... tasmāt būmaviśiṣṭaḥ paramātmeti siddham || 8 || dharmopapattośca | ahaṅgraheṇa - ahamarthaśabdayoḥ paramātmaparyantatva buddhayā | tarhi atasmin taddhīḥ syādityatrāha - ahamarthasya iti | parasya sarvātmatvaṃ na paramāntaryāmibrahmaṇādisiddham, asminnapi prakaraṇe tadavagamyate ityāha - paramātmanaḥ iti | paramātmā ityantenārthoktiḥ | tato vayopādānam | etadeva iti | vijānataḥ iti ṣaṣṭhyantam ityarthaḥ | adhikaraṇārthamupasaṃharati - tasmāt iti || 8 || iti bhūmādhikaraṇam - 2 . <3.akṣarādhikaraṇam ||> akṣaramambarāntadhṛteḥ || 1-3-9 || vājasaneyino gārgigraśne samāmananti - sa hovācaitadvai tadakṣaraṃ ... ... arthasvarūpaṃ yena pramāṇenāvagamyate, na tat pratipādana daśāyāmapekṣaṇīyam || 9 || akṣaramambarāntadhṛteḥ | bhūmnaḥ sve mahimni sthitiruktā | sā pātmādanyatrāpi dṛśyata iti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ | ahasvamadīrdham ityanenaiva varṇatvaśaṅkānudayānna tatparatvamiha pūrvapakṣitam | pramāṇāntara iti | anumānāt śrautirvilambitā; pratyakṣānumitisāpekṣatvāt śruteriti bhāvaḥ | śruteḥ vyutpattisāpekṣatvāt, vyutpatteḥ pratyakṣānumānāpekṣatvācca iti bhāvaḥ || rāddhāntaṃ spaṣṭam | pūrvapakṣayukiṃta pariharati - tanna iti | śabdavācyatayā pratipatterna mānāntarāpekṣetyarthaḥ | kathamanapekṣā, vyutpattyādau apekṣitatvādityatrāha - saṃbandha iti || 9 || evaṃ tarhi akṣaraśabdanirdiṣṭo jīvo'stu ... ... sā ca praśāsanāt || 1-3-10 || sā cāmvarāntadhṛtirasyākṣarasya ... ... ataḥ puruṣottama eva praśāsitrakṣaram || 10 || anantarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - evaṃ tarhi iti | sā ca praśāsanāt | jīvasyāpi niyamanaleśasaṃbhavāt tadvyudāsāyāha - prakṛṣṭam iti | aprati hataṃ śāsana m ityarthaḥ| || 10 || anyabhāvyāvṛtteśca || 1-3-11 || anyabhāvaḥ - anyatvam, pradhānādibhāvaḥ | ... ... yada jñānāt saṃsāraprāptiḥ yajjñānācca amṛtatvaprāptiḥ, tadakṣaraṃ paraṃ brahmaiveti siddham || 11 || anyabhāvavyāvṛtteśca | adṛṣṭam - svadhāryairadṛṣṭam | taddhārakatayā dṛṣṭam | tādṛśadraṣduḥ prakṛtatvāt | nānyadato'sti dhāryeṇa paramātmanā adṛṣṭam, asya dhārakatayā draṣṭṭha netyarthaḥ | cidacidvyāvṛttim ādi śabdāt dhārakadraṣṭrantarābhāvo vivakṣitaḥ || asyāṃ yojanāyāṃ cidacidvyāvṛttikaṇṭhoktisiddhiḥ | tadvyāvartakasakaladharmavācivākyavivakṣā ca syāt | aparasyāṃ tu vyāvṛttirarthasiddhā | dhārakadraṣṭrantararāhityameva kaṇṭhoktaṃ syāt | nānyadasti iti viṣayavākyaṃ sautraśabdairanusṛtaṃ syāt | vyāvartayan ityantena sūtrārthoktiḥ | tataḥ paraṃ phalitāryoktiḥ || sautraḥ caśabdo'nuktasamuccayapara ityabhiprayaṃstadarthamāha - kiṃ ca iti || iti akṣarādhikaraṇam - 3 <4. īkṣatikarmādhikaraṇam ||> īkṣatikarmavyapadeśāt saḥ || 1-3-12 || ātharvaṇikāḥ satyakāmapraśne'dhīyate - yaḥ punaretaṃ .... .... evaṃ caturmukhatve niścite ajaratvādayo yathākathañcit netavyāḥ || īkṣatikarmavyapadeśāt saḥ | ākaśaśabdavat antarīkṣabhmalokaśabdayornānyathā nirvāha iti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ | asminnadhikaraṇe dhyānekṣaṇayorviṣayamedaṃ pūrvapakṣīkṛtya tadaikyaṃ siddhāntayati | parān pratikṣipati atra ityādinā | dhyāna iti sphuṭam | ubhayatra iti paraṃ puruṣam iti | paraśabdaviśeṣitapuruṣaśavdena nirdiṣṭasya viṣayasyobhayatraikatvena pratyabhijñānāt; paratvasya pratiyomyapekṣatvāt, uttaratra jīvadhanāt parāt iti nirdiṣṭasyaiva pratiyoginaḥ pūrvatrāpyanuṣaṅgeṇa pratiyogitayā'vagamāt pratiyomyantarānukteśca na viṣayabhedaśaṅkā iti paroktau pūrvapakṣasiddhāntau na yuktaviti bhāvaḥ | caturmukhasya samaṣṭitvaṃ devādyapekṣayā || iti prāpte pracakṣmahe - īkṣatikarmavyapadeśāt saḥ | ... parameva brahma prātyatayopadiśatīti sarvaṃ samañjasam | ata īkṣatikarma pāramātmā || 12 || rāddhānte paramātmana eva iti | caturmukhaparatve pulliṅgatā syāditi bhāvaḥ | caturmukhasyāpi iti | upadeśajanyajñānaprasaratvāt karmavaśyatā iti bhāvaḥ | na ca ityādi | akhārasyaṃ tulyamiti bhāvaḥ | pūrvaṃ prākṛtāprākṛtavibhāgābhāvāt tadānī lokatrayoktyogāt prākṛtalokadvayānantaroktalokaḥ prākṛta evetyatrāha - etadvai iti | sarvaṃ samañjasam iti | antarikṣaśabdasya pradarśanārthatvamevāsvarasamasmanmate | parasya tu sarvamakharasamityarthaḥ|| iti īkṣatikarmākaraṇam - 4 <5. daharadhikaraṇam ||> dahara uttarebhyaḥ || 1-3-13 || idamāmananti chandogāḥ atha yadidamasmin brahmapure ... .... tathā sati hṛdayāvacchinnasya dyāvāpṛthivyādisarvākṣayatvaṃ nopapadyate || dahara uttarebhyaḥ | pūrvaṃ puriśayasya paramātmatvamuktam | tasyāparamātmatvamihocyata iti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ|ākāśāntarikṣabdavācyādanyasya paratvaniścayāt akṣarekṣatikarmādhikaraṇayoḥ sāhacaryam; tadabhāvāt akṣaradaharādhikaraṇayoḥ sāhacaryābhāvaḥ | parasminnapi tatprayogāt tadvyāvṛttyartha prakarṣaśabdaḥ | apahatapāpmatvādibrahmaguṇaśravaṇāt daharākāśo brahmetyatrāha - tasmin iti | etacca atha syāt ityādinā vyaktībhaviṣyati || rāddhānte - na hi paramātmadharmāṇāmuttarādharabhāva | ata uttaratvaṃ vākyadvārakamityāha - vākyagatebhyaḥ iti | hutu śabdaḥ caturdhyantatva śaṅkāvyudāsāya || nanu ca - daharākāśasya paramātmatve'pi bāhyakāśopameyatvaṃ na saṃbhavati .. ... ata etebhyo hetubhyo daharākāśaḥ parameva brahma || atha syāt iti | avyavahitatvāt ākāśādhikaraṇatvaprathamānta nirdeśarūpaprādhānyāt eṣa iti parāmṛṣṭamanveṣṭavyam | apahatapāpmatvā dayastadguṇa iti na daharakāśaguṇā ityarthaḥ | pariharati - syādetat iti | guṇidhyāne guṇadhīrārthi, na tu guṇadhyāne guṇyantarbhāvaḥ | nātrobhayo pasthāpanā vidhīyate, ubhayopasthāpakaśabdādarśanāt| tacchabdo hi tadantarvartimātraviṣayaḥ yadvṛttanirdiṣṭaviṣayatvāt tacchabdasya ityatrāha - atra iti | na tacchabdaḥ ubhayaparaḥ, yacchabdanirdiṣṭaparāmarśitvāt tacchabdasya, tasya ca tadantarvartimātraparatvadityatrāha - yadidam iti | tyadādīni sarvairnityam napuṃsakamanapuṃsakenaikavaccāsyānyatarasyām ityādinā ekaśeṣa ekavacanaṃ teti bhāvaḥ|| daharākāśa ityādi | uktārthe prāmāṇike hi kliṣaaṭanirvāhākṣayaṇaṃ yuṣyata ityarthaḥ | prativakti - tadavahita iti | yāvān vā ityādivākyai rvyavahitamanveṣṭavyam na paramṛśati eṣā ātmā ityetacchabdaḥ | kiṃ tu avyavahitākāśāparāmarśityarthaḥ| nāsya jarayaitajjīryati ityādairarthamāha tasya iti | anyat spaṣṭam || 13 || gatiśabdābhyāṃ tathā hi dṛṣṭaṃ liṅgaṃ ca || 1-3-14 || itaśca daharākāśaḥ raṃ brahma - tadyathā hiraṇyanidhiṃ ... ... sarvāsāṃ prajānāmajānatīnāṃ gatirasya parabrahmatve paryāptaṃ liṅgam || gatiśabdābhyāṃ thā hi dṛṣṭaṃ liṅgaṃ ca | niṣāda iti | aśrutavibhaktyarthaklṛptitaḥ āśrayāntarakalpanāt śrutasyaiva sāthāpatyasaṃbandhonyāyya - ityevaṃrūpanyāyādityarthaḥ | gati śabdamātrasyārthāntaramāha - athavā iti | antarātmatvena iti | dharmaukyāduktam || 14 || itaśca daharākāśaḥ paraṃ brahma - dhṛteśca mahimno'syāsminnupalabdheḥ || 1-3-15 || atha ya ātmā iti prakṛtaṃ ... ... mahimā'smin daharākāśa upalabhyate; ato daharakāśaḥ paraṃ brahma || 15 || dhṛteśca mahimno'syāsminnupalabdheḥ | dhṛtiḥ - vidhṛtiḥ, asaṅkīrṇatvena dhāraṇam || 15 || prasiddheśca || 1-3-16 || ākāśaśabdaśca parasmin brahmaṇi ... ... prasiddhaḥ bhūtākāśaprasiddharvalīyasītyabhiprāyaḥ || 16 || prasiddhaśca | prasiddhyatiśayo bhūtākāśa ityatrāha - apahata iti || evaṃ tāvat daharakāśasya bhūtākāśatvam ... ... itaraparaparamarśāt sa iti cennāsaṃbhavāt || 1-3-17 || yuduktaṃ vākyaśeṣavaśāt daharākāśaḥ ... ... na hyapahatapāpmatvādayo guṇā jīve saṃbhavanti || 17 || uktaṃ vadan vakṣyamāṇamāha - atha iti | itaraparāmarśāt sa iti cennāsaṃbhavāt | sākṣāt iti | atha ya eṣa ityetacchabdasya prakṛtaparatvāt prāk prakṛto'pi jīva ityarthaḥ | anyat spaṣṭam || 17 || uttarāccet āvirbhūtasvarūpastu || 1-3-18 || uttarāt prajāpativāvayāt, jīvasyaiva ... ... jagadvyāpāra varjam ityatropapādayiṣyāmaḥ|| 18 || uttarāt cet āvirbhūtasvarūpastu | kiṃ prajāpativākyam; tacca paramātmaparaṃ kiṃ na syāt? jīvaparatve ca kimāyātam prakṛtasyetyatrāha etaduktam iti | prāpyasya iti | jīvasya prāpyatayā paramapuruṣasya prasaṅgaḥ | na tu prakaraṇapratipādyatayeti bhāvaḥ | iti cet iti | etaduktam ityanvayaḥ | tu śabdābhipretamāha - āvirbhūtasvarūpasyāpi iti || 18 || yadyevaṃ, daharavākye atha ya eṣa saṃprasādaḥ ... anyārthaśca parāmarśaḥ || 1-3-19 || daharākāśasyaivāpahatapātmatvajagadvidharaṇatvādivat ... prajāpativākye kīrtyamānaṃ phalamapi daharavidyāphalameva || 19 || anyārthaśca parāmarśaḥ | daharadhīreva muktidā cet, kimartha jībopāstividhirityatrāha - prajāpativākye ca iti | aṅgasya kathaṃ phaloktirityatrāha - sarvān iti || 19 || alpaśruteriti cet taduktam || 1-3-10 || daharo'smin ityalpaparimāṇaśrutiḥ ... ... āvirbhūtāpahatapāpmatvādi guṇasvasvarūpa iti na daharākāśaḥ || 20 || upasaṃhākasthahetuḥ pratyuktaḥ | athopakramagataṃ prativakti | alpaśruteriti cet taduktam | upakramaprāhalyādadhikāśaṅkā | mahāvākyasya tato'pi prābalyāt parihāraḥ| uttarasūtrayoḥ paramaprakṛtena saṅgatiṃ jñāpayitumāha ataḥ - iti | jñānādayaḥ satyasaṅkalpatvaphalitāḥ || 20 || itaścaitadevam - anukṛtestasya ca || 1-3-12 || tasya daharākāśasya ... ... anukāryaṃ brahma daharākāśaḥ || 21 || anukūtestasya ca | spaṣṭam || 21 || api smaryate || 1-3-22 || saṃsāriṇo'pi muktāvasthāyaṃ ... ... parasya brahmaṇo bhārūpatvā vagateśca pūrvapakṣānutthānādayuktam | sūtrākṣaravairūpyaṃ ca || 22 || api smaryate | paroktamadhikaraṇāntaratvamanūdya vyudasyati - kecit iti | tejasaḥ prākṛtatvavyudāsāyārambha ityatrāha - jyotiścaraṇa iti | śaṅkādhikyābhāva uktaḥ sūtrākṣara iti | anuśabdokteḥ ityarthe na yuktaḥ | iha śāstre śabdasvarūpaparatvasyāparibhāṣitatvāt | tasya iti sautrapadasya yadeva vidyayeti hi ityavat itaśabdavidhurasya tasya bhāsā iti śrutyupādānaparatvaṃ ca asvarasamiti bhāvaḥ || 22 || iti daharādhikaraṇam - 5 <6. pramitādhikaraṇam ||> śabdādeva pramitaḥ || 1-3-13 || kaṭhavallīṣu śrūyate - aṅaguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣaḥ ... ... na ca bhūta bhavyasya sarvasyeśitṛtvaṃ karmaparavaśasya jīvasyopapadyate || 23 || śabdādeva pramitaḥ | alpaśrute; iti parasya alpaparimāṇatvamuktam | tadviśeṣo jīvasya śrūyate iti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ | parasyāpyalpaparimāṇatvamuktamityatrāha - na ca iti | kṛtvā cinteyam, anyatra parasya tacchravaṇāt | īśānatvaṃ kathamityatrāha - īśānatvam iti | prathamaśrutāṅguṣṭhamātratvasvārasyāt caramaśruteśānatvārasyaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇo matam || rāddhānte - śabdādeva, na liṅgāt | parthāyaśabdādevetyarthaḥ || 23 || kathaṃ tarhi paramātmano'ṅguṣṭhamātratvamityatrāha - hṛdyapekṣayā tu manuṣyādhikāratvāt || 1-3-24 || paramātmana upāsanārtham ... ... sthitaṃ tāvaduttaratra samāpayiṣyate || 24 || hṛdyapekṣayā tu manuṣyādhikāratvāt | jīvasyāpi iti | ubhayāsvārasyāt ekākhārasyaṃ nyāyyamityarthaḥ | aṅguṣṭhamitatvamananugatamityatrāha manuṣyāṇām iti | prasaṅgikārthasyācintyatvaṃ buddhvāha - sthitaṃ tāvat iti || 24 || <7. pramitādhikaraṇagarbhe devatādhikaraṇam ||> taduparyapi bādarāyaṇaḥ saṃbhavāt || 2-3-25 || parasya brahmaṇo'ṅguṣṭhapramitatvopapattaye ... ... ataḥ sāmarthyārthitvayorabhāvāt devādīnāmanadhikāra iti || taduparyapi vādarāyaṇaḥ saṃbhavāt | prasaṅgāt saṅgatimāha - parasya iti | manuṣyaśabdavyāvartyaṃ kiṃ taryaṅmātram, uta devādayo'pīti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ ityarthaḥ | sāmarthyābhāvāt iti | arthitvābhāvasyāpyupalakṣaṇam | upasaṃhāraḥ - anuṣṭhānam | yadyapi iti | pravṛttinivṛttirūpatvābhāvāt brahmavat puruṣārtharūpatvābhāvācca | na vigrahavattve tātparyamityarthaḥ | anyaparatvāt - stutyanuṣṭheyaprakāśanayoḥ | karmaṇo dravthadevatānirūpyatvāt tadapekṣitatvāt vigrahādisiddhirityatrāha - karmavidhayaśca iti | ata eva - śarīrā bhāvādeva || evaṃ prāpre pracakṣmahe - taduryapi bādarāyaṇaḥ ... ... ato vigrahādittvāda devānāmapyadhikāro'styeva || 25 || rāddhānte arthitvasāmarthye kramādivṛṇoti - arthitvam ityādinā | kāni vigrahavattvābhidhāyīni vacāṃsi, kathaṃ taistatpratipādanamityatrāha tathā hi iti | nāmarūpavyākaraṇaśrutyā śruyatyantaratadupabṛṃhaṇasmṛtyādisiddhataccāturvidhyamabhipretam | indro varuṇaḥ somo rudaḥ ityādīnyapi ca santi iti bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha - devādi iti || upāsanaprakaraṇe'pi darśayati - tathā iti | vidhiśeṣatvena tatsiddhimāha - karmavidhi iti | na ca asatā iti | vedavākyānāṃ nirūpakādhai kārikatayā na bālādyupacchandanatulyatā yukteti bhāvaḥ | āpo vai śāntāḥ, ādityo yūpaḥ ityādiṣu pramāṇaāntarasiddhatadviruddhārthasyāpyucyamānatvānna sarvatra prāmāṇyamiti śaṅkāyāmāha - tatra pramāṇāntara iti | vidhyapekṣite hi tātparyam | kathaṃ devatāvigrahādeḥ vidhyapekṣitatvamityatrāha - karmavidheḥ iti | śrautahānāśrutaklṛptī iti bhāvaḥ | vyutpattisamayānavagatam iti | vācyāpūrvapakṣe valṛptirgurviti bhāvaḥ | phalamata ityatra vakṣyamāṇa buddhisaukaryāyehoktam | stutiprakāśanābhyāṃ tatsiddhiratrāsādhāraṇārthaḥ | saṅkīrṇa iti | nityānumeyaśrutivyudāsaḥ || 25 || virodhaḥ karmaṇīti cennānekapratipatterdarśanāt || 1-3-26 || devādīnāṃ vigrahādimattvābhyupagame ... ... saubhariprabhṛtīnāṃ śaktimatāṃ yugapadanekaśarīrapratipattiḥ || 26 || virodhaḥ karmaṇīti cennānekapratipatterdarśanāt | na yogyādṛṣṭiḥ vigrahāṇāṃ, mantroṣadhādibhiriva adṛśyatvasaṃbhavāditi bhāvaḥ || 26 || śabda iti cennātaḥ prabhavāt pratyakṣānumānābhyām || 1-3-27 || virodha iti vartate | mā bhūt karmaṇi ... ... vaidikaśabdānāmānarthakyaṃ vaidasyādimattvaṃ ca na prasajyate || 27 || śabda iti cennātaḥ prabhavāt pratyakṣānumānābhyām | anityatvam - anuccāryamāṇatvam | kathaṃ śabdārthajanma, tataśca kathaṃ codyaparihāra ityatrāha - etaduktam iti | ākṛtyanityatve'pi paśuvrīhyādyananyatva iva pravāhanityatayā parihāraḥ || 27 || ata eva ca nityatvam || 1-3-28 || yata evendravasiṣṭhādiśabdānāṃ devarṣivācināṃ ... ... acaśca vedānāṃ nityatvam, eṣāṃ ca mantrakṛttvamupapadyate || 28 || arthadvārakamanityatvaṃ parihṛtam | śabdadvārakamanityatvaṃ pariharati | ata eva ca nityatvam | kathamityapekṣāyām, uktaṃ viśadayati ebhireva iti | anadhītyaiva askhalitasvaravarṇatayā darśanaṃ mantrakṛttvam || uttarasūtratya śaṅkāmāha - atha syāt iti || atha spāt - naimittikapralayādiṣu indrādyutpattau ... ... samānanāmarūpattvāccāvṛttāvapyavirodho darśanāt smṛteśca || 1-3-19 || kṛtsnopasaṃhāre jagadutpattyāvṛttāvapi ... ... ato devādīnāmapi arthitvasāmarthyayogāt brahmavidyāyāmadhikāro'stīti siddham || samānanāmarūpatvāccāvṛttāvapyavirodho darśanāt smṛteśca | pūrvā ktādeva iti | tattacchabdena tattadarthasmṛtipūrvakasṛṣṭyā samānanāmarūpatvaṃ phalitamiti bhāvaḥ | tadanupapannam, śabdasmṛtipūrvakārthasmartuḥ abhāvādityatrāha - tathā hi iti | śaktimātrāvaśeṣam - bhoktṛtvādiyogyatā'sti, na cu tatkāryakaratvamiti bhāvaḥ | sarvat iti | nāmarūpasāmyaṃ, vedanityatvaṃ, sārthakatvaṃ ca || śabdasyotpattyādyabhyupagame kathaṃ vedanityatā ityatrāha - etadeva ca iti | varṇanityatvādaiḥ pauruṣeye vyabhicārāt nityatayā vibhutayopagatavarṇānām ānupūrvīnibandhanoccāraṇānityatvāt, pūrvakramatulyakramatayā uttarottaramuccāryamāṇatvaṃ nityatvamityarthaḥ | smṛtvoccāraṇe parasyānyādhīnadhītvamāśaṅkyāha ityān iti | svayameva adhyāpayitṛnirapekṣam | avadhāraṇadvayena asmadādeḥ pāścātyaprāthamikoccāraṇa vyāvṛttiḥ | buhu stām iti īdṛśoccāraṇasvasvātanyādhīnaḥ | udāhṛtaśrutismṛtiṣu sarvāsu sṛṣṭyupayogino vedopageśasyakācitkatve'pyanuktatyānyato grāhyatvāt sarvāsu tatsiddhiḥ || īśvarasiddhau saṃpradāyāvicchedasiddhyā nityatve siddhe, vedaprāmāṇyasiddhāvīśvarasiddhiritiṃ na cakrakaṃ śaṅkanīyam, pramāṇyasya svatastvāt | apavādehetoryogyānupalambhanirastatvācca | kṛtstravedaprāmāṇyamiti takrakaṃ yathā parihṛtaṃ, tadvate || 29 || iti devatādhakaraṇam - 7 <8.madhvadhikaraṇam ||> madhvādiṣvasaṃbhavādanadhikāraṃ jaiminiḥ || 1-3-30 || brahmavidyāyāṃ devādīnāmapyadhikāro'stīti ... vamūnāpevaiko bhūtvāṣagrinaiva mukhenaitadevāmṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā tṛpyati ityādinā || 30 || madhvādiṣvasaṃbhavādanadhikāraṃ jaiminiḥ | upāsanasāmānye devatāsāmānyasyādhikāro nirūpitaḥ | atha prāptaphalatvācca tadviśeṣāṇāṃ sa nirūpyate iti saṅgati | karmakartṛvirodhāt prāptaphalatvācca sāmarthyārthitvābhāvau | tadumyaṃ viśadayati - madhuvidyāyam iti upāsyatvam ityarthaḥ || 30 || jyotiṣi bhāvāñca || 1-3-31 || taṃ devā jyotiṣāṃ jyotiḥ ... ... ata eṣu vasvādīnāmanadhikāraḥ || 31 || jyotiṣi bhāvācca | devā etra ityuktam, manudhyānadhikāra prasaṅgāt ato jyotirevetyartha iti bhāvaḥ || 31 || siddhāntasūtram - iti prāpte'bhidhīyate - bhāvaṃ tu bādarāyaṇo'sti hi || 1-3-32 || ādityavāsvādīnāmapi teṣvadhikārabhāvaṃ ... ... brahmaṇa eva sarvatra nicāyyapatvāt iti || 32 || bhāvaṃ tu vādarāyaṇo'sti hi | akṣarārthamuktvā pūrvapakṣayukiṃta pariharati granthadvayena asti hi ityādinā | upāstiphalayorbrahyatatprāptiparyantatve siddhe hyevaṃ parihāra ityatrāha - atra hi iti | ubhayāvasthādityopāsanaṃ pratīnaṃ, na tu taccharīrakaparaviṣayaṃ, tatprāptiphalaṃ cetyatrāha na ha vā iti | upaniṣadaṃ veda - upāstiṃ kurute; ādenapākaṃ pacati itivat | upasaṃharati - ataḥ iti || vasvādisamudāyasyopāsyatvena ekaiṃsyopāsakatvena ca karmakartṛvirodhaparihāraḥ | kalpāntare vakhāditvaprāptimātrasya phalatvasaṃbhavaśca parairvyākhyātau na prāmāṇikāviti darśitau svābhimatārthasya prāmāṇikatvepapādanena | khamatasya sāṃpradayikatvaṃ vadan, paramatasya asāṃpradāyikatvaṃ ca sūcayati tadāha iti || 32 || iti madhvadhikaraṇam - 8 <9. apaśūdrādhikaraṇam ||> śugasya tadanādaraśravaṇāt tadādravaṇāt sūcyate hi || 1-3-33 || brahmavidyāyāṃ śūdrasyāpyadhikāro'sti na vā ... ... ataḥ śūdrasyāpyadhikāraḥsaṃbhavati || śugasya tadanādaraśravaṇāt tadāvaṇāt sūcyate hi | arthitvasāmarthyayoḥ prayojakatve śūdrāderapyadhikāraḥ syāditi śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ | yajñādikarmanadhikāra eva, na tūpāsanānadhikāra ityarthaḥ | nyāyasiddhaḥ karmakāṇḍe apaśūdādhikaraṇa nyāyasiddhaḥ | pradhānayuktimā - tathā iti || iti prāpta ucyate na śūdrasyādhikāraḥ ... ... prārabdhakarmavaśaccedṛśajanmayogina iti teṣāṃ brahmaniṣṭhatvam || rāddhānte - brahmasvarūpādyanavagamalakṣaṇāsāmarthyasya hetumāha asāmarthyaṃ ca iti | upāsanavidhaina śūdādhikāraḥ kalpya ityatrāha yathaiva hi iti | anuṣṭhānāya hi tatvavṛptiḥ rathakārādau yajñādau traivarṇikaistatsiddhaḥ na tatkvṛptirnyāyyā | adhyayanasyāpi prayojakatayā gauravaṃ ca syāt, evamupasaneṣvapītyarthaḥ | itihāsa iti | yathā vyākhyeyaṃ vināvyākhyānamātrānnārthapauṣkalyaṃ tadvat ityarthaḥ || prathamādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ || <1. ānumānikādhikaraṇam ||> ānumānikamapyekeṣāmiti cenna śarīrarūpakavinyastagṛhīterdarśayati ca || 1-4-1 || uktaṃ paramapuruṣārthalakṣaṇamokṣasādhanatayā jijñāsyaṃ .... ... ekeṣāṃ śākhināṃ śākhāsvānumānikaṃ pradhānamapi kāraṇamāmnāyata iti cet || ānumānikamapyekeṣāmiti cenna śarīrarūpakavinyastagṛhīterdarśayati ca || pādasaṅgatiḥ prāguktā tattacchabdo liṅgipara iti | tṛtīyasyāntye adhikaraṇe uktaṃ jīvavailakṣaṇyamayuktam; tata parasya niṣedhādityavāntarasaṅgatiḥ | uktam ityādinā iha tripādyarthoktiḥ sūtrānurodhāt | ānumānikamapi iti anyayogavyavacchedaparatvaṃ hi darśitam | śrībhāṣye'pi brahmaikakāraṇatvasthemne iti eka - sthema śabdābhyā tat sūcitam | tattacchabdo liṅgipara iti pradhānapuruṣādiśabdena vyañjitam | ucyate, uta na iti saṃśayakaraṇam avyaktaśabdasya prakṛtyavācakatvasya siddhāntyabhimatatvāt | anyathā ki brahmātmakam uta na iti saṃśayitavyam | śaṅkāyā anutsūtratvamāha - tadidam iti || atrottaram - neti | nāvyaktaśabdenābrahmātmakaṃ ... ... ataḥ kāpilatantrasiddhasya pradhānasya prasaṅga eva nāsti || rūpyata iti rūpakam - dṛṣṭāntaḥ | rūpakatvena vinyastam - kalpitamityarthaḥ | kāni kathaṃ rūpitāni ityatrāha - ātma iti | kiṃ rūpakavākyam; rūpitānāmihoktiriti kathaṃ jñāyate; sā ca kimarthā; tatra avyaktaśabdasya śarīraparatvaṃ kathamityatrāha - etaduktam iti | sarvasya iti | samyagadhyavasāyasyāpi ityarthaḥ | śarīrasya vaśīkāryatvaṃ sāttvikāhārapoṣyatvam | upāsanopakaraṇakoṭiniveśaḥ parasya kathamityatrāha sa khalu iti | puruṣānna param sā kāṣṭhā ityanyayogavyavacchittiḥ | avyakta śabdasya śarīraparatvaṃ pariśeṣādityāha - tadevam iti | pasaṅga eva - pradhānaparatvopagamena brahmātmakatvamanyatroktam | iha tu na pradhānavācitvameva iti bhāvaḥ || na cātra tantrasiddhaprakriyāpratyabhijñā ... ... evaṃbhūtena rathinā vaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ gantavyamityarthaḥ || 1 || tantrapratyabhijñāṃ dūṣayati - na ca iti | grahaṇam ityantam etaduktam iti pūrveṇānvitam | darśayati ca iti sūtrakhaṇḍaḥ | tadeva vaśīkāryatve paratvameva | chāndaso dīrgha iti | anyathā vāṅmanase iti vaktavyam | na tu vāṅmanasī iti | ataḥ chāndasatve tulye'pi prakaraṇānuguṇyamadhikamiti bhāvaḥ | ātmanaḥ parabrahmaṇi niyamanaṃ tatpravaṇīkaraṇam | vyatyayena tat ityatra tat iti vyākhyeyaṃ padam | suptiṅupagraha ityāderartho'bhipretaḥ || 1|| avyaktaśabdena kathaṃ vyaktasya śarīrasyābhidhānam? tatrāha - sūkṣmaṃ tu tadarhatvāt || 1-4-2 || bhūtasūkṣmamavyākṛtaṃ hyavasthāviśeṣamāpannaṃ ... ... rathavat puruṣārthasādhanapravṛttyarhatvāt || 2 || anantarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - avyakta iti | sūkṣmaṃ tu tadarhatvāt | kārye kāraṇopacāra ityarthaḥ | viparītaṃ kasmānna ityatrāha - tadarhatvāt iti | arthavirodhādityarthaḥ || 2 || yadi bhūtasūkṣmamavyākṛtamabhyupagamyate ... tadadhīnatvādarthavat || 1-4-3 || paramakāraṇabhūtaparamapuruṣādhīnatvāt ... ... paramātmā ca sarveṣāmādhāraḥ parameśvaraḥ iti ca || 3 || anantarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - yadi - iti | tadadhīnatvādarthavat | pradhānopagamānupagamacodyamarthavatvoktyā katham̐ parihṛtamityatrāha - etaduktam iti | svarūpasthiti iti | kāryakaratvasya sattāsthitisāpekṣatvāt tasya tādadhīnye kathite tayostādadhīnyamapi siddhamiti bhāvaḥ | mahimavādaśrutiḥ - yasya pṛthivī śarīram ityādiḥ || 3|| jñeyatvāvacanācca || 1-4-4 || yadi tantrasidghamiha avyaktam ... ... ato na tantrasiddhasyeha grahaṇam || 4 || jñeyatvāvacanācca | spaṣṭam || 4 || vadatīti cenna prājño hi prakaraṇāt || 1-4-5 || aśabdamasparśamarūpamavyayam ... ... pūrvaprakṛtājjīvātmanaḥ paratvamevocyate || 5|| vadatīti cenna prājño hi prakaraṇāt | spaṣṭam || 5 || trayāṇāmeva caivamupanyāsaḥ praśnaśca || 1-4-6 || asmin prakaraṇe hi upāyopeyopetṝṇāṃ ... ... tasmānneha tāntrikasyāvya ktasya grahaṇam || 6 || prājñaparatvaṃ na pradhānaparatvavirodhi; prājñaikaparatvābhāvādityatrāha - trayāṇāmeva caivamupanyāsaḥ praśnaśca | evamupanyāsaḥ iti vyākhyeyam | tatra evaṃpadaṃ vyācaṣṭe - jñeyatvena iti | mokṣopāyabhūtām iti | mokṣopāyatvamaṅgidvārā | yeyam iti | trayāṇāṃ praśnaḥ, prativacanaprakārāt | dharmaḥ - upāyaḥ | adharmaḥ - dharmādanya upeyaḥ | kṛtākṛtam vartamānam | tapāṃsi iti - jñānapradhānā brahmaparā iti ca uparibhāgāḥ| yasya jñānamayaṃ tapaḥ, śraddhā tapa ityupāsate ityādiṣu tapaḥśabdasya jñānaparatayā brahmaparatayā ca prayogadarśanāt | padam - prāpyam || 6 || mahadvacca || 1-4-7 || yathā buddherātmā mahān paraḥ ityatra ... ... na kāpilatantrasiddhaṃ gṛhyata iti sthitam || 7 || mahadvacca | spaṣṭam || 7 || iti ānumānikādhikaraṇam - 1 <2. camasādhikaraṇam ||> camasavadaviśeṣāt || 1-4-8 || atrāpi tantrasiddhaprakriyā nirasyate ... ... svātantryeṇa sarūpāṇāṃ bahvīnāṃ sraṣṭṭhatvaśravaṇācca iti || camasavadaviśeṣāt | pūrvaṃ kāraṇaśabdasya kāryaśarīraparatvamuktam | iha tu kāryavāciśabdāśravaṇāt kāraṇaṃ pradhānamevocyata iti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ| paraiḥ kiṃ pradhānaparamuta tejobannaparamiti vicāraḥ kṛtaḥ tatra svavākyasvārasyābhāvaṃ vakṣyan śrutyantarāsvārasyajñāpanāya pradhānaviṣayaṃ vākyajātamudāhartumāha - atrāpi iti || adhyāsitā - adhiṣṭhitā | tanyate - samaṣṭirūpeṇa preryate vyaṣṭisṛṣṭyartham | atha tadantaryāmiparavākyajātamudāhartumāha - yadātmakāḥ iti | apare ca iti | iha ca vākyāntaraikārthyāt brahmātmakatvasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | tattvabhāvāt - tatvāvirbhāvāt | prakṛtyādayaḥ | ādi śabdena mahadādiḥ | viṣayamāha - śveta iti | svātantryeṇa iti| sṛjamānām iti kartari śānac | svatantraḥ kartā iti bhāvaḥ || evaṃ prāpte'bhidhīyate - camasavadaviśeṣāt | ... .... ato'nena mantreṇa nābrahmātmikā ajā abhidhīyate || 8 || rāddhānte pratijñā'dhyāhartavyā | camasaḥ - camanasādhanam | ajātvamātraśravaṇaṃ brahmātmakasya prāmāṇikatve tadavirodhītyarthaḥ | na cāsyāḥ iti | nirupapadatvānna svātantryeṇa sṛṣṭitvapratītirityarthaḥ || 8 || brahmātmakājāgrahaṇa eva viśeṣaheturastītyāha - jyotirupakramā tu tathā hyadhīyata eke || 1-4-9 || tu śabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ ... ... tasyā eva pratīternāsmin mantre tantrasiddhasvatantraprakṛtipratipattigandhaḥ || 9 || anantarasūtramavatārayati - brahmātmaka iti | jyotirupakramā tu tathā hyadhīyata eke | nātra mantre utpattipratītirityatrāha - sarvasya iti | prayājādīnāmaṅgatvavaditi bhāvaḥ | anyena iti na muktakīrtanam sṛṣṭiprakaraṇavicchedāt; kiṃ tu tadviśeṣaṇatvena | yasmājjātā na parā naiva kiṃcanāsa iti uttaratra sṛṣṭyanuvṛtteriti bhāvaḥ | iyaṃ ca kṛtvācintā ihāpi ityādinā svaśākhāyāmeva brahmātmakatvakhyāpanāt || 9 || kathaṃ tarhi jyotirupakramāyā ... ... kalpanopadeśācca madhvādivadavirodhaḥ || 1-4-10 || prasaktāśaṅkānivṛttyarthaścaśabdaḥ | ... ... saṃbandhayogyacchāgatvaparikalpana matyantaviruddham || 10 || anantarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - kathaṃ tarhi iti | kalpanopadeśācca madhvādivadavirodhaḥ | caḥ tvarthaḥ | jyotiḥkalpana śabdau vedanirdeśānusārāt saṃprasādāt itivat | sūtrakhaṇḍaṃ vyācaṣṭe - madhu iti | udayāstamayamadhutvaklṛptitadabhāvayoriva avasthābhedādavirodha ityarthaḥ || sūtradvayasya paroktārthaṃ dūṣayituṃ prathamasyaitaduktārtham anye tu ityādinānūditaṃ vikalpayati - kim iti | ajātvaikatvasiddhyarthaṃ madhyamaśira uktiḥ| pratyekam iti na samudāyaikatvam | samudāyatrikamevetyarthaḥ | dvitīyaṃ vikalpayati - dvitīya iti | kiṃ tejobannarūpā avasthā ajāśabdoktāḥ, uta svarūpamiti vikalpaḥ | dvitīye'pi iti śrutyasvārasyamuktam| sūtrāsvārasyamāha - tejo'banna iti | jyotirupakrama śabdaḥ tejobannavācīti hi paraiḥ vyākhyātam | prāthamikavikalpeṣu tṛtīyaṃ dūṣayati - tṛtīye'pi iti || atha tṛtīyasūtrasya paroktārthamanūdya vyudasyati - yat punaḥ ityādinā | mukhyārthe saṃbhavati gauṇasvīkārāyogāt prayojanābhāvāt arthavirodhāt ātmānaṃ rathinam itivat rūpyarūpakavāciśabdābhāvāt gauranādyantavatī itivat ucitaviśeṣaṇābhāvāt prayojanasādhanatvādimātravivakṣāyāmasvārasyāt tasya ca padāntarasvārasyārthābhāvācca chāgatvaklṛptirayuktetyarthaḥ | asmaduktārthastu vaidikanirdeśānusāriṇāṃ svarasa eva || 10 || iti camasādhikaraṇam -2 <3. saṃkhyopasaṃgrahādhikaraṇam ||> na saṃkhyopasaṅgrahādapi nānābhāvādatirekācca || 1-4-11 || vājasaneyinaḥ samāmananti - yasmin pañca pañcajanāḥ ... .... pañcasaṃkhyākā viśeṣyante, pañca pañcajanā iti, sapta saptarṣaya itivat || 11 || na saṃkhyopasaṅgrahādapi nānābhāvādatirekācca | prakṛterbrahmātmakatvaṃ sādhitam | tadatrāyuktam | paramātmaparatve saṃkhyādhikyāditi śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ | pañcaśabdadvayāt daśasaṃkhyā syāt | samasaṃkhyāparaśabdayoḥ kathaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ, kathaṃ ca kāpilatantrārthasiddhirityatrāha - etaduktam iti | ātmākāśābhyāṃ saptaviṃśatipratītiḥ sattvarajastamasāṃ pṛthagdravyatvābhyupagamāt yukteti bhāvaḥ || rāddhānte nānātvaṃ - pṛthaktvam anyatvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ, na tu bahutvam | vinā nā hiruk pṛthak iti paryāyapāṭhāt | kālasya vastvantaraviśeṣaṇatve ṣaḍrviśatvam; vastvantaravivakṣāyāṃ saptaviṃśatvam | pañcasu iti | ekopādhigṛhītatvaṃ hi samūhatvam | tannetyarthaḥ | śābdadūṣaṇamuktam anyathā iti | sattvādīnāṃ dravyatvamasiddham, guṇatvāt || 11 || ke punaste pañcajanā ityata āha - prāṇādayo vākyaśeṣāt || 1-4-12 || prāṇasya prāṇamuta cakṣuṣaścakṣuḥ ... .... prāṇādaya eva pañca pañcajanāḥ iti vijñāyante || 12 || uttarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - ke punaḥ iti | prāṇādayo vākyaśeṣāt | spaṣṭam || 12 || atha syāt - kāṇvānāṃ mādhyandinānāṃ ca ... jyotiṣaikeṣāmasatyanne || 1-4-13 || ekeṣāṃ kāṇvānāṃ pāṭhe ... ... na kāpilatantrasiddhatattvapratītiriti sthitam || 13 || anantarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - atha syāt iti | jyotiṣaikeṣāmasatyanne | kathaṃ vākyaśeṣe catuṣṭayoktiḥ ityatrāha - teṣām iti | jyotiṣā ityasya ko'rtha? kathaṃ cendriyāvagama ityatrāha - etaduktam iti | jyotiṣā iti śabdasvarūpanirdeśaḥ | jyotiḥśabdena pradarśanāyogāt | ayaṃ siddhānte'pi tulyaḥ | indriyaprakaraṇaṃ padatrayasvārasyaprābalyaṃ ca jñāpayituṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ svaśabdena vyākhyānam | pañcatvaṃ nirdeśāpekṣayā | jyotiṣṭvapañcatvamanoyogapariśeṣaiḥ tantropādānaniścayaḥ | phalitamāha - tadevam iti | dvidhā parihāroktiprayojanaṃ vadan nigamayati - ataḥ iti || 13 || iti saṃkhyopasaṃgrahādhikaraṇam -3 <4. kāraṇatvādhikaraṇam ||> kāraṇatvena cākāśādiṣu yathā vyapadiṣṭokteḥ || 1-4-14 || punaḥ pradhānakāraṇavādī pratyavatiṣṭhate ... ... ato brahmaikakāraṇaṃ jagaditi niścīyate || 14 || pradhānakāraṇatvaṃ nirastam | tadayuktamityutthānāt saṅgatiḥ | kāraṇatvena cākāśādiṣu yathāvyapadiṣṭokteḥ | ekasmāt - ekarūpāt | brahmaṇi iva iti vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ || rāddhānte - tvarthena caśabdena phalitāṃ pratijñāmāha - sarvajñāt iti | yathā vyapadiṣṭam iti śrutau vyapadiṣṭatvavyāvṛttyarthamāha - janmādi iti | ākāśādiṣu - ākāśādīnām || 14 || nanu - asadvā idamagra āsīt ... ... samākarṣāt || 1-4-15 || asadvā idamagra āsīt ityatrāpi ... ... ato brahmaikakāraṇaṃ jagaditi sthitam || 15 || samākarṣāt | brahmaṇā vipaścitā ityādivākyānyabhipretya vipaścittvā dikamuktam | spaṣṭam | pradhānasyāpi kāryānupraveśo yukta ityatrāha - antaḥ praviṣṭa iti | anyena vyākṛtatvaśaṅkāvyāvṛttyarthaṃ vyācaṣṭe - tadeva avibhakta iti || 15 || iti kāraṇatvādhikaraṇam - 4 <5. jagadvācitvādhikaraṇam ||> jagadvācitvāt || 1-4-16 || punarapi sāṃkhyaḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate - yadyapi ... ... cetanadharmā asminnevopapadyante ityetadadhiṣṭhitaṃ pradhānameva jagatkāraṇam || jagadvācitvāt | saṅgatimāha - yadyapi iti | na arthāntaram - na īśvara ityarthaḥ | pūrvādhikaraṇa īkṣatyadhikaraṇākṣepāt iha ānandamayādhikaraṇākṣepaḥ phalitaḥ | tattadutpattihetukarmavatvaṃ hi kartṛtvam | ataḥ puruṣāṇāṃ kartā ityukte yasya vaitat karma ityuktivaiyarthyaṃ syāt | baddhasvarūpaṃ ca nopadeśyamityatrāha - tadayamartha iti | kṛtimattvaṃ kartṛtvam | śuddhasvarūpamaviditam | karmasaṃbandhastūpalakṣaṇamityarthaḥ | etasmādātmanaḥ prāṇāḥ iti | prāṇaśabdaḥ prañcavṛttiprāṇaparaḥ pūrvapakṣe | asmin prāṇe iti | prāṇa śabdasya lākṣaṇikatvavyudāsāya yojanāntaramāha - athavā iti | paramātmaparatvamāśaṃkyāha prāṇaśabdasya iti || iti prāpte pracakṣmahe - jagadvācitvāt | ... prasiddhaṃ paraṃ brahmaivātra veditavyatayopadiśyate || 16 || rāddhānte - svapakṣe kartrādiśabdasvārasyopapādakaviśeṣaṇāni vadan pratijānīte - atra ityādinā | aviditatvaṃ karmasaṃbandharahitasvarūpasya bhavatītyatrāha - puruṣasya iti | karmasaṃbandha vāciśabdasya tadrahitasvarūpaparatve lakṣaṇetyarthaḥ | jagadvācitve yuktyantaramāha - yasya iti | pṛthaṅnirdeśaprayojanamāha - ya eteṣām iti | jagadutpatteḥ iti | kulālasya hi ghaṭakartṛtvaṃ na ghaṭaviniyogādṛṣṭavataḥ iti bhāvaḥ | prasiddham iti | yacchabdanirdeśāt yato vā imāni itivat prasiddhaṃ kāraṇamanūdyaveditavyatvavidhirityarthaḥ || 16 || jīvamukhyaprāṇaliṅgānneti cet tadvyākhyātam || 1-4-17 || atha yaduktam - jīvaliṅgāt mukhyaprāṇasaṅkīrtanācca ... ... prāṇaśarīrakabrahmopāsanārthaṃ prāṇasaṅkīrtanaṃ liṅgaṃ yujyate || 17 || atha uparitanavākyagatahetumanūdya prativakti - jīvamukhyaprāṇaliṅgānneti cet tavdyākhyātam | pratardanavidyāyāṃ kathaṃ parihṛtaṃ, tatrātideṣṭavyāṃśaḥ kaḥ, sa ca kathaṃ ghaṭata ityatrāha - etaduktam iti | varṇanīyāni ityantena atideṣṭavyāṃśa uktaḥ | na tūpāsanārthatvamatyatideṣṭavyamityarthaḥ | ata eva hi jīvaliṅgasya tadarthatvānuktiḥ || 17 || jīvaliṅgānāṃ punaḥ kathaṃ brahmaparatvamityatrāha - anyārthaṃ tu jaiminiḥ praśnavyākhyānābhyāmapi caivameke || 1-4-18 || tu śabdo jīvasaṅkīrtanena vākyasya ... ... kāraṇatvaṃ kvacidapi vedānte pratīyata iti sthitam || 18 || uttarasūtrasya śaṅkāmāha - jīvaliṅgānām iti | anyārthaṃ tu jaiminiḥ praśnavyākhyānābhyāmapi caivameke || tuśabda ityādi | na tu matāntareṇa nirvāhāntaraparaḥ | api tu pūrvapakṣāt vyāvṛttyarthaḥ ityarthaḥ | kvaiṣaḥ kva vā iti praśnadvayaṃ svapnasuṣuptisthānaviṣayam | prāṇāḥ jīvāḥ | nāḍīnām iti | yadā suptaḥ ityasmāt pūrvabhāvitayā svapnapare pūrvavākye nāḍīvacanāditi bhāvaḥ | vijñānena vijñānamādāya - manasā saha jñānamādāya uparatavyāpāraṃ manaḥ pratīndriyamityarthaḥ | paramātmaguṇatatsāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvāt jīvaśruteḥ upāsanārthatvānuktiḥ | jīvaliṅganirvāhamupasaṃharati - ataḥ iti | vedāntānāṃ prakṛtipuruṣaparatvāsiddhimupasaṃharati - tasmāt iti || 18 || iti jagadvācitvādhikaraṇam - 5 <6. vākyānvayādhikaraṇam ||> vākyānvayāt || 1-4-19 || atrāpi kāpilatantrasiddhapuruṣatattvāvedanaparaṃ ... ... tantrasiddhaṃ puruṣamevābhidadhatīti tadadhiṣṭhitā prakṛtireva jagadupādānam, neśvaraḥ iti || vākyānvayāt | karmavaśyavācipadena tadrahitasvarūpoktiḥ lākṣaṇikīti jīvaparatvaṃ nirastam | atra tu baddhamuktasādhāraṇātmaśabdaśravaṇāt muktaliṅgaśravaṇācca tatparatvaṃ yuktamiti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ | pūrvamevātra na karmasaṃbandho'nyathā neyaḥ bhoktṛtvaśravavaṇāditi vā śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ | vijñātāram iti jīvaliṅgā nugṛhītatvāt vijñātṛśabdo jīvapara iti bhāvaḥ | spaṣṭam || evaṃ prāpte pracakṣmahe - vākyānvayāt iti | sarveśvara eva ... ... guṇāḥ paramātmana eva saṃbhavanti | ataḥ sa evātra pratipādyate || rāddhānte - samañjasaḥ - svārasikaḥ | svārasyaṃ ca sajātīya śrutyantaraikārthyamityabhiprāyeṇāha - tameva iti | prajāpativākyādyaikārthyāt svārasyamityatrāha - paramapuruṣa iti | pradhānārthaparavākyaikārthyaṃ svārasyamityarthaḥ . upakramasvārasyaṃ darśitam; uparitanānāṃ kāraṇatvapratijñānaikyopadeśaparavākyānāṃ sāmañjasyaṃ darśayati - tathā ityādi | etat ayam iti śrutisthedaṃśabdasthāne bhāṣye etat śabdaḥ | jīvasyaikyopadeśāt anupapatiṃta darśayati - na hi idaṃśabdavācyam ityādinā | sthūlasūkṣmacidaciccharīratvābhāvānna kāryeṇa jagadaikyasaṃbhava ityarthaḥ | ata eva - sarvasya paramātmakatvādeva || yattūktaṃ patijāyāputravittapaśvādipriyānvayino ... ... sa paramātmaiva draṣṭavya ityupadiśyate || yat tu ityādi | kathamananvayaḥ, kathaṃ vā tasyāniṣṭatvamityatrāha ātmā vā iti | pūrvavākyasyātmano draṣṭavyatvopayogitvaṃ svarasataḥ pratīyate ityarthaḥ | jīvaparatve'nanvayamupapādayati - ātmana iti tyādinā | śrutau priya śabdo bhogārhatvaparaḥ | kāmāya - prītyai | na patyādiśeṣatayā patyādīnāṃ prayatvam iti | patyādīnāṃ bhogārhatvaṃ na patyādiprītihetutayā, kintu svaprītihetutayā, ityarthaḥ | vākyabhedaḥ - mahāvākyabhedaḥ | so'yam ityādi| svayaṃ niratiśayānandaḥ san iti | svāśritānandāvahasya svayaṃ niratiśayānandatvamarthasiddhamiti bhāvaḥ | śrutyantareṣu tathā spaṣṭatvācca | upadiśyate ityantena tātparyārtha uktaḥ || tadayamarthaḥ - na vā are patyuḥ kāmāya patiḥ priyo bhavati ... ... ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ iti pūrvoktaprakriyayobhayatrātmaśabdāvekaviṣayau || 19 || kathamasya śābdatvamityatrāha - tadayamarthaḥ iti | jīvaparatve'pyanvayo ghaṭate | svaprītaye svātantryāt patyādīnāmupādānaṃ cet nānityānandapatyādyanubhavāya pravarteta, kiṃ tu nityānandasvarūpānubhavāya pravarteta iti śaṅkāyāṃ dvitīyaṃ nirvāhamāha - jīvātmaparatve'pi iti | jīvādapyatiśayānandatvāt paramātmaprāptau pravarteta ityartha ucitatara ityarthaḥ | tarhi ayameva nirvāhaḥ syāditi śaṅkāyāmāha - asmiṃstu iti | paramātmana eva abhidhānāt iti vakṣyamāṇasūtraprakāreṇetyarthaḥ | samādhibhedāyogo hetutayā vivakṣitaḥ | ata eva prathamasya ātma śabdasya sadvārakatvaṃ cāsvarasam | tasmādadvārakabrahmaviṣayau pūrvottaravākyasthātmaśabdau||19|| matāntareṇāpi jīvaśabdena paramātmābhidhānopapādanāyāha - pratijñāsiddherliṅgamāśmarathyaḥ || 1-4-10 || ekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñāsiddheḥ ... ... ato jīvaśabdena paramātmābhidhānamiti || 20 || anantarasūtramavatārayati - matāntareṇa iti | pratijñāsiddherliṅgamāśmarathyaḥ | pratijñopapādakakāryakāraṇabhāvakṛtaikyasiddherityarthaḥ || 20 || utkramiṣyata evaṃbhāvādityauḍulomiḥ || 1-4-21 || yaduktaṃ jīvasya brahmakāryatayā brahmaṇaikyena ... ... jīvaśabdena paramātmano'bhidhānamityauḍulomirācāryo manyate sma || 21 || utkramiṣyata evaṃbhāvādityauḍulomiḥ | pūrvāviruddhamatodayāyogāt sūtrābhipretaṃ prāktanamatadūṣaṇamāha - yaduktam ityādinā | spaṣṭam || avasthiteriti kāśakṛtsnaḥ || 1-4-22 || yaduktam - utkramiṣyato jīvasya brahmabhāvāt ... ... na puruṣastadadhiṣṭhitā ca prakṛtiriti sthitam || 22 || avasthiteriti kāśakṛtsnaḥ| spaṣṭam | kāśakṛtsnamatavaiṣamyamāha evam iti | svīkṛtavān iti | evaṃ vādarāyaṇaḥ iti matāntarākathanāt asya sāmañjasyācca iti bhāvaḥ || iha prakaraṇe jīvavācipadaṃ kim, tena parasyābhidhānaṃ kathamityatrāha ayamatra iti | protsāhanāya iti | svarūpasya prāpyatvajñānāt pravṛttiradhikā syāt ityarthaḥ | ekīkṛtya iti | samityekīkāre iti bhāvaḥ | yatra hi ityādi | tat kena kam iti atadātmakadraṣṭṛdṛśyatatsādhananiṣedhaḥ || yena idam iti vākyaṃ tatprasādādṛte tasya duravagamatvaparam | vijñātāram iti vākyamuktopāyādṛte tatprasādanasya durlabhatvaparam | upasaṃharati - ataḥ iti || 22|| iti vākyānvayādhikaraṇam -6 <7. prakṛtyadhikaraṇam ||> prakṛtiśca pratijñādṛṣṭāntānuparodhāt || 1-4-23 || evaṃ nirīśvarasāṃkhye niraste sati seśvarasāṃkhyaḥ ... ... nopādānam | upādānaṃ tu tadadhiṣṭhitaṃ pradhānameva iti || prakṛtiśca pratijñādṛṣṭāntānuparodhāt | saṅgatimāha - evam iti | śrutyarthāpattimāha - evamaśrute'pi iti | śruteranugrāhakatarkamāha evameva iti | vaijātye'pi vṛściko gomayaṃ vā vṛścikopādānaṃ, tathā prakṛtirvā īśvaro vā jagadupādānaṃ syāt, ekaikasya kāraṇatvaśruterityatrāha kāryaniṣpattiśca iti | śrutipratipannaṃ kathaṃ tyājyamityatrāha - evamiti | tarkānugṛhītavākyamitarasmāt prabalam | itarat tu yūpādityaikyavākyavat ityarthaḥ || evaṃ prāpte'bhidhīyate - prakṛtiśca pratijñādṛṣṭāntānuparodhāt iti | ... .... vikārajananīmajñām ajāmekām ityādibhirabhidhīyate iti || rāddhānte pradhānasvabhāvavyāvṛttyarthamuktam - upādānaṃ ca iti | cārthaṃvadan vākyārthamāha - na nimitta iti | vijñātameva syāt ityantena hetuvācipadaṃ vivṛtam | vaiśeṣikamatena pratijñānupapattimāśaṅkya pariharan vākyārthamāha - kāraṇameva iti || nimittāntarāśaṅkāṃ parihartuṃ yattu iti paroktamanūdya vyudasyati tadasat iti | upadeśatatkarmatvavyudāsāya prakṛtipratyayau vyācaṣṭe praśiṣyate'nena iti | anyatarāsvārasyasāmye'pi arthaucityamadhikamāha etasya iti | śāsitṛtvaṃ hyasādhāraṇam | akartrarthapratyayāntatvamāśaṅkyāha sādhaka iti | vivakṣātaḥ kārakāṇi iti nyāyāditi bhāvaḥ || kāraṇavākye'pi nimittopādanaikyaṃ darśayati - sadeva iti | prakṛtiśabdena - prakṛtivācakaśabdena | anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ tadātmakatvaparaṃ sarvaṃ khalu yatra tu iti vākyadvayam | brahmavyatiriktaṃ nāsti cet vikārāpuruṣārthau brahmaṇi syātāmityatrāha - etaduktam iti | tarhi kāryakāraṇadaśayoḥ ko bheda ityatrāha - kadācit iti | tataḥ kiṃ prakṛtasyetyatrāha evaṃ sarvadā iti || nanu ca mahānavyakte līyate avyaktamakṣare līyate ... ... ato brahmaiva jagato nimittamupādānaṃ ca || 23 || sūkṣmāvasthasyāpyutpattimukhena codayati - nanu ca iti | avyaktāvasthāyā api sūkṣmāvasthāsaṃbhavāt | tadavasthācidviśiṣṭaṃ brahmāvyaktakāraṇamiti | pariharati naiṣa iti | tatra pramāṇamāha - yadā tamaḥ iti| ata eva - tamaḥśabdavācyācitastadā sadbhāvādeva | pṛthivītvādivat tamastvāvasthāprahāṇena paramātmadravyaṃ bhavati cet, layaśabdaḥ śrūyeta; na ca śrutaḥ | ataḥ tamastasmin sthitamityarthaḥ | vastubhedasadbhāve'pyanudbhūtatvāt eka śabdo yuktaḥ, yathā vahnigarbhe dāruṇi, yathā cāntarvatyām | idaṃ tamobhūtam ityanenāvasthāntarāpattireva layaḥ, na tu dravyavināśa iti sphuṭam agnyavasthe ca salile ityādinā ca || yat tu ityādinā paroktasya satarkaśrutiprābalyasya parihāra ucyate | mṛdādeḥ iti | kevalanimittatve kevalopādānatve bahukārakāpekṣatve ca asārvajñyāsarvaśaktitvāsatyasaṅkalpatvādyupādhayaḥ ityarthaḥ || 23 || abhidhyopadeśācca || 1-4-24 || itaścobhayaṃ brahmaiva - so'kāmayata ... ... saṅkalpapūrvikā hi sṛṣṭirupadiśyate || 24 || abhidhyopadeśācca | sphuṭam || 24|| sākṣāccobhayāmnānāt || 1-4-25 || na kevalaṃ pratijñādṛṣṭāntābhidhyopadeśādibhiḥ .... brahmaivopādānamupakaraṇāni ceti parihṛtam | ataścobhayaṃ brahma || 25 || sākṣāccobhayāmnānāt | praśnaprativacanarūpeṇoktiphalamāha - atra hi iti || 25 || ātmakṛteḥ || 1-4-26 || so'kāmayata bahu syāṃ prajāyeya iti ... svayamevātmānaṃ tathā'kuruta iti nimittamupādānaṃ ca || 26 || ātmakṛteḥ | svasya kartṛtvaṃ viruddham | siddhaḥ kartā sādhyaṃ kāryamiti ekasya siddhyasiddhivirodhamāśaṅkyākārabhedena pariharati - avibhakta iti | ākāryaikyānnimittopādānaikyamāha - svayameva iti || satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma, ānando brahma ... ... pariṇāmāt || 1-4-27 || pariṇāmasvābhāvyāt; nātropadiśyamānasya ... ... anāditvādupapadyate cāpyupalabhyate ca iti || anantarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - satyaṃ jñānam iti | pariṇāmāt | pariṇāmāt ityukte tasya virodhihetutvameva ityāśaṅkyāha pariṇāmasvābhāvyāt iti | svabhāva eva hi virodhaheturityatrāha - nātra iti | kathamityapekṣāyām uktaṃ vivṛṇoti - evameva hi iti | tattvakramasṛṣṭivat tadupayogiguṇavacca anuktaṃ sadvārakatvamanyato grāhyamiti darśayan pradhānaviṣayaśrutīnāṃ paraparyantatāmāha - aśeṣa iti | svaśarīratayā api iti eka śabdavyākhyānam | uktārthe mānamāha - tathaiva iti | āvaraṇatvāt tamaḥ anarthamūlatvāt mṛtyuḥ svarūpaikyavyāvṛttyarthamāha - avibhāga iti || evaṃ svasmādvibhāgavyapadeśānarhatayā paramātmanā ... ... ato brahmaiva jagato nimittamupādānaṃ ca || 27 || udāhṛtaśrutisiddhamarthamāha - evaṃ svasmāt iti | tataḥ kiṃ prastutavirodhasya iti śaṅkāyām, avirodhena paścāt vyākhyātuṃ virodhasphorakametatprakaraṇasthavākyamādatte - satyaṃ jñānam iti | vyākhyeyapadāni vyācaṣṭe atra iti | tapa ālocane iti dhātuḥ || śrutyantarānugṛhīte tatprakaraṇavākyānāmarthamāha - tadayamartha iti | udāhṛtavākyeṣu ghaṭakavākyasyārthamāha - tadeva iti | kathaṃ virodhaḥ parihṛta ityatrāha - evam iti | kāryatvadoṣāsaṅkaraṃ cāha - paramātmani ityādinā | avāptakāmalīlāsṛṣṭau mānamāha - sarvāṇi iti | pūrvapakṣyupāttaśrutyarthamāha - asmāt iti spaṣṭam | idaṃ sūtraṃ mṛṣāvādināṃ viruddham | bhedābhedapakṣe'pi bhogyāṃśena pariṇāmaḥ | asmanmate tu viśeṣaṇāṃśena iti asvārasyaṃ tulyam | śrutyantaropapattyānuguṇyaṃ tvadhikamiti vaiṣamyam || 27 || yoniśca hi gīyate || 1-4-28 || itaśca jagato nimittamupādānaṃ ca brahma ... ... yathorṇanābhiḥ sṛjate gṛhṇate ca iti vākyaśeṣādavagamyate || 28 || yoniśca hi gīyate | spaṣṭam || 28 || iti prakṛtyadhikaraṇam - 7 <8. sarvavyākhyānādhikaraṇam ||> etena sarve vyākhyātā vyākhyātāḥ || 1-4-29 || etena - pādacatuṣṭayoktanyāyakalāpena ... .... vyākhyātāḥ iti padābhyāso'dhyāyaparisamāptidyotanārthaḥ || 29 || iti sarvavyākhyānādhikaraṇam - 8 iti śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracite śārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣye prathamasyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ || || samāptaścādhyāyaḥ || etena sarve vyākhyātā vyākhyātāḥ | pūrvādhikaraṇaśeṣatva vyudāsāyāha - pāda iti || indrādisṛṣṭi hiraṇyagarbharudrādīnāṃ kāraṇatvaṃ saṃbhavati ityadhikāśaṅkā | teṣāmapi paramātmasṛjyatvasaṃhāryatvaśravaṇāviśeṣāt atharvaśiraḥprabhṛtayaḥ taccharīrakaparamātmaparāḥ iti parihāraḥ padābhyāsa prayojanamāha - vyākhyātāḥ iti || 29 || iti sarvavyākhyānādhikaraṇam -8 iti śrīharitakulatilakavāgvijayisūnunā śrīraṅgarājadivyājñālabdhavedavyāsāparanāmadheyena śrīmadvaradācāryapādasevāsamadhigataśrībhagavadrāmānujaviracitaśārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣyahṛdayena śrīsudarśanasūriṇā vilikhitāyāṃ śrutapradīpikāyāṃ prathamasyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ || || samāptaścādhyāyaḥ || dvitīyādhyāye prathamaḥ pādaḥ || <1. smṛtyadhikaraṇam ||> smṛtyanavakāśadoṣaprasaṅga iti cennānyasmṛtyanavakāśadoṣaprasaṅgāt || 2-1-1 || prathame'dhyāye pratyakṣādipramāṇagocarāt ... ... tadidamāśaṅkate - smṛtyanavakāśadoṣaprasaṅga iti cet - iti || smṛtyanavakāśadoṣaprasaṅga iti cennānyasmṛtyanavakāśadoṣaprasaṅgāt | saṅgatyarthaṃ prāthamikārthasugrahārthaṃ ca prathamādhyāyārthamanuvadati - prathama iti | dvitīyārthamāha - anantaram iti | samasta iti | tattatpādanirasanīyatarkarvaividhyaṃ vivakṣitam | ayogānyayogavyavacchedena brahmakāraṇatvaṃ nirūpitaṃ prathame | dvitīye tu virodhaḥ parihniyate ityarthaḥ || dvitīyādyapratipādyamāha - prathamam iti | utthānamākṣipati katham iti| pariharati - satyam iti | audumbaryādivākyeṣu śrutinyāyānapekṣaṃ śrutyarthasya niścitvāt tadviruddhasmṛsyanādaro yuktaḥ | iha tu śrutivaividhyāt śrutyarthe saṃśayyamāne, tadviroghena smṛtityāgāyogāt vicāro yukta ityarthaḥ || kapilasya maharṣitve kiṃ mānam? satyapi tasmin bṛhaspatyādyuktalokāyatādivat kiṃ na syāt? uktaprāthamikanyāyato nirṇītatvāt na ca smṛtyapekṣetyatrāha - etaduktam iti | abhyupagacchatā ityantena lokāyatādivyāvṛttiruktā | ṛṣim iti mānoktiḥ | smṛtyupabṛṃhaṇam smṛtirūpobṛṃhaṇam | alpaśrutaiḥ ityādinā tadapekṣā darśitā | na ca nyāyata smṛtyanapekṣatā, vacanavirodhe nyāyadaurbalyāditi bhāvaḥ | sakalāyāḥ iti manvādismṛtivyāvṛttiḥ | tāsāṃ sāvakāśatvāt | asyāścāptapraṇītāyā anavakāśatvamayuktam | pūrvapakṣasyānutsūtratvamāha - tadidam iti || tatrottaram - nānyasmṛtyanavakāśaśeṣaprasaṅgāt iti | anyā hi ...tatpraṇītena lokāyatena śrutyarthavyasthāpanaprasakteḥ - iti || 1 || parihārakhaṇḍamavatārayati - tatrottaram iti | sarvakarmārādhyatvāya kāryabhūtasarvadevatātmatvasiddhaye paramakāraṇatvaṃ vaktuṃ sṛṣṭeḥ pūrvatvāt pralayadaśā subālaśrutyanusāreṇocyate - āsīt iti | idaṃ - jagat, tamobhūtam tamovastham āsīt; agnyavasthe ca salile itivat | aprajñātam prakṛṣṭarūpapratyakṣajñānāgocaraḥ | kutaḥ? alakṣaṇam; śabdasparśarūpādilakṣaṇarahitatvādityarthaḥ | kāryaguṇasiddhyarthaṃ kāraṇenāpi viśeṣaguṇavatā bhāvyamityatrāha - apratarkyam - tarkāgocaraḥ | avijñeyam - vibhajya jñātumaśakyam | tama ekībhavati ityuktāvibhaktāvasthamityarthaḥ || svarūpaikyaśaṅkāṃ vyudasyati prasuptamiva | suṣuptāviva pṛthagvyavahārā narhātisūkṣmāvasthāpannam | svāpādvaiṣamyamāha - sarvataḥ iti | tataḥ - sargakāle prāpte | svayaṃbhūḥ iti kāraṇāntaravattvavyudāsaḥ | bhagavān iti | sṛṣṭyupayogiguṇapauṣkalyadevatāviśeṣoktiḥ yogarūḍhibhyām | idaṃ - vyaṣṭi kāryaṃ vyañjayitum mahābhūtānāmādibhūtamahadahaṅkāraviṣayapravṛttasvasaṅkalparūpajñānaḥ tadarthaṃ tamaḥ prerayan avyaktāvasthaprakṛtiśarīrakaḥ prādurāsīt | akṣarāvasthā'pyarthasiddhā || svarūpapariṇāmanibandhananirdoṣatvādivirodhaśaṅkāvyudāsāyāha - śarīrāt svāt iti | ap - śabdo'ṇḍakāraṇatattvapradarśanārthaḥ | mahābhūtādivṛttaujāḥ ityuktatvāt | vīryam - trivṛtkaraṇajanitāmaṇḍotpādanaśakiṃta ; tadabhāve nāśaknuvan prajāḥ sraṣṭum iti hyuktam | āsīdidam ityādisaptaślokyanusandheyā | ahaṃ kṛtsnasya ityādi sphuṭam || manvādismṛtayaḥ sāvakāśāḥ, kapilaścāptaḥ | upabṛṃhaṇaṃ cāpekṣitamityuktam | kathaṃ tatsmṛtiṃ hitvā smṛtyantaramādīyata ityatrāha - ayamartha iti | bhūtārtha iti | siddhārtha ityarthaḥ | kāryarūpārtha iva vikalpo durvaca iti anyatamatyāgo'vaśyaṃbhāvīti bhāvaḥ | āptatama - śabdena yathāvaddarśanasahitayathādṛṣṭavāditvaṃ vivakṣitam | kapilasya ṛṣitvameva | atra āptimātram | yadvai manuravadat tadbheṣajam ityubhayaṃ manvādīnāmasti iti āptatamam | praṇītāḥ bahvyaḥ nyāyopetāśca iti vaiṣamyatrayamuktam | hetvantaraṃ cāha - upabṛṃhaṇaṃ ca iti || na ca ityādi sphuṭam | vidyāṅgakarmaṇāṃ hi bhagavadārādhanarūpatvaṃ, svargādiphalānāṃ tu tadabhāvāt ārādhyabhūtabrahmaṇi na tātparyamityatrāha na caihika iti | spaṣṭam || yaduktam ityādi | śrutiprāmāṇyāṅgīkāre'pi śrutyarthavirodhasyānādaraṇīyatve prayojakatvāt tat kāpilalokāyatamatayoraviśiṣṭamiti tyājyatvamityarthaḥ || 1 || atha syāt - kapilasya svayogamahimnā ... .... itareṣāṃ cānupalabdheḥ || 2-1-2 || caśabdastuśabdārthaḥ ..... ... na tayā yathokto vedāntārthaścālayituṃ śakya iti siddham || 2 || uttarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - atha syāt iti | manvādīnāṃ dharmapravartanānyaparatvāt na yogāvasara iti bhāvaḥ | itareṣāṃ cānupalabdheḥ | bahūnāmupalabdhibhiḥ ekopalabdheḥ bhrāntitvaniścayaḥ | dharmānuṣṭhānaparatvaṃ tu manonairmalyaheturiti manvādyupalabdhiprābalyahetuḥ | tadrāhityaṃ manomālinyāt bhrāntitvāvahamityarthaḥ ||2 || iti smṛtyadhikaraṇam -1 <2. yogapratyuktyadhikaraṇam ||> etena yogaḥ pratyuktaḥ || 2-1-3 || etena - kāpilasmṛtinirākaraṇena ... ... na tayā vedāntopabṛṃhaṇaṃ nyāyyam iti || 3 || etena yogaḥ pratyuktaḥ | akṣarārthamuktvā śaṅkāyāṃ tātparyārthamāha yoga iti | abrahmātmaka iti | tattvavaiṣamyamuktam | dhyānātmakasya ityanuṣṭhānavaiṣamyam || 3 || iti yogapratyuktyadhikaraṇam -2 <3. vilakṣaṇatvādhikaraṇam ||> na vilakṣaṇatvādasya tathātvaṃ ca śabdāt || 2-1-4 || punarapi smṛtivirodhavādī tarkamavalambamānaḥ ... naitadevam, yatastatrāpyacetanāṃśa eva kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ || 4|| na vilakṣaṇatvādasya tathātvaṃ ca śabdāt | manvādismṛtibhirvedānāmupabṛṃhaṇaṃ kāryamityuktam | tāstarkaviruddhāḥ | tarkānugṛhītasāṃkhyasmṛtyaiva kāryamiti pratyavasthānāt saṅgatiḥ | sotraṃ na iti padaṃ vyācaṣṭe yat iti | asya iti vyākhyeyam | vilakṣaṇatvāt iti padaṃ vyācaṣṭe bhavadabhimata iti | tathātvam ityādisūtrakhaṇḍaṃ vyācaṣṭe na kevalam iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - yaddhi iti | śāstreṇa tarko bādhya ityatrāha avaśyaṃ ca iti | ananyāpekṣasya - pramāṇāntarānapekṣasya | na hi tarko mānam; ato'ṅgatvādapekṣita ityarthaḥ | kvacit kvacit - svato'spaṣṭārthaviṣayeṣu || tarkeṃṇa mānasya kiñcitkāramāha - tarko hi iti | śāstrasya tu iti tuśabdaḥ sādhyavaiṣamye | viśeṣeṇa iti sādhanavaiṣamye | svāpe caitanyānupalambhaḥ, tacchaktiyogaśca vedataditarābhimatau | kathaṃ brahmopādānatokteḥ ghaṭādau dhīniścayāpekṣetyatrāha - vilakṣaṇayorhi iti | yūpādityaikyavaditi bhāvaḥ | kiṃ punaḥ ityādinā vailakṣaṇyāsiddhirāśaṅkya parihṛtā | nanu ca ityādinā anaikāntyam || 4 || atha syāt - acetanatvenābhimatānāmapi ... ... abhimānivyapadeśastu viśeṣānugatibhyām || 2-1-5 || tu śabdaścoditāśaṅkānivṛttyarthaḥ ... ... jagataḥ pradhānopādānatvaṃ vedāntaiḥ pratipādyate - iti || 5 || anantarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - atha syāt iti | abhimānivyapadeśastu viśeṣānugatibhyām | coditāśaṅkānivṛttyarthaḥ, na tu pūrvapakṣavyudāsārtha iti bhāvaḥ | sphuṭam || 5 || evaṃ prāpte'bhidhīyate dṛśyate tu || 2-1-6 || tuśabdāt pakṣo viparivartate - ... ... mākṣikagomayakrimivṛścikādiṣu dṛśyate || 6 || dṛśyate tu | spaṣṭam | parābhimatasālakṣaṇyaṃ ca suvacam | cidacidviśiṣṭasya kāraṇatvasyaiva kāryatvācca | idānīṃ tu parābhimatasālakṣaṇyaniyamo bhagnaḥ || 6 || asaditi cenna pratiṣedhamātratvāt || 2-1-7 || yadi kāryabhūtāt jagataḥ kāraṇabhūtaṃ .... ... sati ca vailakṣaṇye kuṇḍalahiraṇyayoriva dravyaikyamastyeva || 7|| asaditi cenna pratiṣedhamātratvāt | pratyabhijñārhasālakṣaṇyaniyamaniṣiddhaḥ, na tu dravyaikyamityarthaḥ || 7 || atra codayati - apītau tadvatprasaṅgādasamañjasam || 2-1-8 || apītāvityapītipūrvakasṛṣṭyādeḥ .... .... brahmakāraṇavāde vedāntavākyānāmasāmañjasyam - iti || 8 || uttarasūtramavatārayati - atra iti | apītau tadvatprasaṅgādasamañjasam | sṛṣṭyādeḥ | ādiśabdāt sthitiḥ | siddhāntaṃ śaṅkate atha iti | ceṣṭāśrayatvamuktam pañcavṛtti iti | āyatana śabdaḥ sādhanaviśeṣaparaḥ | ata eva hi bhogasādhanamātrasya ityuktam | siddhāntyabhimatalakṣaṇaṃ dūṣayati - atha matam iti | avyāptimāha - śarīratayā iti | ativyāptimāha - sāla iti | pakṣaikadeśavyāptimāha - cetanasya iti | kriyādiṣu | ādi śabdāt guṇaḥ || 8 || atrottaram - na tu dṛṣṭāntabhāvāt || 2-1-9 || naivamasāmañjasyam - ekasyaiva ... ... sūtradvayena itaravyapadeśāt ityadhikaraṇasiddho'rthaḥ smāritaḥ|| 9 || na tu dṛṣṭāntabhāvāt | heyāsaṃbhave ko dṛṣṭānta ityatrāha etaduktam iti | amukhyatvamāśaṅkyāha - atha ca iti | apāmeva devatvādidharmāḥ, na puruṣasyetyatrāha - bhūtasūkṣma iti | so'bhidhyāya ityatra cidacitoraspaṣṭatvādāha - bhūtasūkṣmāt iti | āsīdidam ityādinā prakṛtatvāditi bhāvaḥ | loke ca ityādi | krimikīṭapataṅgādāvanugatatvāya hi tvayā ceṣṭāśrayatvādi lakṣaṇamuktam; na tu dvipāttvādi | anuyāyini saṃbhavati, ananugatasvīkārāyogāt | evaṃ laukikavaidikasarvaprayogānugatalakṣaṇe saṃbhavati, ananugatasvīkāreṇa kvacit gauṇatvāśrayaṇamayuktamiti bhāvaḥ | ataḥ - anuyāyino lakṣaṇatvāt, tvaduktasya cānanuyāyitvādityarthaḥ || anugatalakṣaṇamāha - yasya iti | ceṣṭāśrayatvādikaṃ tritayamananugatam; idaṃ tu lakṣaṇatrayamanugatam | yasya cetanasya yat dravyaṃ sarvātmanā svārthe niyantuṃ śkyaṃ tat tasya śarīram, yasya cetanasya yat dravyaṃ sarvātmanā svārthe dhārayituṃ śakyaṃ, tat tasya śarīram; yasya cetanasya yat dravyaṃ śeṣataikasvarūpaṃ ca, tat tasya śarīramiti vibhāgaḥ | svārthe svaviṣaye śakye'rthe | sarvātmanā - yāvaddravyabhāvitayā | etatsthāne tṛtīye ekaśabdaḥ | svārthaśakya śabdānapekṣaṇāt tṛtīyasya pṛthaguktiḥ | yasya iti - pitrādivat dehasya sapratiyogikavastutvaṃ darśitam | tāvatā pitrāderdehatvaṃ prasajedityuktaṃ niyāmyam iti | dravyam iti kriyādivyudāsaḥ | sarvātmanā iti ghaṭādivyāvṛttiḥ | manuṣyādīnāṃ gaganagamanāderaśakyatvāt asaṃbhavavyāvṛttyarthaṃ svārthe iti | śakyam iti rugṇadehādau avyāptivyudāsaḥ| cetanasya iti dharmabhūtajñānavyāvṛttiḥ | na hi tat jñānaviśiṣṭena niyāmyam | dvitīyatṛtīyayoḥ prabhāvyāvṛttiśca | tṛtīye tu eka śabdena gṛhādivyāvṛttiḥ . śarīratva prayuktadoṣamāśaṅkyāha - uparitana iti || 9 || svapakṣadoṣācca || 2-1-10 || na kevalaṃ brahmakāraṇavādasya .... abhyupagame'pyarthābhāvāt ityādinā prapañcayiṣyate || 10 || svapakṣadoṣācca | anabhyupagamāt - nityanirvikāratvopagamādityarthaḥ || 10 || tarkāpratiṣṭhānādapi || 2-1-11 || sarvasyāpratiṣṭhitatvādapi ... ... tarkāṇāmanyonyavyāghātāt tarkasyāpratiṣṭhitatvaṃ gamyate || 11 || tarkāpratiṣṭhānādapi | spaṣṭam || 11 || anyathā'numeyamiti cedevamapyanirmokṣaprasaṅgaḥ || 2-1-12 || idānīṃ vidyamānānāṃ śākyādīnāṃ ... ... vedārthaviśadīkaraṇa rūpavedopabṛṃhaṇatarkopādānāya sāṃkhyasmṛtirnādaraṇīyā || 12 || anyathā'numeyamiti cedevamapyanirmokṣaprasaṅgaḥ | bhūtasya bhūteneva bhāvino bhāvinā tarkāntareṇa pratihatiḥ saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ | vedaśāstra śabdavaiyadhikaraṇyena sāṃkhyānumatiśaṅkāvyudāsāyāha - vedākhya iti | vedaścakṣuḥ sanātanam ... ... vedaśāstramiti sthitiḥ iti prakaraṇāt || 12 || iti vilakṣaṇatvādhikaraṇam - 3 <4. śiṣṭāparigrahādhikaraṇam ||> etena śiṣṭāparigrahā api vyākhyātāḥ || 2-1-13 || śiṣṭāḥ pariśiṣṭāḥ, na vidyate ... ... visaṃvādadarśanāccāpratiṣṭhitatvameveti parihāraḥ || 13 || etena śiṣṭāparigrahā api vyākhyātāḥ | tṛtīyāsamāsavyudāsāya vyācaṣṭe - śiṣṭāḥ iti | karmadhārayatve hi sāṃkhyasya śiṣṭāparigrahatvasiddhiḥ | anekāntatvasatyāsatyātmakatvādi | ādi śabdāt cāturvidhyaikarūpye || 13 || iti śiṣṭāparigrahādhikaraṇam - 4 <5. bhoktrāpattyadhikaraṇam ||> bhoktrāpatteravibhāgaścet syāllokavat || 2-1-14 || punarapi sāṃkhyaḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate - yaduktaṃ .... ... svarūpapariṇāme ca brahmaṇa eva bhoktṛbhogyatvāpattiriti punarapyasāmañjasyameva || bhoktrāpatteravibhāgaścet syāllokavat | pūrvādhikaraṇe deho dṛṣṭāntitaḥ | tatprayuktabhoktṛtvaśaṅkāyā utthānāt saṅgatiḥ | nanu ca ityādi | anyagṛha iva kāryāntaravaśāt tyannidhau bhoktṛtvamiti pūrvatroktam | iha śarīrasvāmitve bhoktṛtvaṃ na nivāryate ityarthaḥ | sthaviratvādivikārāsaṃbhave'pi iti anena prāguktadṛṣṭāntaparihṛtāṃśa uktaḥ | aparihṛtāṃśamāha - śarīra iti | syāt lokavat iti | saśarīrasya kāraṇatve doṣaḥ parihṛtaḥ | kevalabrahmaṇaḥ kāraṇatve doṣamanupagamena prativakti mṛtsuvarṇa iti || yat tu ityādinā'nūditaṃ poktārthaṃ dūṣayati - tadayuktam iti | upādhiśca iti upādhiśabdaḥ śaktyavidyopādhiparaḥ | vādaśabdavadayaṃśabdaḥ | upādhitadupahitayoravibhāgaḥ śaṅkyata ityatrāha - vilakṣaṇayoḥ iti | svarūpapariṇāme śaṅkāparihārau yuktāvityatrāha - svarūpa iti | kuta ityatrāha - na karma iti | upagamya dūṣayati - svarūpa iti | kālāntareṇa ghaṭaśarāvādisaṅkaro'stīti cet phenataraṅgadṛṣṭānte'pi samāno'yaṃ doṣaḥ | yastu tena parihriyate svarūpapariṇāme'pi parihāryaḥ | pūrvādhikaraṇoktavikārāpumarthadoṣaparihārānupapattimāha - svarūpa iti || 14 || iti bhoktrāpattyadhikaraṇam - 5 <6. ārambhaṇādhikaraṇam ||> tadananyatvamārambhaṇaśabdādibhyaḥ || 2-1-15 || asaditi cenna pratiṣedhamātratvāt ityādiṣu ... ... tasya cānirvacanīyatvaṃ pratītibādhābhyāṃ siddham || tadananyatvamārambhaṇaśabdādibhyaḥ | saṅgatimāha - - asat iti | satyapi iti | kāryopayogitayā - udakāharaṇādikāryopayogitayā | na ca iti | piṇḍe ghaṭo na cet kulālena tanturupādīyeta, tatra ghaṭāsattvāviśeṣādityarthaḥ | matpiṇḍe'sti ghaṭaḥ, na tantuṣu iti kutaḥ? mṛtpiṇḍa eva ghaṭasadbhāvayogya iti cet tarhi tadutpādanayogyaḥ sa eva ityabhiprāyeṇa pariharati - kāraṇa iti | spaṣṭam | āhuḥ - siddhāntyekadeśinaḥ ityarthaḥ || vācārambhaṇam ityāderarthamabhiprayannāha - ato yathā iti | vikāreṣu iti anuvartamānattvaheturabhipretaḥ | ekameva advitīyam ityasyārthamāha - tathā iti | kāryasya sadasadvilakṣaṇatve vyatirekiṇamāha - sata iti | sadasadanyatvaṃ mithyātve'nvayiheturityāha - anirvacanīyaṃ ca iti | sapakṣe sādhakadharmaṃ darśayati - tasya ca iti || kiṃ ca kāryamutpādayan mṛdādi kāraṇadravyaṃ ... .... jīveśvarabaddhamuktaśiṣyācāryajñatvājñatvādivyasthā ca na syāt || vyāvartamānatvasya nirupādhikatvāya kāryadurnirūpatām anugrāhakatarkarūpeṇāha - kiṃ ca iti | satyaṃ cet sunirūpaṃ syādityarthaḥ | uktatarkasya pratyakṣavirodhamāśaṅkyāha - na ca iti | rucakādi - rūcakādyavasthā| samavāyiviṣayā pratyabhijñā ityatrāha - tadatirikta iti | vyaktidvayānupalabdherityarthaḥ | paṭe tantava iva iti paṭaprakriyayoktam | nāpi iti | viśiṣṭasya kārye pratyabhijñānaprasaṅgaḥ ityarthaḥ | ataḥ iti | kāraṇātiriktānupalambhāt nādhyakṣabādhaḥ ityarthaḥ | tata eva na sopādhikatvaṃ, pakṣe'pibādhāditi bhāvaḥ | kṛtsnaṃ mithyā cet, kathaṃ mṛdādisatyatetyatrāha - tadidam iti | kaṇṭhoktaṃ cetyāha - aitad iti | yūpādityaikyasāmyamāśaṅkyāha - na cāgama iti | śaṅkitamanyaparatvaṃ pratītyabhāvāt pratyakṣavirodhādvā iti vikalpaṃ matvā prathamaṃ vyudasyati - yathokta iti | dvitīyaṃ vyudasyati pratyakṣasya ca iti | upagamyāha - virodhe satyapi iti | doṣaḥ - bhedavāsanā | apacchedamabhipretyāha - carama iti | svarūpasadbhāvaḥ - jñānodayaḥ | ādi śabdāt sāmagryutpattiḥ | pramitau - pramitatve | arthaparicchedakatvena hi smṛtivat jñātatayā'rthaṃ jñāpayatītyarthaḥ || atra kecidadvitīyatvaṃ brahmaṇo'bhyupayanta eva ... ... jīvānāṃ bhramasya pravāhānāditvānna taddheturanveṣaṇīyaḥ - iti || nanu ityādyukta laukikavaidikavyavasthāsidhyarthaṃ jīvājñānapakṣaṃ prastauti atra iti | kasya - kimāśrayā | avastubhūtāyāṃ - mithyābhūtāyām | anavaklaptiḥ - asiddhiḥ | brahmāvyatirekasvataḥśuddhibhyāṃ brahmaṇa iva jīvasyāpi avidyānvayo na syādityatrāha - vastutaḥ iti | svataḥ śuddhasyāpi aupādhikāśuddhisaṃbhavāt avidyānvayopapatteḥ janmajarādīnāṃ kālpanikatvopapattirityarthaḥ | aśuddhiḥ doṣārhatā | tasyā dhīnivartyatvāyāha aśuddhirapi iti | aśuddhibhramāt avidyānvayaḥ, tenāśuddhibhramaḥ ityanyonyāśrayamāśaṅkyāha - jīvānām iti || tadetadaviditādvaitayāthātmyānāṃ ... .. brahmaiva kalpakamiti cet brahmājñānamevāyātam || jīvājñānapakṣaṃ dūṣayati - tadetat iti | kiṃ jīvasya akalpita svarūpeṇāvidyāśrayatvam, uta kalpitākāreṇa, atha kalpitākāraviśiṣṭasvarūpeṇa iti vikalpamabhipretya, prathamaṃ śiro dūṣayati - jīvasya iti | dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati - tadatiriktena iti | jīvo hyavidyāśrayaḥ tat kathaṃ jaḍasya tadāśrayatvamityatrāha - na khalu iti | tṛtīyaṃ śaṅkate - kalpita iti | dūṣayati - tanna iti | kuta ityatrāha - svarūpasya iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - avidyāśrayākāra iti | avidyāśrayatve sati viśiṣṭatvaṃ viśiṣṭākāra eva avidyāśraya ityātmāśrayaṇamityarthaḥ | avidyāyā ekatve dūṣaṇamāha - tatraikasmin iti | bahutvaṃ śaṅkate prati iti| bhantsyate - baddho bhaviṣyati | dūṣayati - tanna iti | advaitahāniprasaṅgāt svābhāvikatvānabhyupagamaḥ | kimasyāḥ iti | jīvabhedakalpakā'vidyā tatklapteḥ prāgeva nāśrayituṃ kṣamā, jīvāsiddherityarthaḥ | bījāṅkureṣu iti | tatra notpādakasya utpādakatayotpādyāpekṣeti bhidā | aśakanīyatā - sādhayitumaśakyatā | kṛtanāśādi iti | ādi śabdāt jīvanityatvādiśrutivirodha uktaḥ || jīvākhyadharmiklṛpteḥ pravāhānāditve kathitaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ jīvatvadharmaklṛptipravāhānāditve'pyatidiśati - ata eva iti | dharmaklṛptipakṣasya nirastatāṃ vivṛṇoti - avidyāpravāhe iti | pakṣadvaye'pi dūṣaṇamekamāha āmokṣāt iti | jīvasya - jīvabhāvaviśiṣṭasya || durghaṭatvena parihāraṃ dūṣayati - yaccoktam iti | śuddhavidyāsvarūpatvāt - śuddhajñaptirūpatvāt | uktābhiḥ - anyonyāśrayādibhiḥ | anirmokṣaḥ āvidyajīvāvasthiterityarthaḥ || dārṣṭāntikālocanayā dūṣitam | atha dṛṣṭāntālocanayā dūṣayati yaccoktam iti | doṣapratibhāsānupapattyā dūṣayati - kiṃ ca iti | anyasya iti śirodṛṣṭāntānurodhāduktam || avidyākāryabhramāśrayanirūpaṇayā dūṣayati - kiṃ ca iti | kaḥ kalpakaḥ ko bhramāśrayaḥ | ātmāśraya iti | jīvasiddheḥ svaviṣayabhramāśrayasvasiddhisāpekṣatvāt ātmāśrayaḥ ityarthaḥ || kiṃ ca brahmājñānānabhyupagame, kiṃ brahma ... ... paramārthato brahmavyatiriktābhāvāt tadananyatvaṃ jagataḥ iti || kiṃ ca iti | sphuṭam | ata eva - īkṣāpūrvakasṛṣṭyarthamasya jīvadarśanārthaṃ cāvidyānvayasya upagamādityarthaḥ| māyā - parabhramahetuḥ; svabhramahetuḥ avidyā iti tanmatam | jīvadārśitvam - aparamārthajīvadarśitvam | paramohanahetureva mohanīyadarśanaheturiti śaṅkate - atha iti | tarhi ityādi | sphuṭam | apumarthadṛṣṭihetutvābhāvānugamenāpi dūṣayati – tannirasane ca iti | duḥkhahetutve'pi avastubhāsanameva apumarthaḥ nirasanīyatvāt ato māyāyāśca taddhetutvādavidyātvamiti bhāvaḥ | avidyāmantareṇa nopapadyate iti | mṛṣātvāditi bhāvaḥ | nityayā - apumarthābhāvenānirasanīyatvāditi bhāvaḥ| āśrayavibhāgānupapattyā ca dūṣayati - māyāśrayatayā iti || yat tu ityādi | ata eva - āśrayaikatve'pi sarvavyavasthopapādakahetunā kālpanikatvena | kāryapāramārthye eva kāraṇabahutvam, na tvapāramārthya ityāha - paramārthikī iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - apāramārthikī tu iti || prayogaśca iti | ādyau jīvājñānavādinaṃ prati kathitau | antyau dvau taṃ bhedavādinaṃ ca prati | jaḍatvādayaḥ ekaikamanapekṣāḥ| bhinnatve ca iti vyatirekitrayam | abhinnatvaṃ sādhyam | vastuparicchedāt paricchedāntaradvayaṃ prasañjayati - vastutaḥ paricchinnasya ityādinā | tataḥkimityatrāha evaṃ ca iti | utpatti iti | avikāraśrutivirodhaścetyarthaḥ| ekāvidyayā sarvavyavasthopapattimupasaṃharati - ataḥ iti | brahmājñānavādapakṣamupasaṃharati tasmāt iti | ananyatvaṃ jagataḥ iti | paramārthabhūtānyatvaṃ na bhavati ityarthaḥ| abhāvaḥ nañarthaḥ || atrocyate - nirviśeṣasvaprakāśamātraṃ brahma .... ... ahaṃtvamādyarthavilakṣaṇaṃ cinmātraṃ hyātmā tvanmate || brahmājñānavādinaṃ vaiśeṣikaḥ prativadati - atrocyate iti | niraṃśasya iti | tirodhāne'pi jaḍāṃśaḥ sthitaḥ iti durvacamiti bhāvaḥ | svavacanaviruddham - nityatvādisādhakavacanaviruddham | uktam - asmin prabandhe siddhāntinā ityarthaḥ | mithyātvānityatvabhedamāha - yaddeśa iti | anityatve sādhye siddhasādhyatā; mithyātve tu sopādhikatvavyāghātabādhitatvānaikāntyādīni iti bhāvaḥ | deśakālādi iti | ādi śabdāt kriyādi | deśakālabhrameṣu deśakālāntararūpopādhyabhāvāt sādhyasamavyāptirneti na vācyam | tatrāpi kriyāderupādhitvāditi bhāvaḥ | bādhārhatvaṃ sādhyam; bādhitatvaṃ liṅgamiti na sādhyāviśiṣṭatā | dāhārhatvadāhakāryatvavat | samavahitāt - samanvitāt | kāraṇāntaram - adṛṣṭeśvarasaṅkalpādi | etadāyattatvābhāvāt - vastumātrānāyattatvāt avikṛtatvadharmitayā taddhi prakṛtam || anugrāhyamāha - kāraṇasya ca iti | paroktatarko jātyuktiḥ | kāryakāraṇatvabhaṅgavācisvavacanasya pramitijanakatvopagamāt | na cet sutarāṃ na kāryakāraṇatvabhaṅgaḥ | yathoktaparikaraḥ - deśakālādiḥ | hemapratyabhijñākathamityatrāha - prāk iti | yaccānyat iti | ādi śabdāt virodhe'piśāstrabalīyastvam || yaccoktam ityādi | dehabhedādapratisandhirityatrāha - saubhari iti | antaḥ karaṇabhedādityatrāha - na ca iti | ekaśarīravartyātmana ekatve siddhasādhyatā | anekaśarīravartināṃ cet dharmigrāhakabādha ityarthaḥ | sarvaśarīrāṇāmavidyākalpitatvābhāvāt iti | sapakṣabhūtadehasyāpi avidyākalpitatvābhāvāt dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavaikalyamityabhipretam || yacca cetanāt ityādinā ahameva sarvaṃ cetanajātaṃ cetanatvāt itīdamarthato'nūditam | kālātyāpadeśena dūṣayati -- tadapi iti | uktidūṣaṇamāha - yat tu iti || kiṃ ca nirviśeṣacinmātrātireki sarvaṃ mithyeti vadato mokṣārthaśravaṇādiprayatno niṣphalaḥ ... ... bhedavādinastu sarvacidaciddastuśarīratvena brahmaṇaḥ sarvaprakāratvāt svataḥ parato'pi paricchedo na vidyate || pratitarkānāha - kiṃ ca iti | avidyākāryatvādau niṣphalatvādiprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | karmahetukatvāt tadvadeva tvanmate'pi niṣphalatvāditi cet, na, śrutestulyadoṣatvābhāvena tadbādhena parihārasya suvacatvāditi bhāvaḥ | sa ca vyaktībhaviṣyati || dvidhā mṛṣāvādināṃ gatiḥ | brahma svarūpaparavākyapratipādyamiti, brahma tu na pratipādyaṃ bhedaniṣedhaparā vedāntāḥ iti ca | tatra pratipādyatvapakṣe'niṣṭaṃ prasañjayati - kiṃ ca nirviśeṣa iti | anumānaiḥ - tarkaiḥ | ūhastarko'numānoktiḥ iti prasiddheḥ | nirastān iti | svābhimatārthasādhakatvaṃ nirastamityarthaḥ | atādṛśasya - karmakartṛrahitasya | tādṛśasya iti pāṭhe sakartṛkarmaṇastasya nirviśeṣatve'bhimate sā na sidhyatīti || pūrvamavidyāhetoḥ naiṣphalyamuktam | tanna; asatyāt satyotpatteḥ ityatrāha - yaḥ punaḥ iti | paramate tadasiddhimāha - so'pi iti | svamate tadasiddhimāha - asmābhirapi iti || bādhādṛṣṭimupagamya dūṣayati - duṣṭakāraṇa iti | sā ca netyāha - kiṃ ca iti | mādhyamikavaco doṣamūlamityatrāha - doṣamūlatvaṃ tu iti | ataḥ ... na setsyati ityanvayaḥ | asiddhimupapādayati - loka iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - nirviśeṣa iti | jñātṛtvasaviśeṣatvayorabhāvāt āśrayatayā karaṇatayā ca na pratibhāsādihetutvamityarthaḥ | ādi śabdāt vyavahāraḥ || na kaścidviśeṣo'nyatra tatsaṃraṃbhāt iti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ - adhiṣṭhānasya mithyātve'dhiṣṭhānāntarāpekṣayā anavasthā doṣamṛṣātve'pi tulyā | svarūpapravāhānāditvābhyāṃ daurghaṭyasvaparanirvāhakābhyāṃ ca parihṛtiśca tathā | upapattyanapekṣatve cātiprasaṅgāḥ prāk darśitāḥ | doṣasatyatvāpekṣā cāparamārthatvaprayuktopapattirūpeti || yattu ityādi | ānantyaṃ - sāvadhisaṃkhyārāhityam | svarūpānantyāt - deśakālādyupādhirahitasvarūpānantyāt | deśakālādi iti ādi śabdāt kartrādi | kartrādinā'pyavacchedadarśanāt gṛhādyavacchinnātmapakṣīkāre siddhasādhyatā | avacchinnaghaṭeṣu sapakṣīkṛteṣu bhinnatvaṃ sopādhikam | anyathā dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavaikalyam || yattu ātmanām iti bādhitaviṣayatvamuktam | yat tu bhinnatve iti | deśakālaparicchedau nyūnādhikatvarahitau, paricchedatvāt . vastuparicchedavat itivat vastutaḥ paricchinnasya deśakālaparicchinnatvam abādhitam ityarthaḥ | vastutaḥ ityādi | sphuṭam || avidyābrahmabhedānupagame dūṣaṇamāha - yadi iti | śuktitvamṛṣātve purovarti rajatameva yathā syāditi bhāvaḥ | pratisaṃbandhinyavidyā mṛṣeti cet, ghaṭo'pi mṛṣeti tadvilakṣaṇapaṭasyeva vastuparicchedatatprayuktadoṣāḥ syuḥ | atha sāmānyena bhedānupagamena dūṣaṇamāha - bhedatattva iti | svapakṣo nirdoṣaḥ, parapakṣaḥ sadoṣaḥ iti vibhāgasatyatve bhedasatyatvam, asatyatve bhedasatyatvam ityarthaḥ | vaiśeṣikānantye svābhimatiprakāramāha - ānantya iti | sākṣātsiddhāntipakṣe tadupapattimāha - bhedavādinastu iti | svataḥ iti ghaṭādivyāvṛttiḥ | parataḥ iti dharmabhūtajñānavyāvṛttiḥ | sarvavastusāmānādhikaraṇyārhatvaṃ vastvaparicchedasvaniṣṭha - vastvantarābhāva ityarthaḥ | guṇānantyaṃ ca yathā ṣaḍvarṇāpekṣayā daśavarṇaniṣkasyāparicchedaḥ | prāgukto'pyetadantarbhūtaḥ || tadevaṃ kāraṇāt bhinnasya kāryasya satyatvāt brahmakāryaṃ kṛtsnaṃ jagat brahmaṇo'nyadeva || siddhāntaḥ iti prāpte pracakṣmahe - tadananyatvamārambhaṇaśabdādibhyaḥ | ... .. . bālo yuvā sthaviraḥ iti vuddhiśabdāntarādayaḥ kāryaviśeṣāśca dṛśyante || atha vaiśeṣikapakṣamupasaṃharan rāddhāntamavatārayati - tadevam iti | tadananyatvamārambhaṇaśabdādibhyaḥ | asya kasmādananyatvamityatrāha tasmāt iti | ananyatvam aikyam | virodho nañarthaḥ | pratijñādṛṣṭāntavākyadvayaṃ prakṛtyadhikaraṇaviṣayaḥ | vaiśeṣikanirāsena kāryakāraṇaikyopapādakatvādasya vākyasya etadadhikaraṇaviṣayatvamityabhiprāyeṇoktaṃ tadupapādayadbhyaḥ iti | aikapadyavyudāsāya vācādibhyaḥ ityanuktiḥ | ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣavyudāsāyāha ārambhaṇaśabda iti || udāhṛtavākyānāṃ tadananyaparatvamupapādayati - tathā hi iti | dṛṣṭāntavākyaṃ vyācaṣṭe - yathaika iti | vācā ityādivākyasya tadupapādakatvamāha - atra iti | nāmno mṛdārabdhatvābhāvāt sparśārthatayā vyākhyātam | ghaṭena iti vācā ityajahallakṣaṇetyarthaḥ | siddhaye iti prayojanatayā hetutvamityarthaḥ | teneva - pūrvavākyaprastutena | sparśaśabdārthaṃ vivṛṇvan uktaṃ saṃgraheṇāha udaka iti | buddhyādibhedaḥ ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ āste śete ityādau buddhibhedādavasthābhedācca dṛṣṭaḥ | atra tvavasthābhedanibandhanatve kiṃ niyāmakamityatrāha - ataḥ iti | evakārārthamāha - na tu iti | sāmānyena buddhyādibhedānāmanyathāsiddhimāha - ataḥ iti | dehakṣaṇikatve'pi bālādiśabdānāṃ cetanaparyantatvānna sādhyavikalatā dṛṣṭāntasya, dehasyābādhitapratyabhijñāviṣayatvācca | yaduktam - satyāmeva mṛdi ghaṭo naṣṭa iti vyavahārāt ... ... tadevamārambha ṇaśabdādibhyo jagataḥ paramakāraṇāt parasmāt brahmaṇo'nanyatvamupapādyate || bhāvābhāvavirodhaṃ pariharati - yaduktam iti | kāryabhedaṃ parivakti - tattat iti | kārakavyāpāravaiyarthyaṃ vyudasyati - saṃsthānayoga iti | bhūtapratyayanirdeśaḥ prathamakṣaṇāpekṣayeti yogaśabdasya bhāvaḥ | ato notpadyate iti vyāhāraḥ nātra śakttyu tpannavyāhārābhāvaśca | tata eva kapālatve sati ghaṭasya niṣṭhatvoktiśca evaṃ yuktā | saṃsthānasya ityādinopanyastacodyaṃ pratibandīmukhena pariharati - asatkāryavādino'pi iti | yathotpatterutpatticodanaṃ nityasamajātyuktiḥ tathā'vasthāyā utpattimukhena codyamapi; avasthāviśeṣasya cotpattirūpatvādityarthaḥ | asmākaṃ tu iti | pṛthaksthitipratītikāryānarhāṇāṃ na pṛthagutpattyādyapekṣā yathotpatteḥ , kiṃ tu tadarhāṇāmeva pṛthagutpatyādyapekṣetyarthaḥ | saṃkhyābhedaṃ pariharati - kapālatva iti || atha sautrādiśabdopātteṣu vākyeṣu dārṣṭāntikavākyasyārthamāha tathā iti | sadeva iti evakārāt kāryāsattvavyudāsaḥ | katham asata ityādivākyaikārthyāt tathā ... upapāditam ityanvayaḥ || padānāmuktārthaparatvaṃ draḍhayitumuparitanavākyānāmarthaṃ vadan, ananyatvasiddhimāha - tathā tadaikṣata iti | bahutvekṣitṛtvaśabdābhyām eka advitīya śabdārthaḥ sphuṭīkṛtaḥ | vyaṣṭisṛṣṭisaṅkalpavākyasya śaṅkāmāha - sacchabda iti | sacchabdo brahmaparaścedidaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamayuktam | jagatparaścedīkṣaṇādyayoga ityarthaḥ || tādātmyasya vyāptihetukatvajñāpanāyodāhṛtavākyaṃ vivṛṇoti - tisraḥ iti | kṛtsnam tisra iti nyūnatāṃ vyāvartayati | na tu mānāntarasiddhamadhikamiti bhāvaḥ | acidvastu - idaṃśabdasamānādhikaraṇa devatā śabdo lakṣaṇayā'dhiṣṭheyācitpara iti bhāvaḥ | vastuśabdo 'citpāramārthyasūcakaḥ | tatpāramārthyaṃ tu asṛjata iti sṛjyatvokteḥ || svātmaka iti | anena jīvenātmanā iti ātma śabdaḥ svavācīti bhāvaḥ | nāmarūpe kasyetyatrāha - etat iti | sannihitameva nāmarūpabhāgiti bhāvaḥ | vicitra iti | devādivyaṣṭināmarūpe ityarthaḥ | anena tejaḥśabdatejastvaprabhṛtisamaṣṭināmarūpavyāvṛttiḥ | samaṣṭināmarūpe hi prāgeva vyākṛte | svavācakasya ātmanā iti padasya jīvaviśeṣaṇaśaṅkāvyudāsāya jīvena iti padasya ātmavi śeṣaṇatvaṃ darśayan, samaṣṭyavasthajīvānupraveśavyāvṛttyarthamanupraveśaṃ viśiṃṣan jīvasyāpi nāmarūpabhāktvaṃ darśayati - anena iti | atra etacchabdo jīvaviśiṣṭācitparaḥ | ātmatayā - niyantṛtayā | jīvaparayoḥ svarūpaikyavyudāsāya svātmakatvaṃ vivṛṇoti - svātmanaḥ iti | sihena mayā itivadityarthaḥ || śrutyantareṇedaṃ spaṣṭayati tat - sṛṣṭvā iti | kāryadaśāyāṃ hyayamanupraveśaḥ, na tu kāraṇadaśāyāmityatrāha - tadetat iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - anena iti | sat idaṃ śabdayoḥ kevalabrahmakevalajagatparatvābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | tarapo mukhyatvamarthaḥ | spaṣṭam | ādi śabdopāttaprakaraṇāntaravākyairananyatvamāha - tathā iti || atredaṃ tattvam - cidacidvastuśarīratayā tatprakāraṃ brahmaiva ... ... sadātmanā ca sarvasya abhinnatve sarvajñatvena sarvasvabhāvapratisandhānāt sarvaguṇadoṣasaṅkaraprasaṅgaśca pūrvamevoktaḥ | ato yathoktaprakārameva ananyatvam || 15 || vibhaktatamaḥkāryaṃ hyakṣarādi | tamasaḥ ekībhāvaśravaṇāt cidacitorutpattipralayaśravaṇāt, agre bahutvābhāvena śarīraśarībhāvānna svabhāvavyavasthā yuktā | bhedavyapadeśāt tadananyatvam ityādisūtrāṇāṃ vyāhatiścetyatrāha atredam iti | paramātmanityatvopādānatvajīvanityatvabahutvavaiṣamyādiparihārocitadehātmabhāvaśrutyanyathānupapattyā tadānīmapi cidaciccharīrakatvasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ || asya sūtrasya mṛṣāvādibhiruktamarthaṃ dūṣayati - ye tu iti | bhāskaroktaṃ vyudasyati - ye ca iti | upādhisaṃbandhāt ityantena cidgatadoṣasaṅga uktaḥ | heyākāra ityaciddoṣasaṅgaḥ | na svarūpe heyānvayaḥ, śakteracidrūpapariṇāmādityatrāha - śakti iti || yādavaprakāśoktaṃ vyudasyati - ye punaḥ ityādinā | viplavaḥ - vikāraḥ | sadaiva - kāraṇadaśāyāmapīti bhāvaḥ | yaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvavit ... tasmādetat iti hi śrutiḥ | tataḥ svayaṃbhūḥ iti | bhagavacchabdaḥ īśvaraparaḥ iti bhāvaḥ | nyāyavirodhamāha - na ca iti | saviśeṣatvāt - niyantṛrūpaviśeṣavattvāt | na lakṣaṇā; śaktau pratyayavidhānāt ityatrāha - na ca pācaka iti | keṣāñcideva iti | anyathā viśeṣopādānavaiyarthyamiti bhāvaḥ | pācakādiṣu śaktyarthatvaṃ dṛṣṭamityatrāha - pācaka iti || anuvṛttaṃ sattvaṃ dharma iti pakṣe dūṣaṇamāha - na ca iti | prasaṅgādasattvaṃ śikṣa yati - virodhi iti | dravyapakṣe dūṣaṇamāha - dravyameva iti | dravyasaṃbandhaḥ kriyādeḥ sattvamityatrāha - kriyādiṣu iti | sūtrārthamupasaṃharati ataḥ iti || 15 || athocyeta - ekasyaivāvasthāntarayoge'pi ... .... bhāve copalabdheḥ || 2-1-16|| kuṇḍalādikāryasadbhāve ca kāraṇabhūta ... ... buddhiśabdāntarādayo'vasthābhedamātranibandhanā ityavagamyate | tasmāt kāraṇādananyat kāryam || 16 || uttarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - athocyeta iti | bhāve copalabdheḥ | mṛttikā ityāderartha ihoktaḥ | sāmānādhikaraṇyena pratyabhijñavivakṣitā | pratisandhānānupapatteḥ | na hi ghaṭasthembhasi ghaṭapratisandhānamityarthaḥ | codyaṃ śaṅkate - gomaya iti | na tatrāpi iti | samavāyyanuvṛttivādinā tvayā'pi ādikāraṇapratisandhirvācyā iti bhāvaḥ | sphuṭam || 16 || itaśca sattvāccāparasya || 2-1-17 || aparasya kāryasya kāraṇe sattvācca ... ... vede ca sadeva somyedamagra āsīt iti || 17 || sattvāccāparasya | pūrvasūtre dravyaikyadhīpratyabhijñoktā; iha tu tathā vyapadeśaḥ | vyapadiśyate iti hi bhāṣyam | yadvā ayaṃ sa ityabhijñocyate || asadvyapadeśānneti cenna dharmāntareṇa vākyaśeṣādyukteḥ śabdāntarācca || 2-1-18 || yaduktaṃ kāraṇe kāryasya sattvaṃ ... ... taddhedaṃ tarhmavyākṛtamāsīt tannāmarūpābhyāṃ vyākriyata iti suspaṣṭamuktam || 18 || asadvyapadeśānneti cenna dharmāntareṇa vākyaśeṣādyukteḥ śabdāntarācca | dravyadharmāvityuktam iti | vyavahārayogyatā hi sattvam ityādinā | antara śabdārthamāha - tatra iti | aśrutavākyaśeṣeṣu pradeśeṣu nirvāhamāha - tadaikārthyāt iti | sphuṭam || 18 || idānīṃ kāryasya kāraṇādananyatve nidarśanadvayaṃ ... ... paṭavacca || 2-1-19 || yathā tantava eva vyatiṣaṅgaviśeṣabhājaḥ paṭa iti nāmarūpakāryāntarādikaṃ bhajante, tadvat brahmāpi || 19 || anantarasūtradvayakṛtyamāha - idānīm iti | idānīm - ananyatve sādhite | ato na sādhyavikalateti bhāvaḥ | nidarśanadvayam iti | laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ ca | paṭavacca | bahūnāmekāvasthatvaṃ nidarśitam || 19 || yathā ca prāṇādiḥ || 2-1-20 || yathā ca vāyureka eva śarīre vṛttiviśeṣaṃ ... ... paramakāraṇāt parasmādbra hmaṇo'nanyatvaṃ jagataḥ siddham || 20|| yathā ca prāṇādiḥ | ekasya bahvavasthatvaṃ nidarśitam | adhikaraṇārthamupasaṃharati - iti iti || 20 || iti ārambhaṇādhikaraṇam - 6 <7. itaravyapadeśādhikaraṇam ||> itaravyapadeśāddhitākaraṇādidoṣaprasaktiḥ || 2-1-21 || jagato brahmānanyatvaṃ pratipādayadbhiḥ ... ... ata idamasaṅgata brahmaṇo jagatkāraṇatvam || 21 || itaravyapadeśāddhitākaraṇādidoṣaprasaktiḥ | saṅgatyādikaṃ spaṣṭam | ityādayaḥ iti | ādiśabdāt sukhaduḥkhabhoktṛtvam || 21 || iti prāpte'bhidhīyate -
