adhikaṃ tu bhedanirdeśāt || 2-1-22 || tuśabdaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati; ādhyātmikādi ... ... sarvabhūtāntarātmā'pahatapāpmā divyo deva eko nārāyaṇaḥ ityādibhiḥ || rāddhānte - adhikaṃ tu bhedanirdeśāt || 22 || aśmādivacca tadanupapattiḥ || 2-1-23 || śrutirdarśitā | atha śrutyarthāpattirucyate | aśmādivacca tadanupapattiḥ | aśmakāṣṭha iti | sāmānādhikaraṇye tulye'pi aikyāsaṃbhavāddhi acidvyāvṛttyupagamaḥ | sa cetane'pi tulya iti bhāvaḥ | avasthiteḥ iti sūtram etadadhikaraṇaśeṣam | ādiśabdāt na tu dṛṣṭāntabhāvāt ubhaye'pi hi ityādi vivakṣitam || citsāmānādhikaraṇyanirvāhaḥ kṛtaḥ, jagatsāmānādhikaraṇyanirvāhamāha - ataḥ sarvaṃ iti | na vyavasthitiḥ, avibhāgokterityatrāha sadeva iti | sa kathamityatrāha - avibhāgastu iti || ye punaḥ ityādi | viyuktaviṣayatve doṣa uktaḥ | saṃsṛṣṭaviṣayatve dūṣaṇamāha - na ca iti | akalpitajijñāsyasvarūpasya prakrāntatvādityarthaḥ || vailakṣaṇyam apītau ityatroktamityatrāha - apītau iti | anuvadati - asya śeṣatvena vadati | tarhi tatra ko'rthaḥ pratipādyaḥ ityatrāha - tatra hi iti | na tatra vilakṣaṇayoḥ kāryakāraṇasaṃbhava eva pratipādyaḥ, asatkāryavādanirāsanidarśanādityatrāha - asad iti | prasaṅgādārambhaṇādhikaraṇānuvāda ityarthaḥ | ihābhedaśrutyavirodyena bhedaśrutimukhyārthatvaṃ varṇitam | apītau iti na tu dṛṣṭānta iti acidgatadoṣaḥ, itaravyapadeśāt iti cidgatadoṣaśca parihṛtau | sāmānādhikaraṇyam avasthiteḥ iti nirūḍhamiti sūtratrayam etadadhikaraṇaśeṣam || 23 || iti itaravyapadeśādhikaraṇam - 7 <8. upasaṃhāradarśanādhikaraṇam ||> upasaṃhāradarśanānneti cenna kṣīravaddhi || 2-1-24 || parasya brahmaṇaḥ sarvajñasya satyasaṅkalpasya ... ... kṣīrādiṣvātañcanādyapekṣā na dadhyādibhāvāya | api tu śaudhryārthaṃ rasaviśeṣārthaṃ vā || 24 || satyasaṅkalpatvādidharmairhi vyāvṛttiruktā | tatra satyasaṅkalpatvasyā saṅkoco nirūpyata iti saṅgatiḥ sphuṭam | kṣīrādiṣu iti | ravikarā utsargaṃmātrahetavaḥ, na tu jalasya himarūpapariṇāma iti bhāvaḥ || 24 || devādivadapi loke || 2-1-25 || yathā devādayaḥ sve sve loke ... ... brahmaṇo vedāvagataśakteḥ sukhagrahaṇāyeti pratipattavyam || 25 || devādivadapi loke | sphuṭo'rthaḥ || 25 || iti upasaṃhāradarśanādhikaraṇam -8 <9. kṛtsnaprasaktyadhikaraṇam ||> kṛtsnaprasaktirniravayavatvaśabdakopo vā || 2-1-26 || sadeva somyedamagra āsīt .... ... ato brahmakāraṇatvaṃ nopapadyate || 26 || kṛtsnaprasaktiḥ niravayavatvaśabdakopo vā | prāk dṛṣṭāntitakṣīravat sāvayavaṃ vā na veti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ | iti vacanabhaṅgyā evamuktaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | sat iti | yāvadvādhaṃ hi saṅkocaḥ | iha tadabhāvādasaṅkucitamekapadam avayavato'pi bhedāsahamiti bhāvaḥ | avayava śabdaḥ aṃśaparaḥ | tattaccidacidviśiṣṭapradeśabhedasvarūpaṃ na saṃbhavatīti hṛdayam | idaṃ vā iti | pṛthivyādyavayavavibhāganiṣedhānniravayavatvasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | ādi śabdāt niṣkalam ityādi gṛhyate | eka śabdavyākhyānaṃ niravayava padam | āsīt ityantenopāttavākyānāmartha uktaḥ || phalitamarthamāha - kāraṇāvasthāyām iti | avibhāgamekaṃ niravayavam | eka śabdavācyatvāt niravayavam | ata eva nirastacidacidvibhāgam ityarthaḥ | yadyapi iti | ekaśarīre śarīryaṃśaḥ samāpta iti nānyatra syādityarthaḥ || 26 || ityākṣipte samādhatte - śrutestu śabdamūlatvāt || 2-1-27 || tuśabda uktadoṣaṃ vyāvartayati | ... ... na sāmānyato dṛṣṭaṃ sādhanaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ vā arhati brahma || 27 || śrutestu śabdamūlatvāt | śrutestu iti dharmaviṣayam | śabdamūlatvāt iti dharmiviṣayam | mānāntarāgocare dharmiṇi svamānena dharmyantaravijātīyatayā'vagate taddharmavijātīyadharmānvayasyāpi svamānenaiva avagatau na mānavirodha ityarthaḥ | sāmānyato dṛṣṭam - yena kenacidākāreṇa sāmyanibaddham || 27 || ātmani caivaṃ vicitrāśca hi || 2-1-28 || kiṃ ca - evaṃ vastvantarasaṃbandhino ... ... codyaṃ sarvavastuvilakṣaṇe pare brahmaṇi nāvataratītyarthaḥ || 28 || ātmani caivaṃ vicitrāśca hi | tadaprasaktiśca ityadhyāhāreṇa sūtrakhaṇḍayojanā | vicitra śabdaviśeṣyā bhāvāḥ | sphuṭārthatvāt purāṇavacaḥ - prāthamyam | paricodya, yathoktam ityanvayaḥ || 28 || itaśca svapakṣadoṣāśca || 2-1-29 || svapakṣe - pradhānādikāraṇavāde ... ... saṃyujyamānā api na sthūlakāryārambhāya prabhaveyuḥ || 29 || svapakṣadoṣācca | darśanānuguṇam anumīyamānasyaiva lokadṛṣṭadoṣaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ || 29 || sarvopetā ca taddarśanāt || 2-1-30 || sakaletaravastuvisajātīyā parā ... ... sarvamidamabhyātto'vākyanādaraḥ iti ca || 30 || sarvopetā ca taddarśanāt | niravayavatvaśrutibalāt dharmivaijātyavilakṣaṇaśaktiyogau kalpyāvityuktam | iha tatkaṇṭhoktiriti bhidā | apahatapāpmā iti pāpmānarhatvāt dharmivaijātyasiddhiḥ | manomayaḥ iti malinamanogrāhya dharmivailakṣaṇyasatyasaṅkalpatvaphalitatvāt sarvaśaktiyogaṃ pratipādayanti ityuktam || 30 || vikaraṇatvānneti cet taduktam || 2-1-31 || yadyapyekameva brahma sakaletaravilakṣaṇam .... ... apāṇipādo javano grahītā ityevamādyā || 31 || vikaraṇatvānneti cet taduktam | daṇḍacakrādyanapekṣatve'pi dehādyapekṣā'tra parihriyate | kāryaṃ - śarīram | sūtre karaṇa - uktiḥ pradarśanārthā || 31 || iti kṛtsnaprasaktyadhikaraṇam - 9 <10. prayojanavattvādhikaraṇam ||> na prayojanavattvāt || 2-1-32 || yadyapīśvaraḥ prāksṛṣṭereka eva ... ... brahmaṇaḥ kāraṇatvaṃ nopapadyate iti || 32 || na prayojanavattvāt | saṅgatyādi sphuṭam || 32 || evaṃ prāpte pracakṣmahe - lokavat tu līlākaivalyam || 2-1-33 || avāptasamastakāmasya paripūrṇasya ... .. līlaiva prayojanamiti niravadyam || 33 || lokavattu līlākaivalyam | kevala iti paṇabandhavyudāsaḥ || 33 || vaiṣamyanairghṛṇye na sāpekṣatvāt tathā hi darśayati || 2-1-34 || yadyapi paramapuruṣasya sakaletara ... ... svaśaktyā svakarmaṇaiva devādivastutāprāptiriti || 34 || vaiṣamyanairghṛṇye na sāpekṣatvāt tathā hi darśayati | sādhāraṇatvāt apradhāno heturnimittam yathā kṣityādi | pradhānakāraṇībhūtāḥ ityuktavāt | asādhāraṇyam prādhānyam, yathā bījaśaktiḥ || 34 || na karmāvibhāgāditi cennānāditvādupapadyate cābhyupalabhyate ca || 2-1-35 || prāksṛṣṭeḥ kṣetrajñā nāma na santi | ... ... vicitrasṛṣṭiyogāt brahmaiva jagatkāraṇam || 35 || na karmāvibhāgāditi cennānāditvādupapadyate cāpyupalabhyate ca | api śabdārthamāha - tadanāditve'pi iti | ca - arthamāha - akṛta iti || sarvadharmopapatteśca || 2-1-36 || pradhānaparamāṇvādīnāṃ kāraṇatve ... ... brahmaiva jagatkāraṇamiti sthitam || 36 || iti prayojanavattvādhikaraṇam - 10 iti śrībhagavadrāmānujaviraciteśārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣye dvitīyasyādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ || sarvadharmopapatteśca | etatpādasarvādhikaraṇa śeṣabhūtamidaṃ sūtram ||iti prayojanavattvādhikaraṇam - 10 iti harikulatilakavāgvijayisūnunā śrīraṅgarājadivyājñālabdhavedavyāsāparanāmadheyena śrīmadvaradācāryapādasevāsamadhigata śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracitaśārīkamīmāṃsābhāṣyahṛdayena śrīsudarśanasūriṇā vilikhitāyāṃ śrutapradīpikāyāṃ dvitīyādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ || dvitīyādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || <1. racanānupapattyadhikaraṇam ||> racanānupapatteśca nānumānaṃ pravṛtteśca || 2-2-1 || uktaṃ jagajjanmādikāraṇaṃ paraṃ brahmeti | ... ... atastriguṇaṃ jagat guṇatrayasāmyarūpapradhānaikakāraṇamiti niścīyate || racanānupapatteśca nānumānaṃ pravṛtteśca | pādapañcakārthamanuvadan saṅgatimāha - uktam ityādinā | svapakṣe kāraṇaviṣayaparoktadoṣaḥ parihṛtaḥ | parapakṣe kāraṇaviṣayadoṣa ucyate iti saṅgatiḥ | anena tṛtīyapādasya dvitīyatvaśaṅkā vyudastā, tasya kāryaviṣayatvāt || kāpilanirāsaprāthamye hetumāha - tatra iti | ādi śabdāt cadurviṃśatitattvāṅgīkāra ucyate | paunaruktyamāśaṅkyāha - īkṣateḥ iti | tatsaṅgrahaślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe - mūlaprakṛtirnāma iti | upaṣṭambhanam - parābhibhavaḥ | yena kenāpyākārāntareṇa sāmyaśaṅkāvyudāsāyāha - anyūna iti | nirdharmakaḥ - jñātṛtvarahitaḥ nirastaprāyaḥ - ta nnirāsaḥ phalita ityarthaḥ || te caivam ityādinā sthalaśuddhiḥ kṛtā | bhedānām ityādiślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe - ayamarthaḥ iti | sarūpakāraṇakatvamastu, kathaṃ pradhānasiddhiriti śaṅkāyāṃ samanvayāt iti padaṃ vyācaṣṭe - sattvarajastamomaya iti | jagat vicitrasanniveśatvāt kāryam; kāryatvāt sarūpakāraṇakam ityanumitiḥ | kārye sukhaduḥkhamohānvayāt parimitasya kāraṇatve'navasthiteśca pradhānaṃ kāraṇamiti pakṣadharmatābalasiddham || atrocyate - racanānupapatteśca nānumānaṃ pravṛtteśca ... ... kāryāraṃbhāyaiva parimitatvamavaśyāśrayaṇīyam || 1 || atrocyate ityādi | adhiṣṭhitadārvādeḥ cetanasya ca vyāvartakaṃ hetupadadvayam | pratyanumānopayoginīṃ vyāptiṃ śikṣayati - yadevam iti | nimittānumitāviva viśeṣavirodhaprasaṅgopayoginīṃ vā | dṛṣṭānte'nvayavyatirekau darśayan vākyārthamāha - dārvādeḥ iti | cakārāt iti | kāryānvitamṛdāderiva sattvādimayasukhādeḥ kārye anvayāt sattvādīnāṃ kāraṇatvamiti yat, tat śauklyādāvanaikāntikatayā dṛṣṭamityarthaḥ | guṇā iti iti | svārasyaṃ cābhagnamiti bhāvaḥ || jagat prājñānadhiṣṭhitā citkāraṇakaṃ na bhavati, kāryatvāt; yat kāryaṃ, tadabhijñādhiṣṭhitācitkāraṇakaṃ yathā ghaṭaḥ ityanumānam | prājñādhiṣṭhitācitkāraṇakatvaprasaṅgaḥ iti vā | nanu evam īśvarānumitinirāso vyāhataḥ | kāryatvādinā cetane siddhe, indriyādisṛṣṭeḥ prāk tadanapekṣādhiṣṭātṛtayā viśeṣasiddhiriti | naivam | viṣamāvasthasya kāryāraṃbhakadṛṣṭyā samāvasthaṃ kāraṇamasiddham | siddhe'pi na tvadīpsitasiddhiriti abhyupagamenoktaḥ | anadhiṣṭhitasyācito dārvāderivānārambhakatvāprasaṅgaḥ iti vā || yacca ityādi | ata eva - anekatvādeva | anekatvābhyupagamaṃ darśayati - sāmya iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - ataḥ iti | aparimitatvāt vyavasthā ityatrāha - na ca iti | kathamityatrāha - aparimitatve hi iti | pṛthukāryārambho'nekeṣāṃ saṃyuktapārśvaiḥ saṃyogavattvāt, tacca parimitatvāt, tacca vaiṣamyāt; mitānāṃ viṣamāṇāṃ ca sakāraṇakatvāt, teṣāmapi kāraṇānāmīdṛśatvādanavasthetyarthaḥ || yatra rathādiṣu spaṣṭaṃ cetanādhiṣṭhitatvaṃ, ... .... payo'mbuvaccet tatrāpi || 2-2-2 || yaduktaṃ pradhānasya prājñānadhiṣṭhitasya ... ... na prājñādhiṣṭhitatvaṃ parākṛtam, yo'psu tiṣṭhan ityādiśruteḥ || 2 || anantarasūtramavatārayati - yatra iti | kṣīrādidṛṣṭāntena prājñānadhiṣṭhitatvaṃ sādhayasi cet, tat pakṣīkṛtamityāhetyarthaḥ || payo'mbuvaccet tatrāpi | ādyaśabdāt cakrabhramaṇavyudāsaḥ | spandaḥ - anyathā bhāvaḥ, na cu calanam | pratiprati - prativastu guṇonmeṣaviśeṣāt | prāguktena viruddhamidamityāśaṅkyāha - upasaṃhāra iti || vyatirekānavasthiteścānapekṣatvāt || 2-2-3 || itaśca satyasaṅkalpeśvarādhiṣṭhānānapekṣa ... ... kṣipāmyajasramaśubhānā surīṣveva yoniṣu || iti ca || vyatirekānavasthiteścānapekṣatvāt | avāptā eva kāmāḥ iti avāptasamastakāmaḥ | abbhakṣa itivat | avāptavyaṃ netyarthaḥ | tatra hetuḥ paripūrṇatvam guṇavibhūtyādibhiḥ | vibhūtyāderanukūlatvamāha - anavadhika iti | niravadyasya - akarmavaśyasya | nirañjanasya - sattvādirahitasya | ataḥ icchādyabhāvānna sargādirityarthaḥ | pari iti | pariṇāmaviśeṣapratīkṣaṇānna svātantryahāniḥ tasya svasaṅkalpādhīnatvāt | yathāsaṅkalpaṃ pravṛttikṣamatvaṃ hi svātantryam || nanu ityādinā kṛtaṃ codyaṃ pariharati - anabhijña iti | kapilāgamavyāvṛttyarthamāha - śāstraṃ ca iti | śāstrābhijñairuktamityāha - tathā cāha iti | bibharti - ārādhanatayā svīkaroti | pāpasya tadapacārarūpatvajñāpanāyāha - tathā ca bhagavatā iti || sa bhagavān puruṣottamo'vāptasamastakāmaḥ ... ... ataḥ prājñānadhiṣṭhitaṃ pradhānaṃ na kāraṇam || 3 || ebhirvacanaiḥ kathaṃ codyaparihāraḥ kṛtaḥ? dayāluḥ kathama hite pravartayati? karmasāpekṣanigrahānugrahatve svātantryahāniḥ; svatantraścet jīvānāṃ phalānvayo na syāt, svatantrakartaryeva phalānvayasya yuktatvāt ityatrāha sa bhagavān i ti | ubhayaliṅgatvaṃ, tatkṛtavailakṣaṇyaṃ, sāpekṣatvavyudāsaḥ, phaladānānuguṇajñānādimattvaṃ ca darśitaṃ bhagavān ityādipadaiḥ | bahvāyāsasya līlātvāyogaṃ vyudasyati - svamāhātmya iti | svatantraścet puṇyāpuṇye viparyayeṇakalpayedityatrāha - etāni iti| anāditadvyavasthā ca anāditatsvātantryādhīnetyarthaḥ || sarvapravṛtteḥ tadicchādhīnatve jīvānāṃ na phalānvayaḥ syādityatrāha - tadupādāna iti | pravṛttasya pravartakaḥ anumantā | parāpekṣā darśitā | jīvānāṃ svātantryāvakāśaṃ darśayati - kṣetrajñāstu iti | svayameva prathamapravṛttitadanuguṇecchājñāneṣu bhagavānupekṣaka ityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha - ataḥ svātantrya iti | ādi śabdānnirdayatvamuktam| jīvānāṃ phalānvayāyogaśca | dayāsvarūpaṃ śikṣayati - dayā hi iti | upajīvināmupajīvyaduḥkhāsahiṣṇutvavyāvṛttyarthamāha - svārtha iti | tasyā asthāne doṣamāha - sā ca iti | tarhi sā'navakāśetyatrāha - svaśāsana iti | prītipūrvakaṃ dadāmi ityanvayaḥ, satatayuktānām iti ktasyāśaṃsārthatvāt | na cet bhajatām iti punaruktiḥ | sāmānyena dhārakatvakaraṇakalevarapradatvānumantṛtvaphalapradatvairīśvarāpekṣatvāt sarvatādadhīnyam | pravṛttiviśeṣeṣu jīvasya svātantryāt phalānvayaḥ | na ca kṛtsnasya īśvarādhīnatvahāniḥ, tatsvātantryasyāpi tadadhīnatvāt | na ca vyāhatiḥ | amātyādisvātantryasya nṛpādhīnatvadṛṣṭeḥ | phalānvayaścāmātyādeḥ | īśvaraḥ prathamapravṛttāvupekṣakaḥ, tato'numantā | unmastakaprītyaprītikāriṣu prayojayitā ca upekṣā ca svātantryāt | tacca na doṣaḥ | dharmigrāhakatvāt | anumatiśca daṇḍakalpā | nṛpādiṣu dṛṣṭeḥ | dayā cenna guṇaḥ, nigrahaścenna doṣaḥ asthānapātinostayoḥ viparītarūpatvadarśanāt | tato heturanekāntaḥ | rājño daṇḍyadaṇḍanaṃ śāstravaśyatvāt guṇa iti cet dayā'pi tathetyaśāstravaśye īśvare yathāśāstraṃ guṇa ityupetyam | dayāvakāśastu darśita iti na kā'pyanupapattiḥ| upasaṃharati - ataḥ iti | ataḥ brahmakāraṇavādasya nirdoṣatvāt tavaiva doṣasthiterityarthaḥ || atha syāt - yadyapi prājñānadhiṣṭhitāyāḥ ... ... anyatrābhāvācca na tṛṇādivat || 2-2-4 || naitadupapadyate | tṛṇādeḥ ... ... atra prapañcitaṃ tatraiva vyabhicārapradarśanāya || 4 || uttarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - atha syāt iti | kevaladārvādivyavacchedāyacitsannidhirevālam, na tu saṅkalpaviśeṣavatpuruṣāvaśyaṃbhāvaḥ | gavi suptāyāmapi tadbhuktatṛṇādeḥ kṣīratvāpattidarśanāt na ca tadapi pakṣīkāryam | tāvatā kārye saṃbhavati, adhikaklṛptirayukteti bhāvaḥ || anyatrābhāvācca na tṛṇādivat | anaḍudādyapayuktaṃ prahīṇaṃ vā iti padadvayena citsannidhimātravataḥ kevalasya cācitaḥ pariṇāme dṛṣṭāntatvaṃ dūṣitam | saṅkalpaviśeṣānvitacetanaviśeṣādhiṣṭhānaṃ tu parāniṣṭamityabhipretam prājñānadhiṣṭhitam iti padena prapañcitam | kevaladārvādivyavacchedakena saṅkalpādyaśaktacitsannidhimātreṇa pariṇāme dṛṣṭānto'stītyadhikā śaṅkā'tra parihṛteti bhāvaḥ || tatraiva - payodṛṣṭānte eva || 4 || puruṣāśmavaditi cet tathā'pi || 2-2-5 || athocyeta - yadyapi caitanyamātravapuḥ ... .. nityamuktatvena bandhābhāvo'pavargābhāvaśca || 5 || puruṣāśmavaditi cet tathā'pi | upabhoga śabdena darśanaśabdo vyākhyātaḥ | vibhutvāt samīpagamanānapekṣā cet nityasargaprasaṅgaḥ uktaḥ || aṅgitvānupapateśca || 2-2-6 || guṇānāmutkarṣanikarṣanibandhanāṅgibhāvāddhi ... ... ataśca na prājñānadhiṣṭhitaṃ pradhānaṃ kāraṇam || 6|| aṅgitvānupapatteśca | evamantena paroktānumiterviśeṣavirodha uktaḥ || anyathā'numitau ca jñaśaktiviyogāt || 2-2-7 || dūṣitaprakārātiriktaprakārāntareṇa ... ... ato na kathañcidapyanumānena pradhānasiddhiḥ || 7 || anumānāntare'pyuktamatidiśati - anyathā'numitau ca jñaśaktiviyogāt | jñātṛtve sati hi saṅkalpādadhiṣṭhātrantarānapekṣapravṛttisaṃbhavaḥ | tacca neti nityasargaprasaṅgaḥ ityarthaḥ || 7 || abhyupagame'pyarthābhāvāt || 2-2-8 || anumānena pradhānasiddhyabhyupagame'pi ... ... prakṛtisannidhānasya nityatvena kadācidapvapavargo na setsyati || 8 || abhyupagame'pyarthābhāvāt | nityanirvikārasya bhogāpavargāyoga uktaḥ || 8 || vipratiṣedhāccāsamañjasam || 2-2-9 || vipratiṣiddhaṃ cedaṃ sāṃkhyānāṃ darśanam | .... ... brahmaṇo'yameva svabhāva ityupādhisaṃbandhādyanupapatterasāmañjasyaṃ pūrvamovoktam || 9 || tathā'pi tadabhyupagamaśaṅkāyāmanantarasūtram - vipratiṣedhāccāsamañjasam | parārthatvapratiyogyākāraḥ adhiṣṭhātṛtvaṃ - svātantryam | sākṣisvarūpeṇa anusandhātā | draṣṭā - indriyādibhiḥ | triguṇādiviparyayāt triguṇatatkāryasya jaḍasya adhiṣṭhātṛtvāyogāt | kaivalyārthapravṛtteśca - na hi tyājyameva tyāgakartā | uktārtheṣu vipratiṣedhaṃ darśayati - sākṣitva ityādinā | sa ca iti | cetanadharma tvāt na prakṛteḥ vikāratvānna puruṣasyetyarthaḥ | puruṣasya svātmadarśanam iti | puruṣakartṛkadarśanam | svakartṛkatvena nādhyasyati ca ityarthaḥ || sāṃkhyapakṣanirāso mṛṣāvādināṃ svakaṇṭhagrahītyāha - ye'pi iti | nityanirvikāratvāt adhyāsādyanupapattiḥ | dṛśyatvabādhyatvābhyupagamāt iti | avidyānubhavatadbādhakajñānarūpavikārau nopapadyete ityarthaḥ | ayameva nirvikāratvanirdoṣatvādireva | ubhayaliṅgakatvaśrutivirodho'bhipretaḥ | yadvā upādhisaṃbandhitvāt saduḥkham; vṛhattvāt duḥkhapratibhaṭam ityevaṃ viruddho'yaṃ svabhāvaḥ syāditi asāmañjasyam ityarthaḥ || 9 || iti racanānupapattyadhikaraṇam - 1 <2. mahaddīrghādhikaraṇam ||> mahaddīrghavadvā hrasvaparimaṇḍalābhyām || 2-2-10 || pradhānakāraṇavādasya yuktyābhāsamūlatayā ... ... tadabhyupagataṃ sarvamasamañjasamityeva sūtrārthaḥ || 10 || mahaddīrghavadvā hasvaparimaṇḍalābhyām | prakṛti paramāṇvorānumānikatvāt tannirāso saṅgatau | dvyaṇukatrayāddhi tryaṇukotpattiḥ na tu dvyaṇukaparamāṇubhyāmityatrāha - paramāṇubhyaḥ iti | aṇuhrasvasyāpi pradarśanārthaṃ mahaddī pādānamityarthaḥ, mahaddīrghāṇuhasvotpattivat iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | sarṣapamahīdharayorevāsiddheḥ iti | sāṃśatve avayavānantyāt vaiṣamyākhyadharmāsiddhiḥ | tatparijihīrṣayā niraṃśatve dharmiṇoreva sarṣapamahīdharāvayavinoḥ asiddhirityarthaḥ | kiṃ kurmaḥ? kiṃ matamavalambanīyamityarthaḥ | vaidikaḥ - yuktibādhāgocaraḥ iti bhāvaḥ | asaṅgatam - pādāsaṅgatam | asaṅgatipunaruktī granthadvayenopapādayati - brahma ityādinā || 10 || kimatrānyadasamañjasamityatrāha - ubhayadhā'pi na karmātastadabhāvaḥ || 2-2-11 || paramāṇukāraṇavāde hi ... ... ato jagadutpatteraṇugatakarmapūrvakatvābhāvaḥ || 11 || anantarasūtrasya śaṅkāmāha - kimatra iti | ubhayadhā'pi na karmātastadabhāvaḥ ātmagatasya iti | vyadhikaraṇatvādityarthaḥ | vipākaḥ - phalārhadaśā || 11 || samavāyābhyupagamācca sāmyādanavasthiteḥ || 2-2-12 || samavāyābhyupagamāccāsamañjasam ... ... samavāyamabhyupagamya tasyaiṣa svabhāva iti kalpayituṃ yuktam - iti || 12 || samavāyābhyupagamācca sāmyādanavasthiteḥ | avayavādīnāṃ kathamupapādakāpekṣā? kathamasya tatsāmyaṃ svaparanirvāhakasyetyatrāha - etaduktam - iti || 12 || samavāyasya nityatve anityatve ca .... .... nityameva ca bhāvāt || 2-2-13 || samavāyasya saṃbandhatvāt ... ... jagataśca nityameva bhāvādasamañjasam || 13 || nityameva ca bhāvāt | tataśca nityatvāt kāraṇabhūtaparamāṇvīśvaraklṛptirayukteti bhāvaḥ || 13 || rūpādimattvācca viparyayo darśanāt || 2-2-14 || paramāṇūnāṃ pārthivāpyataijasa ... ... rūpādimattvaṃ tvayā kalpyate | ato'pyasamañjasam || 14 || rūpādimattvācca viparyayo darśanāt | paramāṇūnāmayaṃ viśeṣo yannityatvādinā ghaṭādivaidharmyamityatrāha - na hi iti || 14 || athaitaddoṣaparijihīrṣayā paramāṇūnāṃ ...... ubhayadhā ca doṣāt || 2-2-15 || na kevalaṃ paramāṇūnāṃ rūpādimattvābhyupagamṛ ... ... pūrvoktadoṣa ityubhayadhā ca doṣādasamañjasam || 15 || ubhayadhā ca doṣāt | anyathā ityanuktatvāt śirontaraṃ neti bhāvaḥ || 15 || aparigrahāccātyantamanapekṣā || 2-2-16 || kāpilapakṣasya śrutinyāyavirodha ... ... atyantamanapekṣaiva niḥśreyasārthibhiḥ kāryā || 16 || aparigrahāccātyantamanapekṣā | atyanta śabdavyāvartyamāha - kāpila iti | śrutivirodho dūṣaṇatayoktaḥ || 16 || iti mahaddīrghādhikaraṇam -2 <3. samudāyādhikaraṇam ||> samudāya ubhayahetuke'pi tadaprāptiḥ || 2-2-17 || paramāṇukāraṇavādino vaiśeṣikāḥ ... ... sa ca jñātaiveti copapāditaṃ purastāt || 17 || samudāya ubhayahetuke'pi tadaprāptiḥ | paramāṇuṣu cāturvidhyaikāntatvopagamasāmyāt saṅgatiḥ | saugateṣu paramāṇukāraṇavādino vivektuṃ tadvidhābhedaṃ darśayati - te ca iti | aṇūpagamavatordvayoḥ prastāvāt ītarayostatsājātyāt saṅgatiriti bhāvaḥ || citta iti | cittaṃ - vijñānasantānaḥ | caittaṃ - rāgādikam | rūpaskandho'pi cittaviṣayatvāt cittacaittāntargata iti vācaspatyādayaḥ | rūpaskandhavyatiriktaskandhacatuṣṭayaṃ cittacaittāntargatamiti bhāskarīye | bhūtendriyaviṣayo rūpaskandhaḥ | ahamiti grāhakatvābhimānārūḍho jñaptisantānaḥ vijñānaskandhaḥ | priyāpriyānubhavajanitasukhaduḥkhasya cittasya avasthāviśeṣaḥ - vedanāskandhaḥ | savikalpakapratyayaḥ - saṃjñāskandhaḥ | rāgadveṣādayaḥ - saṃskāraskandhaḥ | tatprāptiḥ - samudāyatvaprāptiḥ | vyāpriyanta iti vyāpāraḥ - calanam | kiṃ śabdaḥ kṣepe | spṛśati - indriyeṇa saṃbandhaṃ karoti | kadā - na kadācit | tadevopapādayati - spṛṣṭvā hi iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - katham iti | jñānasyātmatvamayuktamityāha ahamartha eva iti | ubhayahetuka padaṃ na brāhyāntarahetukatvaparam | cittacaittānāṃ saṅghātatvāyogāt | ato'rthāntaroktiḥ || 17 || itaretarapratyayatvādupapannamiti cenna saṅghāta bhāvānimittatvāt || 2-2-18 || avidyādīnāmitaretarahetutvenopapannaṃ ... ... saṃskārānuvṛttirapi na śakyā kalpayitum || 18 || itaretarapratyayatvādupapannamiti cenna saṅghātabhāvānimittatvāt | ayaṃ samyak pāṭhaḥ | ādi śabdāt jñānaviṣayatvavyavahāragrahaṇam | avidyādayaḥ ke, kathaṃ teṣāmanyonyahetutvaṃ kathaṃ ca tena saṃghaṭitabhāvopapattiḥ ityatrāha etaduktam iti | etaśca iti | etat - avidyādibhiḥ saṅghātaḥ, saṅghātādavidyā ityupalabhyamānaṃ cakrakam avidyādihetubhūtasaṅghātānabhyupagame nopapadyata ityarthaḥ | śukti iti | na hi śuktau rajatabhramaḥ śuktidvayasaṃhatiheturityarthaḥ | sūtrābhipretamāha - kiṃ ca iti | saṃskāreṇeti cet tatrāha - saṃskārāśrayam iti || 18 || uttarotpāde ca pūrvanirodhāt || 2-2-19 || itaśca kṣaṇikatvapakṣe jagadutpattiḥ ... .... na kasyacidarthasya jñānaviṣayatvaṃ saṃbhavati || 19 || uttarotpāde ca pūrvanirodhāt | ghaṭakṣaṇastaddeśasantānasthaghaṭakṣaṇāntaraheturiti cāyuktam | deśāntaranayane ghaṭakṣaṇādutpattiprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ | utpattāvukto doṣo jñaptāvapi tulya ityāha - kiṃ ca iti || 19 || asati pratijñoparodho yaugapadyamanyathā || 2-2-20 || asatyapi hetau kāryamutpadyate ... ... indriyasaṃprayogajñānayoryaugapadyaṃ prasajyeta || 20 || asati pratijñoparodho yaugapadyamanyathā | kṣaṇikatvaṃ sthitameveti cet iti | uttarakṣaṇaḥ pūrvakṣaṇavartīti cedityarthaḥ | dūṣayati indriyasya iti | kāryakāraṇabhāvabhaṅgaprasaṅgaḥ ityarthaḥ | jñānatatkāraṇayaugapadyāpādanamartheṣvapi ghaṭādiṣu pradarśanārtham ||20|| pratisaṃkhyāpratisaṃkhyānirodhāprāpti ravicchedāt || 2-2-21 || evaṃ tāvadasata utpattirnirastā ... ... tatrāpi avasthāntarāpattikalpanasyaiva yuktatvāt || 21 || pratisaṃkhyāpratisaṃkhyānirodhāprāptiravicchedāt | pratipāditaḥ iti | anupalabdhikalpakānyathāsiddhibhyāmityarthaḥ | niścite - abādhitapratyabhijñayeti bhāvaḥ || 21 || ubhayadhā ca doṣāt || 2-2-22 || kṣaṇikatvavādibhirabhyupetā tucchādutpattiḥ ... ... na bhavaduktaprakārāvutpattinirodhau || 22 || ubhayadhā ca doṣāt | na ca pratīyate, tucchatayā iti śeṣaḥ || ākāśe cāviśeṣāt || 2-2-23 || bāhyābhyantaravastunaḥ sthiratva ... ... pañcīkaraṇena rūpavattvāt cākṣuṣatve'pyavirodhaḥ || 23 || ākāśe cāviśeṣāt | kṣaṇikatvanirāsānupayogāt prasaṅgāt saṅgatiḥ || 23 || anusmṛteśca || 2-2-24 || pūrvaprastutaṃ vastunaḥ sthiratvameva ... ... na hyanyenopakrāntamajānadbhiḥ anyaiḥ samāpayituṃ śakyam || 24 || anusmṛteśca | tacca iti | tarkānugṛhītapratyabhijñā balīyasīti bhāvaḥ | pratyakṣānumityoḥ sādhāraṇaṃ dūṣaṇamuktam | pratyakṣaṃ prativakti kiṃ ca iti | vyāvṛttirgamayati iti gamyagamakatvanirdeśo lokaprasiddhyanusārāt | vartamānakālayoga eva hi avartamānāt vyāvṛttiḥ | pūrvottarāvasthāto vartamānatvāvasthābhedaśceti kṣaṇikatvasādhakatayocyate | ekasya nīlatvotpalatvayogavat kāladvayayogāvirodhāt na kṣaṇikatvasādhakatā | abhimataviparīta iti | viparyayeṇāpi vyāptisaṃbhavāt viruddhārthasyāpi sādhakamiti | viruddham - viparītam | prakaraṇasamamityarthaḥ || arthakriyākāritvaṃ viruddhamevetyāha - kiṃ ca iti | ghaṭakṣaṇasattvahetoḥ sopādhikatvamāha - tathā'ntya iti | pūrvaṃ iti | na hyanyadavabhāsyam, anyo viṣayaḥ | atiprasaṅgādityarthaḥ | pratyabhijñāyāḥ saṃskārasacivendriyaṃ sāmagrī | ekasya kāladvayasaṃbandho viṣayaḥ | tathedam iti parārthānumityayoga uktaḥ || 24 || nāsato dṛṣṭatvāt || 2-2-25 || evaṃ tāvat sautrāntikavaibhāṣikayoḥ .... .... jñānavaicitryamarthasya jñānakāle'vasthānādeva bhavati || 25 || nāsato dṛṣṭatvāt | uttarotpāde ityādisūtraṣaṭkaṃ dṛṣṭānubandhidūṣaṇaparamiti, tadanantaraṃ tatparihārāya sautrāntikāvasaraḥ | sa eva yogācāramatamāśaṅkyāha - na ca pūrvaṃ iti | atra ityādi | pratibimbādi iti ādi śabdena sphaṭike japāyā iva chāyāpattirvivakṣitā || 25 || punarapi sādhāraṇaṃ dūṣaṇamāha - udāsīnānāmapi caivaṃ siddhiḥ || 2-2-26 || evaṃ kṣaṇikatvāsadutpattyahetuka ... .... udāsīnānāmapyaihikāmuṣmikaphalaṃ mokṣaśca siddhyet || 26 || udāsīnānāmapi caivaṃ siddhiḥ | prasaṅgasyāniṣṭatvamāha - iṣṭa prāptiḥ iti | saṃskārādiḥ svargāya; vidyādiḥ mokṣāya || 26 || iti samudāyādhikaraṇam -3 <4. upalavdhyadhikaraṇam ||> nābhāva upalabdheḥ || 2-2-27 || vijñānamātrāstitvavādino yogācārāḥ ... ... dravyatvamaviruddhamityuktam | ato na bāhyārthābhāvaḥ || 27 || nābhāva upalabdheḥ| vaicitryaṃ kathamityatrāha - tacca iti | vijātīyajñānotpattiḥ kathamityatrāha - yadghaṭākāra iti | yathā arthasya vijātīyotpādakatvamupagatam tadvaditi bhāvaḥ | jñānārthayoḥ iti | yathā candrayoriti bhāvaḥ || evaṃ prāpte iti | evaṃrūpeṇa iti | jñānetarāpāramārthyaṃ kimanena vā jñānāntareṇa vā sādhyate? prathame'parekṣatayā bhātatvāviśeṣāt jñānamapi tathā kiṃ na syāt | dvitīyamanupalabdhihatamiti bhāvaḥ || sahadhīniyamaṃ pariharati - yat tu iti | abhedahetuniyamo'tīva bhedasādhaka ityāha - tat iti | saṃbandhaśca iti | saṃbandhaḥ - sākṣātsaṃbandhaḥ | dravyasya kathaṃ niyataprakāratvamityatrāha - prabhā iti || 27 || yat paraiḥ svapnajñānadṛṣṭāntena .... ... vaidharmyācca na svapnādivat || 2-2-28 || svapnajñānavaidharmyāt jāgarita ... ... jñānatvasyānaikāntyāt sutarāmarthaśūnyatvāsiddhiḥ || 28 || anantarasūtramavatārayati - yat paraiḥ iti | vaidharmyācca na svapnādivat | svāpnārthamithyātvābhyupagamenoktam | tatsatyatvaṃ hi vakṣyate sūtrakāraiḥ || na bhāvo'nupalabdheḥ || 2-2-29 || na kevalamarthaśūnyasya jñānasya .... ... nārthaśūnyatvamiti khyātinirūpaṇe pratipāditam || 29 || na bhāvo'nupalabdheḥ | kvacidapi iti | suṣuptau dharmisphuraṇameva, na tu dharmadhīsphuraṇamiti bhāvaḥ || 29 || iti upalabdhyadhikaraṇam - 4 <5. sarvathānupapattyadhikaraṇam ||> sarvathā'nupapatteśca || 2-2-30 || atra sarvaśūnyavādī mādhyamikaḥ .... ..... sarvathā sarvaśūnyatvaṃ cānupapannam || 30 || sarvathā'nupapatteśca | prayojanābhāvācca iti | svasattā hyutpatteḥ phalam | sā prāgevāstīti notpatteḥ phalamityarthaḥ | iti prāpte iti | sat iti | dṛṣṭāntārthamuktam | ghaṭaḥ svāpekṣayā san, kapālāpekṣayā asan | ataḥ sadasadātmakatvaṃ ca yuktam | anubhayātmakaṃ ca ghaṭo hi svāpekṣayā nāsan; kapālāpekṣayā na san anubhayātmakaṃ neti tu ubhayātmakasadasaditi uktaṃ syāt ityavasthāviśeṣayogāt tucchatvāsiddhiḥ | sarvathā - śabdena mānakalpanānupapattiścābhipretā iti manvāna āha - kiṃ ca iti | adhikaraṇatrayātmakaḥ saugatanirāsaḥ || 30 || iti sarvathā'nupapattyadhikaraṇam - 5 <6. ekasminnasaṃbhavādhikaraṇam ||> naikasminnasaṃbhavāt || 2-2-31 || nirastāḥ saugatāḥ | jainā api ... ... īśvarānadhiṣṭhitaparamāṇukāraṇavāde pūrvoktadoṣāstathaivāvatiṣṭhante || 31 || naikasminnasaṃbhavāt | ekāntatvāt cāturvidhyopagamasāmyāt kāṇādasaugatanirāsayoḥ saṅgatatvāt saugatānantaramārhatanirāsasaṅgatiḥ | sthitihetubhūtaḥ - sthāvaratvādihetuḥ apravṛttikara ityarthaḥ | tatprayuktasukhaduḥkhopekṣā ityekarāśiḥ | anyathā catuṣṭayāyogāt || rāddhānte - ākārabhedādavirodha ityatrāha - etaduktam iti | dravyāvasthayorbhinnatvapakṣe dūṣaṇamāha - dravyasya iti | tayorabhede nākārabhedādavirodhasiddhiḥ | bhedābhede tvākārāntarāpekṣayā'navastheti prāguktatvānna kaṇṭhoktam | prastutavirodhaḥ kathamityatrāha - tathā hi iti| sattvāsattvanityatvānityatvabhinnatvābhinnatvavirodhā upapāditāḥ | padārthaviśeṣaṇatayaiva iti | sahopalabdhiniyamābhiprāyeṇoktam, na tu jātyādivat ekāśrayatvābhiprāyeṇa sarvapadārthaviśeṣaṇatayā kālāṇutvanirāsaḥ phalitaḥ | ekasmin kāle aneke padārthāḥ santīti kālaviśiṣṭapratītiḥ| anaikāntyasya vyabhicāramāha - kiṃ ca iti || 31 || evaṃ cātmākārtsnyam || 2-2-32 || evaṃ bhavadabhyupagame sati ... ... akārtsnyaṃ prasajyate aparipūrṇatā prasajyate ityarthaḥ || 32 || evaṃ cātmākārtsnyam | asaṃkhyātapradeśaḥ - ekarūpasaṃkhyāhīnadeśaḥ | aniyatapradeśa ityarthaḥ || 32 || atha saṅkocavikāsadharmatayā ... ... na ca paryāyādapyavirodho vikārādibhyaḥ || 2-2-33 || na ca saṅkocavikāsarūpa ... ... doṣaprasakteḥ ghaṭāditulyatvaprasaṅgāt || 33|| anantarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - atha iti | na ca paryāyādapyavirodho vikārādibhyaḥ | vikāraḥ - utpattyādiḥ | tena parimitakālavartitvam anityatvam || 33 || antyāvasthiteścobhayanityatvādaviśeṣaḥ || 2-2-34 || jīvasya yadantyaṃ parimāṇam ... ... asaṅgatamevedamārhatamatam || 34 || antyāvasthiteścobhayanityatvādaviśeṣaḥ | yathā svarūpaṃ muktidaśāsthāyi pūrvamapi sat | evamantyaparimāṇamapi mokṣasthāyitvāt pūrvamapi saditi na dehaparimāṇatvasiddhirityarthaḥ || 34 || iti ekasminnasaṃbhavādhikaraṇam - 6 <7. paśupatyadhikaraṇam ||> patyurasāmañjasyāt || 2-2-35 || kapilakaṇādasugatārhatamatānām .... ... kāpālaṃ vratamāsthāya yatirbhavati mānavaḥ || iti || patyurasāmañjasyāt vedavirodhitvasāmyāt dhīsthatayā saṅgatiḥ | pradhānopagamasāmye'pi sāṃkhyānantaryamatilaṅdhya, ārhatānantarametannirāso'syātyanta bāhyatvajñāpanāya kṛtaḥ nimitta iti tattvavirodhaḥ | tathā ityanuṣṭhānavirodhaścoktaḥ | mitho vyādhātamāha - - mudrikā iti | mudrikāghāraṇādayo nānātantreṣūktāḥ na tvekatra || tatredamucyate - patyurasāmañjasyāt iti | ... ... vedaviruddhatattvopāsanānuṣṭhānābhidhānāt paśupatimatamanādaraṇīyameva || 35 || tatredam ityādi | vaidikapakṣasya tadvaiṣamyamāha - vedāḥ khalu iti | ekatāṃ gatāḥ - sarvaśākhāpratyayanayāditi bhāvaḥ | śambhuśivādiśabdārthaniṣkarṣāyāha - kevala iti | yasya parṇamayī iti dravyaviśeṣanirṇayaparavākyavat nārāyaṇānuvāko devatāviśeṣanirṇayaparaḥ | duhṇā juhoti homasādhanatvavidhiparavākyavat upāsanaparavākyāni tadanuguṇārthānīti bhāvaḥ || kāraṇavākyeṣu devatāntarapratītirityatrāha - tathā iti | chāgapaśunyāyo'bhipretaḥ | yato vā imāni iti vākyābhipretatvāt janmādi iti sūtre'pyabhipreto'yamartha iti parasmāt puṃsaḥ ityantena sūcitam || adhiṣṭhānānupapatteśca || 2-2-36 || vedabāhyānāmanumānāddhi kevalanimitta ... .... śāstrayonitvāt ityatra doṣasyoktatvāt || 36 || adhiṣṭhānānupapatteśca | vakṣyamāṇadūṣaṇasya svāsparśitvāyāha - vedabāhyānām | iti || 36 || karaṇavaccenna bhogādibhyaḥ || 2-2-37 || yathā bhokturjīvasya karaṇakalevara ... .. sarvaṃ prasajyeta | ato nādhiṣṭhānasaṃbhavaḥ || 37 || karaṇavaccenna bhogādibhyaḥ | śarīratvena jagadadhitiṣṭhati cet bhogādiḥ syāt | na cet, dehāntarāpekṣā syāt | śarīre tu tadanapekṣā śarīratvasvaparanirvāhakatvaprayuktā || 37 || antavattvamasarvajñatā vā || 2-2-38 || vāśabdaścārthe | paśupateḥ puṇyāpuṇya ... .... sarvamasamañjasameveti asāmañjasyāt ityuktam || 38 || antavattvamasarvajñatā vā | ivaśabdo vipralambhārthatvadyotakaḥ || iti paśupatyadhikaraṇam - 7 <8.utpattyasaṃbhavādhikaraṇam ||> utpattyasaṃbhavāt || 2-2-39 || kapilāditantrasāmānyāt bhagavadabhihita ... .... na jāyate mriyate vā vipaścit ityādyāḥ || 39 || utpattyasaṃbhavāt | avāntarasaṅgatimāha kapilādi iti | āśaṅkya nirākriyate iti pūrvapakṣasiddhānta sūtradvayadvikārthau | kathamāśaṅkā ityatrāha - tatraivam iti || 39 || na ca kartuḥ karaṇam || 2-2-40 || saṅkarṣaṇāt pradyumnasaṃjñaṃ mano jāyate ... ... asyāpi tantrasya prāmāṇyaṃ pratiṣiddhyate iti || 40 || na ca kartuḥ karaṇam | kartā - jīvaḥ| saṅkarṣaṇādi śabdānāṃ jīvādi viśeṣaṇatvaṃ pūrvapakṣyabhimatam | jīvādiśabdānāṃ saṅkarṣaṇādiviśeṣaṇatvaṃ tu rāddhāntyabhimatam || 40 || evaṃ prāpte pracakṣmahe - vijñānādibhāve vā tadapratiṣedhaḥ || 2-2-41 || vāśabdāt pakṣo viparivartate | ... ... yathā ākāśaprāṇādiśabdaiḥ brahmaṇo'bhidhānam || 41 || vijñānādibhāve vā tadapratiṣedhaḥ | siddhāntasūtratāṃ darśayati - vāśabdāt iti | api vā kartṛsāmānyāt ekaṃ vā saṃyogarūpacodanākhyāviśeṣāt itivat iti bhāvaḥ | vijñānaṃ ca iti | caitanyasvarūpiṇe, iti parā prakṛtiḥ iti ca mantrādyanusāreṇa jñānasvarūpaparamakāraṇabhūtavāsudevaparo vijñānādi śabda ityabhiprāyaḥ | vākyārthamāha -saṅkarṣaṇa iti || ke saṅkarṣaṇādayaḥ? kathaṃ teṣāṃ parabrahmatvam? tadā kathaṃ brahmaṇa utpattiḥ? tataśca śāstraprāmāṇyam katham? ityatrāha - etaduktam iti | cāturātmyamupāsyata ityanena cāturvidhyasya āśrayaṇīyatārthatvasiddhiḥ | svasaṃjñāmabhiḥ - namontaiḥ vyūhanāmabhiḥ | teṣāṃ parabrahmatvaṃ kathamityatrāha tacca iti | cāturātmyopāstiparaśāstrasya vāsudevākhyabrahmopāsanaparatvoktiḥ vāsudevasyaiva cāturvidhye ghaṭate ityarthaḥ | na paraṃ cāturātmyopāsanam, vibhavārcanaṃ cocyate | ce kimarthe? vāsudeva eva hi mokṣadaḥ ityatrāha - taddhi iti | vibhavādayaḥ ke ityatrāha - vibhavo hi iti | caturvyūha - caturvibhāgaḥ | ādiśabdopāttavacaneṣu vyūhavibhavārcanaphalādi draṣṭavyam | teṣāṃ parabrahmatvamastu, kathamutpattisaṃbhava ityatrāha - ataḥ iti | ajāyamānaḥ iti | na paraṃ śrutivirodhābhāvaḥ, tadānuguṇyaṃ ceti bhāvaḥ | jīvādisāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nirvahati - tatra iti || 40 || vipratiṣedhācca || 2-2-42 || vipratiṣiddhā hi jīvotpattiḥ ... ... pañcarātraśāstraṃ svayameva niramimīteti niravadyam || saṅkarṣaṇādīnāṃ viśeṣyatve'nukūlaliṅgamuktam | jīvādīnāṃ viśeṣyatve pratikūlaliṅgamucyate - vipratiṣedhācca | viśeṣeṇa vividhaṃ vā pratiṣedhaḥ vipratiṣedhaḥ, yathā tacchāstraiḥ vipratiṣiddham iti | etatpādasthayoḥ vipratiṣedha śabdayoḥ arthavairūpyaṃ muṇḍopaniṣadi brahmaśabdayorivārthavaśādupapadyate | yadvā tadutvattiniṣedhake śāstre tadutpattivacanaṃ vyāhatam | niṣedhaṃ darśayati - yathoktam iti | utpattipratipādane'pi, tasya śrutāvapi darśanādavirodhanirvahaṇasya ca tulyanyāyatvāt na śāstrasya śrutiviruddhatvamityāha - janma iti | śarīrasaṃyogaviyogakṛtajñānavikāsa saṅkocarūpatayā vakṣyate ityarthaḥ | upasaṃharati - ataḥ iti || jīvotpattyuktyā śāstrasyāprāmāṇyaṃ rāddhāntayadbhiḥ śāstrāvivakṣitārthaṃ vivakṣitatvenāropya dūṣaṇamuktaṃ syāditi matāntaramasamīcīnam | jīvotpattyatiriktaśaṅkāhetumanūdya vyudasyati - yaścaiṣaḥ ityādinā | paroktārthamupagamya parihṛtam | arthāntaraṃ vaktuṃ taddṛṣṭānte śikṣayati - athavā iti | dārṣṭāntike'pyāha - evam iti | kathamidamityatrāha - paścāt iti | vedārthaviśidīkaraṇarūpatāṃ darśayati - tathā iti || praśnaślokānāmuttararūpaślokaḥ vedānteṣu yathā sāraṃ saṅgṛhya bhagavān hariḥ | bhaktānukampayā vidvān sañcikṣepa yathāsukham || iti | yaṃ vākeṣvanukeṣu niṣatsūpaniṣatsu ca | gṛṇanti satyadharmāṇaḥ satyaṃ satye ca sāmasu || mahato vedavṛkṣasya mūlabhūto mahānayam | skandhabhūtā ṛgādyāste śākhābhūtāstathā mune || ityādi cānusandheyam || vedārtho'tra vivakṣitaścet vedā eva pravartayitavyāḥ| kiṃ granthāntaranirmāṇena? buddhāgamādivat idaṃ vipralipsāmūlaṃ kiṃ na syādityatrāha ataḥ sa bhagavān iti | vedaikavedyaḥ - puruṣatvāt asmadvat iti tarko bādhita iti bhāvaḥ | vedāntavedyaṃ hi brahmetyatrāha - parabrahmābhidhāna iti | bhagavacchabdasamākhyāsiddhamarthamāha - nikhila iti | vipralipsādyabhāvāyāha - apāra iti | bhaktān iti buddhāgamādivyāvṛttiḥ | duṣkṛtāmasurādīnāṃ vināśāya hi tatparaṇītiḥ, na tu nāradaśāṇjilyādi sādhuparitrāṇāya ṇāya | idaṃ tu tatheti | ṛgyajuḥ iti | vedānantyāt granthāntara - nirmāṇamityarthaḥ || vedāprāmāṇyāṅgīkāre kiṃ bahuśastadarthoktiḥ? tadarthavaiśadyārthatvakaṇṭhoktiḥ bhāratādiṣu vedārthaparatvena pratipāditatvaṃ sādhuparitrāṇāya pravṛttatva ca | etadviparyayaścāsya sugatāgamādeśca vaiṣamyam | nāradādiśrotṛtvakathanaṃ vipralipsayeti cet, vede'pyanāśvāsaḥ | kenāpi kṛtvā'pauruṣeyatvaṃ khyāpitamiti kathaṃ na śakyate ? yat tu - paraiḥ sūtracatuṣṭayaṃ kasyacidviruddhāṃśasya ... ... yathāgamaṃ yathānyāyaṃ niṣṭhā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | ityanenaikārthyāt || iti utpattyasaṃbhavādhikaraṇam - 8 iti śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracite śārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣye dvitīyasyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || atha paroktaṃ sūtrārthamanūdya vyudasyati - yat tu ityādinā | akṣarānanuguṇatvam - vāśabda apratiṣedha śabdānanuguṇatvam | abhiprāyavirodhaṃ vivṛṇoti - tathā hi iti | vedāntanyāya iti | nānyatareṇālam, prayojanabhedāditi bhāvaḥ | adhītaśākhārthasya viśayaviparyayāpanodaḥ sūtraphalam | anadhītaśākhārthaiḥ saha tanniṣkarṣa upabṛṃhaṇaphalam | idaṃ śreyaḥ - ityādisāmānādhikaraṇyamaupacārikam | etatpratipādyaṃ svargādisādhanam brahma prāpyam | hitam - mokṣasādhanam || bhāratapraśastatvamasyānaikāntikamiti codayati - nanu ca iti | idaṃ kārtsnyena vedāvirodhāt kṛtsnaprāmāṇyarūpam | ekaniṣṭhatve tattvaviśeṣabubhutsā; pṛthaṅniṣṭhatve mānabubhutsā | kiṃ granthakārābhiprāyaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ, uta arthatattvamiti vikalpe prathamaśirasyuttaraṃ jñānānyetāni iti | kṛtsnasya svayam iti vaktavyavaktṛviśeṣaṇadvayaṃ śrūyate | ebhiḥ ulitamāha - evaṃ vadataḥ iti || nyāyānugṛhītavastuparāmarśasvarūpamāha - abrahmātmakatayā iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - ato vedānta iti | uktamarthaṃ vacanāntareṇa viśadayati - atastatraivedam iti | ekībhūtāni iti | parasparāṅgatvādārthamekatvamuktam | vyākhyeyastham ekapadaṃ pañcarātraviśeṣaṇam | kim aṅgi, aṅgānāṃ kathamaṅgatvam, kasminnaṃśe'pekṣā, tat sarvaṃ kathaṃ pañcarātramāsīt ityatrāha - etaduktam iti | tarhīha kathaṃ nirākaraṇamityatrāha śārīrake ca iti | sāṃkhyādīnāṃ kārtsnyena prāmāṇyaparamiva bhārataṃ vacanaṃ vyācaṣṭe - ataḥ iti | sāṃkhyādīnāṃ kṛtsnaprāmāṇyaṃ ceduktaṃ, tadeva vacanamapramāṇaṃ syāt, vedaviruddhāṃśe'pi grāmāṇyābhidhāyitvāt | aviruddhāṃśasya svīkāryatve buddhāgamādāvapi tathā na śaṅkanīyam | tatra vedaprāmāṇyānaṅgīkārāt | ato yathokta evārthaḥ || 42 || iti utpattyasaṃbhavadhikaraṇam - 8 iti haritakulatilakavāgvijayisūnunā śrīraṅgarājadivyājñālabdhavedavyāsāparanāmadheyena śrīmadvaradācāryapādasevāsamadhigataśrībhagavadrāmānujaviracitaśārīrakamīsamāṃsābhāṣyahṛdayena śrīsudarśanasūriṇā vilikhitāyāṃ śrutapradīpikāyāṃ dvitīyasyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || dvitīyādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || <1. viyadadhikaraṇam ||> na viyadaśruteḥ || 2-3-1 || sāṃkhyādivedabāhyatantrāṇāṃ nyāyābhāsamūlatayā ....śrūyamāṇā viyadutpa ttiḥ arthavirodhādvādhyate - iti || 1 || na viyadaśruteḥ | saṅgatimāha - sāṃkhyādi iti | kāraṇaviṣaye paroktadoṣaparihāraparapakṣapratikṣepau pādadvayena kṛtau | atha kāryaviṣaye paroktadoṣāḥ parihriyante iti saṅgatiḥ | ātmana utpattyasaṃbhavaḥ prastutaḥ | tadvanniravayavadravyasya viyato'nutpattiriti avāntarasaṅgatiḥ | cito'citaśca kāryatvaṃ kimekarūpam, uta bhinnarūpamiti saṃśayaḥ | aikarūpyaṃ pūrvapakṣīkṛtya vairūpyaṃ siddhāntīkriyate pādadvayena || tatra prathamādhikaraṇasya saṃśayamāha - tatra iti | kathamaśrutiḥ? akāśaḥ sabhūtaḥ iti śrutirastītyatrāha - saṃbhāvitasya iti | śravaṇam - śabdajanyapramitiḥ| na hyayogye yūpādityatādātmyādāviva iti bhāvaḥ | khapuṣpaṃ dṛṣṭāntatayoktam | asaṃbhavaṃ niravayavadravyatvena sarvagatatvena copapādayati - na khalu iti | kevalatarkoṃ bādhya ityatrāha - ataḥ iti | tejassargaprāthamyaṃ śrutyarthāpattiḥ | tarkāpetaśruteḥ tadyuktā sā balīyasīti bhāvaḥ || 1 || evaṃ prāpte'bhidhīyate - asti tu || 2-3-2|| asti tvākāśasyotpattiḥ | atīndriyārtha......ātmano'nutpattirna niravayavatvaprayukteti vakṣyate || 2 || asti tu | na mānāntarāgocaratvamayogyatā, yāgādeḥ svargasādhanatvādipramityayogāt | bādhakaṃ tu na dharmiṇo'dhyakṣatāmātreṇa nāgamoktadharmabādhaḥ prāguktadoṣāt kiṃ tvadhyakṣāvagatadharmavirodhāt ayogyatā yathā yūpādityaikyasya | na ceha sā'sti | sarvagatatvaniravayavadravyatve asiddhe | daśaguṇatvapañjīkaraṇatvokteḥ| 1 caramaṃ tu mahadādāvanaikāntikaṃ ca | anumānaṃ cāgamabādhitamityarthaḥ | tarhi kathamātmanityatvamityatrāha - ātmano'pi iti || 2 || punaścodayati - gauṇyasaṃbhavācchabdācca || 2-3-3|| "tasmādvā etasmādātmana ākāśaḥ....iti viyato'mṛtatvaśabdācca || 3 || uttarasūtrasaṅgatimāha - punaḥ iti | gauṇyasaṃbhavācchabdācca | tejaḥprāthamyāt tataḥ prāk na viyatsṛṣṭisaṃbhavaḥ | paścāttu tvanmate'pi netyarthaḥ || kathamekasya saṃbhūtaśabdasya ākāśāpekṣayā... syāccaikasya brahmaśabdavat || 2-3-4|| ekasyaiva "tasmādvā etasmāt... anuṣaṅge ca śravaṇā - vṛttāvivābhidhānāvṛttirvidyata eva ityarthaḥ || 4 || syāccaikasya brahmaśabdavat | tatra brahma śabdo dviḥ prayuktaḥ | iha tu anuṣaṅgādekasya kathaṃ mukhyagauṇatve ityatrāha - anuṣaṅge ca iti | 1 prayogabhede'pi vṛttibhedaklṛptiḥ abhidhānāvṛttyā | sā'nuṣaṅge'pi tulyeti tayā tatklṛptiraviruddhā ityarthaḥ | abhidhānāvṛttiḥ - bodhanavyāpārāvṛttiḥ|| pariharati - pratijñāhāniravyatirekāt || 2-3-5|| chāndogyaśrutyanusāreṇānyāsāṃ....ākāśasyāpi brahmakāryatvena tadavyatirekādeva bhavati || 5 || antarasya rāddhāntasūtratāmāha - pariharati iti | pratijñāhāniravyatirekāt | sphuṭam || 5 || śabdebhyaḥ || 2-3-6 || itaśca viyadutpattiḥ chāndogye pratīyate... śrutyantara pratipannāṃ viyadutpatiṃta na nivārayitumalam || 6 || śabdebhyaḥ | aitadātmyam ityādivākyaṃ kṛtsnakāryasya kāraṇabrahmātmakatvaparatvādupāttam | ādi śabdāt sanmūlāḥ ityādi gṛhyate | na ca iti | na hi ghaṭotpattivacanaṃ paṭotpattivārakamityarthaḥ | prāthamyaṃ vārakamityatrāha - viyat iti | śrutaprahāṇena aśrutaprāthamyaklṛptirayukteti bhāvaḥ || yāvadvikāraṃ tu vibhāgo lokavat || 2-3-7 || tuśabdaścārthe | aitadātmyam ... ... surāṇāmiva cirakāla sthāyitvābhiprāyam || 7 || yāvadvikāraṃ tu vibhāgo lokavat | vikārattvam - kāryatvam| ādi śabdādekatvāvadhāraṇādi | evaṃ ca iti | anyathā vāyorapyanutpattiḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ || 7 || etena mātariśvā vyākhyātaḥ || 2-3-8|| anenaiva hetunā mātariśvano vāyorapi .... mātariśvaparāmarśartham ||8|| etena mātariśvā vyākhyātaḥ | atideśasūtratvābhāvaḥ śaṅkādhikyābhāvāt| mātariśvanaḥ pṛthagyogamakṛtvā tejo mātariśvanaḥ ityuttarasūtraṃ na kṛtam | ataḥ ityādestata ūrdhvamanuvṛttyartham | asaṃbhavastu iti sūtrasya mahadādiviṣayatvāt 5 viyatsūtrānantaryaṃ mātariśvasūtrasya || 8 || asaṃbhavastu sato'nupapatteḥ || 2-3-1|| tuśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ | asaṃbhavaḥ....avagatakāryabhāvasyānutpattirnaupapadyate iti || 9 || asaṃbhavastu sato'nupapatteḥ | na hi brahmaṇo'nutpattirvācyā | viyadādikaṃ vinā keṣāmanutpattyasaṃbhavaḥ? kasya cānupapattirityatrāha - etaduktam iti | pratijñādibhiḥ iti ādiśa bdāt ekatvāvadhāraṇādyuktam || iti viyadadhikaraṇam-1 <2. tejodhikaraṇam ||> tejo'tastathā hyāha || 2-3-10|| brahmavyatiriktasya kṛtsnasya....."vāyoragniḥ" iti hyāha || 10 || tejo'tastathā hyāha | avāntarasaṅgatimāha - brahma iti || 10|| āpaḥ || 2-3-11 || āpo'pi, ataḥ tejasaḥ...."tadapo'sṛjata" iti hyāha ||11|| āpaḥ | ataḥ ityādyanuṣaṅgaḥ || 11|| pṛthivī ||2-3-12|| pṛthivī adbhya utpadyate...."tā annamasṛjanta" iti hyāha || 12 || pṛthivī | tathā ihāpyanuṣaṅgaḥ || 12 || nanvannaśabdena kathaṃ pṛthivyabhidhīyate? ata āha - adhikārarūpaśabdāntararebhyaḥ || 2-3-13|| mahābhūtasṛṣṭyadhikārāt pṛthivyeva .... brahmaṇaḥ paramparayā kāraṇatve'pyupapadyante iti || 13 || uttarasūtrāvatārāyāha - nanu iti | adhikārarūpaśabdantarebhyaḥ | adhikāraḥ - prastāvaḥ || 13 || evaṃ prāpte pracakṣmahe - tadabhidhyānādeva tu talliṅgāt saḥ || 2-3-14|| tuśabdāt pakṣo vyāvṛttaḥ..."yasya buddhiḥ śarīram," "yasyāvyaktaṃ śarīram" ityādi || 14 || tadabhidhyānādeva tu talliṅgāt saḥ | talliṅgāt - abhidhyānameva paraliṅgam | sarvaśākhāpratyayanayāt mahadādiṣvapi īkṣāsiddhimāha - mahadahaṅkāra iti | na paramīkṣānupapattyā tattaccharīrakasya kāraṇatvam, śrautaṃ ca tattaccharīrakatvamityāha - śrūyate ca iti || 14 || yaccoktam "etasmājjāyate prāṇo .... ... viparyayeṇa tu kramo'ta upapadyata ca ||2-3-15|| tuśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ | ... ... ityādikamapi sarvasya brahmaṇaḥ sākṣātsaṃbhavasyottaṃbhanam || 15|| viparyayeṇa tu kramo'ta upapadyate ca | ataḥ - śabdārthamāha - sa ca iti | uparudhyeta iti svārasyahāniruktā | uttaṃbhanam - sthāpakam || 15 || antarā vijñānamanasī krameṇa talliṅgāditi cennāviśeṣāt || 2-3-16 || vijñānasādhanatvāt indriyāṇi vijñānam .... tejaḥ prabhṛtayaśca śabdāstadātmabhūtaṃ brahmaivābhidadhati || 16|| antarā vijñānamanasī krameṇa talliṅgāditi cennāviśeṣāt | vyākhyeyaṃ padaṃ vyācaṣṭe - vijñāna iti | atrāpi - na kevalaṃ śrutyantareṣveva iti bhāvaḥ| taiḥ saha pāṭhaliṅgāt - agryaprāyanyāyāditi bhāvaḥ | kasyāviśeṣa ityatrāha - etasmāt iti | etasmāt prāṇaḥ, etasmānmanaḥ iti īdṛśo hyanvaya iti bhāvaḥ | dīpe kaṇṭhoktatayā vyākhyātam | śrutyantarasiddha iti | vāyuvikārasya prāṇasya bhūtebhyaḥ prāgutpattivirodhāditi bhāvaḥ | vyavahitakāryāṇāmapi brahmaṇa utpattiścet, kathaṃ tejaḥprabhṛtiśabdairabhidhānamityatrāha - tejaḥprabhṛtayaḥ iti || nanu evaṃ sarvaśabdānāṃ brahmavācitve..... carācaravyapāśrayastu syāt yadvayapadeśo'bhāktastadbhāvabhāvitvāt || 2-3-17|| tuśabdaḥ coditāśaṅkānivṛttyarthaḥ | ....nāmarūpavyākaraṇaśrutyā hi tathā'vagatam || 17 || anantarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - nanu iti | carācaravyapāśrayastu syāt tadvyayapadeśo'bhāktastadbhāvabhāvitvāt | hetukhaṇḍaṃ vivṛṇvan vākyārthamāha samasta iti | prathamayojanāyāṃ vyutpattyabhāvānyathāsiddhiḥ kaṇṭhoktā syāt| dvitīyasyāṃ brahmaparyantatve mānopanyāsaḥ śrotaḥ syāt | ubhayoḥ anyatarārthaḥ ārthaḥ || iti tejo'dhikaraṇam - 2 <3.ātmādhitakaraṇam ||> nātmā śruternityatvācca tābhyaḥ || 2-3-18|| viyadādeḥ kṛtsnasya parasmāt brahmaṇaḥ... seyaṃ svarūpānyathābhāvalakṣaṇotpattirjīve pratiṣidhyate || nātmā śruternityatvācca tābhyaḥ | saṅgatimāha - viyadādeḥ iti| evaṃ svānantarakāraṇaśarīrakabrahmaṇo viyadādyutpattiruktā | tarhi tadvanniravayavasyātmano'pi seti saṅgatiḥ | viyadādivat utpattirasti nāstīti saṃśayaḥ | śrutyarthāpattiśrutibhiḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ | prajāśabdaśca saṃsṛṣṭajīvaparaḥ|| rāddhānte ātmanaḥ iti | tābhyaḥ siddhāntitatvāt iti śabdārthaḥ | katham iti kṛtaṃ codyaṃ pariharati - ittham iti | vyāharti parihartuṃ kāryalakṣaṇamāha - kāryatvaṃ hi iti | vaiṣamyamāha - iyān iti || etaduktaṃ bhavati - bhogyabhoktṛniyantṛn.... prakārabhūtacidacidvastugatāḥ apuruṣārthāḥ svarūpānyathābhāvāśceti sarvaṃ samañjasam || 18 || acitaḥ kāryatvaṃ svarūpānyathātvarūpam, citastu dhīsaṅkocavikāsarūpamiti kṛto vibhāgaḥ | parasya ca kāryatvaṃ tayoranyataraprakāreṇeti cetanatvāt dharmānyathābhāvarūpakāryatvaṃ, tena ca karmamūlāsārvajñyaṃ syādityatrāha - etaduktam iti | bhogyagatam - na tu svāsādhāraṇamiti bhāvaḥ | utpattyādi iti vināśagrahaṇam | ghaṭakaśrutyarthamāha - sarvāvasthayoḥ iti | sadaivaṃ cet kathaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāva ityatrāha - tat kadācit iti | kāryatvam avasthāntarāpattirūpamiti phalitam | kāryatvāvāntarabhidāmupapādayati - tatra iti | tathā sati brahmaṇaḥ kāryatvaṃ kathamityapekṣāyāṃ sādhāraṇaṃ kāryatvamāha - kāraṇāvasthāyā iti | pratijñādṛṣṭāntau kathamityatrāha - ata eva iti | anekākāraviśiṣṭaikavastuno'vasthābhedamātre dṛṣṭāntaḥ | kāṭhinyādivat mānaviruddhākārastu tyājya iti bhāvaḥ | utpatyanutpattyādiśrutīnāṃ viṣayabhedamāha - īdṛśa iti| aniṣṭa śabdaḥ sadvārakāvasthāniyantṛtvavyudāsārthaḥ ekatvāvadhāraṇaṃ nirvahati - evam iti || ye tu iti | sautratvāta svopagamāccetyarthaḥ | tarhi tatpakṣa eva svīkārya ityatrāha - iyān iti | niyantraṃśasya na bhoktṛtvamityatrāha - niyantraṃśasya iti ||18|| iti ātmādhikaraṇam-3 <4.jñādhikaraṇam ||> jño'ta eva || 2-3-19|| viyadādivajjīvo notpadyata ityuktam, tatprasaṅgena jīvasvarūpaṃ nirūpyate| .... ... kartā vijñānātmā puruṣaḥ "evamevāsya paridraṣṭurimāḥṣoḍaśakalāḥ" iti || 19|| jño'ta aiva | saṅgatimāha - viyadādivat iti | saṅgatiḥ prāsaṅgikī | kāryatāprakāro hi pādanirūpyaḥ | svātmānaṃ prati jñātṛtvam svasvānyabhānapratisaṃbandhitvaṃ vivakṣitam | svarūpam - svābhāvikākāraḥ akādācitkamityarthaḥ | ataḥ śirodvayapratiyogitvaṃ tṛtīyaśirasaḥ | idamevātra nirūpyam | tatra svabhānapratisaṃbandhitayā pratyaktvam; tasya svāpo'pi vidyamānatvāt ajaḍasvarūpatvam | anyabhānapratisaṃbandhitayā jñānāśrayatvam | śaṅkāviśeṣaparihārārthamaṇutvamityeṣāmarthānāṃ jñatvanirūpaṇāntarbhāvādaikādhikaraṇyam || aparaḥ - kāṇādādiḥ | sarvagatatvaṃ ca iti | jñānādikaṃ kārya śabdārthaḥ | bhogyavastu cābhipratam | aṇutvagatyordvayoḥ klṛpteḥ vibhutvaklṛptirvaramiti lāghavamabhipretam || rāddhānte - etacchabdaḥ prakṛtajātīyaparāmarśīti śrutivyaktibhedāvirodhaḥ ||19|| yattūktaṃ jñātṛtve svābhāvike sati..... utkrāntigatyāgatīnām || 2-3-20|| nāyaṃ sarvagataḥ, api tvaṇurevāyamātmā....vibhutve hyetā utkrāntyādayo nopapadyeran || 20 || utkrāntigatyāgatīnām | śrutyarthāpattiruktā || 20|| svātmanā cottarayoḥ || 2-6-21|| caśabdo 'vadhāraṇe | yadyapi śarīraviyogarūpatvena .... ataste svātmanaiva saṃpādye || 21|| svātmanā cottarayoḥ | kathañcit iti asvārasyasūcan | gateḥ śrautatvāt aṇutvameva kalpyamiti na gauravam | vibhutvaklṛpnistu śrutiviruddheti bhidetyarthaḥ || nāṇuratacchuteriti cennetarādhikārāt || 2-3-22 || "yo'yaṃ vijñānamayaḥ prāṇeṣu" iti jīva.....madhye paraḥ pratipādyata iti tatsaṃbandhīdaṃ mahattvam; na jīvasya || 22 || nāṇuratacchateriti cennetarādhikārāt | yasya - jīvasya, anuvittaḥ - upāsyaḥ, prāpyo vā | viderjñānalābhārthatvāt | jñānārthatve iḍanityatvaṃ chāndasam | adṛṣṭo draṣṭetivat arhārthīyā niṣṭhā | pratibuddhaḥ - prājñaḥ || 22 || svaśabdonmānābhyāṃ ca|| 2-3-23|| sākṣādaṇuśabda eva śrūyate "eṣo'ṇurātmā....ato'ṇurevāyamātmā ||23|| svaśabdonmānābhyāṃ ca | iha śrutirdarśitā | aṇutvaṃ ca śrautamitina kiñcit kalpyam | svaśabdaḥ aṇutvavācakaḥ | na tvākṣepakaḥ|| atha syāt - ātmano'ṇutve.... avirodhaścāndanavat || 2-3-14|| yathā haricandanabinduḥ .... .... daihaikadeśavartī sakaladeśavartinīṃ vedanāmanubhavati || 24 || śaṅkāmāha - atha iti| vedanāduḥkhānubhavaḥ ;pradarśana vā sukhasya || avirodhaścandanavat | vedanāmanubhavati - duḥkhamanubhavatītyarthaḥ || avasthitivaiśeṣyāditi cennāmabhyupagamāddhṛdi hi || 2-3-25|| haricandanabindvāderdehadeśaviśeṣa... candanadṛṣṭāntaḥ pradarśitaḥ,na tu candanasya deśaviśeṣāpekṣā || 25 || avasthitivaiśeṣyāditi cennābhyupagamāddhṛdi hi | kāryakaratvaupayikatvāt tatraikaśatam ityupāttam | na tu iti | na tu hanmātrāpekṣā | nāsānayanādimarmasthityā kāryakaratvādityarthaḥ || ekadeśavartinaḥ sakaladehavyāpi... guṇādvā''lokavat || 2-3-26|| vāśabdo matāntaravyāvṛttyarthaḥ; ātmā...anyatravṛttirmaṇiprabhāvadupapadyata iti prathamasūtre sthāpitam || 26 || saubharyādīnāmeketaradeheṣu prāguktadiśā kāryakaratvayagānnirvāhāntaroktiḥ || guṇādavā''lokavat | kathamayutasiddhadharmasya deśāntare vṛttirityatrāha - jñātuḥ prabhā iti || 26 || nanu - uktaṃ jñānamātramevātmeti |.... vyatireko gandhavat tathā ca darśayati || 2-3-27 || yathā pṛthivyāḥ gandhasya guṇatvena .... darśayati ca śrutiḥ "jānātyevāyaṃ puruṣaḥ" iti || 27|| nanu iti jñānasvarūpavacanamabhipretam | tannirvāhāya vyatireke mānaṃ darśyate || vyatireko gandhavat tathā ca darśayati | jānāti iti viśiṣṭavācakaśabdaḥ || 27 || pṛthagupadeśāt || 2-3-28 || svaśabdenaiva vijñānaṃ vijñātuḥ pṛthagupadiśyate - na hi vijñāturvijñāterviparilopo vidyate iti || 28 || pṛthagupadeśāt | viśeṣaṇasya padāntareṇa nirdeśo darśitaḥ || 28 || yat tu uktam yo vijñāne tiṣṭhan .... .... tadguṇasāratvāt tu tadvyapadeśaḥ prājñavat || 2-3-29 || tuśabdaścodyaṃ vyāvartayati | ... ... yaḥ sarvajñaḥ ityādiṣu prājñasya jñānaṃ sārabhūto guṇa iti vijñāyate || 29 || vyatireke mānasiddhe jñānarūpatvavacanaṃ nirvoḍhuṃ prāguktaśaṅkāmuddhāṭayati - yat tu iti || tadguṇasāratvāt tu tadvyapadeśaḥ prājñavat | tacchabdārthamāha vijñāna iti | ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaśaṅkāvyudāsāyāha - vijñānameva iti | guṇa śabdaḥ apradhānavācī | guṇaḥ śeṣabhūtaḥ, tasya sāratvaṃ guṇāntarāpekṣayā prakṛṣṭatvam | tacca homādiguṇabhūtadadhyādivyāvartakam apṛthaksiddhatvam | tena guṇiparyantabodhanasya mukhyatvasiddhiḥ | vijñānameva - dravyameva sadayutasiddhamiti bhāvaḥ | prājñavat ityaṃśaṃ vyācaṣṭe - yathā iti | dṛṣṭānte dharmadharmibhāvasya prāmaṇikatvaṃ darśayati - yadeṣa iti| spaṣṭam || 29 || yāvadātmabhāvitvācca na doṣastaddarśanāt || 2-3-30 || vijñānasya yāvadātmabhāvidharmatvāt ... ... svaprakāśatvena vijñānamiti vyapadeśo na doṣa iti samuccinoti || 30 || paṭaḥ śukla ityādau guṇapadena guṇyuktiḥ dharmisamarpakapadāntarasamabhivyāhārāt | iha tu tadabhāvānna guṇyuktiryukteti svarūpameva jñānamucyate, na dhīdharmakaṃ svarūpamityatrāha - yāvadātmabhāvitvācca na doṣastaddarśanāt | ātma śabdo dharmiparaḥ | tadvyapadeśaḥ na doṣaḥ | dūṣyata iti doṣaḥ | karmaṇi ghañ | dharmivācipadāntarābhāvasvarūpadoṣaduṣṭo na bhavatītyarthaḥ | taddarśanāt ityetat vyācaṣṭe - tathā iti | kathaṃ śaṅkayāḥ parihṛtatvamityatrāha - svarūpa iti | śauklyasya paṭanirūpakatvābhāvāt dharmivācipadāntarāpekṣā | gotvādestu nirūpakatvāt na gavadipadānāṃ tadapekṣā | jñānapadaṃ tadvadityarthaḥ | jñānamacidapekṣayā jīvasya nirūpakam | parasya tu svato nityāsaṃkucitaṃ jñānaṃ nirūpakam | atra pūrvasūtroktasyāyutasiddhatvasya hetoḥ asiddhiśaṅkā ca yāvadātmabhāvitvoktyā'rthānnirastā bhavati | ayāvadadharmibhāvināmapi guṇānāmayutasiddhirasti | kiṃ punaryāvaddharmiṃbhāvināmiti || yaccoktam - suṣuptyādiṣu jñānābhāvāt ... ... puṃstvādivat tvasya sato'bhivyaktiyogāt || 2-3-31 || tuśabdaścoditāśaṅkānivṛttyarthaḥ | ... ... manasaitān kāmān paśyan ramate ityādiśrutyaikārthyāt || 31 || puṃstvādivat tvasya sato'bhivyaktiyogāt | na bālye puṃstvamityatrāha - saptadhātu iti | svāpe'pi dhiyaḥ svaprakāśatārhatvānna jaḍatvam | svasiddhyahamarthasyāpi jñānasyaivopalabhyo viṣayasaṃbandhāpekṣa ityatrāha - suṣuptyādiṣvapi iti | ahandhīvedyatve jaḍatvādītyatrāha - ete ca iti | nityopalabdhyādyaprasaṅgāyāha - sa cāyam iti | na pretya iti | dehātmadhīrnetyarthaḥ || 31 || saṃprati jñānātmavāde tasya sarvagatatve dūṣaṇamāha - nityopalabdhyanupalabdhiprasaṅgo'nyataraniyamo vā'nyathā || 2-3-32 || anyathā sarvagatatvapakṣe tasya jñānamātratvapakṣe ca .... ... karaṇaiḥ sarvadā saṃyuktatvāt adṛṣṭāderapyaniyamāduktadoṣaḥ samānaḥ || nityopalabdhyanulabdhiprasaṅgo'nyataraniyamo vā'nyathā | nityopalabdhiḥ prasajatu | kathamanupalabdhiḥ? ubhayaṃ ca sadā prasajedityatrāha etaduktam iti | vikalpitaśiro'bhiprāyeṇoktamityarthaḥ | svamate tvaprasaṅgamāha - asmākam iti | jaḍātmavibhutvapakṣe'pi śirobhedena dūṣaṇatrayasāmyamāha - karaṇāyatta iti | adṛṣṭādeḥ iti | dehasādhāraṇyāt tatkṛtādṛṣṭāniyama ityarthaḥ || 32 || iti jñādhikaraṇam - 4 <5. kartradhikaraṇam ||> kartā śāstrārthavattvāt || 2-3-33 || ayamātmā jñātā, sa cāṇuparimāṇa ityuktam | idānīṃ .... ya ātmānameva kevalaṃ kartāraṃ manyate, na sa paśyatītyarthaḥ || 33 || kartā śāstrārthavattvāt | jñātṛtvasāpekṣatvāt kartṛtvasya, tadanantaraṃ taccintāsaṅgatiḥ | hantāram iti | mahāntaṃ vibhum iti prakaraṇokte paramātmani na jāyate ityaciddharmaḥ, hantāram iti puṇyapāpakartṛtvarūpajīvadharmaśca niṣidhyata iti śaṅkāvyudāsāyoktaṃ jīvasya iti | avāntaraprakaraṇe parasya na prasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | prakṛtau nityāyāṃ kartṛtvarūpajīvadharmaḥ nāśitvaṃ ca niṣidhyati iti śaṅkāvyudāsāyoktaṃ sarvaṃ prakṛtidharmam iti | kārtsnyena prakṛtidharmaniṣedhaparaṃ prakaraṇamiti bhāvaḥ | hantum iti dvitīyāntaḥ, jantum itivat | hananamātre kartṛtvaniṣedhaḥ, na sarvakriyāsu iti śaṅkāvyudā sāyāha - tathā ca iti || rāddhānte - śāsrārthavattvāt iti | prayojanatayā hetutvam | avayavārthanirūpaṇena kartṛtvamāha - śāsanācca iti | guṇānāmeva kartṛtā iti aupacārikoktiḥ | guṇasahakṛtatvaṃ sphuṭayati - tathā ca iti | ātmanaḥ kartṛtvaṃ bhagavadgītāyāmabhyupagatamityāha - tathā iti | idamapi vacanaṃ viśadayitumāha - adhiṣṭhānam iti | śarīravāḍmanobhiḥ ityādirapyanusandheyaḥ || 33 || upādānādvihāropadeśācca || 2-3-34 || sa yathā mahārājaḥ iti prakṛtya ... ... prāṇānāmupādāne vihāre ca kartṛtvamupadiśyate || 34 || upādanādvihāropadeśācca | indriyaprāṇadehapreraṇakartṛṃtvamuktamityarthaḥ || vyapadeśācca kriyāyāṃ na cennirdeśaviparyayaḥ || 2-3-35 || vijñānaṃ yajñaṃ tanute karmāṇi tanute .... ... buddheḥ karaṇatvāt vijñāneneti karaṇadhibhaktinirdeśaḥ syāt || 35 || vyapadeśācca kriyāyāṃ na cennirdeśaviparyayaḥ | vijñānena iti | upacaritatve tadeva doṣa iti bhāvaḥ || 35 || upalabdhivadaniyamaḥ || 2-3-36 || ātmano'kartṛtve doṣa ucyate | ... ... antaḥkaraṇādīnāmapi niyamo nopapadyate; yadāyattā vyavasthā syāt || 36 || upalabdhivadaniyamaḥ | antaḥkaraṇabhedāt vyavasthetyatrāha - ata eva ca iti || 36 || śāktiviparyayāt || 2-3-37 || buddheḥ kartṛtve karturanyasya bhoktṛtvānupapatteḥ ... .... puruṣo'sti bhoktṛbhāvāt iti hi teṣāmabhyupagamaḥ || 37 || śaktiviparyayāt | kathaṃ mānābhāva ityatrāha - puruṣo'sti iti || samādhyabhāvācca || 2-3-38 || buddheḥ kartṛtve mokṣasādhanabhūtasamādhāvapi ... .... prakṛtiḥ samādhātumalam | ato'pyātmaiva kartā || 38 || samādhyabhāvācca | acetanatvāt prakṛtenyathāviṣayatvācca samādhyanupapattiḥ || 38 || yathā ca takṣobhayathā || 2-3-39 || vāgādikaraṇasaṃpanno'pyātmā ... ... bhogavāñchādiniyamakāraṇābhāvāt sarvadā kartṛtvameva syāt || 39 || yathā ca takṣobhayathā | tvadukto doṣastvanmate evetyāha - vuddhastu iti || 39 || iti kartradhikaraṇam - 5 <6. parāyattādhikaraṇam ||> parāt tu tacchateḥ || 2-3-40 || idaṃ jīvasya kartṛtvaṃ kiṃ svātantryeṇa? .... ... bhrāmayan sarvabhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā iti || 40 || parāt tu tacchateḥ | saṅgatiḥ sphuṭā || rāddhānte - tat iti vyākhyeyam | kartṛtvam iti vyākhyānam || 40 || nanvevaṃ vidhiniṣedhaśāstrānarthakyaṃ .... .... kṛtaprayatrāpekṣastu vihitapratiṣiddhāvaiyarthyādibhyaḥ || 2-3-41 || sarvāsu kriyāsu puruṣeṇa kṛtaṃ .... ... kṣipābhyajasramaśubhānāsurīṣveva yoniṣu ityuktam || 41 || anantarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - nanu iti | kṛtaprayatrāpekṣastu vihitapratiṣiddhāvaiyarthyādibhyaḥ | ādi śabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe - nigraha iti | bhāṣyastha - ādi śabdena phaladānagrahaṇam | pravṛttasya pravartako'numantā | anyasāpekṣatve prathamapravṛttasya ca phalānvaye ca dṛṣṭāntamāha - yathā iti | rājasaṃśrayaṇādikamudāharaṇam | anyāpekṣatve'pi vidhiniṣedhabhāktvaṃ rathākarṣakeṣu dṛṣṭam | aṃśe pāratantryāt na phalamiti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ | aṃśe svātantryāt phalamiti siddhāntaḥ || sādhāraṇakāraṇamīśvaraḥ karaṇakalevaracitpravṛttidānādinā | viśeṣakartṛtve tu prāgupekṣakaḥ paścāt tvanumantā | anumatiśca phaladānatulyā | ataḥ parāyattatvam | prathamapravṛttau svātantryāt phalānvayaḥ | dayā tvanyatra sāvakāśā | apravṛttapravartanarūpaṃ prayojayitṛtvaṃ daśyata iti codayati - nanu iti | phaladānakalpamiti buddhyā pariharati - ucyate iti | lokadṛṣṭyā'numantṛtvāt doṣāpādanaṃ dharmigrāhakadhvastam | anumantuḥ phalānvayaśca śāstravaśyatve satyanumantṛtvāt | na tvanumantṛtvamātrāt | ataḥ sarvamupapannam || iti parayattādhikaraṇam - 6 <7. aṃśādhikaraṇam ||> aṃśo nānāvyapadeśādanyathā cāpi dāśakitavāditvamadhīyata eke || 2-342 || jīvasya kartṛtvaṃ paramapuruṣāyattam ... ... ubhayavyapadeśopapattaye jīvo'yaṃ brahmaṇoṃ'śa ityabhyupetyam || 42 || aṃśo nānāvyapadeśādanyathā cāpi dāśakitavāditvamadhīyata eke | jīvo'numatidānāt pravṛttaścet rājabhṛtyādivat spaṣṭabhedaḥ syāt iti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ | brahmaṃśa iti pakṣe ca kiṃ viśeṣyaikadeśatayāṃśaḥ, uta viśiṣṭaikadeśarūpaviśeṣaṇatayā iti vikalpo garbhitaḥ śruti iti | vādivimaterapi śrutivaividhyamūlatvāt iti bhāvaḥ | nanu iti śaṅkitaṃ paunaruktyaṃ pariharati satyam iti | pūrvaṃ śarīrātmabhāvenābhedaśrutimukhyatvamuktam | taccātra śarīravācināmākṛtinayaviṣayatve sthāpite sidhyet | tacca prabhāyā ivāyutasiddhaviśeṣaṇatayāṃśatve sidhyati | viśeṣaṇatayāṃśatvāt vilakṣaṇatvasiddhiriti ubhayavyapadeśamukhyatvamihaiva pratiṣṭhitamityarthaḥ | kiṃ tāvat ityādi | viśeṣyaikadeśarūpāṃśavādinam atyantabhedavādī dūṣayati - brahmarṇo'śaḥ iti | yadvā iti | abheda ṣaṅvidhatātparyaliṅgasadbhāvo'bhipretaḥ || rāddhānte - tataśca iti | nikṛṣṭairapi sāmānādhikaraṇyamabhedasyaupacārikatvavirodhīti bhāvaḥ | paroktānyathāsiddhi dūṣayati - na ca iti | abhedaśrutivirodhaparihārādikaṃ pūrvavat | spaṣṭam | satyopādhyavacchinnabrahyajīvapakṣaṃ dūṣayati - upādhyavacchinnam ityādinā || 42 || mantravarṇāt || 2-3-43 || pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni .... ... asantateścādhyatikaraḥ ityanantarameva cātmabahutvaṃ vakṣyati || 43 || mantravarṇāt | kathamaṃśatvāpratīrityatrāha - aṃśavācī iti | nityo nityānām iti viśiṣṭavidhiḥ | bhedasya svābhāvikatvamalaukikam | bhedakākārābhāvanmuktau kathaṃ bhedadhīrityatrāha - evam iti | jñānasvarūpatvena iti jīvādvaitavacananirvāhaḥ sūcitaḥ | pratyaktayā parāktayā ca bhedaḥ || api smaryate || 2-3-44 || mamaivāṃśo jīvaloke jīvabhūtaḥ ... ... puruṣottamāṃśatvaṃ smaryate | ataścāyamaṃśaḥ || 44 || api smaryate | sphuṭam | aṃśatve'pi jīvasya brahmaikadeśatvena ... ... prakāśādivat tu naivaṃ paraḥ || 2-3-45 || tuśabdaścodyaṃ vyāvartayati .... .... jīvaśarīrakabrahmavācakatve naikārthābhidhāyitvādityayamarthaḥ prāgeva prapañcitaḥ || 45 || śaṅkāmāha - aṃśatve'pi iti | prakāśādivat tu naivaṃ paraḥ | ādi śabdārthamāha - yathā gavāśva iti | kathamaṃśatvamityatrāha ekavastu iti | tataḥ kiṃ prakṛtaśaṅkāyā ityatrāha - viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ iti | bahulatvaviralatvādisvabhāve vailakṣaṇyam | ayamarthaḥ sautra ityāha tadidam iti | sūtrakhaṇḍe'mumarthaṃ darśayati - yathābhūtaḥ iti | vākyārthamāha - yathaiva hi iti | tenobhayavyapadeśamukhyatvasiddhimāha - evam iti | bhānuḥ bhānumān ityādayaḥ sapakṣāḥ iti | prāgeva iti | prāguktārtha etatsūtrābhipreta ityarthaḥ || 45 || smaranti ca || 2-3-46 || evaṃ prabhāprabhāvadrūpeṇa śaktiśaktimadrūpeṇa ... .... ātmaśarīra - bhāvenāṃśāṃśitvaṃ vadanti ityucyate || 46 || smaranti ca | aṃ śatve smṛtiḥ prāguktā | viśeṣaṇatayāṃśatve tviyamupāttā | smṛtau dṛṣṭāntena vaiśadyāt tatkaṇṭhoktiḥ || 46 || evaṃ brahmaṇośatve brahmapravartyatve ... ... anujñāparihārau dehasaṃbandhājjyotirādivat || 2-3-47 || sarveṣā brahmāṃśatvajñatvādinai - karūpatve .... .. śrotriyāderanujñāyate | abhiśastādestu parihriyate || 47 || adhikaraṇatrayārthamanuvadan anantarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - evam iti | anujñāparihārau dehasaṃbandhājjyotirādivat | ādi śabdārthamāha - yathā ca iti || 47 || asantateścāvyatikaraḥ || 2-3-48 || brahmāṃśatvādinaikarūpatve satyapi .... ... ityabhiprāyeṇa svapakṣe bhogavyatikarābhāva uktaḥ || 48 || asantateścāvyatikaraḥ | samantāt tatiḥ santatiḥ, tadabhāvaḥ aṇutvam | tātparyamāha - bhrānta iti || 48 || nanu bhrāntabrahmajīvavāde'pi ... ... ābhāsa eva ca || 2-3-49 || akhaṇḍaikarasaprakāśamātrasvarūpasya ... ... ekatvābhyupagamāt bhogavyatikarastadavastha eva || 49 || ābhāsa eva ca | tirodhānādikamevānupapannam | upapanne'pi na vyavasthopapattirityarthaḥ || 49 || pāramārthikopādhyupahitabrahmajīvavāde .. .... adṛṣṭāniyamāt || 2-3-50 || upādhiparaṃparāhetubhūtasyādṛṣṭāsyāpi .... ... svasaṃbandhena brahmasvarūpacchedāsaṃbhavāt || 50 || adṛṣṭāniyamāt pradeśabhedānniyama ityatrāha - upādhibhiḥ iti || 50 || abhisandhyādiṣvapi caivam || 2-3-51 || adṛṣṭahetubhūtābhisandhyādiṣvapyuktādeva hetoraniyama eva || 51 || abhisandhyādiṣvapi rcaivam | caḥ avadhāraṇe | ādi śabdādudyogānuṣṭhānādiḥ | uktāt - acchedyatvādikāt || 51 || pradeśabhedāditi cennāntarbhāvāt || 2-3-51 || yadyapyekameva brahmasvarūpam, tacchedānarham .... ... sūtrairvedāvalambināmātmaikatvavādināṃ doṣa ucyate || 52 || iti aṃśādhikaraṇam - 7 iti śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracite śārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣye dvitīyasyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || 3 || pradeśabhedāditi cennāntarbhāvāt | upādhīnām ityādigranthadvaye jīvānāṃ mitha īśvareṇa ca vyatikara uktaḥ | punaruktimāśaṅkyāha - pūrvatra iti || 52 || iti aṃśādhikaraṇam - 7 iti śrīharitakulatilakavāgvijayisūnunā śrīraṅgarājadivyājñālabdhabedavyāsāparanāmadhayena śrīmadvaradācāryapādasevāsamadhigataśrībhagavadrāmānujaviracitaśārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣyahṛdayena śrīsudarśanasūriṇā vilikhitāyāṃ śrutapradīpikāyāṃ dvitīyasyādhyayasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || dvitīyādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || <1. tadantarapratipattyadhikaraṇam ||> tadantaraprātipattau raṃhati saṃpariṣvaktaḥ praśnanirūpaṇābhyām || 3-1-1 || atikrāntādhyāyadvayena nikhilajagadekakāraṇam .... ... ata evaṃ praśnaprativacanābhyāṃ dehahetubhūtaiḥ bhūtasūkṣmaiḥ saha tatra tatra yātīti gamyate || 1 || tadantarapratipattau raṃhati saṃpariṣktaḥ praśnanirūpaṇābhyāma | uttaradvikasaṅgatyarthaṃ pūrvadvikārthamāha - atikrānta iti | ayamarthaḥ ityantena prathamādhyāyārtha uktaḥ | smṛtiityādinā dvitīyasya | dvayoranugatārthamāha - ataḥ iti | dvitīyadvikārthamāha - uttareṇa iti | siddhaviṣayacintābṛtā; sādhyaviṣayacintā vartiṣyata ityarthaḥ | tṛtīyasyārthamāha - tatra iti | kathaṃ prathamadvitīyayorupāsanoktirityatrāha - upāsana iti | tatra iti | jāgare doṣāḥ phalitāḥ syurati bhāvaḥ || praśnānantaraṃ bhūtasūkṣmapariṣvaṅgoktyadarśanāt arthāntaravyavadhāna śaṅkāvyudāsāya anekapraśnatatprativacanarūpatāṃ prakaraṇasya darśayati - pañcāgni ityādinā | vyāvartane - vyāvartakākārau | śraddhā - bhūtasūkṣmāvasthāviśeṣaḥ | somarāja - amṛtamayadevaśarīram | abhilapyāḥ - samāsāvagatasaṃbandho vācyavācakabhāvarūpaviśeṣa iti bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kiṃ bhūtasūkṣmānvayasiddherityatrāha - evamukte iti praśnaprativacanavākyayo rdvayorapi āhutau iti nirdeśena hotavyadravyākāṃkṣāyāṃ svavākyasthatayā apām eva hotavyatvopapatteḥ | pañcasvāhutiṣu tāḥ anuvṛttā iti tāsāṃ puruṣavacastvamityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha - ataḥ iti || 1 || nanu āpa puruvacasaḥ inyukteḥ .... ... tryātmakatvāt tu bhūyastvāt || 3-1-2 || tuśabdaścodyaṃ vyāvartayati ... ... dehe ca lohitādibhūyastve nāraṃbhakeṣu apāṃ bhūyastvaṃ gamyate || 2 || anantarasūtraṅkāmāha - nanu iti | tryātmakatvāt tu bhūyastvāt | nanu ekaikaṃ trivṛtkṛtāni sarvāṇi bhūtāni dehe santi | tat kathaṃ trivṛtkaraṇaṃ sarvabhūtasadbhāve heturuktaḥ? ucyate - trivṛtkaraṇaśruteḥ pratyekaṃ trivṛtkṛtabhūta samudāyasyaiva vyaṣṭidehāraṃbhakatāpratipādanaparatvāditi | vyaṣṭisṛṣṭyarthamanupraveṣṭavyatayā śrutānāṃ tāsāṃ devatānāmekaikasya na hi trivṛtkaraṇamucyate tisro devatā anupraviśya tāsāṃ trivṛtaṃ trivṛtamekaikām iti | ataḥ trivṛtkṛtasamudāya eva dehāraṃbhakaḥ | ato dehe ca iti | trivṛtkṛtāt bhūtāntarāt trivṛtkṛtānāmapāṃ dehe bhūyastvamityarthaḥ || 2 || praṇagateśca || 3-1-3 || itaśca bhūtasūkṣmapariṣvaktasya gamanamiti gamyate | .... ... tadāśrayabhūtānāṃ bhūtasūkṣmāṇāmapi gatirabhyupagantavyā || 3 || prāṇagateśca | smaryate ca || sūtradvayaṃ sphuṭam || 33 || agnyādiśruteriti cenna bhāktatvāt || 3-1-4 || yatrāsya puruṣasya mṛtasyāgna vāgapyeti ... ... ataḥ cakṣurādyapyayaśrutiradhiṣṭhātṛdevatāpakramaṇadvārā || 4 || agnyādiśruteriti cenna bhāktatvāt | anapiyadbhiḥ - apyayarahitaiḥ | keśādyapyayaśrutivat vāgādyapyayaśrutistattaddevatāpakramaṇadvārā | vāgabhimānidevatā agnimaṣyeti - vāgabhimānitvaṃ vihāya kevalamagnirūpeṇa tiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ || 4 || prathame'śravaṇāditi cenna tā eva hyupapatteḥ || 3-1-5 || yaduktam - adbhiḥ sūkṣmābhiḥ bhūtāntarasaṃsṛṣṭābhiḥ ... .... ato bhūtāntarasaṃsṛṣṭābhiradbhiḥ saṃpariṣvakto jīvo raṃhatītyupapannam || prathame'śravaṇāditi cenna tā eva hyupapatteḥ | śraddhā iti | praśnagataprakārasya prativacanānte nigamanāt madhye'pi tatprakāra evokta iti śraddhā - āpaḥ ityarthaḥ | apāmeva, na tu manovṛttiviśeṣasya || 5|| aśrutatvāditi cenneṣṭādikāriṇāṃ pratīteḥ || 3-1-6 || yat punaruktam - adbhiḥ saṃpariṣvakto jīvo yātīti ... .. viśeṣye jīva eva paryavasyati | ataḥ saṃpariṣvakto jīvo yātītyupapadyate || 6 || aśrutatvāditi cenneṣṭādikāriṇāṃ pratīteḥ | asminneva vākye mahāvākye ityarthaḥ | tadbhūya iti | tadyogī bhavatītyarthaḥ | sphuṭajīvavākyaikārthyāt asphuṭārthasya vākyasya tatparatvamityarthaḥ | śraddhā - śabdena tadviśiṣṭakathanaṃ lākṣaṇikamityatrāha - dehasya iti || 6 || nanu ca taṃ devā bhakṣayanti iti .... ... bhāktaṃ vā'nātmavittvāt tathā hi darśayati || 3-1-7 || vāśabdaścodyaṃ vyāvartayati | ... .... tasmāt bhūtasūkṣmaiḥ saṃpariṣvakto jīvo raṃhatīti siddham || 7 || anantarasūtrasyākāṃkṣāṃ codyamukhena darśayati - nanu iti | bhāktaṃ vā'nātmattvāt tathā hi darśayati | ihāmutra copakaraṇatvaṃ vivṛṇoti - iha iti | annatvena - bhogyatvena | bhakṣaṇasyānnavināśarūpavyāvṛttiḥ | adhikaraṇārthamupasaṃrati - tasmāt iti || 7 || iti tadantarapratipattyadhikaraṇam - 1 <2. kṛtātyayādhikaraṇam ||> kṛtātyaye'nuśayavān dṛṣṭasmṛtibhyāṃ yathetamanevaṃ ca || 3-1-8 || kevaleṣṭāpūrtadattakāriṇām, dhūmādinā .... ... tatrākāśāvarohaṇādyathetam; vāyvādiprāpteḥ pitṛlokādyaprāpteścānevam || 8 || kṛtātyaye'nuśayavān dṛṣṭasmṛtibhyāṃ yathetamanevaṃ ca | yāvatsaṃsāraṃ prakṛtyasaṃbandho niṣiddhaḥ | atha taddhetubhūtakarmasaṃbandha ucyate iti saṅgatiḥ | abhyāśaḥ - abhyāgantāraḥ | abhukta iti śrutyarthāpattikathanam | yathetam - yathāgatam || 8 || caraṇāditi cenna tadupalakṣaṇārtheti kārṣṇājiniḥ || 3-1-9 || ramaṇīyacaraṇāḥ kapūyacaraṇāḥ iti .... ... sukhaduḥkhaprāptyasaṃbhavāt | sukhaduḥkhe hi puṇyapāparūpakarmaphale || 9 || caraṇāditi cenna tadupalakṣaṇārtheti kārṣṇājiniḥ anavadyānikarmāṇi iti yajñādīni; asmākaṃ sucaritāni iti ācāra iti pūrvapakṣiṇo bhāvaḥ puṇya śabdena yajñādi ucyete || 9 || ānarthakyamiti cenna tadapekṣatvāt || 3-1-10 || evaṃ tarhi aphalatvādācārasya .... ... karmopalakṣaṇārtheti kārṣṇājinerabhiprāyaḥ || 10 || ānarthakyamiti cenna tadapekṣatvāt | sphuṭam || 10 || sukṛtaduṣkṛte eveti tu bādariḥ || 3-1-11 || puṇyaṃ karmācarati pāpaṃ karmācarati ... ... phalamiti tu svīkṛtam | ataḥ sānuśayā eva pratyavarohanti || 11 || sukṛtaduṣkṛte eveti bādariḥ | pṛthak iti | anavadyānikarmāṇi iti pratyakṣaśrutisiddha karmoktiḥ | gobalīvarda iti | lākṣaṇikārthasvīkārādapi mukhyāryāparityāgena viṣayasaṅkoco yukta iti bhāvaḥ | adhikaraṇārthamupasaṃharati - ataḥ iti || 11 || iti kṛtātyayādhikaraṇam - 2 <3. aniṣṭādikāryadhikaraṇam ||> aniṣṭādikāriṇāmapi ca śrutam || 3-1-12 || kevaleṣṭāpūrtadattakāriṇaḥ ... ... tai sarve gacchanti ityaviśeṣeṇa sarveṣāmeva gatiśravaṇāt || 12 || aniṣṭādikāriṇāmapi ca śrutam | karmasaṃbandhaniyama uktaḥ | tatrāpi sādhukarmasaṃbarndhe niyamo netyucyate iti saṅgatiḥ | dehāraṃbhaḥ pañcamāhutyapekṣa iti śrutyarthāpattiścābhipretā || 12 || evaṃ tarhi sukṛtaduṣkṛtakāriṇoḥ ... .... saṃyamane tvanubhūyetareṣāmārohāvarohau tadgatidarśanāt || 3-1-13 || tuśabdaḥ śaṅkāṃ vyāvartayati ... ... vaivasvataṃ saṅgamanaṃ janānāṃ yamaṃ rājānam ityādiṣu || 13 || saṃyamane tvanubhūyetareṣāmārohāvarohau tadgatidarśanāt | saṃyamane iti nimittasaptamī | ayaṃ loko nāsti iti | nātra sukhamityarthaḥ || 13 || smaranti ca || 3-1-14 || smaranti ca sarveṣāṃ ... ... vaśaṃ yānti yamasya bhagavan kila ityādiṣu || 14 || api sapta ||3-1-15 || pāpakarmaṇāṃ gantavyatvena rauravādīn sapta narakānapismaranti || nanu saptasu lokeṣu gacchatāṃ ... ... tatrāpi tadvyāpārādavirodhaḥ || 3-1-16 || teṣvapi saptasu yamājñayaiva ... ... paścāccandrārohāvarohau staḥ || smaranti ca || 14 || api sapta || 15 || tatrāpi tadvyāpārādavirodhaḥ | tritayaṃ sphuṭam | iti pūrvapakṣasūtrāṇi || iti prāpta ucyate - vidyākarmaṇoriti tu prakṛtatvāt || 3-1-17 || tu śabdaḥ pakṣavyāvṛttyarthaḥ | ... .... ya iṣṭādikāriṇaḥ te sarve iti pariṇeyam || 17 || vidyākarmaṇoriti tu prakṛtatvāt | iti śabdasya hetvarthatā darśitā phalabhogārthatvāt iti | vidyāprasaṅgaḥ kimarthaḥ ityatrāha - etaduktam iti | vidyāviṣayatvam iti | viṣaya śabdaḥ phalaparaḥ | pariṇeyam – nirvāhyam || 17 || nanu pāpakarmaṇāṃ candragamanābhāve .. ... na tṛtīthe tathopalabdheḥ || 3-1-18 || tṛtīyasthānasya śarīrāraṃbhāva ... ... puruṣavacastvahetutvamātraṃ pratipādayati, nānyannivārayati, avadhāraṇāśravaṇāt || 18 || na tṛtīthe tathopalabdheḥ | jāyasva mriyasva iti | jāyante mriyante ityarthaḥ | vedasvātantryādīśvaraśāsanaṃ vā | phalānubhavāśrayatayā sthānatvam | pañcamyām iti | na tvanyayogavyaccheda ityarthaḥ || 18 || smaryate'pi ca loke || 3-1-19 || puṇyakarmaṇāmapi keṣāñcit ... ... loke smaryate draupadīdhṛṣṭadyumnaprabhṛtīnām || 19 || smaryate'pi ca loke | sphuṭam || 19 || darśanācca || 3-1-20 || śrutāvapi dṛśyate keṣāñcit ... ... bhūtayoḥ pañcamāhutimantareṇotpatiṃtardṛśyate || 20 || darśanācca | aṇḍajam iti | kāryatraividhyāt trīṇi bījāni ityarthaḥ || 20 || nanu svedajānāmatra saṅkīrtanaṃ ... ... tṛtīyaśabdāvarodhaḥ saṃśokajasya || 3-1-21 || saṃśokajasya - svedajasyāpi ... ... ataḥ kevalapāpakarmaṇāṃ candraprāptirna saṃbhavati || 21 || tṛtīyaśabdāvarodhaḥ saṃśokajasya | udbhijjasyāyonijatvasāmyāt tṛtīyaśabdena saṅgrahaḥ || 21 || iti aniṣṭādikāryadhikaraṇam - 3 <4. tatsvābhāvyapattyadhikaraṇam ||> tatsvābhāvyāpattirūpapatteḥ || 3-1-22 || iṣṭādikāriṇo bhūtasūkṣmapariṣvaktāḥ ... ... tadāpattivacanaṃ tatsaṃsargakṛtatatsādṛśyāpattyābhiprāyam || 22 || tatsvābhāvyāpattirupapatteḥ| saṅgirtiṃ darśaṃyati - iṣṭhādi iti | ākāśādibhāvaḥ - ākāśādiśarīrakatvam | aviśeṣāt - prakaraṇasthatvāviśeṣāt | tatsaṃsargakṛtatatsādṛśyāpattyabhiprāyam iti | tatsaṃsargakṛtabhedakasthūlākārarāhityamuktamityarthaḥ || 22 || iti tatsvābhāvyāpattyadhikaraṇam - 4 <5. nāticirādhikaraṇam ||> nāticireṇa viśeṣāt || 3-1-23 || ākāśaprāptiprabhṛti yāvadvrīhyādiprāpti .... ... durniṣprapatataraṃ - duḥkhaniṣkramaṇataramityarthaḥ || 23 || nāticireṇa viśeṣāt | adhikaraṇāntaram | ākāśādau kiñjidvilambo vrīhyādāvativilambaśca nāticira śabdasūcitau || 23 || iti nāticirādhikaraṇam - 5 || <6. anyādhiṣṭhitādhikaraṇam ||> anyādhiṣṭhite pūrvavadabhilāpāt || 3-1-24 || avarohanto jīvā vrīhyādibhāvena ... ... ata ākāśādibhāvavacanavat vrīhyādibhāvena janmavacanamaupacārikam || 24 || anyādhiṣṭhite pūrvavadabhilāpāt | adhikaraṇāntaram | kevala - śabdābhipretamāha - yatra hi iti | vrīhyādiśleṣe'pi niyāmyatvamastīti dehatvaṃ bhūtasūkṣmāṇām | dhīsaṅkocānniyamanapratibandhaḥ || 24 || aśuddhamiti cenna śabdāt || 3-1-25 || naitadasti - yadanyādhiṣṭhite vrīhyādiśarīre ... ... tādātvikālpaduḥkhakāriṇamapi rakṣakameva vadanti, pūjayanti ca tajjñāḥ || aśuddhamiti cenna śabdāt | bhāṭṭoktaparihāraṃ sāṃkhyo'nūdya dūṣayati na ca ityādinā kṣīraṃ pittopahatasya pathyaṃ, na tu pramehagrastasya itivanna virodhaḥ ityarthaḥ | śaṅkate - athocyeta iti | atha gurūktaṃ dūṣayati - naivam iti | laukikavaidikahiṃsayoḥ ko bheda ityatrāha - laukikyāmapi iti | rāgotthānakamānavaiṣamyāt vyavasthā cet, śyenasyāpi adharmatvaṃ na syāditi bhāvaḥ | saṃvatsarapaśvālambhanādyabhiprāyeṇāha - tathā iti | pratyavāyaparihāraphalatve'pi rāgāt pravṛttiriti hṛdayam || pariharati - tanna iti | duḥkhahetutvaṃ cāstīti hiṃsātvamityatrāha - atiśayati iti | na vā u tve iti | na paraṃ svargalābhādahiṃsātvaklṛptiḥ | kiṃ tu tatkaṇṭhoktaṃ ceti bhāvaḥ | parānarthodarkatayā śyenayāgasya hiṃsātvamiti vaiṣamyaṃ phalitam || 25 || retassigyogo'tha || 3-1-26 || itaścaupacārikaṃ vrīhyādijanmavacanam .... ... yathā tadyogamātraṃ pratipādayati, tadvat vrīhyādibhāvo'pītyarthaḥ || 26 || retasmigyogo'tha | aupacārikatadbhāvoktiprakaraṇamavicchinnamiti bhāvaḥ || 26 || yoneḥ śarīram || 3-1-27 || yoniprāpteḥ paścādevānuyāyināṃ .. ... tataḥ prāgāśādiprāptiprabhṛti tadyogamātramevetyarthaḥ || 27 || iti śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracite śārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣye tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ || yoneḥ śarīram | yoniḥ - yoṣidyoniḥ | saṃsarataḥ śarīraṃ cet bhogārtham | na cet tanna saṃsāriśarīramityabhiprāyaḥ || 27 || iti anyādhiṣṭhitādhikaraṇam - 6 śrīharitakulatilakavāgvijayisūnunā śrīraṅgarājadivyājñālabdhavedavyāsāparanāmadheyena śrīmadvaradācāryapādasevāsamadhigatabhagavadrāmānujaviracitaśārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣyahṛdayena śrisudarśanasūriṇā viracitāyāṃ śrutapradīpikāyāṃ tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ || tṛtīyādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || <1. sandhyādhikaraṇam ||> sandhye sṛṣṭirāha hi || 3-2-1 || evaṃ karmānurūpagamanāgamanajanmādiyogena ... ... sa hi kartā ityāha hi | svapnadṛk jīva eva tatra pratīyate || 1 || sandhye sṛṣṭirāha hi | pādasaṅgatimāha - evam iti | janmādi iti ādi śabdena sukhādyanubhavoktiḥ | duḥkhitvaṃ ravyāpitam iti | svarge'pi pātabhayāditi bhāvaḥ || 1 || nirmātāraṃ caike putrādayaśca || 3-2-2 || kiñca enaṃ jīvaṃ svapne kāmānāṃ nirmātāram .... .. ata upakaraṇādyabhāve'pi sṛṣṭiḥ upapadyate || 2|| nirmātāraṃ caike putrādayaśca | putrādayaśca iti liṅgaṃ darśitam | kathaṃ parikarasya sṛṣṭitvam ityatrāha - jīvasya ca iti || 2 || iti prāpte'bhidhīyate - māyāmātraṃ tu kārtsnyenānabhivyaktasvarūpatvāt || 3-2-3 || tu śabdaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati | svapne ... ... tathā śrutyaikārthyāt paramapuruṣameva kartāramāha || 3 || rāddhānte - māyāmātraṃ tu kārtsnyenānabhivyaktasvaparūpatvāt | mātracā pyanāścaryatvavyudāsaḥ | tuśabdalabdhārthamāha - paramapuruṣa iti | mithyāvyāvṛttyarthaṃ vyācaṣṭe - māyā iti | na bhavanti iti mithyātvamuktamityatrāha - atrāpi iti | sṛjatyānuguṇyāt iti bhāvaḥ || 3 || svābhāvikaṃ cejjīvasyāpahatapāpmatvādikaṃ .... .... parābhidhyānāt tu tirohitaṃ tato hyasya bandhaviparyayau || 3-2-4 || tuśabdaḥ śaṅkāvyāvṛttyarthaḥ | ... .... eṣa hyevānandayāti bhīṣā'smādvāḥ pavate ityādiṣu || 4 || parābhidhyānāt tu tirohitaṃ tato hyasya bandhaviparyayau | tataḥ iti vyākhyeyam | tatsaṅkalpāt iti vyākhyānam | bandhasya tādadhīnyāt tadantargatasya tirodhestādadhīnyasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ || 4 || dehayogādvā so'pi || 3-1-5 || so'pi tirobhāvo dehayogadvāreṇaḥ ... .... tāvanmātrakālāvasānān tadekānubhāvyānarthānutpādayati || 5|| karma prakṛtiśca hi tirodhāyakamityatrāha - dehayogādvā so'pi iti | śaktiḥ - apṛthagviśeṣaṇam | vāśabdo vyavasthitavikalpavācītyabhiprayannāha - sṛṣṭikāla iti || anayoḥ sūtrayoravāntarārthopapādanaparatvānnigamayati - ato'nabhivyakta iti | jīvavat parasyāyogyatvākāravyudāsāya prāk saṃkṣiptaṃ vistareṇāha - tasmin lokāḥ iti | asthiratvādihetumāha - ataḥ iti || 5 || sūcakaśca hi śruterācakṣate ca tadvidaḥ || 3-2-6 || icaśca svāpnā arthā na jīvasaṅkalpapūrvakāḥ ... ... śubhasya sūcakameva sṛṣṭvā paśyet | ataḥ svapne sṛṣṭirīśvareṇaiva kṛtā || 6|| anantarasūtraṃ prathamāpādārthopapādakam | sūcakaśca hi śruterācakṣate ca tadvidaḥ | iha svāpnasṛṣṭūyuktasatyasaṅkalpatvāvirbhāvaklṛptivyudālaḥ . svāpnādhyāyavidaḥ - svapnaparavedavākyavidaḥ || 6 || iti sandhyādhikaraṇam - 1 <2. tadabhāvādhikaraṇam ||> tadabhāvo nāḍīṣu tacchaterātmani ca || 3-2-7 || idāniṃ suṣuptisthānaṃ parīkṣyate ... ... brahma tu paryaṅkasthānīyam | ato brahmaiva sākṣāt suṣuptisthānam || 7 || tadabhāvo nāḍīṣu tacchaterātmani ca | saṅgatiḥ sphuṭā | vṛttyabhāvaḥ | aṇutvāt | rāddhānte - kathaṃ kāryabheda ityatrāha - saṃbhavati ca iti | hṛdayānnāḍyā niṣkramya purītati śayanam, pratyavasṛpya iti śruteḥ || 7 || ataḥ prabodho'smāt || 3-2-8 || yato brahmaiva sākṣāt suṣuptisthānam ... ... na viduḥ sata āgacchāmahe ityādiṣu || 8 || ataḥ prabodho'smāt | ataḥ asmāt iti padadvayaṃ vyākhyeyam | yo yato brahmaiva, brahmaṇaḥ iti vyākhyānam || 8 || iti tadabhāvādhikaraṇam - 2 <3. karmānusmṛtiśabdavidhyadhikaraṇam ||> sa eva tu karmānusmṛtiśabdavidhibhyaḥ || 3-2-9 || kiṃ suṣupta eva prabodhasamaye uttiṣṭhati ... ... paramātmānamupasaṃpadyāśvastaḥ punabhāgāyottiṣṭhati || 9 || sa eva tu karmānusmṛtiśabdavidhibhyaḥ | saṅgatiḥ sphuṭā | na kañcana pāpmāna spṛśati ityasyārthamāha - sakalopādhivinirmuktasya iti | na cāsau iti | sarvapravṛttijñānaśūnyaḥ suṣuptaḥ | muktastu na tathā iti vaiṣamyamuktam | na kañcana iti śruterarthamāha - ataḥ iti | ādi śabdoktam anuṣṭhānam | iyaṃ śrutiranuṣṭhānādyaśaktiparā | asya sukhādyanubhavakarmānuṣṭhānaviraha eva, na tu sarvopādhinirmokṣaḥ | sati saṃpattiḥ nāma dehādyadhiṣṭhātṛtvaviraheṇa brahmaṇi sthiti, sadā dhyeyatvādasya || 9 || iti karmānusmṛtiśabdavidhyadhikaraṇam -3 <4. mugdhādhikaraṇam ||> mugdhe'rdhasaṃpattiḥ pariśeṣāt || 3-2-10 || mugdhamadhikṛtya cintyate - kimiyaṃ mūrchā ... ... maraṇaṃ hi sarvaprāṇadehasaṃbandhoparitiḥ, sūkṣmaprāṇadehasaṃvandhāvasthitirmūrchā || 10 || mugdhe'rdhasaṃpattiḥ pariśeṣāt | saṅgatiḥ sphuṭā | prasiddhyupapatteḥ - jñānalopāviśeṣāditi bhāvaḥ | abhighātādi iti ādi śabdādaniṣṭaśravaṇam | nimittākāravairūpye kramāta suṣuptimaraṇa vyāvartake | suṣuptau prāṇo bhūyānupalabhyate; mūrchāyāmalpaḥ; mṛtau na kaścit || 10 || iti mugdhādhikaraṇam - 4 <5. ubhayaliṅgādhikaraṇam ||> na sthānato'pi parasyobhayaliṅgaṃ sarvatra hi || 3-2-11 || doṣadarśanādvairāgyodayāya jīvasyāvasthāviśeṣāḥ .... .. ityādiśrutismṛtibhyaḥ ubhayalakṣaṇaṃ hi brahmāvagatam || 11 || na sthānato'pi parasyobhayaliṅgaṃ sarvatra hi | saṅgatimāha - doṣa iti | brahmaṇo heyapratyanīkatvaṃ kalyāṇaguṇākaratvaṃ ca pādārthaḥ | svāpnārthasraṣṭvatvasuṣuptisthānatvayorapi kalyāṇaguṇarūpatvādiha saṅgatiḥ | mūrchā tu suṣuptisāpekṣatvādiha cintitā || sthāneṣu - avasthāsu | tattadavasthaśarīre - jāgāradihetutvāvasthaśarīre | anutthānaśaṅkāṃ pariharati - ittham iti | rājakopadvārabhūtakhaḍgaprahārasyeva dvārahetoḥ sākṣādapuruṣārthahetutvāt svecchādhīnatve'pi tathātvānapagamāt pūrvapakṣotthānamityarthaḥ | pṛthivyātmādi iti | tatsaṃsargau ca pañcama iti nayādātmani sthitā nāśuddhirityātmopādānam || 12 || bhedāditi cenna pratyekamatadvacanāt || 3-2-12 || yathā jīvasya prajāpativākyāvagatāpahatapāpmatvā ... .. sa eva saṃbandhaḥ tattadvicitraniyamanarūpalīlārasāyaiva syāt || 12 || bhedāditi cenna pratyekamatadvacanāt | jīvasyobhayalasiṅgakatve'pi tattaddehayogarūpāvasthābhedena hyapumarthaḥ, tathā parasyāpītyarthaḥ | pariharati tanna iti | āvṛttatvāt kṣityādisaṃbandhasya jīvasya nityatvenāśaṅkanīyasya vyāvartyatvāyogācca amṛta śabdo na nityatvaparaḥ | kiṃ tu tattaddoṣarāhityaparaḥ | jīvasya tirodhānādiśrutivaśādubhayaliṅgatva śrutisaṅkoca, na tu parasyetyarthaḥ | na hi iti | vastusvabhāvāyattatvābhāvānnāpumarthatvamityarthaḥ | tādūpye - sukhaduḥkhahetutve | na hyekasya viruddhamākāradvayaṃ svabhāva iti bhāvaḥ | na paramupapattyā karmanibandhanatvaṃ klṛptam, kaṇṭhoktaṃ cetyāha - tathā ca iti | puruṣabhedena sukhaduḥkhakaratvamāha - narakasvarga iti | kālabhedenaikasyaikaṃ prati taddhetutvamāha - tadeva iti || 12 || api caivameke || 3-2-13 || api ca eke śākhinaḥ ekasminneva dehasaṃyoge ... .. tayoranyaḥ pippalaṃ svādvattyanaśnannanyo'bhicākaśīti iti || 13 || api caivameke | sphuṭam || 13 || atha syāt -anena jīvenātmanā .... .... arūpavadeva hi tatpradhānatvāt || 3-1-14 || devādiśarīrānupraveśe tena tena rūpeṇa .... ... brahma nirastanikhiladoṣatvakavyāṇaguṇākaratvarūpobhayaliṅgameva || 14 || anantarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - atha syāt iti | arūpavadeva hi tatpradhānatvāt | kenākāreṇārūpatulyatvamityatrāha - jīvavat iti | nanu iti | kathaṃ kāryānanvayaḥ, niyamanādikāryānvayāt dhīśabdaparyavasānena karmavaśyatvānvayāccetyarthaḥ | parihagati - ittham iti | sukhaduḥkhakāryaviśeṣāsparśo vivakṣitaḥ, na tu niyamanādyasparśaḥ | dhīśabdaparyavasāyikaṃ karmānvayaṃ pariharati - vidhi iti | niṣkarṣakaśabdavat brāhmaṇādiśabdāḥ jīvaparyantāḥ syuḥ | paraparyantatve'pi gauro brāhmaṇa iti gauratvavat viśeṣaṇabhūtajīvadvārakaṃ vā karmavaśyatvaṃ syādityarthaḥ || 14 || nanu ca - satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma .... ... prakāśavaccāvaiyarthyāt || 3-2-15 || yathā satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma ityādi ... ... nirastanikhilāvidyādidoṣatvādyabhidhāyivākyāvaiyarthyādubhayaliṅgabheva brahma || 15 || anantarasūtramavatārayati -
