nanu ca iti | ārthaśrautaniṣedhau darśitau | prakāśavaccāvaiyarthyāt | vyāptyā cet, dhīḥ kasyacideva | śrutibalāt na cet, saguṇatvamapi | na ca vyāptivirodhaḥ, dharmabhūtajñānasyaiva jñānānāśrayatvāditi bhāvaḥ || 15 || āha ca tanmātram || 3-2-16 || kiṃ ca satyaṃ jñānamanantam ityādi ... ... neti neti iti ca niṣedhasya viṣayo'nantarameva vakṣyate | | 16 || āha ca tanmātram | sūtrābhyāṃ virodhābhyupagamena tadabhāvena cārthaguṇaniṣedhaḥ pratyuktaḥ | atha śrautaṃ pariharannārthasya ca parihāroṣayogi mānaṃ darśayati || 16 || darśayati cātho api smaryate || 3-2-17 || darśayati ca vedāntagaṇaḥ ... ... brahmaṇa ubhayaliṅgatvāt tatsthānaprayuktā doṣā na paraṃ brahma spṛśanti || 17 || darśayati cāthā api smaryate | prathame sūtre svapakṣamūlatayā mānaṃ darśitam | iha tu dūṣaṇaparihārāya | vedāntagaṇa iti | atho śabdaḥ pramāṇakārtsnyapara iti bhāvaḥ | darśayati smaryate iti sautraśabdavivaraṇam | nirdoṣatvaṃ darśayati - niṣkalaṃ ... ... niravadyam ityādinā | sāmānyaviśeṣagobalīvardanayāvabhipretau || 17 || ata eva copamā sūryakādivat || 3-2-18 || yato nānāvidheṣu sthāneṣu sthitasyāpi ... ... ekadhā bahudhā caiva dṛśyate jalacandravat | ityādiṣu || 18 || ata eva copamā sūryakādivat | tathātmaikaḥ iti | ekasvabhāva ityarthaḥ || 18 || atra codayati - ambuvadagrahaṇāt tu na tathātvam || 3-2-19 || tuśabdaścodyaṃ dyotayati | abhbuvaditi ... ... ato na tathātvam - dārṣṭāntikasya na dṛṣṭāntatulyatvamityarthaḥ || 19 || ambuvadagrahaṇāt tu na tathātvam | dṛṣṭāntāvaighaṭyāya dārṣṭāntikasya pṛthivyādau sthiteḥ mithyātvamupetyamiti bhāvaḥ || 19 || pariharati - vṛddhihrāsabhāktvamantarbhāvādubhayasāmañjasyādevaṃ darśanācca || 3-2-20 || pṛthavyādisthānāntarbhāvāt sthāninaḥ ... .. samastakalyāṇaguṇākarasya pṛthivyādisthānato'pi na doṣasaṃbhavaḥ || 20 || vṛddhihāsabhāktvamantarbhāvādubhayasāmañjasyādevaṃ darśanācca | samañjaṃsaṃ bhavati | ityantena bhāṣyeṇa evam ityantasūtrāṃśo vyākhyātaḥ | smṛtivaco'rthamāha - ghaṭa iti | dṛṣṭāntadvayaṃ kimarthaṃ doṣāsparśasyānugatahetuḥ ka ityatrāha - etaduktam iti| deśata iva svabhāvato viprakarṣasyāpi doṣāsparśahetutājñāpanamubhayadṛṣṭāntatphalam| sannikarṣatrayasamudāyo doṣasparśahetuḥ | anyatamaviprakarṣo'pyasparśaheturityarthaḥ | darśanācca iti sūtrāṃśaḥ || 20 || atha syāt - dve vāva brahmaṇo rūpe ... .... prakṛtaitāvattvaṃ hi pratiṣedhati tato bravīti ca bhūyaḥ || 3-2-21 || naitadupapadyate yahbrahmaṇaḥ prakṛtaviśeṣavattvaṃ ... ... api tu pūrvaprakṛteyattāmātram | ata ubhayaliṅgameva paraṃ brahma || 21 || anantarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - atha syāt iti | mahārajanaṃ - kusumbhaḥ | prakṛtaitāvatvaṃ hi pratiṣedhati tato bravīti ca bhūyaḥ | anūdya niṣedhatīti na bhrāntajalpakalpatā ityatrāha - na hi iti | nopapadyate ityantena hi śabdābhiprāyo vivṛtaḥ | sātra iti iti | itiḥ prakārārthaḥ | iyattā ca prakāra ityarthaḥ | prakāraniṣedhaparatve tvāntatvaṃ na ghaṭate ityarthaḥ || anantaram iti tataḥ śabdadārtha uktaḥ na hyetasmāt iti niṣedhaḥ pratītaḥ, na tu guṇaḥ, svarūpameva satyaṃ pratītamityatrāha - ayamarthaḥ iti || brahmaṇaḥ pramāṇāntarāgocaratvena ... ... tadavyaktamāha hi || 3-2-22 || tat - brahma pramāṇāntareṇa na vyajyate .... .. na cakṣuṣāgṛhyate nāpi vācā ityādi || 22 || anantarasūtrasaṅgatimāha - brahmaṇaḥ iti | pratyakṣasya sanmātragrāhitvena brahmaṇaḥ pramāṇāntaragocaratvamāśaṅkya tannirākaraṇamukhena tasya mānāntarāgocaratvaṃ draḍhayatītyarthaḥ | etacca dīpasārayoḥ spaṣṭīkṛtam | tadavyaktamāha hi | sphuṭam || 22 || hetvantaraṃ cāha - api saṃrādhane pratyakṣānumānābhyām || 3-2-23 || api ca saṃrādhane - samyak prīṇane ... .. brahmaṇo mūrtāmūrtarūpadvayādiviśiṣṭatāṃ prāgasiddhāṃ nānuvadituṃ kṣamam || 23 || api saṃrādhane pratyakṣānumānābhyām | dhyānagamyo'stu, tataḥ kiṃ saṃrādhanena sākṣātkārasyetyatrāha - bhaktirūpa iti || 26 || prakāśādivaccāvaiśeṣyaṃ prakāśaśca karmaṇyabhyāsāt || 3-2-24 || itaśca prakṛtaitāvattvameva pratiṣedhati ... ... teṣāṃ mūrtāmūrtādiviśiṣṭatvamapyaviśeṣeṇa pratīyate - ityarthaḥ || 24 || prakāśādivaccāvaiśeṣyaṃ prakāśaśca karmaṇyabhyāsāt | mūrtāmūrtādiprapañcaviśiṣṭatāyā upāsanārthamāropitatvaśaṅkā'tra nirasyate | teṣāmapi mūrtāmūrtādiprapañcaviśiṣṭapratītiḥ bhrāntiriti śaṅkāyāmuttarakhaṇḍaṃ vyācaṣṭe - brahmasvarūpabhūta iti | upāsanena sākṣātkṛtatvāt prakāśānandāderiva prapañcaviśiṣṭatāyāḥ paramārthatvamityarthaḥ || 24 || uktaṃ brahmaṇa ubhayaliṅgatvupasaṃharati - ato'nantena tathā hi liṅgam || 3-2-25 || ataḥ uktairhetubhiḥ brahmaṇaḥ ... ... tathā hi satyubhayasiṅgaṃ brahmopapannaṃ bhavati || 25 || ato'nantena tathā hi liṅgam | neti netyasyāvadhiniṣedhaparatvāt niravadhikena kalyāṇaguṇajātena viśiṣṭatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ siddhamityarthaḥ | ubhayaliṅgatvaṃ pūrvapakṣīkurvatāmupasaṃhārasūtraṃ na ghaṭate, tatsamarthanenopasaṃhārāt || iti ubhayaliṅgādhikaraṇam - 5 <6. ahikuṇḍalādhikaraṇam ||> ubhayavyapadeśāt tvahikuṇḍalavat || 3-2-26 || mūrtāmūrtātmakasyācitprapañcasya ... ... tasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ saṃsthānaviśeṣā evācidvastūni || 26 || ubhayavyapadeśāt tvahirūkuṇḍalavat | saṅgatimāha - mūrta iti | acitprasaṅgāt saṅgatiḥ| pradhāna iti | patitvādikathanāt śarīratvaṃ vivṛtaṃ bhavati | ahikuṇḍalanyāyena - ekadravyāvasthāviśeṣeṇa ekajāti yogasya khaṇḍādidṛṣṭānte satyapi prabhātadvadupādānaṃ guṇapradhānabhāvasadbhāvāt | jīvasyeva iti | aṃśo nānā ityasmādasya vibhāgo dyotitaḥ | tajjīvabrahmaikyaviṣayam | idaṃ cācidbrahmaviṣayam | paunaruktyamāśaṅkyāha - i ha iti | sphuṭam || 26 || prakāśāśrayavadvā tejastatvāt || 3-2-27 || vāśabdaḥ pakṣavyāvṛttyarthaḥ | brahmasvarūpasyaiva ... ... eva macitprapañcasya brahmaṇo rūpatvamityarthaḥ || 27 || prakāśāśrayavadvā tejastvāt | ahikuṇḍalavat iti acidbrahmaṇoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvena bhedābhedoktiḥ| prakāśāśrayavat iti | vyaktyātmanā jātyātmanā ca bhedābhedoktiriti bhāvaḥ || 27 || pūrvavadvā || 3-2-28 || vāśabdaḥ prakṣadvayavyāvṛttyarthaḥ | ... ... tatheha jīvasyācidvastunaśca brahma pratyaṃśatvam || 28 || pūrvavadvā | prathamapakṣaparigṛhītavyāvṛttyarthaṃ pakṣadvayaśabdaḥ | uktadoṣāt - nirvikāratvanirdoṣatvabādhāt | sakalaśrutismṛti iti | brahmatvaṃ jātiścet khaṇḍo muṇḍa itivadīśvarādiśabdaiḥ jagacchabdasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt | brahmaiva jātiścen sārvajñyādiguṇāśrayatvānupapattiriti bhāvaḥ | kimapṛthaksiddhadharmatayā'śatvaṃ dṛṣṭamityatrāha - tadevam iti || 28 || pratiṣedhācca || 3-2-29 || sa vā eṣa mahānaja ātmā ... .... brahmaṇo nirdoṣatvena kalyāṇaguṇākaratvena cobhayaliṅgatvamapi siddham || 29 || pratiṣedhācca | kathaṃ kāryakāraṇānanyatvādītyatrāha - ataḥ sūkṣma iti | ityādi iti ādi śabdāt sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vivakṣitam || 29 || iti ahikuṇḍalādhikaraṇam - 6 <7. parādhikaraṇam ||> paramatassetūnmānasaṃbandhabhedavyapadeśebhyaḥ || 3-2-30 || idānīmasmāt parasmājjagannimittopādana ... ... parasmām brahmaṇaḥ paramapi kiñcidastīti gamyate iti || 30 || paramatassetūnmānasaṃbandhabhedavyapadeśebhyaḥ | parasmāt iti prāpyatālakṣaṇaṃ paratvamuktam | parabrahmaṇaḥ iti tu svakāryāpekṣayā paratvam | sthemne - prāpyatvopayogiguṇavaikalye hi nobhayaliṅgatvapauṣkalyam | pūrvatra nirdoṣatvaṃ sthāpitam | iha tu kalyāṇaguṇātmakatvamiti saṅgatiḥ | asaṅkarakṛtvavyāvṛttyarthamāha - etam iti | tathā iti |kevalaḥ ṣaṣṭhyantasahitaśceti bhidā || 30 || evaṃ prāpte'bhidhīyate sāmānyāt tu || 3-2-31 || tu śabdaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati ... ... taratiśca prāptivacanaḥ | yathā vedāntaṃ tarati iti || 31 || sāmanyāt tu | taraterarthamāha - etam iti || 31 || buddhyarthaḥ pādavat || 3-2-32 || yo'yaṃ catuṣpāt brahma ṣoḍaśakalam ... ... brahmaṇo vāgādipādavyapadeśaḥ upāsanārthaḥ evamayamapi || 32 || buddhyarthaḥ pādavat | ānantyāt na kāraṇaviṣayamityatrāha - jagatkāraṇatvam iti | ato yathā iti | nikhilakāraṇasya vāgādyavacchedāsaṃbhavāt tasyopāsarthatvaṃ siddhamiti bhāvaḥ || 32 || svayamanunmitasya kathamupāsanārthatayā ... ... sthānaviśeṣāt prakāśādivat || 3-2-33 || pratipannavāgādisthānaviśeṣarūpopādhi ... ... ghaṭādisthānabhedaiḥ paricchidyānusandhānasaṃbhava ityarthaḥ || 33 || sthānaviśeṣāt prakāśādivat | sūtramidaṃ dṛṣṭāntaviṣayam || 33 || upapatteśca || 3-2-34 || yaduktam amṛtasyaiṣa setuḥ iti .... ... tasyaiṣa ātmāvivṛṇute ta nūṃ svām ityananyopāyatvaśravaṇāt || 34 || upapatteśca | ananyopāyatvam - prāpyasyaivopāyatvam | vṛṇute vivṛṇute iti tadubhayasiddhaḥ || 34 || tathā'nyapratiṣedhāt || 3-2-35 || yat punaruktaṃ tato yaduttarataram ... ... sa evehāpi parāt paraḥ iti samaṣṭipuruṣāt paratvenocyate || 35 || tathā'nyapratiṣedhāt | yasmāt param iti pañcamyāḥ paraśabdānvaye samaniṣedho na sidhyet | tataśca tadvedanasyaiva mukttyupāyatā na sidhyet | sā hi pratijñātā tameva viditvā iti | apara śabdavaiyarthyaṃ ca | na tatsamaḥ iti virodhaśceti bhāvaḥ | na ca aparaśabdasaṅkocaḥ, saṅkocānyathāsiddheḥ | tato yaduttarataram ityatra tataḥ śabdasya hetvarthatā hi vakṣyate | ato na gobalīvardanayaḥ aparaparyāyasya anyaśabdasyāvyavahitānvayaṃ darśayati - tathā iti | śrutyantarāvirodhamāha - tathā na iti | tadvākyaṃ na kāraṇaviṣayamityatrāha - taddhi iti || hiraṇyagarbhaśabdasya śivaśabdavat sādhāraṇyābhāvāt, śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃbhūrdruhiṇaḥ iti prasiddhyā śaṃbhvādiśabdopapatteḥ vākyāntare dhātṛśabdācca caturmukhaḥ paramakāraṇamityatrāha - adbhyaḥ iti | vidyudvarṇatvārṇavaśāyitvasamānavākyoktalakṣmīpativaiḥ avagataparamapuruṣabhāvakāraṇaprakaraṇasāmarthyānnetyarthaḥ | paroktaśruterarthamāha - tataḥ iti | hetvarthatve satyanvayaṃ darśayati - yaduttarataram iti | tenedaṃ pūrṇaṃ puruṣeṇa mahān prabhurvai puruṣaḥ iti pūrvāparaikārthyāt sarvānanaśisogrīvādinā puṃsūktanārāyaṇānuvākapratyabhijñānācca madhyastha śiva śabdaḥ śāśvataśivaparaḥ anyathā iti | nānyaḥ panthāḥ yasmāt param iti ca virodhau syātāmitityarthaḥ || 35 || anena sarvagatatvamāyāmaśabdadibhyaḥ || 3-2-36 || anena - brahmaṇā, sarvagatatvaṃ - sarvasya jagato vyāptatvaṃ ... .... ataḥ idaṃ paraṃ brahmaiva sarvasmāt param || 36 || anena sarvagatatvamāyāmaśabdādibhyaḥ | idaṃ svapakṣe pramāṇaparaṃ sūtram | nityaṃ vibhum iti śrutiḥ paramapuruṣaviṣayā parāt paraṃ puruṣam iti prakaraṇasthatvāt | vibhuṃ - prabhum | ādi śabdāt dhāraṇaniyamana pūrvakavyāptiparaṃ samānādhikaraṇaṃ ca vākyajātaṃ gṛhītam | puṃsūktādyuktatrividhāparicchedaḥ samādhikaniṣedhaḥ brahmaśivakarmakasargasaṃhārā hyanyathā nopapadyante || iti parādhikaraṇam - 7 <8. phalādhikaraṇam ||> phalamata upapatteḥ || 3-2-37 || uktamupāsisiṣopajananārthaṃ jīvasya ... ... na hyacetanaṃ karma kṣaṇadhvaṃsi kālāntarabhāviphalasādhanaṃ bhavitumarhati || 37 || phalamata upapatteḥ | siddhāntopakramamidam | phalatvamuktam; phaladatvaṃ virūpyate iti saṅgatiḥ | tacca kalyāṇaguṇa iti pādāntarbhāvaḥ | sādhāraṇaphalaśabdoktiphalamāha - tulya iti | pūrvakāṇḍe dvāramātraṃ cintitam | iha tu tadviśeṣa iti bhidā | itarasyāyogyatvamāha - na hi iti || śrutatvācca || 3-2-38 || sa vā eṣa mahānaja ātmā ... .. bhogāpavargarūpaṃ phalamayameva dadātīti hi śrūyate || 38 || śrutatvāc | annādaḥ - annadaḥ | na paraṃ yogyatvāyogyatvābhyāmasya phaladatvaṃ kalpyam | śrutaṃ ca ityarthaḥ || 38 || saṃprati pūrvapakṣamāha - dharmaṃ jaiminirata eva || 3-2-39 || ata eva - upapatteḥ śāstrācca ... ... apūrvadvāreṇa phalasādhanatvamavagamayati || 39 || dharmaṃ jaiminirata eva | upapattimāha - loke iti | śrutimāha - tathā iti | sādhanatvaṃ śrutam | sadvārakatvaṃ kalpyamiti na virodhaḥ || 39 || pūrvaṃ tu bādarāyaṇo hetuvyapadeśāt || 3-2-40 || tuśabdaḥ pakṣavyāvṛttyarthaḥ | pūrvoktaṃ ... .... parasmāt puruṣāt bhogāpavargarūpaṃ phalaṃ ca, vadantīti sarvaṃ samañjasam || 40 || iti phalādhikaraṇam - 8 iti śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracite śārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣye tṛtīyasyādhyāsyaya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || siddhāntamāha - pūrvaṃ tu bādarāyaṇo hetuvyapadeśāt | mantrārthaṃvādayoranyaparatvamāśaṅkāyāha - kāminaḥ iti | rātrisatrapratiṣṭhāpagoraṇaśatayātanāsādhyasādhanatvaśarkarāñjanadravyapaśuviśeṣādivatmantrārthavādoktaḥ svīkāryaṃ iti bhāvaḥ devatā phaladā'stu, apūrvamapi svīkriyetetyatrāha evam iti | śrutahānāśrutaklṛptī anyāyye ityarthaḥ | vācyāpūrvapakṣe na doṣa ityatrāha - liṅādayaḥ iti | liṅvācyatvamapi kalpyamiti klṛptidvayamityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha - tadevam iti . tataḥ kiṃ bhagavataḥ phaladatve ityatrāha - vāyvādi iti | saṃbhavaṃ darśayati - loke ca iti | tarkavirodhaḥ kālātyayāpadeśahata ityabhiprayannāha - vedāntāstu iti | upabṛṃhaṇasiddhatvāt stutyādi uktam | sarvaṃ - vidhyarthavādamantrajātamityarthaḥ || 40 || iti phalādhikaraṇam - 8 iti śrīharitakulatilakavāgvijayisūnunā śrīraṅgarājadivyājñālabdhavedavyāsāparanāmadheyena śrīmadvaradācāryapādasevāsamadhigataśrībhagavadrāmānujaviracitaśārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣyahṛdayena śrīsudarśanasūriṇā viracitāyāṃ śrutapradīpikāyāṃ tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || tṛtīyādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || <1. sarvavedāntapratyayādhikaraṇam ||> sarvavedāntapratyayaṃ codanādyaviśeṣāt || 3-3-1 || uktaṃ brahmopāsisiṣopajananāya vaktavyaṃ ... .... ataḥ ebhiḥ pratyabhijñānāt śākhāntare'pi vidyaikyam || 1 || sarvavedāntapratyayaṃ codanādyaviśeṣāt | pāsaṅgatimāha - uktam iti | anyatroktasyānyatra svīkāraḥ upasaṃhāraḥ | tatraivopayogaḥ vikalpaḥ | abhede upasaṃhāraḥ | bhede vikalpaḥ | prathamādhikaraṇakṛtyamāha - prathamam iti | aneka iti | ekarūpasaṃjñāphalakatvena śrūyamāṇāyāḥ ityarthaḥ | śākhāntarādhikaraṇoktanyo'tra pravartate, na veti vicāraḥ | neti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ | tatra yuktimāha - aviśeṣa iti | agnihotraṃ juhoti, dadhnā juhoti ityetadvyāvṛttyartham aviśeṣa śabdaḥ | bhedakatvāt - iḍo yajati barhiryajati ityādāvivetyabhiprāyaḥ | pūrvakāṇḍoktasiddhāntayukttyaivālamiti śaṅkāyāmadhikāṃ yukiṃta darśayati - ata eva iti | ata eva - vidyābhedādeva | kathamanyathā niyamānupapattirityatrāha - vidyaikye hi iti || rāddhānte karmakāṇḍasūtrāt ekam ityanuṣaktam | saṃyogāt ityanuktiḥ codanāprādhānyāt | karmopāstisādhāraṇyāya karmavyāvṛttopāsanavācidhātvabhiprāyeṇa dhātvarthaviśeṣa ityuktam | kvacidvide kvacidupāseśca śravaṇe'pyaikyasidhyarthaṃ vidiparyāyasya ityuktam | karmaṇo dravyadevate iva vidyāyā upāsyaṃ rūpam, tasyāḥ tannirūpyatvāt || 1|| yat tūktam aviśeṣapunaḥśravaṇāt ... ... bhedānneti cedekasyāmapi || 3-3-2 || aviśeṣapunaḥśrutyā prakaraṇāntarācca ... ... punaḥśrunyupapattestatra na vidheyāntarasaṃbhavaḥ || 2 || anantarasūtramavatārayati - yat tu iti | bhedānneti cedakasyāmapi | pūrvatra siddhāntasādhako hetuḥ saṃkṣiptaḥ | iha tu pūrvapakṣaparihārahetuḥ saṃkṣipyate | vidheyam - sāmānyam; tadviśeṣa upāsanam | anyathānupapattyā iti | aviśeṣapunaḥ śrutiprakaraṇabhedayoḥ veyarthyarūpānupapattyā ityarthaḥ || 2 || yaccoktaṃ śirovratavatām ... ... svādhyāyasya tathātve hi samācāre'dhikārācca savavacca tanniyamaḥ || 3-3-3 || naitadasti - śirovratopadeśa ... ... ātharvaṇikaikāgnisaṃbandhinaḥ tatraiva bhavanti ,na tretāgniṣu || 3 || anantarasūtramavatārayati - yaccoktam iti | svādhyāyasya tathātve hi samācāre'dhikārācca savavacca tanniyamaḥ | vidyaikye'pi na sarvaśākhināṃ śirovrataprāptiḥ | tasya vidyāṅgatvābhāvādityarthaḥ | vedavratena - śirovratena, idaṃ - vranatāntaraṃ, vyākhyātam ityatideśaḥ | vedavrata śabdoktatvāt vedādhyayanāṅgatvāvagama ityarthaḥ | teṣāmeva iti vākyasyārthamāha - teṣām iti adhyayanāṅgasya kathaṃ niyam ityatrāha - savavacca iti | kasyacit karmaviśeṣasya śākhāviśeṣavatāmasādhāraṇatvaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ | saptasūryāḥ - ārogādisaptasūryadevatyāḥ || 3 || darśayati || 3-3-4 || darśayati ca śrutirūpāsanasya ... ... tadubhayatra vidyaikatvena guṇopasaṃhārādevopapadyate || 4 || darśayati ca | taittirīyakavākyasyāpūrṇopadeśatvāt chāndogyopajīvanaṃ vidyaikyadyotakamityarthaḥ || 4 || tadevaṃ śākhāntarādhikaraṇanyāyasiddhaṃ ... ... upasaṃhāro'rthābhedādvidhiśeṣavat samāne ca || 3-3-5 || evaṃ sarvavedānteṣu samāne satyupāsane ... ... tadupasaṃhārā viśeṣādupasaṃhartavya ityarthaḥ | caśabdo'vadhāraṇe || 5|| anantarasūtramavatārayati - tadevam iti | upasaṃhāro'rthābhedādvidhiśeṣavat samāne ca | upāsane ekasaṃjñāphalake guṇa śabdaḥ aṅgaparaḥ || iti sarvavedāntapratyayādhikaraṇam - 1 <2. anyathātvādhikaraṇam ||> anyathātvaṃ śabdāditi cennāviśeṣāt || 3-3-6 || evaṃ codanādyaviśeṣāt vidyaikatvam ... .... anyathopakramagata udgīthaśabdaḥ kartari lākṣaṇikaḥ syāt; ato vidyaikyam || 6 || anyathātvaṃ śabdāditi cennāviśeṣāt | sāmānyena vidyāsu sarvaśākhāpratyayanayāvatāra uktaḥ | tadviśeṣeṣu bhedābhedahetubhāvābhāvau nirūpyete iti saṅgatiḥ | dvayāḥ - dvividhāḥ | atyayāma - jayāma | āsanyam - āsannam; mukhyam | parābhavati ityanvayaḥ | saṃyetire - yuddhaṃ cakruḥ | ākhaṇam - mṛtpiṇḍaḥ ṛtvā - prāpya | na vidhiḥ śrutaḥ ityatrāha - vedanaviṣaya iti | ārthavādike phale na tātparyamityatrāha - udgītha iti || viṣayaḥ śodhitaḥ | saṃśayamāha - tatra iti | sūtramavatārayati - atra iti | udagāyat - udgātari prāṇadṛṣṭiṃ kṛtavanta ityarthaḥ | evaṃ veda, evaṃvidi iti evaṃ śabdaḥ kartṛkarmaṇoḥ prāṇadṛṣṭiparaḥ | kevala iti | codanādyaviśeṣasamudāyādaikyam | śabdāntarādiṣvanyatamena bheda ityarthaḥ | tanna iti | upakramānuguṇyāt kartṛtvamupacaritamityarthaḥ || 6 || iti prāpte pracakṣmahe na vā prakaraṇabhedāt parovarīyastvādivat || 3-3-7 || na veti pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati; na caitadasti .. ... hiraṇmayapuruṣadṛṣṭividhānāt parovarīyastvādiguṇaviśiṣṭadṛṣṭividhānamarthāntarabhūtam || rāddhānte . na vā prakaraṇabhedāt parovarīyastvādivat | praṇavasya svaraviśeṣalābhāyaḥ udgītha - śabdenoktiḥ | vājinaḥ iti | apavādakābhāvāt kṛtsnaviṣayaḥ udgītha śabdaḥ| vidheya iti | vidheyabhede rūpabhedaḥ phalita ityarthaḥ| na ityukte'pi vyāvṛttisiddhau vāśabdoktitātparyamāha - kiṃ ca iti | na ca iti | upakramanayo nādhikasvīkāravirodhī, kiṃ tvavagatabhaṅgavirodhī | na cātra tadbhaṅgaḥ ityarthaḥ | yathā iti | upāsyaikye dṛṣṭiviśeṣaṇaikye'pi dṛṣṭiviśeṣaṇaviśeṣabhedāt vidyā bhidyante, kimutopāsyabhedādityarthaḥ|| 7 || saṃjñātaścet taduktamasti tu tadapi || 3-3-8 || udgīthavidyeti saṃjñaikyāt tat ... ... yathā codgīthavidyeti chāndogye prathamaprapāṭhakoditāsu vahvīṣu vidyāsu || 8 || saṃjñātaścet taduktamasti tu tadapi | sphuṭam | udgīthaśabdenāvayavoktiḥ prāgeva samāptā | iha tu kṛtsnoktiriti śaṅkā vyudasyate || 8 || vyāpteśca samañjasam || 3-3-9 || chāndogye prathamaprapāṭhake uttarāsvapi ... ... kartodgātā prāṇadṛṣṭyopāsya iti vidyānānātvaṃ siddham || 9 || vyāpteśca samañjasam | kathamavayave samudāyaśabdoktirityatrāha - avayave ca iti | nigamayati - ataḥ iti || 9 || iti anyathātvādhikaraṇam - 2 <3. sarvabhedādhikaraṇam ||> sarvābhedādanyatreme || 3-3-10 || chāndogyavājasaneyakayoḥ prāṇavidyā ... ... vasiṣṭhatvādiguṇayogāt prāṇojyeṣṭha pratipanna iti nāsti vidyābhedaḥ || 10 || sarvābhedādanyatreme | pūrvatra dṛṣṭiviśeṣaṇatayā prāṇaḥ prastutaḥ | iha tu tadviṣayasvatantropāsanaṃ nirūpyate iti saṅgatiḥ | viṣayaḥ śodhyate chāndogya iti | jyaiṣṭhyam - vṛddhatvam | śraiṣṭhyam - praśasyatvam | praśasyasya śraḥ jya ca vṛddhasya ca ityanuśāsanāt | vasiṣṭhādi śabdāḥ vāgādīnāṃ svasvakāryasāmarthyaviṣayāḥ | vyūdire - vivādaṃ cakruḥ | vivadamānāḥ iti vājipāṭhaḥ | tvaṃ taddhasiṣṭho'si - mama kāryasāmarthyasya tvadadhīnatvāt sāmarthyaṃ tavaivetyarthaḥ || 10 || iti sarvābhedādhikaraṇam - 3 <4. ānandādyikaraṇam ||> prāṇavidyāṅgaviṣayamanyadapi nirūpaṇam ... ... ānandādayaḥ pradhānasya || 3-3-11 || atra brahmasvarūpaguṇānāṃ sarvāsu paravidyāsu .. ... sarvatrānandādayastadguṇā upasaṃhartavyāḥ || 11 || madhye saṅgativaśāt prastutamarthāntaramavatārayituṃ prāṇavidyāṅgaviṣaya cintāntarasya kariṣyamāṇatvamāha - prāṇavidyāṅga iti | saṅgatimāha - yathā iti | anuktānām yadaham ityādivacanabhaṅgayā anuktānām || ānandādayaḥ pradhānasya | svarūpaguṇānām - svarūpapratiṣattyanubandhiguṇānām | abhedāt iti | atha śabdānuśāsanam, keṣāṃ śabdānām itivat samastaikadeśānuṣaṅgaḥ | ānandādayaḥ - ānandatvādayaḥ | dvyekayoḥ itivat || 11 || evaṃ tarhi guṇyapṛthagbhāvādeva ... ... priyaśirastvādyaprāptirupacayāpacayau hi bhede || 3-3 12|| brahmasvarūpaguṇānāṃ prāptāvucyamānāyāṃ ... ... satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma ityādi virudhyate || 12 || priyaśirastvādyaprāptirupacayāpacayau hi bhede | upacayāpacayau - pīnatvakṛśatve | ādi śabdāt asthūlamanaṇu iti vākyaṃ gṛhyate || nanvevameva brahmasaṃbandhināmeva ... ..... itare tvarthasāmānyāt || 3-3-13 || tuśabdaścodyaṃ vyāvartayati ... ... ye yatra śrutāḥ, te tatropasaṃhāryāḥ iti niravadyam || 13 || itare tvarthasāmānyāt | arthaḥ - dharmī | pratītiviṣayatvaniyamaḥ sāmyam | satyatvādīnāṃ tatpratītyanubandhitvaṃ darśayati - yato vā iti | upalakṣitam iti | viśeṣyāṃśe upāsye kāraṇatvamupalakṣaṇam | jñāpyānantarbhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| viśiṣṭaṃ kāraṇavākyāvagatam | viśeṣyāṃśastu satyatvādinirūpya ityarthaḥ || 13 || yadi upacayāpacayaprasaṅgāt priyaśirastvādayaḥ ... ... ādhyānāya prayojanābhāvāt || 3-3-14 || prayojanāntarābhāvādādhyānāyāyaṃ ... ... priyaśirastvādīnāṃ na sarvadā ānandamayapratītāvanuvartante || 14 || anantarasūtrāvatārāyāha - yadi iti | ādhyānāya prayojanābhāvāt | pratipattyartham iti | dhyānopayogiśāstrajanyajñānasiddhyarthamityarthaḥ | na sarvadā - na upāstāvapi ityarthaḥ || 14 || ātmaśabdācca || 3-3-15 || anyo'ntara ātmā''nandamayaḥ ... ... tasya sukhapratipattyarthaṃ rūpaṇamātramiti gamyate || 15 || ātmaśabdācca | sphuṭam || 15 || nanu - anyo'ntara ātmā prāṇamayaḥ ... ... ātmagṛhītiritaravaduttarāt || 3-3-16 || anyo'ntara ātmā''nandamayaḥ ... ... bahu syāṃ prajāyeya ityānandamayaviṣayāduttaravākyāt || 16 || ātmagṛhītiritaravaduttarāt | uttarāt ātmagṛhītitvaniścayo dṛṣṭānte'pi tulyaḥ || 16 || anvayāditi cet syādavadhāraṇāt || 3-3-17 || pūrvatra prāṇamayādiṣvanātmasvātmaśabdānvaya ... ... aparamātmani paramātmabuddhyā ātmaśabdānvaya iti niravadyam || 17 || anvayāditi cet syādavadhāraṇāt | nottarāt iti | upakramo hi prabala iti bhāvaḥ | kutaḥ iti | upakramasyāpi tathātvāt na tenottarabādha ityarthaḥ | tarhi madhye kathaṃ paramātmani prayoga ityatrāha - annamayāt iti | na tatrāpyaparamātmabuddhyopacaritaḥ prayogaḥ | kiṃ tu pūrvasmādantaratvamātreṇa paramātmabuddhayaiva prayogaḥ | tato'pyantaradarśanāt tatra tadbuddhirjñātā | pūrvatra tu nivṛttā | pūrvatrāpi parabuddhyā prayukta iti nopakramabādha ityarthaḥ || 17 || iti ānandādyadhikaraṇam -4 <5. kāryākhyānādhikaraṇam |> kāryākhyānādapūrvam || 3-3-18 || pūrvaprastutaprāṇavidyāśeṣabhūtam ... ... adbhiḥ paridadhati ityadbhiḥ paridhānamevoktam | nācamanam || 18 || kāryākhyānādarapūrvam | avāntarasaṅgatimāha - pūrva iti | lambhuko ha vāso bhavati - vāso labdhavān bhavati | anam - prāṇam | stutyarthatayā - na tu upāsārthatayā || rāddhānte - aprāptaṃ vidhīyate aprāprākhyānāt iti sādhyāviśiṣṭatvamityatrāha - aprāpta iti | aprāptyaviśeṣe'pi vidhipratyayāt ācamanāntaravidhirityatrāha - etaduktam iti | pratipannasyaivāprāptatve sati, arthāntaraklṛptyayogāt upakramopasaṃhārāta śākhādvayānugatatvācca vāsastvadhīrvidheyā | na tu ācamanāntaram, uktaviparyādityarthaḥ || 18 || iti kāryākhyānādhikaraṇam - 5 <6. samānādhikaraṇam ||> samāna evaṃ cābhedāt || 3-3-19 || vājasaneyake agnirahasye śaṇḍilyavidyā .. .....satyasaṅkalpatvaguṇābhedānna rūpabhedaḥ ato | vidyaikyam || 19 || samāna evaṃ cābhedāt | pūrvādhikaraṇaṃ prāṇavidyāprasaṅgāt kṛtam | tatpūrveṇāsya saṅgatiḥ | svarūpapratītyantarbhūtaguṇānāmiva satyasaṅkalpatvāntargata - vaśitvādīnāmupasaṃhāryatvamiti kūcit adhikasya satyasaṅkalpatvasya kvacit adhikasya vaśiṣitvādeścārthāntaratvābhāvāt, na rūpabheda ityarthaḥ || 19 || iti samānādhikaraṇama - 6 <7. saṃbandhādhikaraṇam ||> saṃbandhādevamanyatrāpi || 3-3-20 || bṛhadāraṇyake śrūyate - satyaṃ brahma ... .... brahmaṇaḥ satyasyaikatvena vidyaikyādubhayorubhayatropasaṃhāraḥ || 20 || saṃbandhādevamanyatrāpi | evaṃ śabdena saṅgatiḥ sphuṭā | upaniṣat śabdavyākhyānaṃ rahasyanāmanī iti | sūtrārthamāha - yathā iti || 20 || evaṃ prāpte pracakṣmahe na vā viśeṣāt || 3-3-21 || na vaitadasti - yadvidyaikyāt .... ... ubhayatra hṛdayādhāratveno - pāsyatvāt | ato vyavasthite || 21 || darśayati ca || 3-3-22 || darśayati cākṣyādhārādityādhārayoḥ ... svato hyaprāptāvatideśena prāptyapekṣā || 22 || na vā viśeṣāt | darśayati ca | spaṣṭaṃ sūtradvayam | sthānasyopā syāntargatyanantargatikṛtabhedābhedābhyāṃ nāmno vyavasthityavyavasthitī iti pūrvapakṣa rāddhāntau || 21, 22 || iti saṃbandhādhikaraṇam - 7 <8. saṃbhṛtyadhikaraṇam ||> saṃbhṛtidyuvyāptyapi cātaḥ || 3-3-23 || taittirīyake nārāyaṇīyānāṃ khileṣu ca ... .... manomayatvā - pahatapāpmatvādiviśiṣṭasyopāsyasya māhātmyapratipādanaparāḥ || 23 || saṃbhṛtidyuvyāptyapi cātaḥ nāmnoriva saṃbhṛtyādīnāmapi vyavastheti saṅgatiḥ | anārabhya - aprastutya | dvivacanena bhāvyamityatrāha - samāhāra iti | tarhi kathamarbhakaukaso jyāyastvādyuktirityatrāha - śāṇḍilya iti || nanu evaṃ tarhi sarvāsu ānantyānugamavirodhaḥ | naivam, svābhāvikaupādhikabhedenāvirodhāt | aupādhikālpatvavataḥ tatraiva sthāne aupādhikamahattvaṃ viruddham | svato'nantamapi anugrahāt - alpasthānasthamiti dhīraviruddhā | māhātmyapratipādanaparāḥ - na tu tadvidyāsvasādhāraṇo - pāsyākāraparāḥ ityarthaḥ || 23 || iti saṃbhṛtyadhikaraṇam - 8 <9. puruṣavidyādhikaraṇam ||> puruṣavidyāyāmapi cetareṣāmanāmnānāt || 3-3-24 || taittirīyake puruṣavidyā''mnāyate ... ... vidyābheda iti ekatrāmnātānāṃ guṇānāmitaratrānupasaṃhāraḥ || 24 || puruṣavidyāyāmapi cetareṣāmanāmnānāt | dyuvyāptisannidhyuktasaṃbhṛtyāderiva brahmavidyāsannidhisthapuruṣavidyāyāstaccheṣatvamiti saṅgatiḥ | phalasaṃyogāśravaṇāt iti puruṣavidyāmātrasya brahmavidyātvābhāvāt uttaratroktaṃ phalamatadarham | pūrvatrāhīnanayādanvetīti bhāvaḥ | chāndogye śrutasyaiva iti | virodhiphaloktireva bhedikā | na tu phalānuktiriti bhāvaḥ || rāddhānte - aphalaṃ tadaṅgam iti | aphalatvaṃ pūrvamuktam | na cāsyā aphalatve phalaśrutipaunaruktyam | pūrvamadhikāriviśeṣaṇatayoktvā, paścāt aṅgamabhidhāya phalasya nigamitatvāt || 24 || iti puruṣavidyādhikaraṇam - 9 <10. vedhādyadhikaraṇam ||> vedhādyarthabhedāt || 3-3-25 || ātharvaṇikā upaniṣadāraṃbhe śukraṃ pravidhya ... ... iha pāṭho divākīrtyatvāraṇyenuvākyatvakṛtaḥ || 25 || vedhādyarthabhedāt | sannidhisthapuruṣavidyāyā iva tādṛśāṃ śaṃ no mitrādi mantrāṇāṃ brahmavidyāṅgatvamiti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ | pravargyādīni iti | ādi śabdāt mahāvratādi || rāddhānte - ādi śabdāt ṛtavadanādi | anaṅgatve sphuṭe'pi kathaṃ vedhādeḥ sautratvamityatrāha - etaduktam iti | mantrasāmarthyāt - mantrāvagatavastusāmarthyāt | tarhi kathamupaniṣatsu pāṭhaḥ ityatrāha - śukram iti || 25 || iti vedhādyadhikaraṇam - 10 <11. hānyadhikaraṇam ||> hānau tūpāyanaśabdaśeṣatvāt kuśācchanda sastutyupagānavat taduktam || 3-3-26 || chandogā āmananti - aśva iva romāṇi ... .... kauṣītakināmubhayāmnānamaviśeṣapunaḥśravaṇatvena pratipattṛbhedādaviruddham || hānau tūpāyanaśabdaśeṣatvāt kuśācchandasstutyupagānavat taduktam | sannidhimatāmapyatadaṅgatvamuktam | tathā sannihitatvāt hānādicintā vartate iti saṅgatiḥ| upāyanam - anyatra prevaśaḥ | utayanti iti hi śrutiḥ || rāddhānte - upāyanaśabdaṃpriti anyasya śeṣatvavyudāsāyāha - upāyanaśabdasya iti | upāyana śabdaḥ śeṣa ityarthaḥ | viparītaṃ kiṃ na syādityatrāha - upāyanavākyasya iti | tadupapādayati - viduṣā iti | viduṣaḥ prādhānyenāpekṣitaṃ hi prahāṇam | upāyanaṃ tadupayogitvāt taccheṣamityarthaḥ | hānyupāyanavacasoḥ pradhānaśeṣabhāve dṛṣṭāntatvavyudāsāyāha - pradeśāntara iti | kuśāḥ - pātraviśeṣāḥ | tathā iti | devaśabdasya alpāctaratvena pūrvatvasaṃbhavāt kramo vākyāntarāpekṣa iti bhāvaḥ | samayā viṣite samayā udite | upākaroti - pristauti | śeṣatvānupagame'niṣṭamāha evam iti | na yujyate - pākṣikabādhagarbhatvāditi bhāvaḥ|| taduktam iti sūtrakhaṇḍaḥ | taṃ pūrayati - pūrva iti | ekavākyatvāt iti | anyonyaśeṣaśeṣibhāvena anvayādekavākyatvam | kevalasya iti | abhāvāt - aprāmāṇikatvāt | kauṣītakinām iti | anyataroktāvapyanyatarasyārthasiddhatvāt sarvatrobhayamuktamiti ubhayoktiḥ aviśeṣapunaḥ śrutiḥ iti adhyetṛbhedādavirodha ityarthaḥ || 26 || iti hānyadhikaraṇam - 11 <12. sāṃparāyādhikaraṇam ||> sāṃparāye tartavyābhāvāt tathā hyanye || 3-3-27 || sṛkṛtaduṣkutayorhānamupāyanaṃ ca ... ... tasya tāvadeva ciraṃ yāvanna vimokṣye'tha saṃpatsye iti || 7 || sāṃparāye tartavyābhāvāt tathā hyanye | saṅgatirgatā | tāṇḍinaḥ - chandogāḥ | rāddhānte - tartavya iti | taratiḥ prāptivācī || 27 || chandata ubhayāvirodhāt || 3-3-28 || evamarthasvābhāvyāt sukṛtaduṣkṛta ... ... prathamaśrutāvayavāt prāganugamayitavya ityarthaḥ || 28 || chandata ubhayāvirodhāt | padanām - mahāvākyāpekṣayā padasthānīyānāṃ vākyāvayavānām | kutra keṣāmanvaya ityatrāha kauṣītakī iti | agnihotraṃ juhoti 1 / yavāgūṃ pacati itivat || 28 || atra pūrvapakṣī pratyavatiṣṭhate - gaterarthavattvamubhayathā'nyathā hi virodhaḥ || 3-3-29|| sukṛtaduṣkṛtayorekadeśasya ... .... ata utkrāntisamaye viduṣo niśśeṣakarmakṣayo nopapannaḥ || 29 || gaterarthavattvamubhayathā'nyathā hi virodhaḥ | aṇutve'pi satyasaṅkalpānāvirbhāvāt dehavirahācca gatyaśaktiḥ || 29 || atrottaram - upapannastallakṣaṇārthopalabdherlokavat || 3-3-30 || upapanna evokrāntikāle sarvakarmakṣayaḥ .... ... tadeva taṭākādikamaśithilaṃ kurvantastatra pānīyapānādi kurvanti, tadvat || 30 || upapannastallakṣaṇārthopalabdherlokavat dehatvākāreṇa sajātīyārthopalabdhiḥ | na tu karmakṛtaitaddeha evetyabhiprāyeṇa tallakṣaṇa ityuktam, na tu tadupalabdheḥ iti | vidyāmāhātmyaṃ vivṛṇoti - vidyā hi iti | svaphalāptihetudehasthitikaratvaṃ puṇyapāpayoriva yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | yathā iti | anyahetūtpannasya hetvabhāve'pi kāryāntarārthasthitau dṛṣṭāntaḥ || 30 || atha syāt - jñānināṃ sākṣātkṛtaparatattvānāṃ .. ..... yāvadadhikāramavasthitirādhikārikāṇām || 3-3-31 || nāsmābhiḥ sarveṣāṃ jñānināṃ dehapātasamaye .. ... atastaṣāṃ na dehapātādanantaramarcirādigatiprāptiḥ|| 31 || anantarasūtramavatārayati - atha syāt iti | yāvadadhikāramavasthitirādhikārikāṇām | adhikāraḥ - padam | dehapātānantaraprāptārcirādigatīnāmeva tatsamakālapuṇyapāpakṣaya iti parihāraḥ || 31 || iti sāparāyādhikaraṇam - 12 || <13. aniyamādhikaraṇam ||> aniyamaḥ sarveṣāmavirodhaḥ śabdānumānābhyām || 3-3-32|| upakosalādiṣu yeṣūpāsaneṣu .. ... evaṃ sarvavidyāsādhāraṇī iyaṃ gatiḥ prāptaivopakosalavidyādāvanūdyate || 32 || aniyamaḥ sarveṣāmavirodhaḥ śabdānumānābhyām | gatiḥ prastutā | atha tanniyamāniyamacinteti saṅgatiḥ | siddhāntabījamāśaṅkyāha - ye ceme iti | upāsate iti | iti vākyasyetyarthaḥ | pramāṇābhāvāt - satyatapa śabdayoḥ na brahmavācitve mānamiti bhāvaḥ || rāddhānte - upāttavākye sarvabrahmavidukiṃta darśayati - itthaṃ viduḥ iti | tapaḥ śabdasya iti | paramaṃ yo mahat tapaḥ ityādyabhipretam | anyatra iti | tayoḥ brahmaparatve'pi iha tathātvaṃ na syāditi na vācyam, brahma gamayati ityuktatvāt phalasya yathopāsanatvācca | smṛtirapi iti | brahmavidaḥ iti hyucyate ityarthaḥ || 32 || iti aniyamādhikaraṇam - 13 <14. akṣaradhyadhikaraṇam ||> akṣarādhiyāṃ tvavarodhaḥ sāmānyatadbhāvābhyāmaupasadavat taduktam || 3-3-33 || bṛhadāraṇyake śrūyate - etadvai tadakṣaraṃ .. ... guṇamukhya vyatikrame tadarthatvānmukhyena vedasaṃyogaḥ iti || 33 || akṣaradhiyāṃ tvavarodhaḥ sāmānyatadbhāvābhyāmaupasadavat taduktam | arcirādeḥ sarvavidyāsādhāraṇyamuktam | tathā asthūlatvāderapi tannirūpyate iti saṅgatiḥ | prapañcatyanīkatārūpaḥ iti | prapañcapratyanīkaṃ brahma | prapañcapratyanīkatvaṃ nāma prapañcasvabhāvaviruddha svabhāvatvam asthūlatvādi | asthūlam ityādipadāni hi viṣayavākyasthāni | asthūlam - sthūlādanyam | anena bhinnāśrayatvalakṣaṇavirodhaḥ phalita iti bhāvaḥ| nirdoṣatvaviśeṣarūpa - maśanāyādyatītatvādi tattadvidyāvyavasthitam | sāmānyena sarvaheyapratyanīkatvaṃ sarvavidyāṅgamityabhiprāyavān prapañcapratyanīka śabdaḥ | niravadyamityādiśruteḥ satyatvamapīhāntarbhūtam | asthūlatvādi tu niṣedharūpamiti bhidā | ataḥ pṛthak cintanam | pramāṇābhāvāt - hetvabhāvāt | vastusāmarthyaṃ heturityatrāha - svarūpa iti || rāddhānte - sāmānyatadbhāvau samuccitya hatuḥ | pratītau bhāvāt - viṣayatvena bhāvāt | dharmāntaraniṣedhasya dharmipratītipūrvakatvāt na pratiṣedharūpāṇāṃ tatpratītyanubandhiguṇatvamityatrāha - etaduktam iti | asādhārāṇākāreṇa - asādhāraṇasvarūpeṇa | tṛtīyānirdiśa aupacārikaḥ | asādhāraṇasvarūpagrahaṇamityarthaḥ| anyathottaragrantho na ghaṭate | ākāraḥ - svarūpam| pratyagātmano'pi heyavirahāt nāsādhāraṇyamityatrāha - pratyagātmanastu iti | viparītam asādhāraṇaṃ, rūpam iti tattatsājātyaśaṅkā vyudāsakadharmatvamātraṃ vivakṣitam; na tu sajātīyavijātīyeṣvavidyamānatvamātram | avikāratve'bhihite'pi; jaḍatvaśaṅkā nāpaiti| ajaḍatvoktāvapi sthūlatvāṇutvādiśaṅkāṃ nāpaiti | vyāpakajaḍatvādinivṛttyā sthūlatvādiśaṅkā neti cet, vyāpakajaḍatvādinivṛttyā vyāpyavasyutvanivṛttiḥ kiṃ na śaṅkyeta? śāstraikagamyasya vastuno vyāptyaviṣayatvāditi cet, sthūlatvādiśaṅkāyāmapi tulyam | tataśca sthūlasya kasyacidvastuviśeṣasyājaḍatvādi saṃbhavatīti sthūlatvāditattadvastusājātyaśaṅkānāpaiti | ataḥ sthūlatvādisarvaheyapratyanīkatayaiva tattajjātīyatvaśaṅkā śāmyatīti asthūlatvādikaṃ tattatsājātyaśaṅkānivārakatvādasādhāraṇaṃ rūpam || viśeṣita śabda upetaparaḥ | dṛṣṭāntopajīvyāṃśamāha - guṇānām iti | jāmadagnyam - jamadagninā anuṣṭhitam | puroḍāśī - puroḍāśadravyakam | upāṃśutvena - upāṃśu yajuṣā iti vacanāt yājurvaidikopasadaṅgatvāt upāṃśutā | anyathā hi uccaiḥ sāmnā iti uccairgānaṃ syāt || 33 || nanvevaṃ sarvāsu brahmavidyāsu .... ... iyadāmananāt || 3-3-34 || āmananam - ābhimukhyena mananam ... ... pradhānānuvartino'pi cintanīyatvena pratividyaṃ vyavasthitāḥ || 34 || anantarasūtrasya śaṅkāmāha - nanvevam iti | iyadāmananāt | akṣarārthamāha - āmananam iti | tātparyamāha - yena iti || 34 || iti akṣaradhyadhikaraṇam - 14 || <15. antaratvādhikaraṇam ||> antarā bhūtagrāmavat svātmano'nyathā bhedānupapattiriti cennopadeśavat || 3-3-35 || bṛhadāraṇyake uṣastapraśna evamāmnāyate ... ... brahmaṇaḥ kṛtsnaprāṇiprāṇanahetutvāśanāyādyatītatvapratipādanena rūpaikyādvidyaikyam || antarā bhūtagrāmavat svātmano'nyathā bhedānupapattiriti cennopadeśavat | heyapratyanīkatvaṃ parasyāsādhāraṇaṃ cet aśanāyādyatītaṃ brahma syāt prāṇitṛtvādyupeto jīvaḥ syāditi śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ | uṣastapraśna śabdena prakaraṇaṃ lakṣyate | na rūpabhedaḥ, praśnaikarūpyādityatrāha - prativacana iti | sarvāntaratvaṃ kathamityatrāha - bhūtagrāmavataśca iti | asvārasyamāśaṅkayāha - tathāpi iti | tadidam ityādi | antarā ityādinya sūtravyākhyānam || atrottaram ityādi | nirupādhika śabdena jīvavyāvṛttiḥ | dṛṣṭerdraṣṭāram iti odanapākaṃ pacati itivat | uttare api praśnaprativacane ityarthaḥ | evaṃ dharmibhedādvidyāyabhedaḥ pratyuktaḥ || 35 || atha syāt - yadyapyubhe praśnaprativacane ... .... vyatihāro viśiṃnti hītaravat || 3-3-36 || nātra vidyābhedaḥ, praśnaprativacanābhyām ... ... guṇātguṇāntaraviśiṣṭatayopāsyaṃ pratipādyate, tadvat || 36 || anantarasya śaṅkāmāha - atha syāt iti | dharmebhedāt rūpabheda uktaḥ | praṣṭṛbhedāt vidyābhedasaṃbhavahetuḥ | praṣṭraikye tadaikyaṃ saṃbhavet | vidyāntaranairapekṣyāditi | vyatihārovirśiṣanti hītaravat | vyatihāraṃ vivṛṇoti - uṣastasya iti | tatphalamāha - evam iti | tadeva vadan virśiṣanti iti padaṃ vyācaṣṭe - enaṃ sarva iti | guṇaikyāt rūpabhedaḥ pratyuktaḥ | praṣṭṛbhedo vaiśvānaravidyādau vyabhicārīti bhāvaḥ | nanu iti | sarvaprāṇayitṛtvāśanāyādyatītatvayoranyatareṇālaṃ vyāvṛttadhiyaḥ ityarthaḥ | taducyate iti | vyāvṛttabuddhyatiśayajananārthamiti parihāraḥ || 36 || tatrāpi praśnaprativacanabhede .... .... saiva hi satyādayaḥ || 3-3- 37 || saiva hi sacchabdābhihitā paramakāraṇa ... .... satyādayaḥ sarveṣu paryāyeṣūpapādyopasaṃhiyante || dṛṣṭānta vidyaikyasthāpanāya uttarasūtramavatārayati - tatrāpi iti | saiva hi satyādayaḥ | paramakāraṇatvam upāsyaguṇaḥ | tadupayogisatyatvātmatvādīnāṃ pratiparyāyamāvṛtterityarthaḥ || kecitu - vyatihāro virśiṣanti ... ... itaretarāśrayatvamityevamādibhiḥ yathoktaprakārameva sūtradvayam || 37 || matāntaramanūdya vyudasyati - kecit tu iti | so'pi sūtre vaktavya ityatrāha - tat tu iti | sarvatra prasiddhopadeśāt ātmeti iti sūtradvayamacijjīvatādātmyaparam | iha jīvaparayoranyonyabhāvāropaṇamityatrāha - na ca iti | tathyaṃ na iti | tākrṣyadhyānavadasadāropo na mokṣāyeti bhāvaḥ | uttareṇa ca ityādi | tataḥ kimityatrāha - na ca iti | dvayoḥ - vākyayormadhye | jahāti ca - śarīramityarthaḥ | dvayoḥ - uttaravākyoktayorupāsanayoḥ | guṇaphalam - aṅgaphalam | pramāṇābhāvāt - hetvabhāvāt | uttarayoḥ - pāpahatidehahānayoḥ | saṃyogabhedābhāvāt - pradhānaphalaikyādityarthaḥ | ādi śabdāt svamatopapattayaḥ uktāḥ || 37 || iti antaratvādhikaraṇam - 15 <16. kāmādyadhikaraṇam ||> kāmādītaratra tatra cāyatanādibhyaḥ || 3-3-38 || chāndogye śrūyate - atha yadidam .... ... ākāśasyābhidhāyakatvamavagamyate | ato vidyaikyam || 38 || kāmādītaratra tatra cāyatanādibhyaḥ| prāṇayitṛtvāśanāyādyatītatvayordharmibhedābhāvāt vidyaikyamuktam | atra tu guṇāṣṭakasya vaśitvādeśca dharmibheda iti śaṅkāyā saṅgatiḥ | atra vyomātītavyudāsaḥ phalitatvāt | guṇāṣṭakam, vaśitvādi ca iti dharmabhedaḥ | ākāśaḥ, tatra śayānaśceti dharmibheda uktaḥ || rāddhānte - dharmamātrasyopāsyatvaśaṅkāṃ vyudasyan itaratra iti padaṃ ca vyācaṣṭe - vājasaneyake iti | ākāśa ityādi | svataḥ prāptamākāśaśabdasya - bhūtākāśaparatvaṃ chāndogye paramātmadharmaśravaṇāpoditam | vājasaneyake tu nāpavādaḥ ākāśe śayānasya paramātmadharmaśravaṇāt sa eva paramātmetyarthaḥ|| atha syāt - yaduktaṃ vājasaneyake ... ... ādarādalopaḥ || 3-3-39 || brahmaguṇatvena pramāṇāntarāprāptānāṃ ... .... brahmaṇaḥ pratipādyatasmin satyakāmatvādayo vidhīyante || 39 || anantarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - atha iti | chāndogyadaharavidyā saguṇaviṣayā | iyaṃ tu nirguṇaviṣayā vidyā | ato naikyamityarthaḥ || ādarādalopaḥ | aprāptānām iti niṣedhārthānuvādaśaṅkā nirastā | apūrvatvaṃ tātparyaliṅgaṃ coktam | vihitasya niṣedhāyoga upapattiḥ | tadya ihātmānam ityādinā phalamuktam | tatraivābhyasaḥ siddhiḥ | na ca ityādi | guṇoktirna vipralipsāmūlā , nairguṇyoktāvapi prasaṅgāt | na cārvācīnaphalopāsanārthā, mokṣaprakaraṇasthatvāt satyaśruteśceti bhāvaḥ | neha nānāṣa'sti ityāderarthamāha - neha iti | gobalīvardanayāt brahmaprakāratayā bhedo vihita iti abrahmātmakabhedaviṣayo niṣedhaḥ | ekadhā iti tu brahmātmakatayā aikarūpyamuktam | sa eṣa na iti prapañcavairūpyam, prakaraṇānuguṇyāt | nāsya iti | asya - prapañcasya || 39 || nanvevamapi tadya ihātmānam .... .... upasthite'tastadvacanāt || 3-3-40 || upasthitiḥ - upasthānam brahmopasaṃpanne .. ..... mumukṣoḥ satyakāmatvādayo guṇā upasaṃhāryāḥ || 40 || anantarasūtramavatārayaṃśvodayati - nanu iti | upasthite'tastadvacanāt | ata eva iti . anantaroktyā hetutvamārthamiti bhāvaḥ | kathaṃ brahmānubhavato'nyāpekṣā ityatrāha - tadetat iti || 40 || iti kāmādyadhikaraṇam - 16 <17. tannirdhāraṇāniyamādhikaraṇam ||> tannirdhāraṇāniyamastaddṛṣṭeḥ pṛthagdhyapratibandhaḥ phalam || 3-3-41 || omityetadakṣaramudīthamupāsīta ... ... godohanādivat karmasūdgīthādyupāsanānāmaniyamenopasaṃhāraḥ || 41 || tannirdhāraṇāniyamastaddṛṣṭeḥ pṛthagdhyapratibandhaḥ phalam | satyakāmatvādīnāmupasaṃhāryatvamaktam | evamudgīthādidhiyāṃ niyamenopasaṃhāra iti śaṅkāyā saṅgatiḥ | śākhāntaroktasya śākhāntarādhītakratvaṅgadvārā karmaśeṣatvāya prokṣaṇādau satyapi parṇatā dṛṣṭāntitā | kathamaphaladatve'nuṣṭhānaṃ, phaladatve kathamaṅgatvamityatrāha - karmāṅgatvena iti | tacchatamityatrāha - yadeva iti | phalaśrutirarthavāda ityarthaḥ| na ca godohanavākya iva phalaṃ sannikṛṣṭam, vākyāntarasthatvāditi cābhipretam || rāddhānte - ārthavādikaphalasya svīkāryatvāya rātrisatranaya uktaḥ | pratiṣṭhā hyārthavādikī svīkriyate || 41 || iti tannirdhāraṇāniyamādhikaraṇam - 17 <18. pradānādhikaraṇam |> pradānavadeva taduktam || 3-3-42 || daharavidyāyāṃ tadya ihātmānam ... .... taduktaṃ nānā vā devatā pṛthaktvāt iti || 42 || pradānavadeva taduktam | pūrvaṃ prāsaṅgikam | atastatpūrvaṃ cintitadaharavidyāviṣayacintāntaram iti saṅgatiḥ | kevalaguṇicintanam - ānandatvādiviśiṣṭasvarūpacintanam | guṇacintanama - guṇāṣṭakacintanam | sakṛdeva - tantreṇa || rāddhānte - guṇaviśiṣṭākāraḥ - guṇasaṃbandhirūpam, guṇaguṇirūpasamudāyaḥ | sa ca svarūpamātrāt bhinnaḥ | apahata iti | apahatapāpmādiśabdānāṃ dharmiparyaṃntatvāt satyān kāmān ityatrāpi tadupāstirvihitetyarthaḥ || iti pradānādhikaraṇam - 18 <19. liṅgabhūyastvādhikaraṇam ||> liṅgabhūyastvāt taddhi balīyastadapi || 3-3-43 || taittirīyā daharavidyānantaramadhīyate ... .. iti nirṇiyamānatvācca prathamārthe dvitīyeti niściyate || 43 || liṅgabhūyastvāt taddhi balīyastadapi | pūrvaprakṛta iti saṅgatirjñāpitā | paravidyā iti dṛṣṭidhīvyudāsaḥ | ātmā duhāyām ātmānārāyaṇaḥ iti cātmaśabdaikyamārtham || rāddhānte - cihna iti | śrutyanantaraliṅgavyudāsaḥ | padmakośa iti | aidātmyamidaṃ sarvam tattvamasi itivat sāmānyoktasya viśeṣaniṣṭhatayā uktiriti bhāvaḥ | na ca iti | yenā''vṛtaṃ khaṃ ca divam itivat dvitīyāntānuguṇaṃ prathamāntavaco nīyatāmityatrāha - antarbahiśca iti | vidyāt ityādividhipadarahitavākyapratipannārthasvabhāvavirodhādityarthaḥ | pūrvaśeṣatve vidhyadhyāhāraḥ, prathamāntāsvārasyamarthavirodhaḥ; iha tu dvitīyāntāsvārasyamiti | nārāyaṇa param iti na pañcamīlopaḥ | vibhaktyarthalakṣaṇānupapatteḥ | samāse'pi niṣādasthapatinayaprāpteḥ mahopaniṣadaikārthyāt pūrvāparaśrutthantaravirodhāt supāṃ suluk vidhānācceti bhāvaḥ | ātma śabdastu ātmā vā idam ātmā vā are ityādiṣvapi nārāyaṇapratyabhijñāparaḥ || 43 || iti liṅgabhūyastvādhikaraṇam - 19 <20. pūrvavikalpādhikaraṇam ||> pūrvavikalpaḥ prakaraṇāt syāt kriyā mānasavat || 3-3-44 || vājasaneyake'gnirahasye manaścitādayaḥ ... .... vidyārūpasyāpi kriyāmayakratvaṅgatayā kriyārūpatvam tathehāpi || 44 || pūrvavikalpaḥ prakaraṇāt syāt kriyā mānasavat | nārāyaṇānuvāke iva prakaraṇasya vākyādinā bādhābhāvāt manaścitādayaḥ kriyāmayakratvanupraveśinaḥ iti saṅkayā saṅgatiḥ | sautranirdeśānurodhena kriyārūpāḥ vidyārūpāḥ iti nirdiṣṭam | tadvivaraṇam - kriyāmayakratvanupraveśena vidyāmayakratvanupraveśena iti ca | manaścitādīnāṃ svarūpasya vidyārūpatve na vipratipattiḥ | aṅgidvārā vidyārupatve tu vipratipattiḥ | ataḥ sūtre kriyā śabdo lākṣaṇikaḥ | kriyāmayakratvaṅgatayā tatsaṃbandhītyarthaḥ || homasthānatvāt agnitvam | nāgnimātrasya katvapekṣeti śaṅkāvyudāsāya citya śabdaḥ | saṃpāditānām - anusaṃhitānām | sannidhānam - buddhisthatvam| iṣṭakacitena nairapekṣyamityatrāha - vikalpyamānāḥ iti | avivākye - vividhākyarahite | yadvā, vivākye - vigatavākye | svarūpeṇāsato'pi grahasya mānasatvaṃ manojanyopayogitvāt || 44 || atideśācca || 3-3-45 || itaśceṣṭakacitenāgninā ... .. (kriyāmayakratvanupraveśena) kriyārūpā eveti || 45 || atideśācca | vīryaṃ - kāryakaratvasāmarthyam | upakāraṃ darśayati - tataśca iti || 45 || evaṃ prāpte pracakṣmahe - vidyaiva tu nirdhāraṇāddarśanācca || 3-3-46 || tuśabdaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati | .... ... kraturapi vidyāmayo'tra pratīyate || 46 || rāddhānte - vidyaiva tu nirdhāraṇādṛrśanācca | darśanāt ityaṃśaṃ vyācṣṭe - dṛśyate ca iti | eṣu - manaścitādiṣu | | yat kiṃ ca yajñe karma iti pradhānabhūtakarmoktam | yajñīyam iti aṅgabhūtam || 46 || nanu - atra vidhipadāśravaṇāt ... ... śrutyādibalīyastvācca na bādhaḥ || 3-3-47 || śrutiliṅgavākyānāṃ prakaraṇāt ... ... kratvanupraveśasaṃbhavamalabhamānaṃ vidyāmayakratvanupraveśe liṅgaṃ bhavati || 47 || anantarasya śaṅkāmāha - nanu iti | vidhiḥ kalpyetetyatrāha - phalasaṃbandha iti | śrutyādibalīyastvācca na bādhaḥ | vidyayā iti | prayojanatayā hetutvam | vākyapratipannamarthamāha - evaṃvit iti | liṅgamupapādayati - sarva iti || 47 || yaccedamuktaṃ vidhipratyayāśravaṇāt ... ... anubandhādibhyaḥ prajñāntarapṛthaktvavat dṛṣṭaśca taduktam || 3-3-48 || iṣṭakacitānvayinaḥ kriyāmayāt ... ... manaścitādīnāmapi svakratudvāreṇa phalamityavagamyate || 48 || anantarāvatārāya prāguktaśaṅkāyāmaparihṛtāṃśamāha - yaccedam iti | anubandhādibhyaḥ prajñāntarapṛthaktvavat dṛṣṭaśca taduktam | dṛṣṭaśca iti | phalasaṃbandhe'pi śrutahānaprasaṅgāya hi vidhiklṛptiḥ | sā'pi prāptā sānubandhaśrutyādibhiḥ vidyāmayakratvavagamādityarthaḥ | phalaṃ ca śrutamityāha - phalaṃ ca iti || 48 || yatpunaratideśena tulyakāryatva ... .... na sāmānyādapyupalabdhermṛtyuvanna hi lokāpattiḥ || 3-3-49 || nāvaśyamatideśādavāntara vyāpārasyāpi ... .... vidyāmayakratudvāreṇa phalamityatideśādavagabhyate || 49 || na sāmānyādapyupalabdhermṛtyuvanna hi lokāpattiḥ | avāntaravyāpārasya - kriyāmayakratvanvayasya | deśarūpa iti | deśaḥ - āśrayaḥ | aṅgāśrayo'ṅgī || 49 || pareṇa ca śabdāsya tādvidhyaṃ bhūyastvāt tvanubandhaḥ|| 3-3-50 || pareṇa ca brāhmaṇena asyāpi ... .... agnyaṅgānāṃ bhūyastvāt tatsannidhāvihānubandhaḥ kṛtaḥ || 50 || pareṇa ca śabdasya tādvidhyaṃ bhūyastvāt tvanubandhaḥ| na paraṃ śrutyādibhiḥ, prakaraṇena ca vidyāmayakratvaṅgatā ucyate | pṛṇānāṃ pūrayantīm bhuvam | pṝ pālanapūraṇayoḥ | etat iti liṅgavyatyayaḥ | etamagna yo vedaḥ ityarthaḥ || 50 || iti pūrvarvikalpādhikaraṇam - 20 <21 . śarīre bhāvādhikaraṇam ||> eka ātmanaḥ śarīre bhāvāt || 3-3-51 || sarvāsu paravidyāsūpāsyopāsana ... ... naivam taṃ yathā yathopāsate ityupāsyaviṣayatvāt tasya || 51 || eka ātmanaḥ śarīre bhāvāt | pūrvaṃ prāsaṅgikam | tatpūrvasmin bhagavata eva sarvavidyopāsyatvamuktam | tathā pratyagātmanaśceti imamupāsyopāsakopāsanaparaṃ dīpe vyākhyātam | taddīpopajīvyamupāsyakoṭiniveśaṃ vakṣyan tadupayogādāha - vakṣyati ca iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - tāvatā iti || evaṃ prāpte pracakṣmahe vyatirekastadbhāvabhāvitvānna tūpalabdhivat || 3-3-52|| na tvetadasti - yat jñātṛtvādyākāra ... ... tāvanmātrameva tatrāpekṣitamiti na kiñcidapahīnam || 52 || rāddhānte - vyatirekastadbhāvabhāvitvānna tūpalabdhivat | vyatirekadharmamātrasya cintyatvavyudāsāyāha - asya mokṣa iti | phalitamāha ataḥ iti taṃ yathā iti tacchabdo viśiṣṭaviṣayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ | ata eva - prāpyākārasyānusandheyatvādeva hi prāpyacintanoktirityarthaḥ| pūrvapakṣoktadṛṣṭāntasya vaiṣamyamāha - karmasu iti | vaidhatvāvaiṃdhatve vaiṣamyamityarthaḥ || 52 || iti śarīre bhāvādhikaraṇam - 21 <22. aṅgāvabaddhādhikaraṇam ||> aṅgāvabaddhāstu na śākhāsu hi prativedam || 3-3-53 || omityetadakṣaramudgīthamupāsīta .... .... naikasya sannidhiviśeṣo'stīti na vyavasthā || 53 || aṅgāvabaddhāstu na śākhāsu hi prativedam | yatra yatra brahmopāsyaṃ, tatra tatra śuddhātmana upāsyatvamuktam | eva yatra yatra udgīthānupraveśaḥ tatra tatra tadupāstirasti na veti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ | sarva iti | sarvaśākhāpratyanayenodgīthaikyādākṣepaḥ | bhedakadharmaiḥ bhinnatvāt samādhiḥ| tasminneva iti | gāmānaya ityādau viśeṣaparyavasānadṛṣṭeriti bhāvaḥ|| rāddhānte - sannihitā - dhīsthā dhīsthatvaṃ hi sannidhiḥ | sa ca śabdaśaktyā darśitaḥ | gāmānaya ityādiṣu ayogyatvaṃ vyavasthāpakam | na tvasannidhirati bhāvaḥ| arthato'pi sannidhimāha - sarvaśākhā iti | aṅgisannidheraṅgasannidhirityarthaḥ || 53 || mantrādivadvā'virodhaḥ || 3-3-54 || vāśabdaścārthe | ādiśabdena ... .... sarvāsu śākhāsuviniyogo na virūdhyate | tadvadihāpyavirodhaḥ || 54 || mantrādivadvā'virodhaḥ | sarvaśākhāsūdgīthānuvṛtte (tau) dṛṣṭāntaḥ mantrādiḥ| tataśca sarvaśākhināmupāsane'dhikāraḥ || 54 || iti aṅgāvabaddhādhikaraṇam - 22 <23. bhūmajyāyastvādhikaraṇam ||> bhūmnaḥ kratuvajjayāyastvaṃ tathā hi darśayati || 3-3-55 || prācīnaśāla aupamanyavaḥ ityārabhya ... ..... bhūmavidyāstutyanupapatteḥ ataḥ samastopāsanameva nyāyyam || 55 || bhūmnaḥ kratuvajjyāyastvaṃ tathā hi darśayati | pūrvaprakṛtasāmāvayavabhūtodgīthasya samastasya vyastasya copasyatvaṃ śrutam | evaṃ kiṃ vaiśvānaravidyāyāṃ samastasya vyastasya vobhayasya vopāsyatvamiti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ| attyannam - annamatti | vaiśvānaropāstirupakrāntā, tat kathaṃ mūrdhamātro pāstirityatrāha - vaiśvānaratvaṃ cāha - iti | vaiśvānare uktasya - vaiśvānaraviṣayatayoktasya | vākyabhedaḥ - mahāvākyabhedaḥ | yathai bhūma iti | prāsaṅgikārthabahutvaṃ pradhānapratipādyaikyāvirodhītyarthaḥ| vyastopāsanaṃ prāsaṅgikamiti na virodhaḥ || rāddhānte - anuvādamātram - samudāyopāsanatatphale vivakṣite | tadekadeśakathanam anuvāda ityarthaḥ | sa ca phralaviśeṣāṇāṃ samastopāsanaphalāntargatatvajñāpanārthaḥ | anyathā vākyabhedāt pratyavāyakathanācca | ata idam ityādi | anarthāśravaṇaṃ vaiṣamyamuktam | ādhikyapratiyogitvenopayogitvaṃ ca vaiṣamyamāha - nāmādi iti | atiśayitaphalatvaṃ śrūyate, tataḥ kiṃ mahāvākyaikyasyetyatrāha - tata eva iti| anyathā iti | avivakṣitve || 55 || iti bhūmajyāyastvādhikaraṇam - 23 <24. śabdādibhedādhikaraṇam ||> nānā śabdādibhedāt || 3-3-56 || iha brahmavidyāḥ sarvāḥ brahmaprāptirūpa .... ... bedāntavākyāni avidheyajñānaparāṇītri kuddaṣṭinirasanāya | ato vidyābheda iti sthitam || 56 || nānā śabdādibhedāt | pūrvaṃ vidyāviśeṣacintā pravṛntā; atha sarvavidyāviṣayavacinteti saṅgatiḥ | ādi śabdena paramaṃ guhyamabhipretam | uttarādhikaraṇe ca punarukiṃta pariharati - atreva iti | aviśeṣapunaḥ śrutiprakaraṇāntarayoḥ sāmānyena vidyābhedakatve siddhe hi, vidyāviśeṣāṇāṃ bhedābhedacintāprāptirityarthaḥ | rūpaphalaikye pūrvapakṣabījam || rāddhānte - vidheyam - sāṅgaṃ pradhānaṃ karma | anubandhāḥ - avayavāḥ | tadbhedahetavaḥ śabdādayaḥ | taiḥ anubandhabhedāt vidheyabhedaḥ | dhātvarthabhedāt rūpabhedavyudāsāyāha - pratyayāvṛtti iti | bhindanti - arthena hi dhiyāṃ viśeṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ | brahma iti prakaraṇabheda uktaḥ | ihokteḥ phalamāha - asmin iti || 56 || iti śabdādibhedādhikaraṇam - 24 <25. vikalpādhikaraṇam ||> vikalpo'viśiṣṭāphalatvāt | 3-3-57 || brahmaprāptiphalānāṃ sadvidyādaharavidyādīnāṃ .... ... brahmaprāptiphalā ityaviśiṣṭaphalatvāt sarvāsāṃ vikalpa eva || 57 || vikalpo'viśiṣṭaphalatvāt | bhede siddhe hi vikalpasamuciyaccintā iti saṅgatiḥ || rāddhānte - sāmya śrutyupādānāt niravadhikānandabrahmasāmyāpannaḥ syāt | anyanairapekṣyārthaṃ svasya iti | anavadhikātiśayānandam iti bahuvrīhiḥ | ānanda - jananamityarthaḥ | kāścit aniṣṭanivṛttyarthāḥ, kāścit brahmāvāptyarthā iti samuccaya ityatrāha - sarvāśca | iti || 57 || brahmaprāptivyatiriktaphalāstu .... .... kāmyāstu yathākāmaṃ samuccīyeran na vā pūrvahetvabhāvāt || 3-3-48 || aparimitaphalatvābhāvādityarthaḥ || 58 || uttarasūtraṃ pūrveṇa ghaṭayan tadarthamāha - brahmaprāptivyatirikta iti | kāmyasamuccayavikalpayoḥ icchā niyāmiketi yathākāma śabdārtha iti bhāvaḥ || kāmyāstu yathākāmaṃ samuccīyeran na vā pūrvahetvabhāvāt | hetupadaṃ vyācaṣṭe apari iti || 58 || iti vikalpādhikaraṇam - 25 <26. yathāśrayabhāvādhikaraṇam ||> aṅgeṣu yathāśrayabhāvaḥ || 3-3-59 || udgīthādikratvaṅgeṣvāśritāḥ ... .... .... upāsanāstanmukhena kratvaṅgabhūtā iti niyamenopādeyā eva || 59 || aṅgeṣu yathāśrayabhāvaḥ yathākāmaṃ kāmyānāṃ samuccayavikalpāvuktau | evamudgīthādividyāśca yathākāmam upādeyā veti saṅgatiḥ | nanu iti | punarukiṃta parihartuṃ pūrvamuktāṃśamāha - tatra hi iti | na hi iti | phalasya svavākyasyatvābhāvāt vilambaḥ godohanavāvayādvaiṣamyam | aṅgatvavirodhyabhāva uktaḥ | anukūlahetumāha - udgītha iti | vrīhīn itivat dvitīyā - śrutyā śeṣatvamiti bhāvaḥ | phalasya vākyāntarasthatāṃ darśayati - yadeva iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - svavākyena iti | phalasya svavākyasthatvābhāve sati avyabhicaritakratusaṃbandhijuhūsaṃbandhāt parṇatāyā aṅgatve siddhe vākyāntarasthāpāpaślokaśravaṇādiphalaśrutirarthavāda ityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha - ataḥ iti | prayogavidhiḥ - anuṣṭhāpakatvadaśāpannavidhiḥ na tu jñāpakāvasthaḥ || 59 || śiṣṭeśca || 3-3-60 || śiṣṭiḥ śāsanam, vidhānamityarthaḥ ... .... udgīthāṅgabhāva eva hi vidheya iti gamyate || 60 || śiṣṭeśca | yuktiruktā | liṅgānyucyante | godohanavaiṣamyamāha - godohana iti || 60 || samāhārāt || 3-3-61 || hotṛṣadanāddhaivāpi durudgītham ... .... vedanahānāvanyena samādhānaṃ bruvat tasya niyamenopādānaṃ darśayati || 61 || samāhārāt | samāhāraḥ - samādhānam || 61 || guṇasādhāraṇyaśruteśca || 3-3-62 || upāsanaguṇasya upāsanāśrayasya ... ... udgīthādyupāsanānāmudgīthādivanniyamenopādānam || 62 || guṇasādhāraṇyaśruteśca | upāsanārthatvavivakṣayā tadāśrayasya guṇa śabdenoktiḥ| samāhāraḥ - anuvṛttiḥ | tadupapādayati - tena iti || iti prāpta ucyate - na vā tatsahabhāvāśruteḥ || 3-3-63 || na caitadasti yadudgīthādyupāsanānāṃ ... .... tatra phalaśrutirarthavādamātraṃ syāt || 63 || rāddhānte - na vā tatsahabhāvāśruteḥ | sahabhāvamātrānna aṅgatvamityatrāha - aṅgabhāve hi iti | niyamo vivakṣitaḥ ityarthaḥ | aṅgatvavirodhitatpṛthakphalasādhanatvabhipretam | tadupapādayati - yadyapi iti | sādhanabhāvaḥ pratipādyate iti | godohanavākye sādhanatvaṃ kalyamiti ekavilambaḥ| iha tu tanna kalpyam | karmamātrasya vidyāsādhyatvābhāvāt | vīryavattaratvaviśiṣṭasyaitatsādhyatvām iti sādhanabhāvasya śābdātvāt | praṇayanamātrasyaiva godohanasādhyatāpratītiḥ | na tu paśusādhanatāviśiṣṭasya, sādhanavācakatvābhāvāt | phalaṃ tu vākyāntarasthamityeko vilambaḥ iti ekavilambavattvasāmyamabhipretam || tena phalasādhanatayaiva vidhirityatrāha - tena iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - kratuphalāt iti | tarhiṃ kathaṃ dvitīyāśrutyā śeṣatvamityatrāha - ata upāsanasya iti | mātracā śeṣitvavyudāsaḥ | godohanaṃ kiṃsaṃbandhi paśusādhanamitivat upāsanaṃ kiṃviṣayaṃ phalasādhanamityapekṣāyāṃ sannihitodgīthasaṃbandhitve sati godohanaṃ prati praṇayanamātrasyeva upāsanaṃ pratyudgīthasya na śeṣitvamityarthaḥ | pṛthavakyalatve adhikāryantareṇānuṣṭheyamityatrāha - udgīthaśca iti | yathā kratvadhikṛtasthaiva godohane paśukāmanā - nimittamadhikārāntaraṃ tadvadityarthaḥ || vīryavattaratvasya pṛthakphalatāmāha - vīrya iti | parṇatārvaiṣamyamāha - parṇatādīnāṃ tu iti | parṇatāphalaṃ vākyāntarasthatayā sādhanabhāvasya kalpyatayā ca vilambadvayopahatamiti aṅgatvamityarthaḥ | phalasya vākyāntarasthatvāt vilambānuktiḥ spaṣṭatvāt | juhvā juhoti ityukte dravyaviśeṣākāṃkṣā'sti, naivamudgīthasyopāsanaṃ pratyākāṃkṣā iti arthasiddham || 63 || darśanācca || 3-3-64 || darśayati ca śrutirupāsanopādānaniyamam .... ... samāhārādiliṅgānāṃ prāyikatvamavagamyate | ato'niyama eveti sthitam || iti yathāśrayabhāvādhikaraṇam - 26 iti śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracite śārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣye tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || darśanācca | yuktiḥ parihṛtā | liṅgāni nirasyante | abhirakṣaṇam kratuphalāpratibandhakaraṇādi | prāyikatvam iti | samādhānaṃ sati saṅkalpe syāt| guṇasādhāraṇyamapi tathā | yadvā tena iti padaṃ praṇavamātraparam, na tu sopāsanatatparam | śiṣṭaśca udgīthasaṃbandhitayā, na tu śeṣatayeti bhāvaḥ | iti yathāśrayabhāvādhikaraṇam - 26 iti śrīharitakulatilakavāgvijayisūnunā śrīraṅgarājadivyājñālavdhavedavyāsāparanāmadheyena śrīmadvaradācāryapādasevāsamadhigataśrībhagavadrāmānujaviracitaśārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣyahṛdayena śrīsudarśanasūriṇā viracitāyāṃ śrutapradīpikāyāṃ tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || tṛtīyādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ || <1. puruṣārthādhikaraṇam |> puruṣārtho'taḥ śabdāditi bādarāyaṇaḥ || 3-4-1 || guṇopasaṃhārānupasaṃhāraphalā ... .... tathā vidvān nāmarūpādvimuktaḥ parāt paraṃ puruṣamupaiti divyam ityādi ||1 || puruṣārtho'taḥśabdāditi bādarāyaṇaḥ | aṅgicintānantaramaṅgacinteti pādasaṅgatiḥ | vidyāyāḥ aṅgitve sati hi tadaṅgasya cintyatā | ataḥ tasyā aṅgitvaṃ prathamaṃ nirūpyate || 1 || atra pūrvapakṣī pratyavatiṣṭhate - śeṣatvāt puruṣārthaṃvādo yathā'nyeṣviti jaiminiḥ || 3-4-2 || naitadevaṃ yadvidyātaḥ puruṣārthāvāptiḥ ... ... ataḥ vidyāyāḥ kratuśeṣatvānnātaḥ puruṣārthaḥ || 2 || dvitīyamavatārayati - atra iti | śeṣatvāt puruṣārthavādo yathā'nyeṣviti jaiminiḥ | karmasu iti | adhītya iti jñānaṃ karmaśeṣamiti ātmajñānamapi taccheṣam | kratuśeṣaprokṣaṇādidvārabhūtavrīhyāderiva jñātavyātmanaśca karmaśeṣatayā tatsvarūpoktiparatvādityarthaḥ | aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvam sarvaṃ khalu iti aciteva citā'pyaikyāyoga iti bhāvaḥ | vedāntavākyeṣveva - vilakṣaṇaparatayā tvadukteṣveveti bhāvaḥ | liṅgaiḥ - jñāpakaiḥ | kartu rjuhvā ivāvyabhicaritakratusaṃbandhitvābhāvāt na taddhīḥ parṇatāvat kratvaṅgamiti codayati - nanu ca iti | pariharati - naivam iti || 2 || kāni punastāni liṅgāni, yaduṣabṛṃhita ... ..... ācāradarśanāt || 3-4-3 || brahmavidāṃ prādhānyena karmasveva .... ... karmaṅgatvameveti na vidyātaḥ puruṣārthaḥ || 3 || anantarasūtrāvatārāyāha - kāni iti | ācāradarśanāt | guṇamukhyavyatikrame mukhyasya hi anuroddhavyatā | ataḥ karmaprādhānyamiti bhāvaḥ || 3 || liṅgamidam, prāptirucyatāmityatrāha - tacchateḥ || 3-4-4 || śrutireva hi vidyāyāḥ karmaṅgatvamāha ... ... vidyayā karoti iti vidyāmātraviṣayā hīyaṃ śrutiḥ || 4 || liṅgam - anugrāhakam | prāptiḥ - mānata siddhiḥ | tacchateḥ | tṛtīyāśrutyā aṅgatvāvagamaḥ || 4 || samanvāraṃbhaṇāt || 3-4-5 || taṃ vidyākarmaṇī samanvārebhete ... .... nyāyena vidyāyāḥ karmaṅgatve satyeva bhavati || 5 || samanvāraṃbhaṇāt | viparyaye'pi sāhityaṃ saṃbhavatītyatrāha - uktena iti | nyāyena - ātmanaḥ karmaśeṣatvādinā || 5 || tadvato vidhānāt || 3-4-6 || vidyāvataḥ karmavidhānāt vidyā .... ..... karmasu viniyukteti na pṛthakphalāyāvakalpate || 6 || tadvato vidhānāt | adhītya iti | snātvā juhoti itivaditi bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha - arthāvabodha iti | arthadhīparyantatā kathamityatrāha - - artha iti | śruteravivakṣitārthatvādidoṣaparihārarthamityarthaḥ || 6 || niyamāt || 3-4-7 || icaśca na vidyātaḥ puruṣārthaḥ | ... .... karmaṇa eva phalamityavagamyate| vidyā tu karmāṅgamiti || 7 || niyamāt | kṛtsnāyuṣaḥ kratuśeṣatvāt, madhyagataṃ sarvaṃ taccheṣamityarthaḥ || 7 || evaṃ prāpte pracakṣmahe - ādhikopadeśāt tu bādarāyaṇasyaivaṃ taddarśanāt || 3-4-8 || tuśabdāt pakṣo vyāvṛttaḥ ... .... śrūyamāṇaṃ phalamiti vidyātaḥ puruṣārtha iti suṣṭhūktam || 8 || rāddhānte - adhikopadeśāt tu bādarāyaṇasyaivaṃ taddarśanāt | liṅgeṣu satsu kathaṃ vidyātaḥ phalamityatrāha - liṅgāni iti | upāsanavākyānāṃ svarūpaparavākyoktaguṇasāpekṣatvāt vedanopadeśavākyeṣu ityuktam | juhūvat kartuḥ pratyabhijñābhāvāt na taddvārā taddhiyaḥ karmāṅgatvamiti phalaśrutiḥ nārthavāda ityarthaḥ || 8 || liṅgānyapi nirasyante - tulyaṃ tu darśanam || 30-4-9 || yaduktaṃ brahmavidāṃ karmanuṣṭhānadarśanāt ... ... vidyāyāḥ karmāṅgatve karmatyāgaḥ kathamapi nopapadyate || 9 || tulyaṃ tu darśanam | ananuṣṭhāne'pi darśanaṃ tulyam iti śabdārthaḥ| anaikāntikam iti phalitoktiḥ | anaikāntikam - aniyatam | anuṣṭhānasyaiva darśanamiti na niyatamityarthaḥ | anuṣṭhānānanuṣṭhānavyāhatistvanmata eva | brahmavidyāphalānāmarthavādatvāt mokṣārthatvatrivargārthatvavibhāgānupapatterityabhipayannāha - vidyāyāḥ iti || 9 || yaduktaṃ - śrutyaiva vidyāyāḥ ... ... asārvatrikī || 3-4-10 || na sarvavidyāviṣayeyaṃ śrutiḥ ... ... yacchabdena nirdiśya tasya hi vīryavattaratvamucyate || 10 || asārvatrīkī | prakaraṇāt śrutirbalīyasītyatrāha - na hi iti | yat karoti tadvidyayā iti nānbayaḥ, kliṣṭatvāt | yadvidyayā karoti tadvīryavattaramityanvaye sati vidyayā kāryamanuvadato vacasaḥ prāpakāpekṣāyāṃ, tatprāpakaṃ prakaraṇaṃ vidyāśabdaṃ saṅkovayati | ataḥ anuvādatayā'nyasāpekṣasya vidyayeti padasya svato niścayāsāmarthyāt ekapadasāmarthyarūpā śrutirnetyarthaḥ || yaccedamuktaṃ, taṃ vidyākarmaṇī ... ... vibhāgaḥ śatavat || 3-4-11 || taṃ vidyākarmaṇī samanvārabhete ... .... ratnārtha śatamiti vibhāgaḥ pratīyate; tathehāpi || 11 || vibhāgaḥ śatavat | samanvāraṃmaṇaśrutermokṣārthavidyākarmaviṣayatve ayamarthaḥ - prārabdhāvasāne mokṣaṃ dātuṃ vidyā'nveti; janmāntareṣa'pi vidyāṃ janayituṃ karmānveti iti || 11 || adhyayanamātravataḥ || 3-4-12 || yaduktaṃ - vidyāvataḥ karmavidhānāt ... ... puruṣārthasādhana bhūtāvidyeti na tasyāḥ karmasaṃbandhagandho vidyate || 21 || adhyayanamātravataḥ | ādhānavat iti śabdasvārasyaṃ darśitam | pravartakābhāvāt anāraṃbhaṇīyatvādyarthānupapatiṃta pariharati - gṛhītasya iti | atra vaktavyaṃ sarvaṃ prathamasūtre'bhihitam | arthadhīparyantatvamupagamyāha - yadyapi iti | vidyāyā adhyayanaśabdavācyātiriktatvādityarthaḥ | yathā iti | anuṣṭhānaṃ prati svarūpajñāvat vidyāṃ prati śāstrajanyaṃ jñānaṃ śeṣamityarthaḥ || nāviśeṣāt || 3-4-13 || yaccoktaṃ kurvanneveha karmāṇi ... .... viduṣastvāprayāṇādupāsanasyānuvartamānatvāt || 13 || nāviśeṣāt | pradhānānuvṛttyā'ṅgānuvṛttirupapannetyāha - viduṣastu iti || 13 || evamarthasvābhāvyena codyaṃ parihṛtya ... ... stutaye'numatirvā || 3-4-14 || vāśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ .... .... na karma lipyate nare iti | ato na karmāṅgaṃ vidyā || 14 || arthasvābhāvyam - arthajñānādanyatvam; karmāṅgatvaṃ ca | stutaye'numatirvā | īśāvāsyam iti | īṭśabde tṛtīyā | īśenā''vāsyamiti bhāvaḥ | na ramate iti naraḥ | nissaṅge tvayi na karma lipyate iti, ito'nyathā nāsti idaṃ tattavamityarthaḥ || 14 || kāmakāreṇa caike || 3-4-15 || api caivameke śākhinaḥ ... .... gārhasthyatyāgo na saṃbhavati | ato na vidyā karmāṅgam || 15 || kāmakāreṇa caike | kāmāt yathābhimatāśramadharmānuṣṭhānaṃ kāmakāraḥ | gārhasthya ityādyadhyāhṛtam | nāṅgāvalambenāṅginastyāga ityarthaḥ || 15 || upamardaṃ ca || 3-4-6 || puṇyāpuṇyarūpasya samasta ... ... tadvidyāyāḥ karmāṅgatve na saṅgacchate || 16 || upamardaṃ ca | na hyaṅgena aṅgina upamarda ityarthaḥ || 16 || ūrdhvaretastu ca śabde hi || 3-4-17 || ūrdhvaretassvāśrameṣu brahmavidyā ... .... yāvajjīvaśrutistvaviraktaviṣayā || 17 || ūrdhveretassu ca śabde hi | smṛtiṣu pratīyante ityatrāha - śruti iti | dharmaskandhāḥ - dharmāśrayāḥ || 17 || parāmarśaṃ jaiminiracodanāccāpavadati hi || 3-4-18 || yadidaṃ trayo dharmaskandhāḥ ... ... āśramā na santīti jaiminirācāryo manyate || 18 || parāmarśaṃ jaiminiracodanāccāpavadati hi | sphuṭam || 18 || anuṣṭheyaṃ bādarāyaṇaḥ sāmyaśruteḥ || 3-4-19 || gṛhasthāśramavadāśramāntaramapyanuṣṭheyaṃ .... ...devayānavidhānasya tatrāpi tatprāptiraṅgīkaraṇīyā || 19 || anuṣṭheyaṃ bādarāyaṇaḥ sāmyaśruteḥ na sāmyaṃ vācyam, āśramāntarakīrtanasyaivābhāvāditi śaṅkate - na ca iti | vyākhyānāntararavyāvṛttyarthamāha - ato yajñaḥ iti | yaugikaḥ iti | prokṣaṇīnayāccaturthāśramaparatvāyogo'bhipretaḥ | arthanupapattyā api tadayogamāha - tacca sarveṣām iti | tatra puṇyalokabhājaḥ ityasyārthamāha - brahmaniṣṭhāvikalāḥ iti || 19 || parāmarśapakṣe vidhānapakṣe ca .... ... vidhirvā dhāraṇavat || 3-4-20 || vāśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ | .... .... ata ūrdhvaretassu ca brahmavidyāvidhānāt vidyātaḥ puruṣārtha iti siddham || 20 || vidhirvā dhāraṇavat | ṛṇaśrutiḥ - tribhiḥ ṛṇavā jāyate ityādikā| apavādaśrutiḥ - vīrahā ityādiḥ | svasvāśramadharmaviṣayāḥ iti | tattadāśramiṇāṃ tattaddharmānuvṛttiparāḥ | na tvāśramāntarāṇāṃ vidyāṅgatvavirodhinyaḥ ityarthaḥ | adhikaraṇārthamupasaṃharati - ataḥ iti || iti puruṣārthādhikaraṇam - 1 <2. stutimātrādhikaraṇam ||> stutimātramupādānāditi cennāpūrvatvāt || 3-4-21 || idamidānīṃ cintyate - sa eṣa rasānāṃ ... .. udgīthādiṣu rasatamādidṛṣṭividhānameva nyāyyam || 21 || stutimātramupādānāditi cennāpūrvatvāt | brahmasaṃsthaśrutiprasaṅgāt rasatamatvādiparavākyāni stutyarthāni neti śaṅkā jāyeteti prasaṅgāt saṅgatiḥ | pūrvoktapaptarasāpekṣayā aṣṭamatvam | hetuṃ vivṛṇoti - kratvaṅga iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - yathā iti | kratvaṅgopādānapūrvakatvepi na parṇatāyāḥ stutyarthatā, upādātuṃ śakyātvāt | svarlokatvādikaṃ tvaśakyamiti bhāvaḥ || rāddhānte - juhvādeḥ pṛthivītvādikamapyaprāptamityatrāha - na ca iti | na ca rasatamatvādeḥ pṛthivītvāderivopādātumaśakyatvam, utpattirūpeṇāśakyatve'pi jñaptirūpeṇa śakyatvāt | pṛthivītvādeḥ jñaptirūpeṇopādātuṃ śakyatve'pi ekavākyatvapratīti balāt na dṛṣṭividhyarthateti bhāvaḥ | yayā kayā ca iti | rasatamatvāderaprāptatvāt na tadanuvādena stutiḥ | ayogyatvāt nāprāptavidhānena stunatiḥ | kratumannidhyabhāvena ekavākyatvapratītyabhāvāt nāmukhyaguṇānvayena stutiḥ| ato dṛṣṭividhirityabhiprāyaḥ || 21 || bhāvaśabdācca || 3-4-22 || upāsīta ityādibhāvaśabdācca ... .... tasmādupāsanavidhānārthā etāḥ śrutayaḥ || 22 || pūrvapakṣayuktiḥ parihṛtā | svapakṣe heturucyate - bhāvaśabdācca | bhāvaḥ - kriyā || 22 || iti stutimātrādhikaraṇam -2 <3. pāriplavārthādhikaraṇam ||> pāriplavārthā iti cenna viśeṣitatvāt || 3-4-23 || pratardano ha vai daivodāsiḥ ..... ... ākhyānaśrutayaḥ pāriplavaprayogārthāḥ, api tu vidyāvidhyarthāḥ || 23 || pāriplavārthā iti cenna viśeṣitatvāt | idaṃ ca prāsaṅgikam | rasatamatvādeḥ stutyarthatvaṃ pūrvapakṣīkṛtam | evaṃ prātardanādyākhyānāni kiṃ stutyarthāni na veti saṅgatiḥ | pāriplavāḥ - ākhyānāni; tacchaṃsanārthā ityarthaḥ | pratipādanārthāni - stāvakatvena pratipādanārthāni | vidyāvidhyarthāḥ - stāvakatayā śeṣabhūtāḥ teṣāmeva| anyathā ākhyānānantyāt aśakyatvamiti bhāvaḥ || 23 || tathā caikavākyopabandhāt || 3-4-24 || ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ .... ... ityevamādeḥ karmavidhyarthatvam; na pāriplavārthatvam || 24 || tathā caikavākyopabandhāt | upabandhaḥ - anvayaḥ || 24 || iti pāriplavārthādhikaraṇam - 3 <4. agnīndhanādyadhikaraṇam ||> ata eva cāgnīndhanādyanapekṣā || 3-4-25 || stutiprasaṅgādavāntarasaṅgativiśeṣeṇa ... ... karmānapekṣā teṣu vidyā | kevalasvāśramavihitakarmāpekṣetyarthaḥ || 25 || ata eva cāgnīndhanādyanapekṣā | pūrvayoḥ prāsaṅgikatvāt prathamādhikaraṇena saṅgatimāha - stuti ityādinā | spaṣṭam || 25 || iti agnīndhanādyadhikaraṇam - 4 <5. sarvāpekṣādhikaraṇam ||> sarvāpekṣā ca yajñādiśruteraśvavat || 3-4-26 || yadi vidyā yajñādyānapekṣaiva .... ... svakarmaṇā tamabhyarcya sidiṃdha vindati mānavaḥ iti || 26 || sarvāpekṣā ca yajñādiśruteraśvavat | saṅgatiḥ sphuṭā | yajñādiśrutirapi iti | icchāsādhanvamāheti bhāvaḥ || rāddhānte - satyeva iti | icchāsādhanatve anyonyāśrayatvādirabhipretaḥ | na yajñāpekṣā, vākyādeva tadutpatterityatrāha - jñānaṃ ca iti | āprayāṇāt iti | aṅgino'nuvṛttyā'ṅgānuvṛttiriti bhāvaḥ | pravṛttirūpayajñādiḥ manovyākulāyetyatrāha - evaṃrūpaṃ ca iti | adṛṣṭadvārā iti parihāraḥ || 26 || iti sarvāpekṣādhikaraṇam - 5 <6. śamadamādyadhīkaraṇam ||> śamadamādyupetaḥ syāt tathāpi tu tadvidhestadaṅgatayā teṣāmapyavaśyānuṣṭheyatvāt || 3-4-27 || gṛhasthasya śamadamādīnyapi ... .... ato gṛhasthasya śamadamādayo'pyanuṣṭheyāḥ || 27 || śamadamādyupetaḥ syāt tathāpi tu tadvidhestadaṅgatayā teṣāmapyavaśyānuṣṭheyatvāt | saṅgatiḥ pūrvapakṣe saphuṭā | latvaśanādivyāvṛttyarthaṃ prayojanaśūnyeṣu ityuktam | kāmyaṃ ca mumukṣāḥ prayojanaśūnyam | avihitaṃ - vihitādanyat; avihitāpratiṣiddhaṃ niṣiddhaṃ ca || 27 || iti śamadamādyadhikaraṇam -6 <7. sarvānnānumatyadhikaraṇam ||> sarvānnānumatiśca prāṇātyaye taddarśanāt || 3-4-28 || vājināṃ chandogānāṃ ca prāṇavidyāyāṃ ... ... prāṇavidaḥ sarvannīnatvaṃ prāṇātyayāpattāveveti niścīyate || 28 || sarvānnānumatiśca prāṇātyaye taddarśanāt | śamādyanuṣṭhānamuktam | śamaviśeṣarūpabhojananiyatiḥ cintyate iti saṅgatiḥ | prāṇavido'pi sarvānnānumatirasti kimuta brahmavida ityādyābhiprāyikam | na tu sūtre kaṇṭhoktam || rāddhānte - maṭacī - aśmavṛṣṭiḥ | ibhyam - hastipam || abādhācca || 3-4-29 || āhārāśuddhau sattvaśuddhiḥ ... ... prāṇavido'lpaśakteḥ sarvānnānumatirāpadviṣayaiva || 29 || abādhācca | spaṣṭam || 29 || api smaryate || 3-4-30 || api ca āpadviṣayameva sarvānnīnatvaṃ .... .... lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatramivāṃbhasā iti || 30 || api smaryate | na paraṃ sarvānnīnatvasya āpadviṣayatvaṃ prāṇavidaḥ kalpyama; sarveṣāṃ kaṇṭhoktaṃ cetyarthaḥ || 30 || śabdaścāto'kāmakāre || 3-4-31 || yato bahmavidāmanyeṣāṃ ca .... ... iti matvā brāhmaṇaḥ surāṃ na pibatītyarthaḥ || 31 || śabdaścāto'kāmakāre | brāhmaṇa śabdaḥ asaṅkocāt brahmavidamapyāheti bhāvaḥ || 31 || iti sarvānnānumatyadhikaraṇam - 7 <8. vihitatvādhikaraṇam ||> vihitatvāccāśramakarmāpi || 3-4-32 || yajñādikarmāṅgikā brahmavidyā .... .... jīvananimittatayā nityavadvihitatvādityarthaḥ || 32 || vihitatvāccāśramakarmāpi | paramaprakṛtenāvāntarasaṅgatimāha - yajñādi iti| nityānitya iti | yāvajjīvamanuṣṭhānaṃ mumukṣānuguṇamanuṣṭhānaṃ ca viruddhamityarthaḥ || āśrami iti pāṭhe kevala śabdaḥ amumukṣuparaḥ | anuṣṭheyāni iti | karmāṇi ityadhyāhāraḥ || 32 || tathā vidyāṅgatayā ca, tametaṃ ... ... sahakāritvena ca || 3-4-33 || vidyotpattidvāreṇa vidyāsahakāritayā .... ... viniyogapṛthaktvenobhayārthatvaṃ na virudhyate ityarthaḥ || 33 || sahakāritvena ca | vidyotpatti iti samuccayavyudāsaḥ | nityānityasaṃyogavirodha ityatrāha - agnihotra iti | viniyogaḥ - śeṣatvajñāpakavidhiḥ || 33 || tadvadeva karmāntaratvamapi nāstītyāha - sarvathā'pi ta evobhayaliṅgāt || 3-4-34 || sarvathā - vidyārthatve āśramārthatve'pi ... ... viniyogāt karmasvarūpabhede pramāṇābhāvācca || 34 || sarvathā'pi ta evobhayaliṅgāt | śabdaikye'pi kuṇḍapāyināmayanāgnihotre bhedo dṛśyate ityatrāha - - karmasvarūpa iti | āvṛtteraṅgāntarasya ca nairapekṣyaṃ ta eva iti nirṇayaphalam || 34 || anabhibhavaṃ ca darśayati || 3-4-35 || dharmeṇa pāpamapanudati ityādibhiśca ... ... pratyahaṃ prakṛṣyamāṇā vidyotpattaye | atasta eva ubhayatra yajñādayaḥ || 35 || anabhibhavaṃ ca darśayati | ādi śabdo yajñādivākyaparaḥ | aṅgatvaṃ tatkṛtakiñcitkāraṃ ca vaddvākyam yajñādiśabdena tattulyaśabdena vā nirdiśatītyarthaḥ || 35 || iti vihitatvādhikaraṇam - 8 <9. vidhurādhikaraṇam ||> antarā cāpi tu taddṛṣṭeḥ ||| 3-4-36 || caturṇāmāśramiṇāṃ brahmavidyāyām .... .... devatārādhanādibhiḥ vidyānugrahaḥ śakyate kartum || 36 || antarā cāpi tu taddṛṣṭeḥ | saṅgatimāha - caturṇām iti | ādi śabdāt akṛtadāraḥ | varṇadharmaiḥ anugrahaḥ ityarthaḥ | anaikāntikānām - aniyatānām || 36 || api smaryate || 3-4-37 || api ca anāśramiṇāmapi ... ... japādyanugṛhītayā vidyayā siddho bhavatītyarthaḥ || 37 || api smaryate | brāhmaṇaḥ - tadadhīte, tadveda ityarthaḥ | kathaṃ japādibhiranugrahopagama ityatrāha - japādi iti || 37 || viśeṣānugrahaśca || 3-4-38 || na kevalaṃ nyāyasmṛtibhyāmayamarthaḥ .... ... vidyayā''tmānamanviṣyet iti || 38 || viśeṣānugrahaśca | sphuṭam || 38 || atastvitarajjyāyo liṅgācca || 3-4-39 || tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe | ataḥ - anāśramitvāt .... .... mṛtabhāryasya cāvairāgye sati dārālābha āpat || 39 || tarhi śaktairapyāśramā upekṣyā ityatrāha - atastvitarajjyāyo liṅgācca | atulyakāryatvāt - śaktaṃ prati ityarthaḥ | āpadaṃ śikṣayati - nivṛtta iti | brahmaniṣṭheṣvanugataṃ vairāgyaṃ kālāntarādibhogyanairapekṣyaṃ gārhasthyadharmalipsā cetyavirodhaḥ || 39 || iti vidhurādhikaraṇam -9 <10. tadbhūtādhikaraṇam ||> tadbhūtasya tu nātadbhāvo jaiminerapi niyamāt tadrūpābhāvebhyaḥ || 3-4-40 || naiṣṭhikavaikhānasaparivrājakāśramebhyaḥ ..... jaiminerapi - ityavigānaṃ darśannuktaṃ svābhimataṃ draḍhayati || 40 || tadbhūtasya tu nātadbhāvo jaiminerapi niyamāt tadūpābhāvebhyaḥ | vidhurāderiva anāśramitvasāmyāt pracyutānāmapi vidyādhikāro'sti neti śaṅkāyā saṅgatiḥ | vaikhānasaḥ - vānaprasthaḥ | brahmacārī ityādiśrutiḥ naiṣṭhikaviṣayā || 40 || atha syāt naiṣṭikādīnāṃ ... ... na cādhikārikamapi patanānumānāt tadayogāt || 3-4-41 || adhikāralakṣaṇoktamapi prāyaścittaṃ ... ... ato'dhikāralakṣaṇoktaṃ prāyaścittamitarabrahma cāriviṣayam || 41 || anantarasya śaṅkāmāha - atha syāt iti | adhikāralakṣaṇam ṣaṣṭham| avakīrṇipaśuḥ - gardabhaḥ | upakurvāṇabrahma vārī bhraṣṭaḥ avakīrṇī | na cādhikārikamapi patanānumānāt tadayogāt | tarhi tatprāyaścitaṃ kiṃ viṣayamityatrāha - ataḥ iti || 41 || upapūrvamapītyeke bhāvamaśanavat taduktam || 3-4-42 || naiṣṭhikādīnāṃ brahmacaryapracyavanaṃ ... ... prāyaścittasaṃbhavāt brahmavidyāyogyatā'pyasti || 42 || upapūrvamapītyeke bhāvamaśanavat taduktam | upakurvāṇasya brahmacaryabhraṃśasya upapātakasya prāyaścitaṃ naiṣṭhikādiṣvatidiṣṭamiti vidyāyogyatā ityarthaḥ | strīsaṃsargādiprāyaścittādeḥ gṛhasthādāvaprasaṅgāt svāśramāvirodhi śabdaḥ || 42 || bahistūbhayathā'pi smṛterācārācca || 3-4-43 || tuśabdo matāntaravyāvṛttyarthaḥ | ... ... atasyeṣāṃ nāsti brahmavidyāyāmadhikāraḥ || 43 || bahistūbhayathā'pi smṛterācārācca | yadyapi iti | patanatatprāyaścittavacanavirodhe sati patanasmṛtiḥ pāpakarmaṇo vaidikakarmānadhikārāpādakaśaktināśakaprāyaścittābhāvaviṣayā | prāyaścittavacanaṃ pratyavāyasajātīyarucijananaśaktivināśakaviṣayamiti vyavasthā kāryetyarthaḥ | varjanaphalamāha - nopadiśanti iti || 43 || iti tadbhūtādhikaraṇam - 10 <11. svāmyadhikaraṇam ||> svāminaḥ phalaśruterityātreyaḥ || 3-4-44 || karmāṅgāśrayāṇyudgīthādyupāsanāni ... .... rasatamatvānusandhānaṃ yajamanenaiva kartuṃ śakyate || 44 || svāminaḥ phalaśruterityātreyaḥ | upāsanānuṣṭhātṛvibhāgacintāntaram udgīthādyupāsanasyāpi taccintanaṃ kriyate iti prasaṅgāt saṅgatiḥ | sphuṭam || iti prāpte'bhidhīyate - ātvajyamityauḍulomistasmai hi parikrīyate || 3-4-45 || ātvajyaṃ - ṛtvijaḥ karma .... ... śāstraphalaṃ prayoktari iti nyāyācca phalikartṛkatvameva || 45 || rāddhānte - ātvajyamityauḍulomistasmai hi parikrīyate | tacchabdārthaḥ phalasādhana iti vyākhyātaḥ | prayojanāya iti caturthyartha uktaḥ | parikrīyate ityasyārthamāha - karmavidhiṣu iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - tadantargatāni iti | aṅgatve sati hi ṛtvikkartṛkatvamityatrāha - yadyapi ityādi | kratvadhikṛta iti | agryaprāyanaya uktaḥ | ṛtvikkartṛkakarmaṇo vīryavattaratvasādhanavidyāyāstatkartṛkatvam antaraṅganayācca syāt | tadunugṛhītaṃ vidyayā karoti iti vākyasvārasyaṃ ca | daharādidhiyāṃ matathātve kiṃ vaiṣamyamitrāha - daharādiṣu iti || 45 || iti svāmyadhikaraṇam - 11 <12. sahakāryantaravidhyadhikaraṇam ||> sahakāryantaravidhiḥ pakṣeṇa tṛtīyaṃ tadvato vidhyādivat || 3-4-46 || tasmādbrāhmaṇaḥ pāṇḍityaṃ .... .... pāṇḍityādikaṃ maunatṛtīyaṃ vidyāyāḥ sahakāryantaraṃ vidhīyate || 46 || sahakāryantaravidhiḥ pakṣeṇa tṛtīyaṃ tadvato vidhyādivat | pūrvaṃ yajñādiḥ śamādiśca sahakārī nirūpitaḥ | tadvat sahakāryantaraṃ nirūpyate iti saṅgatiḥ | mauna śabdo hi mananārthaḥ | ata uktam jñānārthatvāt iti | vidhīyate iti | padārthā uktāḥ | vākyārthamāha - etaduktam iti | jñānārthatvāt anuvāda ityatrāha - maunaṃ ca iti | pakṣeṇa iti vyākhyeyam | anuvādasya nairarthyāt pākṣikau'pyartho vidhitvānuguṇaḥ svīkārya ityarthaḥ || pāṇḍityabālyamaunabrāhmaṇa śabdārthaḥ kaḥ? tasmāt brāhmaṇaḥ, atha brāhmaṇaḥ ityatra brāhmaṇasya pāṇḍityādikaṃ, pāṇḍityādikena ca brāhmaṇyam iti vyāhatirityatrāha - tadevam iti | prathamabrāhmaṇaśabdo vidvamnātraviṣayaḥ | dvitīyastu vidyākāṣṭāprāptiviṣayaḥ | paripūrtiḥ kalyāṇaguṇaiḥ | ubhayaliṅgatvamuktaṃ padābhyām | aprāptaṃ vedanam iti nirdoṣatvakalyāṇaguṇayoḥ kāṣṭhājñānam | tadupadeśaikalamyam| tat pāṇḍityam | amaunaṃ pāṇḍityabālyayajñādikam || 46 || atha syāt - yadi sarveṣvāśrameṣu ... ... kṛtsnabhāvāt tu gṛhiṇopasaṃhāraḥ || 3-4-47 || tuśabdaścodyaṃ vyāvartayati | ... ... sarvāśramadharmapradarśanārtho gṛhiṇopasaṃhāra ityabhiprāyaḥ || 47 || anantaramavatārayati - atha syāt iti | kṛtsnabhāvāt tu gṛhiṇopasaṃhāraḥ | chāndogye brahmavido gārhasthyena sthitivacanaṃ pradarśanārtham | bṛhadāraṇyakavirodhādityarthaḥ || 47 || tathā etasminnapi vākye .... .... maunavadinareṣāmapyupadeśāt || 3-4-48 || sarveṣaṇāvinirmuktasya bhikṣācaraṇa .... ... maunatṛtīyaḥ pāṇḍityādiḥ vidyāsahakāritvena vidhīyate iti || 48 || saṅgatyarthamimamarthaṃ saṃkṣipan anantarasūtramavatārayati - tathā iti | maunavaditareṣāmapyupadeśāt | evaṃvidha śabdaḥ īṣaṇātyāgādipūrvakatvaparaḥ | adhikaraṇārthaṃ nigamayati - ataḥ iti || 48 || iti sahakāryantaravidhyadhikaraṇam - 12 <13. anāviṣkārādhikaraṇam ||> anāviṣkurvannanvayāt || 3-4-49 || tasmāt brāhmaṇaḥ pāṇḍityaṃ ... ... āhāraśuddhau sattvaśuddhiḥ ityādiṣu || 49 || anāviṣkurvannanvayāt | saṅgatiḥ sphuṭā | bādhyante - abrahmaviddhiṣayāṇītyarthaḥ || rāddhānte - niyamaśāstraviṣayavibhāgāḥ niyamavirodhītyarthaḥ || 49 || iti anāviṣkārādhikaraṇam - 13 <14. aihikādhikaraṇam ||> aihikamaprastutapratibandhe taddarśanāt || 3-4-50 || dvividhā vidyā - abhyudayaphalā ... ... udgīthavidyāyuktasya karmaṇaḥ phalāpratibandhaśravaṇāt || 50 || aihikamaprastutapratibandhe taddarśanāt | aṅgacintā kṛtā | aṅginiṣṭhāsiddhisamayaścintyate iti saṅgatiḥ | udgīthādividhurakarmāṃgakavidyāsiddhau vicāraḥ iha uttarasūtre ca kriyate | vidyāyāḥ sukṛtasādhyatve sati hyayaṃ vicāra ityatrāha - yathoktam iti || 50 || iti aihikādhikaraṇam - 14 <15. muktiphalādhikaraṇam ||> evaṃ muktiphalāniyamastadavasthāvadhṛteḥ tadavasthāvadhṛteḥ || 3-4-51 || muktiphalasyāpyupāsanasya .... ... dviruktiradhyāyaparisamāptiṃ dyotayati || 51 || iti śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracite śārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣye tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ || || samāptaścādhyāyaḥ || evaṃ muktiphalāniyamastadavasthāvadhṛteḥ tadavasthāvadhṛteḥ adhikaraṇāntaram| saṃgatiḥ sphuṭā | tasya - pūrvasūtroktasya | sarvebhyaḥ ityādi | prabalatvam bhagavatprītyatiśayāvahatvakṛtam | aprītyatiśayādhāyako brahmavidapacāraḥ pratibandhakaḥ iti parihāraḥ || 51 || iti muktiphalādhikaraṇam - 15 iti śrīharitakulatilakavāgvijayisūnunā śrīraṅgarājadivyājñālabdhavedavyāsāparanāmadheyena śrīpadvaradācāryapādasebāsamadhigataśrībhagavadrāmānujaviracitaśārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣyahṛdayena śrīsudarśanasūriṇā viracitāyāṃ śrutapradīpikāyāṃ tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ || || samāptaścādhyāyaḥ || caturthādhyāye prathamaḥ pādaḥ || <1. āvṛttyadhikaraṇam ||> āvṛttirasakṛdupadeśāt || 4-1-1 || tṛtīye'dhyāye sādhanaiḥ saha vidyā ... ... vedanādiśabdairabhidhīyate iti niścīyate || 1 || āvṛttirasakṛdupadeśāt | adhyāyasaṅgatimāha - tṛtīye iti | svopayogyaryaiḥ saha vidyā cintitā | atha phalacinteti saṅgatiḥ | vidyāviṣaye prāganirūpitāṃśaḥ prathamaṃ nirūpyate sādhyasādhanabhāvasaṃbandhajñāpanārthaṃ prītirūpatvāt phalarūpatājñāpanārthaṃ ca | aśrutā'pyāvṛttiḥ kkacit kriyate ityatrāha - na ca iti || rāddhānte - ekaikopaniṣadi prayogo darśitaḥ paryāyatvaṃ ca ityādinā | bahūpaniṣatsu prayogaṃ darśayati - tathā iti | atra chāgapaśunayo'bhipretaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha - dhyānaṃ ca iti || 1 || liṅgācca || 4-1-2 || liṅgaṃ - smṛtiḥ | smṛteścāyamartho ... ... tasmādasakṛdāvṛttameva vedanaṃ śāstrārthaḥ || 2 || liṅgācca spaṣṭam || 2 || iti āvṛttyadhikaraṇam - 1 <2. ātmatvopāsanādhikaraṇam ||> ātmeti tūpagacchanti grāhayanti ca || 4-1-3 || idamidānīṃ cintyate - kimupāsyaṃ ... ... ata upāsiturātmatvena brahmopāsyamiti sthitam || 3 || ātmeti tūpagacchanti grāhayanti ca | uktopāsanakarmabhūtaṃ brahma kimayutasiddhirūpasaṃbandhaviraheṇa upāsyam, uta upāsitṛśarīrakatvena iti śaṅkayā saṅgatiḥ | yathā puruṣārthyo'ta ityadhikaraṇasya śrutyarthākṣepeṇotthānaṃ, tathā'syāpyabhedaśrutyarthākṣepeṇotthānam | anya śabdaḥ śarīrātmabhāvarūpasaṃbandharahitavācī | nāyamasmadīyaḥ, api tvanyaḥ iti saṃbandhaviśeṣarahite prayogāt | upāsiturātmatve upāsitāraṃ prati śarīritvena upāsyopāsakabhāvena jīveśvarayoḥ bhūtyarājatulyatvāvagamāt, pṛthaktvadhiyo mokṣopāyatvācca bhedastāttvika iti upāyaparavākyabalāt amedaśrutyākṣepo'bhipretaḥ || ayathābhūtā syāt iti saṃsāritvaprāptirityarthaḥ || rāddhānte - ātma śabdaṃ vivṛṇoti - upāsitā iti | upagacchanti - gatyarthāḥ buddhyarthāḥ | upāsate ityarthaḥ | upāsanavidhiṣvevābhedadarśanāt upasitṛśarīrakatvenopāsyamityarthaḥ | tarhi bhedopāsanavidhivirodha ityabhiprāyatayoktam - kathamabhyupagacchanti iti | sanmūlāḥ ityādibhirupetasya ya ātmani ityasyārthamāha - sarvasya iti | yuktamiti upapādayanti ityanvayaḥ || ekatvapṛthaktvaśrutyoravirodhamāha - evaṃ ca iti | tadviśadayati - aham iti | tadupapādayati - adhikasya iti | eṣaḥ iti padaṃ jīvaparam, pulliṅgatvāt; parasya ca devatā śabdoktavāt | viśeṣaṇamātramapūrṇam; viśiṣṭa eva pūrṇa ityarthaḥ || 3 || ici ātmatvopāsanādhikaraṇam - 2 <3. pratīkādhikaraṇam ||> na pratīke na hi saḥ || 4-1-4 || mano brahmetyupāsīta .... ... pratīkasyopāsiturātmatvābhāvānna tathā'nusandheyam || 4 || na pratīke na hi saḥ | uktamātmatayā upāsanam | pratīkeṣvapi tathā kāryaṃ na veti saṅgatiḥ | brahma śabdanirdeśāt tadevopāsyam | manaḥ - ādi tu dṛṣṭiviśeṣaṇamiti pūrvapakṣaḥ || rāddhānte - upāsyaṃ hi brahmetyatrāha - pratīkopāsaneṣu iti | brahma śabdaḥ kathamityatrāha - brahma tu iti || 4 || nanu atrāpi brahmaivopāsyam ... ... brahmadṛṣṭirutkarṣāt || 4-1-5 || manaādiṣu brahmadṛṣṭireva yuktā .... ... bhṛtye tu rājadṛṣṭirabhyudayāya || 5|| anantarasyāvatārāyāha - nanu iti | brahmadṛṣṭirutkarṣāt | na mana ādyacinamātramupāsyaṃ, kiṃ tu abhimānidevateti na virodhaḥ || 5 || iti pratīkādhikaraṇam -3 <4. ādityādimatyadhikaraṇam ||> ādityādimatayaścāgaṃ upapatteḥ || 4-1-6 || ya evāsau tapati tamudgītham ... ... karmaṇāmapi phalasādhanatvam; ataḥ taddṛṣṭirudgīthādyaṅgeḥ || 6 || ādityādimatayaścāṅga upapatteḥ | ihāpi dṛṣṭiviśeṣacintā iti saṅgatiḥ | udgīthasya brahmavat cāramyaṃ ca pūrvapakṣayuktirārtham | aphalebhyāḥ - aphalasādhanebhyaḥ || rāddhante - mana ādau brahmaṇo dṛṣṭiviśeṣaṇatvam iti karaṇāt, na tu cāramyāt | iha tu upāsiśabdena avyavahitamudgīyapadaṃ prathamākāṃkṣitopāsyāparam | vyavahitaṃ tu ādityādipadam pāścātyaviśeṣaṇākāṃkṣā pūrakam || iti ādityādimatyadhikaraṇam -4 <5. āsīnādhikaraṇam ||> āsīnaḥ saṃbhāvat || 4-1-7 || mokṣasādhanatayā venāntaśāstraiḥ .... ... pratatranivṛttaye sāpāśraye āsīnaḥ kṛryāt || 7 || āsīnaḥ saṃbhavāt | anantarayoḥ prāsaṅgikatvāt tataḥ pūrveṇa saṅgatimāha - mokṣa iti | āsikāvacanaṃ manonukūlatābhiprāyamiti pūrvapakṣaḥ | tadavaśyaṃbhāvāt tatparihāraḥ || 7 || dhyānācca || 4-1-8 || nididhyāsitavyaḥ iti dhyāna ... ... vijātīya pratyayāntarāvyavahitamekacintanamityuktam || 8 || dhyānācca | dhyāna śabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ || 8 || acalatvaṃ cāpekṣya || 4-1-9 || niścalatvaṃ cāpekṣya pṛthivyantarikṣa ... ... niścalatva mupāsakasya āsīnasyaiva saṃbhavet || 9 || acalatvaṃ cāpekṣya | āpaḥ - taṭākādijalam | aikāgryakāryaniścalatayā sāmyam || 9 || smaranti ca || 4-1-10 || smaranti cāsīnasyaiva dhyānaṃ ... ... upaviśyāsane yuñjyādyogamātmaviśuddhaye iti || 10 || smaranti ca | spaṣṭam || 10 || yatraikāgratā tatrāviśeṣāt || 4-1-11|| ekāgratātiriktadeśakāla ... ... mano'nukūle iti vākyaśeṣāt || 11 || yatraikāgratā tatrāviśeṣāt | kālaḥ iti | tithyādiniyamo netyarthaḥ || 11 || iti āsīnadhikaraṇam - 5 <6. āprayāṇādhikaraṇam ||> āprayāṇāt tatrāpi hi dṛṣṭam || 4-1-12 || tadidamapavargasādhanamuktalakṣaṇam .... ... yāvadāyuṣaṃ brahmalokamabhisaṃpadyate iti || 12 || āprayāṇāt tatrāpi hi dṛṣṭam | saṅgatyādi sphuṭam || 12 || iti āprayāṇādhikaraṇam - 6 <7. tadadhigamādhikaraṇam ||> tadadhigama uttarapūrvāghayoraśloṣavināśau tadvyapadeśāt || 4-1-13 || evaṃ vidyāsvarūpaṃ viśodhya ... .. vidyāyāḥ duścaritivirati niṣpādyatvāvagamāt || 13 || tadadhigama uttarapūrvāghayoraśloṣavināśau tadvyapadeśāt | vidyāprāptau iti| upāsanaprārambha ityanuktiḥ atadrūpavidyānippatterapi sautratvābhiprāyanibandhanā | aśloṣavināśayoḥ uttarapūrvāgha viṣayatvaṃ yagoyatādhīnam | na hi saṃśliṣṭasya aśloṣo yuktaḥ | atastasya nāśa eva | uttaratyāśloṣaḥ | ananumave'pi nāśo dṛṣṭa ityatrāha - na ca iti || rāddhānte - viṣayabhedādavirodhaṃ nidarśayati - yathā iti | aśleṣavināśau vivṛṇoti - aghasya iti | uktasyopapannatvamāha - tadevam iti | svargādisvarūpeṇa sādhyamiti na taddhetukarmaṇaḥ pāpanivartakatvam | atra tu pratibandhanivṛttireva sādhyeti vidyā prāyaścittatulyā | prārabdhopāsanasya tatsamāptau sarvamahaṃ kṣamiṣyāmi iti saṅkalpaḥ | ato na sāṃparāyādhikaraṇavirodhaḥ | kṣāntam iti tadā saṅkalpaḥ || 13 || iti tadadhigamādhikaraṇama - 7 <8. itarādhikaraṇam ||> itarasyāpyevamasaṃśleṣaḥ pāte tu || 4-1-14 || uttarapūrvāghayorvidyayā aśleṣavināśau ... .... vidyānuguṇa dṛṣṭaphalāni sukṛtāni naśyantītyarthaḥ || 14 || itarasyāpyevamasaṃśleṣaḥ pāte tu | saṅgatyādi spaṣṭam | adhikaśaṅkāmāha -
