sṛkṛtasya iti| sautrakhaṇḍāntaramavatārayati - nanu iti | naśyanti iti | pratibandhaphalāni cet naśyanti ityarthaḥ || 14 || iti itarādhikaraṇam - 8 <9. anārabdhakāryādhikaraṇam ||> anārabdhakārye eva tu pūrve tadavadheḥ || 4-1-15 || brahmavidyotpatteḥ pūrvottarabhāvinoḥ ... .... śarīrasthiti hetubhūtasaṃskārasadbhāve pramāṇamasti || 15 || anārabdhakārye eva tu pūrve tadavadheḥ | saṅgatimāha - brahma iti | tataḥ brahmavidyotpatteḥ || rāddhānte - saṃskāravaśāt dehasthitiṃ prativakti - na ca iti || 15 || iti anārabdhakāryādhikaraṇam -9 <10. agnihotrādyadhikaraṇam ||> agnihotrādi tu tatkāryāyaiva taddarśanāt || 4-1-16 || itarasyāpyevamasaṃśleṣaḥ iti ... ... dūṣitāntaḥkaraṇasya vidyotpattireva na syāt || 16 || agnihotrādi tu tatkāryāyaiva taddarśanāt | saṅgatimāha - itarasya iti | pūrvatra ūrdhvaretassvadarśanāt nityānityasaṃyogavirodhāt, iha sukṛta phalāśleṣācca ananuṣṭheyatvaṃ parihṛtamiti na punaruktiḥ || rāddhante - tarhi sakṛdanuṣṭheyamityatrāha - vidyāyāśca iti || 16 || yadi agnihotrādisādhukṛtyā .... .... ato'nyāpi hyekeṣāmubhayoḥ || 4-1-17 || ataḥ agnihotrādisādhukṛtyāyāḥ ... ... vidyayā aśleṣavināśaśrutiśca tadviṣayā || 17 || anantarasya śaṅkāmāha - yadyagnihotrādi iti | dviṣantaḥ ityāderviṣayo mṛgyaḥ | uttarāghasyābhuktatvāt anārabdhaphalatvācca biśayatvopapatteḥ ataḥ suhṛdaḥ ityupāttam || ato'nyāpi hyekeṣāmubhayoḥ | prākkṛtaṃ vṛṣṭyannadihetoḥ paścātkṛtaṃ ca pratibaddhaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ viṣaya ityarthaḥ || 17 || anuṣṭhitasyāpi karmaṇaḥ phalapratibandha ..... yadeva vidyayeti hi || 4-1-18 || yadeva vidyayā karoti tadeva ... ... suhṛdaḥ sādhukṛtyām iti śāṭyāyanakam || 18 || anantarasūtrasaṅgatimāha - anuṣṭhitasyāpi iti | pūrvoktam - pṛthagghyapratibandhaḥ phalam ityuktam || yadeva vidyayeti hi | sphuṭam || iti agnihotrādyadhikaraṇam - 10 <11. itarakṣapaṇādhikaraṇam ||> bhogena tvitare kṣapayitvā'tha saṃpadyate || 4-1-19 || yayoḥ puṇyapāpayoḥ aśleṣavināśāvuktau ... .. suhṛdogahṇanti, pāpaṃ ca dviṣanta iti niravadyam || 19 || iti itarakṣapaṇādhikaraṇam - 11 iti śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracite śārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣye caturthasyādhyāyasya prathaḥ pādaḥ || bhogena tvitare kṣapayityavā'tha saṃpadyate | saṅgatiḥ sphuṭā | rāddhante - pūrvapakṣabījaṃ pariharati - tasya tāvat iti | atra dehatadavadhī ma śrutau | dhūtvā ityatra dehaḥ śrutaḥ, na tvavadhiḥ | ekavacanaṃ jātyabhiprāyam yathā vidhūya pāpam ityabhipretya avadhiniyamāśravaṇāt ityuktam || pūrvādhikaraṇeṣūktamarthaṃ sugrahatvāya saṃkṣipati - tadevam iti || 19 || iti itarakṣapaṇādhikaraṇam - 11 iti śrīharitakulatilakavāgvijayisūnunā śrīraṅgarājadivyājñālabdhavedavyāsāparanāmadhenena śrīmadvaradācāryapādasevāsamadhigataśrībhagavadrāmānujaviracitaśārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣyahṛdayena śrīsudarśanasūriṇā vilikhitāyāṃ śrutapradīpikāyāṃ caturthasyādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ || caturthādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || <1. vāgadhikaraṇam |> vāṅmanasi darśanācchabdācca || 4-2-1 || idānīṃ viduṣo gatiprakāraṃ cintīyitum ... ... manasā vāk saṃyujyate, na tu tatra līyate, iti parihartavyam || 1 || vāṅmanasi darśanācchabdācca | dehasthitau vidyāphalamuktam | atha gatyupakramarūpotkrāntiścintyate iti pādasaṅgatiḥ | kathañcit - vākpravṛtti - hetutvarūpāvasthālakṣaṇayeti bhāvaḥ || rāddhānte - dṛśyate hi iti | pravṛtasvakārye dāruṇi nivṛttasvakāryasyāgneriva vāco manasyantarbhāva iti bhāvaḥ | yaduktam iti | vāksaṃpatti śabdayordvayorapyamukhyatvāt paramasaṃpattiśabdāsvārasyamityarthaḥ | na ca tatrāpyatyantāsvārasyam | darśanaśabdau samuccityahetū || 1 || ata eva sarvāṇyanu || 4-2-2 || yato vāco manasā saṃyogamātraṃ .... ... apunarbhavamindriyairmanasi saṃpadyamānaiḥ iti || 2 || ata eva sarvāṇyanu | anu - paścāt || 2 || iti vāgadhikaraṇam - 1 <2. mano'dhikaraṇam |> tanmanaḥ prāṇa uttarām || 4-2-3 || tat - sarvendriyasaṃyuktaṃ, manaḥ ... .. prāṇaśabdenāpāṃ lakṣaṇā ca syāt - iti || 3 || tanmanaḥ prāṇa uttarāt | paraṃparayā - svakāraṇapṛthivīdvārā ityarthaḥ || 3 || iti mano'dhikaraṇam -2 <3. adhyakṣādhikaraṇam ||> so'dhyakṣe tadupagamādibhyaḥ || 4-2-4 || yathā vāṅmanasi saṃpadyate ... .... yamunā sāgaraṃ gacchati iti vaco na virudhyate tadvat || 4 || so'dhyakṣe tadupagamādibhyaḥ| saṅgati sphuṭā ādi śabdaḥ utkrāntipratiṣṭhāparaḥ| arthāntareṇa saṃyujya arthāntaragamane'pi anyataravāciśabdena nirdeśe dṛṣṭāntamāha - yathā iti || 4 || iti adhyakṣādhikaraṇam - 3 <4. bhūtādhikaraṇam ||> bhūteṣu tacchateḥ || 4-2-5 || prāṇastejasi iti jīvasaṃyuktasya ... .... jīvasya sañcarataḥ sarvabhūtamayatvaśruteḥ || 5 || bhūtaṣu tacchateḥ | spaṣṭā saṅgatiḥ || 5 || nanu tejaḥprabhṛtiṣu ekaikasmin ... .... naikasmin darśayato hi || 4-2-6 || naikasmin, ekaikasya ... ... tejo'bhidhīyate | ato bhūteṣveva saṃpattiḥ || 6 || antantaramavatārayati - nanu iti | naikasmin darśayato hi | tisro devatā anupraviśya tāsāṃ trivṛtaṃ trivṛtamekaikām iti sṛṣṭyarthamanupraveṣṭavyatattveṣu ekaikasya trivṛtkaraṇopadeśāt pratyakaṃ trivṛtkṛtabhūtatrayasya kāryakaratvaṃ pratīyate iti, atrivṛtkṛteṣvekena dehāraṃbhāyogāt bhūtasūkṣma sahaṃtiḥ svūkāryā iti bhāvaḥ || 6 || iti bhūtādhikaraṇam - 7 <5. āsṛtyupakramādhikaraṇam ||> samānā cāsṛtyupakramādamṛtatvaṃ cānupoṣya || 4-2-7 || iyamutkrāntiḥ kiṃ vidvadaviduṣoḥ ... .... yo brahmānubhavaḥ tadviṣayamityabhiprāyaḥ || 7 || samānā cāsṛtyupakramādamṛtatvaṃ cānupoṣya | bhāvyadhikaraṇārthadvayasya vidvadaviduṣoḥ samānatve satyapi, asyādhikaraṇasya tadīrdhvabhāvitvā bhāvaḥ tadarthasya bidūtsvavigītatvāt | ato vigītāṃśasya samānatvamupapādyate iti saṅgatiḥ || rāddhānte -utkrāntau satyāṃ hi samānatvamityatrāha - viduṣo'pi hi iti | atha samānatvamupapādayati - sā ca iti || 7 || tadāpīteḥ saṃsāravyapadeśāt || 4-2-8 || avaśyaṃ ca tat - amṛtatvam ... .... akṛtaṃ kṛtātma brahmalokamabhisaṃbhavāni iti ca || 8 || tadāpīteḥ saṃsāravyapadeśāt | caramadehāvadhi vilagbaśrutyā jīvanmukttyayoga uktaḥ || 8 || sūkṣmaṃ pramāṇataśca tathopalabdheḥ || 4-2-9 || itaśca viduṣo'pi bandhaḥ ... ... sūkṣmaśarīramanuvartate | ataśca bandho na dagdhaḥ || 9 || sūkṣmaṃ pramāṇataśca tathopasalabdheḥ | iha sūkṣma dehasthityā tadayoga uktaḥ|| nopasardenātaḥ || 4-2-10 || ataḥ yadā sarve pramucyante ... ... vacanaṃ na bandhopamardenāmṛtvaṃ vadati || 10 || nopamardenātaḥ | atra upāsanadhruvānusmṛtitva darśanarūpatvaprītirūpatvāprayāṇānuvṛttisuduṣkarma dhūnananāḍīviśeṣaniṣkramaṇamārgaviśeṣa sūkṣmadehasthityādiviṣayabahuśrutibhiḥ tadayogo'bhipretaḥ | pradhānayukttyanantaraṃ pūrvasūtreṇa nigamanaṃ kṛtam | tathā'bhyuccayayuktirucyate || 10 || asyaiva copapatterūṣmā || 4-2-11 || asya - sūkṣmaśarīrasya kvacit ... ... āsṛtyupakramāt samānotkrāntiriti suṣṭhūktam || 11 || asyaiva copapatterūṣmā | santāpayati ityādyuktasya bhaṣmaṇaḥ sārvatrikatvāt, iha kācitkopmopalambhaḥ sūkṣmadehasya kācitkasyotkrantimattvādityarthaḥ | paramaprakṛtaṃ nidamayati - tasmāt iti || 11 || punarapi viduṣa utkrāntiḥ na .... .... pratiṣedhāditi cenna śārīrāt spaṣṭo hyokeṣām || 4-2-12 || yaduktaṃ viduṣo'pyutkrāntiḥ ... .... bhūtasūkṣmavajjīvaṃ pariṣvajyagacchanti - iti pratipādayatīti niravadyam || 12 || pratiṣedhāditi cenna śarīrāt spaṣṭo hyekeṣām | taijomātrāḥ - bhūtasūkṣmāṃśān | hṛdayam - hṛdayādapakrāmatītyarthaḥ | akāmayamānādi padatrayam eṣaṇātrayarāhityaparam || rāddhānte - tasya ityādi | ṣaṣṭhyantatacchabdanirdiṣṭaḥ śārīro'stu, tatsaṃbandhināṃ prāṇānāmutkrāntyapādānaṃ śarīramevetyarthaḥ | ṣaṣṭhyāḥ karaṇatadvattālakṣaṇasaṃbandhaparatvamabhyupagamya pariharati - na iti | aprastutadharmiṇo'pādānatvasya ca klṛpteḥ varaṃ prastutasyaiṃvāpādānatāklṛptirityarthaḥ | ṣaṣṭhyā evāpādānatāparatvaṃ vaiyarthyaśaktibhyāmupapādayati - kiṃ ca iti | prasaṅgasyā niṣṭatve sati hi niṣedhyatvamityatrāha - tataśca iti | grahaḥ - rajjuḥ | mṛtyum - agnipapajayatītyarthaḥ | tarhi kathaṃ prāṇānutkrāntirityatrāha - avidupastu iti || 12 || smaryate ca ||4-2-13 || smaryate ca viduṣo'pi mūrdhanyanāḍyā ... .... brahmalokamatikramya tena yati parāṃ gatim || 13 || smaryate ca | spaṣṭam || 13 || iti āsṛtyupakramādhikaraṇam - 5 <6. parasaṃpattyadhikaraṇam ||> tāni pare tathā hyāha || 4-2-14 || sakaraṇagrāmaḥ saprāṇaḥ karaṇādhyakṣaḥ ... .... paramātmasaṃpattyā sukhaduḥkhopabhogāyāsaviśramaḥ, tadvadihāpi || 14 || tāni pare tathā hyāha | saiṣā iti | iyatyaṃśe vimatiriti sā parihṛtetyarthaḥ iti saṅgatiruktā | anyat spaṣṭam || 14 || iti parasaṃpattyadhikaraṇam - 6 <7. avibhāgādhikaraṇam ||> avibhāgo vacanāt || 4-2-15 || seyaṃ paramātmani saṃpattiḥ ... ... punastatrāvyaktādisṛṣṭyavacanācca || 15 || avibhāgo vacanāt | saṅgatiḥ spaṣṭā | tejaḥ śabdasya jīvāmātraparatve lakṣaṇā, saṃpattiśabdārthavairūpyaṃ ca | ataḥ suṣuptāviva na viśeṣyāṃśasya layaḥ | nāpi viśiṣṭasya, sūkṣmadehaśaithilyena viśeṣaṇabhūta bhūtasūkṣmāṇāṃ tatsamaṣṭau layāyogāt, tata eva tamasi layāyogāt | sūkṣmadehāraṃbhāya punaḥ avyaktādisṛṣṭyavacanāt, tadanāraṃbhe gatyanupapatteśca saṃpattiḥ saṃsargamātramityarthaḥ | avyaktādisṛṣṭyavacanācca iti kalpakābhāvaścoktaḥ || iti avibhāgādhikaraṇam - 7 <8. tadokodhikaraṇam ||> tadoko'grajvalanaṃ tatprakāśitadvāro vidyāsāmarthyāt taccheṣagatyanusmṛtiyogācca hārdānugṛhīnaḥ śatādhikayā || 4-2-16 || evaṃ gatyupakramāvadhi vidvadaviduṣoḥ ... ... vidvān tāṃ nāḍīṃ vijānātīti tayā viduṣo gatirupapadyate || 16 || tadoko'grajvalanaṃ tatprakāśitadvāro vidyāsāmarthyāt taccheṣagatyanusmṛtiyogācca hārdānugṛhītaḥ śatādhikayā || saṅgatimāha - evam iti | spaṣṭam || 16 || iti tadoko'dhikaraṇam - 8 <9. raśmyanusārādhikaraṇam ||> śśamyanusārī || 4-2-17 || viduṣo hṛdayācchatādhikayā ... .... viduṣāṃ raśbhyanusāreṇaiva brahmaprāptirastyeva || 17 || raśbhyanusārī | sphuṭaṃ saṅgatyādikam || 17 || iti raśmyanusārādhikaraṇam - 9 <10. niśādhikaraṇam ||> niśi neti cenna saṃbandhasya yāvaddehabhāvitvāt darśayati ca || 4-2-18 || idamidānīṃ cintyate - viduṣo .... .... divā ca śuklapakṣaśca ityādivacanamavidvadviṣayam || 18 || niśi neti cenna saṃbandhasya yāvaddehabhāvitvāt darśayati ca | saṅgatirgatā| rāddhānte - anekadehabhogyasyaprārabdhasya kathaṃ yāvaddehabhāvitvam? tathā'pi ayuktaṃ karmāntaraṃ saṃbhavati | kathaṃ nindoktiḥ parihṛtā syāt? tasyāścāvaiyarthyaṃ kathamityatrāha - etaduktam iti || 18 || iti niśādhikaraṇam - 10 <11. dakṣiṇāyanādhikaraṇam ||> acaścāyane'pi dakṣiṇe || 4-2-19 || niśi mṛtasyāpi viduṣo brahmaprāptau ... ... dharpravartanāya uttarāyaṇaprāśastyapradarśanārthaḥ tathāvidhācāraḥ || 19 || acaścāyane'pi dakṣiṇe | saṅgatyādi spaṣṭam | niśi dakṣiṇaṇāyane ca mṛtasya dehasya caramatvaṃ na syāt | tathā sati hi bandhakakarmābhāva iti cenna - dakṣiṇāyane mṛtasyāpi vākyaśeṣe brahmaṇo mahimānamāpnoti iti brahmaprāptiśravaṇāditi bhāvaḥ || na ca atha yo dakṣiṇe ityadhikāryantaraviṣayam, aprastutatvāt; mahimānāvabhijayati ityaikyapratīteśca | na ca mahimānau vidvān ityanvayaḥ; vidvacchabdasya tasyaivaṃ viduṣaḥ iti prakṛtādhikāriparatvāt jayateḥ sakarmakatvasya svataḥ prāptatvāt lokamabhijayati ityādi śrautaprayogācca || 19 || nanu ca viduṣo mumūrṣūn prati ... .... yoginaḥ prati smaryete smārte caite || 4-2-20 || nātra mumūrṣūn prati ... ... vidyāniṣṭhān prati vidhīyate, na mumūrṣūn prati maraṇakālaviśeṣaḥ || 20 || iti dakṣiṇāyanādhikaraṇam - 11 iti śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracite śrīśārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣye caturthasyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || anantarasūtramavatārayati - nanu ca iti | yoginaḥ prati smaryete smārte caite | smārta padārthamāha - smṛti iti | smartavyatayetyarthaḥ | smartum iti tat sphuṭīkṛtam | upakramākhyāvayavāt mahāvākyasvārasyaprābalyamabhiprayatā ante madhye ca mārgaparatvaṃ darśatam || 20 || iti dakṣiṇāyanādhikaraṇam - 11 iti śriharitakulatilakavāgvijayisūnunā śrīraṅgarājadivyājñālabdhavedevyāsāparanāmadheyena śrīmadvaradācāryapādasevāsamadhigataśrībhagavadrāmānujaviracitaśārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣyahṛdayena śrīsudarśanasūriṇā viracitāyāṃ śrutapradīpikāyāṃ caturthasyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || caturthadhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || <1. arciṃrādyadhikaraṇam ||> arcirādinā tatprathiteḥ || 4-3-1 || viduṣa utkrāntasya nāḍīviśeṣeṇa ... .. anyatrāpi sarvatrāgnyādityādayaḥ pratyabhijñāyante || 1 || arcirādinā tatprathiteḥ | pādasaṅgatimāha - viduṣaḥ iti | brahmavitsaṃbandhajñāpanāya yathā ityādyupāttam | śavyam - śavārham | anekarūpatvāt - kramabhedāt kramibhedācceti bhāvaḥ || rāddhānte - alpāntaram - saṃvatsara sthāne devaloka śruteriti bhāvaḥ | ya evametadviduḥ, ye ceme araṇye śraddhāṃ satyaptupāsate iti śrutirmārgaikye pramāṇam | pratyabhijñānam anugrāhakam || neyaṃ śrutiranupadiṣṭamārgaviśeṣopāsanaviṣayā | mārgabhede saṅkocaḥ, saṅkocānmārgabhedaḥ ityanyonyaśrayaṇāt | aikyaṃ tu pratyabhijñasiddham | athaitayoḥ pathoḥ iti devayānapitṛyānamārgadvitvaśrutisvārasyācca mārgaukatvaṃ siddham | eṣāṃ bhāṣye'nuktiḥ bhāṣyāntaroktatvāt | sarvaparavidyāsu brahmatatpraptirūpaphale pratyabhijñāte'pi guṇānantyādupasaṃhārāśakteḥ vidyaikyānupagamaḥ; mārge tu dvādaśapadārthānatirekeṇa cintāyogyatvāt pratyabhijñayā aikyopagamo yuktaḥ || iti arcirādyadhikaraṇam -1 <2. vāyvadhikaraṇam ||> vāyumabdādaviśeṣaviśeṣābhyām || 4-3-2 || arcirādinaiva gacchanti vidvāṃsaḥ .... ... yo'yaṃ pavata eṣa devānāṃ gṛhāḥ iti || 2 || vāyumabdādaviśeṣaviśeṣābhyām | saṅgitiḥ sphuṭā | saṃśayaṃ vakttuṃ sthalaṃ śodhayati - tatra ityādinā | māsānantaraṃ saṃvatsaradevalokayoḥ kramaṃ niścitya devalokavāyvoḥ saṃśayaḥ | viśeṣābhāvācca iti | abdadevalokayoḥ pañcamyuktakramasāmye'pi, abdasya māsānantaratve nyūnakālānantaramadhikakāla niveśarūpo viśeṣaḥ prāguktaḥ iha tu na tathetyarthaḥ || rāddhānte - devaloka śabdaḥ sāmānyaśabdaḥ | lokaparatvavyāvṛttyarthamāha - vāyuścāsau iti || 2 || iti vāyvadhikaraṇam - 2 <3. varuṇādhikaraṇam ||> taṭito'dhi varuṇaḥ saṃbandhāt || 4-3-3 || koṣītikināṃ, sa etaṃ devayānaṃ ... .... varuṇāduparīndrādīrniveśayitavya iti || 3 || taṭito'dhi varuṇaḥ saṃbandhāt | nirūpitanirūpaṇīyāṃśa jñāpanārthaṃ pūrvoktakrameṣu kauṣītakivākyāvigānam, vigītāṃśe tasya daurbalyaṃ cāha - kaiṣītakinām ityādinā | upadeṃśāvaiyarthyāya iti | kramibādhāt kramabādho nyāyya iti bhāvaḥ | indraprajāpatī api iti | kramadvayabhaṅgāt ekakramabhaṅgo varamiti bhāvaḥ || rāddhānte - salisādadho vidyuta, tasyāḥ sphuṭadṛśyatvāt | tayoriva tadabhimānidevatayoḥ saṃbandha ityarthaḥ | meghodare taṭidanvayo'stu; kathaṃ tena pāṭhakramaṃ bādhitvā taṭidupari varuṇaniveśaḥ? kathaṃ vā indraprajāpatyostatrāvakāśa ityatrāha - etaduktam iti | arthakramasya pāṭhakramādbalīyastayā taṭidupari varuṇaḥ | kauṣītakipāṭhānurodhāt āgantūnāmante niveśanayāt tadupari indraprajāpatī ityarthaḥ || 3 || iti varuṇādhikaraṇam - 3 <4. ātivāhikādhikaraṇam ||> ātivāhikāstalliṅgāt || 4-3-4 || idamidānīṃ cintyate - kimarciṃrādayaḥ .... .. arcirādyātmūtān abhimānidevatāviśeṣāt | taṃ pṛthivyabravīy itivat || 4 || ātivāhikāstalliṅgāt bhogabhūmerapyavācakāḥ ityatrāha - ete eva iti | lokā aharādisaṃjñā iti pūrvapakṣiṇo hṛdam | viparītaṃ kasmānnetyatrāha - ata eva iti | vijihīte ityapi lokaliṅgamiti bhāvaḥ || rāddhānte - arcirādiśabdāḥ kathaṃ devatāvācinaḥ ityatrāha - vadanti ca iti || 4 || yadyevaṃ tatpuruṣo'mānavaḥ sa ... ... vaidyutenaiva tatastacchateḥ || 4-3-5 || tataḥ vidyutaḥ upari, vaidyutena ... .... teṣāmapyātivāhikatvenānvayo vidyate eva || 5 || anantaramavatārayati - yadyevam iti | vaidyutenaiva tatastacchateḥ || spaṣṭam || 5 || iti ātivāhikādhikaraṇam - 4 || <5. kāryādhikaraṇam ||> kāryaṃ bādarirasya gatyupapatteḥ || 4-3-6 || arcirādinaiva gacchati vidvāt ... .... ato'rcirādirāti vāhikagaṇastameva nayati || 6 || kāryaṃ bādarirasya gatyupapatteḥ | saṅgatimāha - arcirādinaiva iti | upāstinayatyoḥ karma caturmukhaḥ | sarvagatatvāt sārvajñyādiguṇapūrteḥ saṃbandhasya ca kvācitkatbābhāvāt na gatyapekṣā iti paripūrṇādi padābhiprāyaḥ upāstivaiyarthyaṃ - parihapati - nityaprāpta iti || 6 || viśeṣitatvācca || 4-3-7 || puruṣo'mānava etya brahmalokān ... .... hiraṇyagarbhasya samīpagamanamarcirādinā gataḥ pratyabhisandhatte || 7 || viśeṣitatvācca | 1 etaṃ brahmalokam ityatra svīkṛtakarmadhāraya vyāvṛtyarthamāha - bahuvacanena ca iti || 7 || nanvevaṃ tatpuruṣo'mānavaḥ sa enān ... .... sāmīpyāt tu tadvyapadeśaḥ || 4-3-8 || yo brahmāṇaṃ vidadhāti iti hiraṇyagarbhasya ... .... gatyanupapattiviśeṣaṇādibhiḥ uktairhetumiḥ niścīyate ityarthaḥ || 8 || sāmīpyāt tu tadvyapadeśaḥ | viśeṣaṇādibhiḥ iti ādi śabdena gatyupapattiḥ || 8 || atha syāt arcirādinā hiraṇyagarbhaprāptau .... ... kāryātyaye tadadhyakṣeṇa sahāta paramabhidhānāt || 4-3-9 || kāryasya - brahmalokasya atyaye ... ... parāmṛtāt parimucyanti sarve iti vacanāccāvagamyate || 9 || kāryātyaye tadadhyakṣeṇa sahātaḥ paramabhidhānāt | ayamarthaḥ kiṃmānaka ityatrāha - te brahma iti | parāmṛtāt - parāmṛtaṃ prāpya | lyablope pañcamī || 9 || smṛteśca || 4-3-10 || smṛteścāyamartho'vagamyate .. ... kāryamupāsīnamevārcirādiko gaṇo nayatīti bādarermatam || 10 || smṛteśca | parasya - brahmāyuṣaḥ || 10 || atra jaiminiḥ pakṣāntaraparigraheṇa pratyavatiṣṭhate - paraṃ jaiminirmukhyatvāt || 4-3-11 || paraṃ brahmopāsīnānarcirādirnayati ... ... aprākṛtāśca lokā nātyantāya na santi, śrutismṛtītihāsapurāṇaprāmāṇyāt || 11 || pakṣāntaraparigraheṇa - pūrvapakṣādanyena, na tu kṛtsnasiddhāntenetyarthaḥ | paraṃ jaiminirmukhyatvāt | niśśeṣa iti | vidyāniṣpattiḥ - vidyāyāḥ kāryakaratvadaśāpattiḥ | nitarāṃ vikāso vā | nityatve'pi kāla viśeṣāpekṣāvat sarvagatatve'pi deśaviśeṣāpekṣā yukteti bhāvaḥ | utkrāntyanupapattyā na gatirityatrāha - viduṣaḥ iti . svecchāparikalpitāḥ - nityecchāparikalpitāḥ | nātyantāya iti na na santi - na santi iti na; santyeva atyantaṃ santyevetryarthaḥ | tadakṣare parame vyoman ityādimānadārḍhyaṃ vivakṣitam || 11 || darśanācca || 4-3-12 || darśayati śrutiḥ mūrdhanyanāḍyā ... .... paraṃ jyotirupasaṃpadya svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyate iti || 12 || darśanācca | utthāya iti | devayānena gatisiddhiḥ || 12 || yaduktaṃ prajāpateḥ samāṃ veśma prapadye ... .... na ca kārye pratyabhisandhiḥ || 4-3-13 || na yācaṃ pratyabhisandhiḥ ... ... parameva brahmopāsīnamarcirādirātivāhiko gaṇo nayatīti jaiminermatam || 13 || na ca kārye pratyabhisāndhiḥ | sphuṭam || 13 || idānīṃ bādarāyaṇastu bhagavāt svamatena siddhāntamāha - apratīkālambanān nayatīti bādarāyaṇaḥ ubhayathā ca doṣāt tatkratuśca || 4-3-14 || apratīkālambanāna - pratīkālambanavyatiriktān ... ... acinmiśropāsane tatkratunyāyāccārcirādinā gatirbrahmaprāptiśca na vidyate || 14 || apratīkālambanāt nayatīti bādarāyaṇaḥ ubhayathā ca doṣāt tatkratuśca| jaiminimatāt ko bheda ityatrāha - etaduktam iti | na ca ityatra pratīkālambana śabdo gobalīvardanayāt dṛṣṭayupāsakaparaḥ, kāryamupāsīnān iti pṛthagukteḥ | tadetadāha - iti | kāryamupāsīnasya kāryameva prāpyam, na paraṃ brahma; tatkratu nayāt | ataḥ paraprāpako'rcirādirna tasyetyarthaḥ || apratīkālambanān nayati iti pratijña vyāhanyena | tadya ittham ityasya pratīkā lambanaviṣayatvāt ityatrāha - pañcāgni iti | ye ca ityuktayordvayorapi apratīkālambanatvasādhanāya tatkratuśca iti sūtrakhaṇḍaḥ | phalasya yathopāsanatvāt brahmaprāptiphalopāstiniṣṭhaḥ pañcāgnividapi brahmopāsananiṣṭhaḥ | ato brahmaprāptyānuguṇayāt pṛthaṅnirdeśavaiyarthyocca yathokta eva tayorvibhāgāḥ | ke punaḥ pratīkālambanā ityatrāha - nāmādi iti || 14 || tamimaṃ viśeṣaṃ śrutireva darśayatītyāha - viśeṣaṃ ca darśayati || 4-3-15 || yāvannāmno gataṃ tatrāsya yathākāmacāraḥ ... ... prakṛtiviyuktaṃ brahmātmakamupāsīnānātivāhiko gaṇo nayatīti siddham || 15 || iti kāryādhikaraṇam - 5 iti śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracite śārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣye caturthasyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || viśeṣaṃ ca darśayati | nāmno gatam - devādināmagocaraḥ | upasaṃharati - tasmāt iti || brahmaṇā saha iti smṛtiḥ na arcirādigatapuruṣaviṣayā | kiṃ tu caturmakhalokasthayogiviṣayā | te brahma ityasya ca niṣādasthapatinayāt brahmākhyaloke vartamānāḥ caramadehānte parāmṛtāt prasannāt brahmaṇa eva hetoḥ parimucyante ityarthaḥ | karmadhārayasya hetau pañcamyāśca svārasyāt || 15 || iti kāryādhikaraṇam - 5 iti haritakulatilakavāgvijayisūnunā śrīraṅgarājadivyājñābdhavedavyāsāparanāmadheyena śrīmadvāradācāryapādasevāsamadhigata śrīmagavadrāmānujaviracitaśārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣyahṛdayena śrīsudarśanasūriṇā vilikhitāyāṃ śrutapradīpikāthāṃ caturthādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || catirthādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ || <1. saṃpadyāvirbhāvādhikaraṇam ||> saṃpadyāvirbhāvaḥ svena śabdāt || 4-4-1 || paraṃ brahmopāsīnānāmātmānaṃ ca prakṛtiviyuktaṃ .... ... svenarūpeṇa iti viśeṣaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, aviśeṣaṇe'pi tasya svakīyarūpatvasiddheḥ || 1 || saṃpadyāvirbhāvaḥ svena śabdāt | pādasaṅgatimāha - param iti | rūpeṇa - ākāreṇa | na ca duḥkha iti | duḥkhanivṛttiriṣṭā sukhanivṛttiraniṣṭā iti tadubhayānvayāt mokṣasya pumarthāpumarthamiśratvaprasaṅgaḥ iti bhāvaḥ | anarthakaṃ syāt iti | abhiniṣpattiśabdānarthakyam ityarthaḥ || svena śabdaḥ kathamityatrā - svena iti | sva śabdo'sādhāraṇaparaḥ; na tvasādhyatvaparaḥ abhiniṣpattivacanāt | rūpeṇa abhiniṣpadyate - rūpaviśiṣṭatayā sādhyate; rūpaṃ sādhyamityarthaḥ || rāddhānte - anarthakaṃ syāt iti | na hyanyasya rūpeṇānyo'bhiniṣpadyate iti asādhāraṇyasyārthasiddhatvāt svena śabdānarthakyamityarthaḥ || 1 || yat tu - uktaṃ svarūpasya nityaprāptatvāt ... ... muktaḥ pratijñānāt || 4-4-2 || karmasaṃbandhatatkṛtadehādivinirmuktaḥ ... .... yukttyā'yamartho niṣpadyate ityādiṣu || 2 || anantarasūtramavatārayati - yata tu uktam iti | muktaḥ pratijñānāt | mukta iti pratijñāpadaṃ vyācaṣṭe - karma iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - ataḥ iti | prāgasiddhatirodhinivṛttivācitvāt nābhiniṣpatti śabdavaiyarthyamityarthaḥ | sā hi iti| sā - tarodhinivṛttiḥ | pratijñātā nivṛttatirodhānaṃ svarūpaṃ pratijñātamityarthaḥ | tadvivarītumāha - kuta iti | ya ātmā ityādi | etam iti padasya guṇāṣṭakaviśiṣṭaprakṛtaparatvāt, guṇāṣṭakasya jagarādau tirohitatvāt, pratiparyāyama etam ityuktiḥ akarmatirohitasvābhāvikarūpābhiprāyā | śroturāśayaparīkṣārthaṃ jāgarādikathanamityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha - ataḥ iti | śabdasya vācakatvamāha - svarūpāvirbhāve'pi iti | idamekaṃ muniṣpannam ityādi draṣṭavyam || yaccoktam - ātmasvarūpasya muṣuptau ... .... ātmā prakaraṇāt || 4-4-3 || anantaramavatārayati - yaccoktam iti | ātmā prakaraṇāt | paraviṣayatva śaṅkāyāmāha - idaṃ ca iti | ānandasya hetvapekṣā na ānandatvakṛtā; kiṃ tu svābhāvikānandasya tirohitatvāt saṃsāradaśāyāṃ tadapekṣā| muktau svataḥ siddhasya āvirbhāva eveti na tasyopādhyapekṣā | ato na mokṣaśāstrasyāpumarthaparyavasāyitvamityarthaḥ || 3 || iti saṃpadyāvirbhāvādhikaraṇam - 1 <2. avibhāgena dṛṣṭatvādhikaraṇam |> avibhāgena dṛṣṭatvāt || 4-4-4 || kimayaṃ paraṃ jyotirupasannaḥ sarvabandhavinirmuktaḥ ... ... adhikaṃ tu bhedanirdeśāt adhikopadeśāt ityādi ca || 4 || avibhāgena dṛṣṭatvāt | saṅgatiḥ spaṣṭā | sāmyasādharmya śabdau vacanasthatvādupāttau, nārthabhedāt | saha śrut sāmyasārdhmo kttyā ca śrīrodanayoriva raktayoriva ca mukto svaniṣṭhatvāvagamāt muktadaśāvasthitarūpasya tāttvikalatvāt upāyaparavākyādīnāṃ tadvaruddhārthaparatvāyogāt svātmakatvena brahmanubhavo na yukta iti abhedaśrutyarthākṣepeṇa utthānam || rāddhānte - dṛṣṭatvamastu; tataḥ kimityatrāha - svātmānaḥ iti | saha iti| 4 brahmaparyantatvenānubhavaḥ sahaśruteḥ bhogyasāhityaparatvādupapadyate ityarthaḥ | muktiviṣayavākyeṣveva abhedadarśanāt tasya ghaṭakaśrutinirvāhitabhedaśrutyavirodhitvāt svātmaśarīrakabrahmanubhava iti siddhāntaḥ | vyākhyātrantaramate pūrvaparavaighaṭayamāha - brahmaprakāratayā iti || 4 || iti avibhāgena dṛṣṭatvādhikaraṇam -2 <3. brāhmādhikaraṇam |> brāhmeṇa jaiminirupanyāsādibhyaḥ || 4-4-5 || pratyagātmanaḥ paraṃ jyotirupasaṃpadya ... .... vijñānamātrasvarūpattvaṃ na saṃbhavatīti jaiminermatam || 5 || brāhyeṇa jaiminirupanyāsādibhyaḥ prathamādhikaraṇenāsya saṅgatimāha - pratyagātmanaḥ iti | brāhmatvaṃ kathamityatrāha - apahatapātmatvādayo hi iti | jñānatve jñānādyaśrayatvāyogagāt svarūpaṃ jaḍamiti jaiminermatam || 5 || citi tanmātreṇa tadātmakatvādityauḍulomiḥ || 4-4-6 || caitanyamātramevāsya svarūpamiti ... ..... citi tanmātrarūpeṇāvirbhāva ityauḍulomermatam || 6 || citi tanmātreṇa tadātmakatvādityauḍulomiḥ | tṛtīyānirdeśa aupacārikaḥ | vikārasukha iti | ādi śabdāt upekṣā| satyakāmatvam kādācātkasukharāhityam | satyasaṅkalpatvam - upekṣārāhityam | na hyupekṣakaḥ satyasaṅkalpaḥ iti pūrvapakṣiṇo bhāvaḥ || 6 || saṃprati bhagavāt bādarāyaṇaḥ svamatena siddhāntamāha - evamapyupanyāsāt pūrvabhāvādavirodhaṃ bādarāyaṇaḥ || 4-4-7 || evamapi - vijñānamātrasvarūpatvapratipādane satyapi .... ... sarvatra vijñānasvarūpatvam; svaprakāśasvarūpatvamityarthaḥ || 7 || evamapyupanyāsāt pūrvabhāvādavirodhaṃ bādarāyaṇaḥ | guṇāṣṭakavākye satyapi hi tatpūrvapakṣitamiti śaṅkāyāṃ tātparyamāha - tulya iti | eva kāro vākyaśeṣaḥ, na svatantaraḥ; avadhāraṇasya avadyāraṇīyaviśeṣa sākāṃkṣatvāt | tena bahūnāṃ śiṣiṇāṃ vākyānāṃ na bhaṅgo nyāyyaḥ | ataḥ eva kārabhaṅgena vākyadvayārthāvirodho neya ityarthaḥ | vastuvirodhaḥ - jñānasya jñānādyāśrayatvāyogaḥ | saḥ pūrvameva parihataḥ | aśavayasya - bāghitu maśakyasya || evamapi ityādivākyādeva suvyaktatvaṃ tadekadeśadṛṣṭantavākyenopapādayati - sa yathā iti | dārṣṭāntike'pyavirodhamāha - na caivam iti | dṛṣṭāntavākye'pyavirodhaḥ kathamityatrāha - yathā iti | dṛṣṭāntavākyagatāvadhāraṇasya ko'rthaḥ, kastatropajīvyāṃśa ityatrāha - idamatra vākya iti | vijñānasvarūpatvaṃ vivṛṇoti - svaprakāśa iti || 7 || iti brāhmādhikaraṇam - 3 <4. saṅkalpādhikaraṇam ||> saṅkalpādeva tacchateḥ || 4-4-8 || muktaḥ paraṃ brahmopasaṃpadya ... .... vijñānaghana eva itivat vyavasthāpanaṃ kriyate || 8 || saṅkalpādeva tacchateḥ | saṅgatimāha - mukta iti | prayatra śabda saṅkalpavyatiriktavyāpāraparaḥ | eva kāraḥ ayogavyavacchedakaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ | rāddhānte - saṅkocakābhāvāt anyayogamapi vyavacchinatti ityabhiprāyaḥ || ata eva cānanyādhipatiḥ || 4-4-9 || yato muktaḥ satyasaṅkalpaḥ, ata eva .... .... ata eva sa svarāṭ bhavati ityucyate || 9 || ata eva cānanyādhipatiḥ | satyasaṅkalpahetukaṃ guṇāntaramihoktam | ananyādhipatiḥ - paramātmavyatiriktaṃ prati na paratantra iti bhāvaḥ, anyathā ananya śabdavaiyarthyāt | arthaṇāha - ata eva iti || iti saṅkalpādhikaraṇam - 4 <5. abhāvādhikaraṇam ||> abhāvaṃ bādarirāha hyevam || 4-4-10 || kiṃ muktasya dehendriyāṇi na santi ... .... iti muktasyā śarīratvaṃ hyāha śrutiḥ || 10 || abhāvaṃ bādarirāha hyovam | saṅgatirvicāreṇa sphuṭā || 10 || bhāvaṃ jaiminirvikalpāmananāt || 4-4-11 || muktasya śarīrendriyabhāvaṃ jaiminiḥ ..... .... tadeva hi śarīraṃ priyāprayahetuḥ || 11 || bhāvaṃ jaiminirvikalpāmananāt | aśarīratve'pi priyāpriyayoḥ karmamūlatvāt karmārabdhadehaniṣedha ityarthaḥ || 11 || bhagavāṃstu bādarāyaṇaḥ svamatena siddhāntamāha - dvāraśāhavadubhayavidhaṃ bādarāyaṇo'taḥ || 4-4-12 || saṅkalpādeva ityetadataḥśabdena ... .... upaitiyajaticodanābhyāṃ saṅkalpabhedena satramahīnaṃ ca bhavati || 12 || dvādaśāhavadubhayavidhaṃ bādarāyaṇo'taḥ upairtiyajaticodanābhyām | yajamānabahutvaikatvābhyāṃ ca satramahīnaṃ ca dvādaśāhaṃ tadvadityarthaḥ || 12 || yadā śarīrādyupakaraṇavattvam ... .... tanvabhāve sandhyavadupapatteḥ || 4-4-13 || svenaiṃva sṛṣṭatanuprabhṛtyupakaraṇābhāve ... ... līlāpravṛtteneśvareṇa sṛṣṭaiḥ pitṛlokādibhirlilārasaṃ bhuṅkte || 13 || anantarasūtraṃ saṅgamayati - yadā iti | tanvabhāve sandhyavadupapatteḥ | paramapuruṣasṛṣṭaiḥ - advārakasṛṣṭaiḥ || 13 || bhāvo jāgradvat || 4-4-14 || svasaṅkalpādeva sṛṣṭatanuprabhṛti .... .... svapitṛlokādikaṃ svayameva sṛjantīti sarvamupapannam || 14 || bhāve jāgradvat | muktasya pitrādisargeṇa, brahmaṇi bhogyatāvaikalyam, asyānyaparatvaṃ, pitrādīcchāyāḥ karmahetukatvaṃ ca parihān sadvārakādvārakapitrādisṛṣṭeḥ tallīlāntargatatvamāha - paramapuruṣo'pi iti || 14 || nanu - ātmā amuparimāṇa ityuktam ... .... pradīpavadāveśastathā hi darśayati || 4-4-15 || yathā pradīpasyaikasyaikasmin deśe .... .... amuktasya karmaṃ niyāmakam| muktasya tu sveccheti viśeṣaḥ || 15 || anantarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - nanu iti | pradīpavadāveśastathā hi darśayati | tarhi jñānena vastvantarāṇyapyadhitiṣṭhedityatrāha - ityān iti | ātmābhimānānuguṇyam - pravartakatvaśaktivaiśiṣṭyam | śarīraṃ preryam | idamiti grahaṇānuguṇatvam - prakāśakatvaśaktimātrānvitatvam | dharmeṇa anekatravyāptiviṣayā śrutiḥ | saubharyādibhyo muktasya ko bhedaḥ? anekadehādhiṣṭhānakṣamaścet pūrvāvasthāyāmapi karotu ityatrāha - amuktasya iti || 15 || nanu - paraṃ brahma prāptasyāntarabāhyajñānalopaṃ .... ..... svāpyayasaṃpattyoranyatarāpekṣamāviṣkṛtaṃ hi || 4-4-16 || nedaṃ vacanaṃ muktaviṣayam .... .... vacanaṃ svāpyayasaṃpattyoranya tarāpekṣam || 16 || anantarasya śaṅkāmāha - nanu iti | svāpyayasaṃpattyoranyatarāpekṣamāviṣkṛtaṃ hi | satā somya iti brahmasaṃpatteḥ prasiddhatvāt, utkrāntau brahmasaṃpattivākyaṃ darśitam - tejaḥ parasyām iti | asya mṛtiviṣayatvaṃ vāṅmanasi ityādinā jñāpitam | iti vacanāt vidyete ityanvayaḥ || sūtrakhaḍāntaraṃ vyācaṣṭe - suṣupti iti | satā somya tejaḥ parasmām ityubhayamihānusandheyam || 16 || iti abhāvādhikaraṇam - 5 <6. jagadvyāpāravarjādhikaraṇam ||> jagadvyāpāravarjaṃ prakaraṇādasannihitatvācca || 4-4-17 || kiṃ muktasyaiśvaryaṃ jagatsṛṣṭyādi paramapuruṣāsādhāraṇaṃ ... ... muktasya sannidhānamasti, yena jagadvyāpārastasyāpi syāt || 17 || jagadvyāpāravarjaṃ prakaraṇādasannihitatvācca | jagatsṛṣṭyādi sarveśvaratvam iti | īśvaratvaprakāro hi sṛṣṭyādiḥ | ata evamuktam | satyasaṅkalpatāvicārarūpatvāt saṅgatiḥ || rāddhānte - nirvyāja śabdo yathāvasthitaparaḥ | kanyā manaḥ, prakāśakatvāt | kanatirhi dīptyarthaḥ | sautrahetudvayena brahmalakṣaṇasya kāraṇatvasya avyāptyativyāptivyudāsaḥ || 17 || pratyakṣopadeśānneti cennā''dhikārikamaṇḍalasthokteḥ || 4-4-18 || sa svarāḍ bhavati tasya sarveṣu lekeṣu ... .... ... anubhavatītyanena vākyenocyate; na jagadvyāpāraḥ || 18 || paraprakaraṇe jagadvyāpāroktirmuktasya mā bhūt, svaprakaraṇe tvastītyatrāha - pratyakṣopadeśānneti cennā''dhikārikamaṇḍalasthokteḥ | akarmavaśyasva kathaṃ brahmānubhavavyatiriktāpekṣetyatrāha - akarmapratihata iti | sūtrāryaṃ nigamayati - tadevam iti || 18 || yadi saṃsārivat mukto'pi ... ... vikārāvarti ca tathā hi sthitimāha - || 4-4-19 || vikāre - janmādike na vartate iti ... ... kāmacāraḥ ityādinocyate; na muktasya jagadvyāpāraḥ || 19 || anantarasūtramavatārayati - yadi iti | anityabhogatvaśaṅkā parihniyate - vikārāvarti ca tathā hi sthitimāha - vikāravarti | vikārāḥ . spaṣṭam | anubhavatu, tataḥ kimityatrāha - tadvibhūti iti | tathā hi iti vyākhyeyam | tadvyākhyānamukhena brahmānubhavitṛtve mānaṃ darśitam | vibhūtestadantarbhāve mānaṃ darśayati - tasmin iti | phalitamāha - ataḥ iti || 19 || darśayataścaivaṃ pratyakṣānumāne || 4-4-20 || asya pratyagātmano muktasya ... ... satyasaṅkalpatvaṃ paramapuruṣasāmyaṃ ca jagadvyāpāravarjam || 20 || paraviṣayāṇi niyantṛtvādiparavākyānyapi bhogaparāṇi syuḥ | na cet jīvaviṣayāṇyapi niyantṛtvādiparāṇi syurityatrāha - - darśayataścaivaṃ pratyakṣānumāne| bhīṣā'smāt ityādi | jīvaviṣayavākyānāmiva anyanirvāho na śakyate iti bhāvaḥ | eṣa sarveśvaraḥ ityādi | asaṅkocāt muktasya ca niyāmyatvasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | muktasya viśeṣato niyāmyatvaṃ darśayati - tathā iti| brahma - jīvaḥ | amṛtaṃ - mokṣaḥ | śāśvata dharmaḥ - jñānam | sukham - ānandaḥ || anyādhīnatvanityatvavirodhamāśaṅkya pariharati - yadyapi ityādinā | tasya - apahatapātmatvādeḥ, tathāvidhatvam - svābhāvikatvam | tasya - pratyagātmanaḥ tadāyattatām upapādayatiṃ - paramapuruṣasya iti | na paraṃ muktasvarūpādi; anyadapi nityaṃ vastu tadadhīnasvarūpādhikamityāha - evam iti|| nirupādhikaparaśeṣaṃ svamaparokṣayato muktasya ātmābhimānānanuguṇatvāt niyantṛtvaṃ pratikūlamiti niyantṛtvābhāvo nānāndavaikalyāvahaḥ; api tu tatpauṣkalyāvahaḥ | ātmābhimānānuguṇatvena bhogyavyavasthā nṛpaśvādiṣu dṛṣṭā || 20 || bhogamātrasāmyaliṅgācca || 4-4-21 || brahmayāthātmyānubhavarūpabhogamātre muktasya ... .... śrutyānuguṇyena varṇanīyamiti jagadvyāpāravarjameva muktaiśvaryam || 21 || bhogamātrasābhyaliṅgācca | pūrvasūtre ānandayāti sarvamidaṃ praśāsti ityananyathāsiddhavacanavirodhāt upādanatānupapattyādiyuktivirodhācca sāmyasatyasaṅkalpatvaśrutyoḥ saṅkocayitavyatvumuktaṃ gobalīvardanayāt | iha tu sāmānyato'vagataṃ sāmyaṃ chāgapaśunayāt vākyāntaradṛṣṭabhogalakṣaṇasāmye paryavasyet niyāmyatvādiśrutyānuguṇyāccetyuktam | adhikaraṇārthamupasaṃharati ataḥ iti || 21 || yadi paramapuruṣāyatte muktaiśvaryaṃ ... .... anāvṛttiḥ śabdādanāvṛttiḥ śabdāt || 4-4-22 || yathā nikhilaheyapratyanīkakalyāṇaikatāno ... ... vāsudevaḥ sarvamiti sa mahātmā surdurlabhaḥ iti | sūtrābhyāsaḥ śāstraparisamāptiṃ dyotayati | iti sarvaṃ samañjasam || 22 || iti jagadvyāpāravarjādhikaraṇam - 6 iti śrībhagavadrāmānujaviracite śārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣye caturthasyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ || || samāptaścādhyāyaḥ || śāstraṃ ca parisamāptam || anantarasūtraśaṅkāmavatārayati - yadi iti | anāvṛttiḥ śabdādanāvṛttiḥ śabdāt | bhagavatā muktasyāparityājyatvopapādakatayā tasya brahmānubhavajihāsānudayajñāpakatayā mānasiddhatve dṛṣṭāntatayā beyapratyanīkatvā diguṇoktiḥ | aicchapitṛlokādivyāvṛttyarthaṃ duḥkhālayam ityādyupāttam | ataḥ karmakṛtāvṛttiḥ niṣiddhyate; na punaḥ imān lokān ityupaniṣadavagata sañcāraḥ || phadāhṛtamānasya anugrāhakamāha - na ca ityādinā | puruṣāntareṇa vā svecchayā vā karmaṇā vā bhagavatā vā nivṛttiḥ | tatra prathamaḥ kalpaḥ samābhyadhikarāhityādīśvarasya nirastaḥ | na cocchinna ityādinā dvitīya tṛtīyaśirasī pratyukte; cetanasya niravadhikānandajihāsānupapatteḥ, karmaṇaḥ svāsanasyāpunaraṅkuravinaṣṭatvācca | caturthaṃ pratikṣipati - na ca paramarupuṣaḥ iti | jñānino'tyarthapriyatvahetukasya nāvartayāmīti saṅkaplasya asatyatva prasaṅgācca na bhagavadicchayā nivṛttiśaṅketyarthaḥ || iti sarvaṃ samañjasam | sarva śabdena bhedaśrutyabhedaśrutighaṭakaśrutirūpaguṇādi vidhiniṣedhakavākyapratyakṣādipramāṇānudāhṛtaśrutismṛtītihāsapurāṇavacanatadanugrāhakatarkajātaṃ vivakṣitam | iti śabdaḥ akhilabhuvana ityādyuktāśeṣārthaparāmarśī | teṣāṃ sarveṣāmanayā diśā sāmañjasyaṃ draṣṭavyam | etadviruddhamāna tarkaparihāraśvoktayā diśā neyaḥ | mitagambhīre bhāṣye sarvaṃ garbhitamanusandheyam | tadavagāhamānaiḥ svapakṣasthāpanaparapakṣapratitakṣepau sukarau ityetadabhiprāyeṇa iti sarvaṃ samañjasam ityuktam || 22 || iti śrīharitakulatilakavāgvijayisūnunā śrīraṅgarājadivyājñālabdhavedavyāsāparanāmadheyena śrīmadvaradarājāryapādasevāsamadhigataśrībhagavadrāmānujaviracitaśārīrakamīmāṃsābhāṣyahṛdayena śrīsudarśanasūriṇā vilikhitāyāṃ śrutapradīpikāyāṃ caturthasyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ || samāptaścādhayāyaḥ | śāstraṃ ca samāptam || hariḥ o ||
